`src/audio/audio_mixer.cpp`:

```cpp
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX            // windows.h (pulled in by minimp3_ex.h) would turn std::min / std::max into macros
#endif
#include "audio/audio_mixer.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

#define MINIMP3_IMPLEMENTATION
#include "minimp3_ex.h"

// the decoder only needs the plain C parts; keep windows.h macros out of the code below
#ifdef min
#undef min
#endif
#ifdef max
#undef max
#endif

namespace ab {

namespace {

uint32_t U32(const uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24); }
uint16_t U16(const uint8_t* p) { return (uint16_t)(p[0] | (p[1] << 8)); }

bool EndsWith(const std::string& s, const char* suffix) {
    size_t n = std::strlen(suffix);
    if (s.size() < n) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (std::tolower((unsigned char)s[s.size() - n + i]) != suffix[i]) return false;
    return true;
}

// RIFF / WAVE with a "fmt " chunk (PCM, 8 or 16 bit) and a "data" chunk.
bool LoadWav(const std::vector<uint8_t>& f, AudioClip& out, std::string* error) {
    if (f.size() < 12 || std::memcmp(f.data(), "RIFF", 4) != 0 || std::memcmp(f.data() + 8, "WAVE", 4) != 0) {
        if (error) *error = "not a RIFF WAVE file";
        return false;
    }
    int format = 0, bits = 0;
    size_t pos = 12;
    while (pos + 8 <= f.size()) {
        uint32_t size = U32(&f[pos + 4]);
        const uint8_t* body = &f[pos + 8];
        size_t avail = std::min<size_t>(size, f.size() - pos - 8);
        if (!std::memcmp(&f[pos], "fmt ", 4) && avail >= 16) {
            format = U16(body);
            out.channels = U16(body + 2);
            out.rate = (int)U32(body + 4);
            bits = U16(body + 14);
        } else if (!std::memcmp(&f[pos], "data", 4)) {
            if (format != 1 || (bits != 8 && bits != 16) || out.channels < 1 || out.channels > 2) {
                if (error) *error = "WAV was not PCM (8 or 16 bit, mono or stereo)";
                return false;
            }
            if (bits == 16) {
                out.samples.resize(avail / 2);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < out.samples.size(); i++) out.samples[i] = (int16_t)U16(body + i * 2);
            } else {
                out.samples.resize(avail);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < avail; i++) out.samples[i] = (int16_t)((body[i] - 128) << 8);
            }
            return true;
        }
        pos += 8 + size + (size & 1);
    }
    if (error) *error = "WAV has no data chunk";
    return false;
}

}  // namespace

bool LoadAudioClip(const std::string& path, AudioClip& out, std::string* error) {
    std::ifstream file(path.c_str(), std::ios::binary);
    if (!file) { if (error) *error = "cannot open " + path; return false; }
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    if (EndsWith(path, ".mp3")) {
        mp3dec_t dec;
        mp3dec_file_info_t info;
        std::memset(&info, 0, sizeof(info));
        if (mp3dec_load_buf(&dec, bytes.data(), bytes.size(), &info, nullptr, nullptr) != 0 || !info.buffer || info.samples == 0) {
            if (error) *error = "cannot decode " + path;
            std::free(info.buffer);
            return false;
        }
        out.channels = info.channels;
        out.rate = info.hz;
        out.samples.assign(info.buffer, info.buffer + info.samples);
        std::free(info.buffer);
        return true;
    }
    if (!LoadWav(bytes, out, error)) {
        if (error) *error = path + ": " + *error;
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void AudioMixer::CreateOutput(int channels, int bits, int rate) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    channels_ = channels; bits_ = bits; rate_ = rate;
    created_ = true;
    wake_.notify_all();
}

AudioMixer::~AudioMixer() {
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); quit_ = true; }
    wake_.notify_all();
    if (preload_.joinable()) preload_.join();
}

void AudioMixer::AddClip(const std::string& name, const std::string& path) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    Entry e;
    e.path = path;
    clips_[name] = e;
    if (EndsWith(path, ".wav")) {                    // short sounds are decoded in the background (music is decoded when it is played)
        toLoad_.push_back(name);
        if (!preload_.joinable()) preload_ = std::thread(&AudioMixer::PreloadLoop, this);
        wake_.notify_one();
    }
}


// v2.2: a clip that was decoded elsewhere (the sound of a video): resampled to the output rate like any other clip
void AudioMixer::AddPcmClip(const std::string& name, int rate, int channels, const std::vector<int16_t>& samples) {
    if (channels < 1 || rate < 1) return;
    auto clip = std::make_shared<AudioClip>();
    clip->channels = channels; clip->rate = rate; clip->samples = samples;
    int target, outCh;
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); target = rate_; outCh = channels_; }
    if (outCh == 1 && channels == 2) {            // v3.0: the iPhone game mixes in mono (createAudioOutput(1, 16, 16000)): a stereo clip is mixed down, or it plays at half speed
        std::vector<int16_t> mono(samples.size() / 2);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < mono.size(); i++) mono[i] = (int16_t)(((int)samples[i * 2] + (int)samples[i * 2 + 1]) / 2);
        clip->samples.swap(mono); clip->channels = 1;
        return AddPcmClip(name, rate, 1, clip->samples);
    }
    if (rate != target) {
        size_t inFrames = samples.size() / channels, outFrames = (size_t)((double)inFrames * target / rate);
        std::vector<int16_t> r(outFrames * channels);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < outFrames && inFrames > 0; i++) {
            double src = (double)i * rate / target;
            size_t a = (size_t)src, b = std::min(a + 1, inFrames - 1);
            float t = (float)(src - a);
            for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) r[i * channels + c] = (int16_t)(samples[a * channels + c] * (1 - t) + samples[b * channels + c] * t);
        }
        clip->samples.swap(r); clip->rate = target;
    }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    Entry e;
    e.clip = clip;
    clips_[name] = e;
}

void AudioMixer::PreloadLoop() {
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> l(m_);
    for (;;) {
        wake_.wait(l, [this] { return quit_ || (created_ && !toLoad_.empty()); });
        if (quit_) return;
        std::string name = toLoad_.front();
        toLoad_.pop_front();
        auto it = clips_.find(name);
        if (it == clips_.end() || it->second.clip || it->second.failed) continue;
        std::string path = it->second.path, error;
        int rate = rate_;
        l.unlock();
        std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> clip = Decode(path, rate, &error);       // the slow part runs without the lock
        l.lock();
        it = clips_.find(name);
        if (it == clips_.end() || it->second.clip || it->second.path != path) continue;
        if (clip) it->second.clip = clip;
        else { it->second.failed = true; lastError_ = error; }
    }
}

std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> AudioMixer::Decode(const std::string& path, int rate, std::string* error) {
    auto clip = std::make_shared<AudioClip>();
    if (!LoadAudioClip(path, *clip, error)) return nullptr;
    // The exe plays a clip as it is. A clip whose rate differs from the output's is resampled here (linear).
    if (clip->rate != rate && clip->rate > 0) {
        int ch = clip->channels;
        size_t inFrames = clip->samples.size() / ch;
        size_t outFrames = (size_t)((double)inFrames * rate / clip->rate);
        std::vector<int16_t> r(outFrames * ch);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < outFrames; i++) {
            double src = (double)i * clip->rate / rate;
            size_t a = (size_t)src, b = std::min(a + 1, inFrames - 1);
            float t = (float)(src - a);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++)
                r[i * ch + c] = (int16_t)(clip->samples[a * ch + c] * (1 - t) + clip->samples[b * ch + c] * t);
        }
        clip->samples.swap(r);
        clip->rate = rate;
    }
    return clip;
}

std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> AudioMixer::ClipFor(Entry& e) {
    if (e.clip || e.failed) return e.clip;
    std::string error;
    std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> clip = Decode(e.path, rate_, &error);
    if (!clip) { e.failed = true; lastError_ = error; return nullptr; }
    e.clip = clip;
    return clip;
}

int AudioMixer::VoicesOnTrack(int track) const {
    int n = 0;
    for (const Voice& v : active_) if (v.track == track && !v.stopped) n++;
    for (const Voice& v : waiting_) if (v.track == track && !v.stopped) n++;
    return n;
}

int AudioMixer::Play(const std::string& name, float volume, bool loop, int track) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    playsAsked++;
    if (!started_ || track < 0 || track >= kAudioTracks) { playsRefused++; return -1; }
    auto it = clips_.find(name);
    if (it == clips_.end()) { playsRefused++; return -1; }      // the exe ignores a name that was never registered
    if (trackLimit_[track] >= 0 && VoicesOnTrack(track) >= trackLimit_[track]) return -1;
    std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> clip = ClipFor(it->second);
    if (!clip) { playsRefused++; return -1; }
    Voice v;
    v.clip = clip; v.name = name; v.volume = volume; v.loop = loop; v.track = track;
    v.id = nextId_++;
    auto fx = fx_.find(name);
    if (fx != fx_.end()) { v.pitch = fx->second.pitch; v.tempo = fx->second.tempo; v.pan = fx->second.pan; }
    waiting_.push_back(v);
    return v.id;
}

void AudioMixer::Stop(const std::string& name) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    for (Voice& v : active_) if (v.name == name) v.stopped = true;
    for (Voice& v : waiting_) if (v.name == name) v.stopped = true;
}

void AudioMixer::StopAll() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    for (Voice& v : active_) v.stopped = true;
    for (Voice& v : waiting_) v.stopped = true;
}

bool AudioMixer::IsActive(const std::string& name) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    for (const Voice& v : active_) if (v.name == name && !v.stopped) return true;
    for (const Voice& v : waiting_) if (v.name == name && !v.stopped) return true;
    return false;
}

void AudioMixer::SetTrackVolume(float volume, int track) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    if (track < 0 || track >= kAudioTracks) return;
    trackVolume_[track] = std::min(1.0f, std::max(0.0f, volume));
}


// ---- v2.2 playback controls
void AudioMixer::SetSpeed(float speed, int track) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    speed = std::min(8.0f, std::max(0.05f, speed));
    if (track < 0) masterSpeed_ = speed;
    else if (track < kAudioTracks) trackSpeed_[track] = speed;
}
float AudioMixer::Speed(int track) const {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    return track < 0 ? masterSpeed_ : track < kAudioTracks ? trackSpeed_[track] : 1.0f;
}
void AudioMixer::Pause(bool paused, int track) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    if (track < 0) paused_ = paused;
    else if (track < kAudioTracks) trackPaused_[track] = paused;
}
bool AudioMixer::Paused(int track) const {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    return track < 0 ? paused_ : track < kAudioTracks ? trackPaused_[track] : false;
}
void AudioMixer::SetMasterVolume(float v) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    masterVolume_ = std::min(4.0f, std::max(0.0f, v));
}
void AudioMixer::SetClipVolume(const std::string& name, float volume) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    for (Voice& v : active_) if (v.name == name) v.volume = volume;
    for (Voice& v : waiting_) if (v.name == name) v.volume = volume;
}
void AudioMixer::SetClipSpeed(const std::string& name, float speed) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    speed = std::min(8.0f, std::max(0.05f, speed));
    for (Voice& v : active_) if (v.name == name) v.speed = speed;
    for (Voice& v : waiting_) if (v.name == name) v.speed = speed;
}

template <class F> void AudioMixer::EachVoice(const std::string& name, F f) {
    for (Voice& v : active_) if (v.name == name) f(v);
    for (Voice& v : waiting_) if (v.name == name) f(v);
}
void AudioMixer::SetClipPitch(const std::string& name, float p) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    p = std::min(8.0f, std::max(0.05f, p));
    fx_[name].pitch = p; EachVoice(name, [&](Voice& v) { v.pitch = p; });
}
void AudioMixer::SetClipTempo(const std::string& name, float t) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    t = std::min(8.0f, std::max(0.05f, t));
    fx_[name].tempo = t; EachVoice(name, [&](Voice& v) { v.tempo = t; });
}
void AudioMixer::SetClipPan(const std::string& name, float p) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    p = std::min(1.0f, std::max(-1.0f, p));
    fx_[name].pan = p; EachVoice(name, [&](Voice& v) { v.pan = p; });
}
void AudioMixer::ResetClipEffects(const std::string& name) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    fx_.erase(name); EachVoice(name, [&](Voice& v) { v.pitch = 1; v.tempo = 1; v.pan = 0; });
}
bool AudioMixer::SeekClip(const std::string& name, double seconds) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    bool any = false;
    EachVoice(name, [&](Voice& v) {
        double frame = std::max(0.0, seconds * v.clip->rate);
        int cc = std::max(1, v.clip->channels);
        size_t frames = v.clip->samples.size() / cc;
        if (frame >= (double)frames) frame = frames ? (double)frames - 1 : 0;
        v.pos = (size_t)frame * cc; v.frac = 0; v.posD = v.base = frame; v.outCount = 0; any = true;
    });
    return any;
}
double AudioMixer::ClipTime(const std::string& name) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    double t = -1;
    EachVoice(name, [&](Voice& v) {
        if (t >= 0) return;
        int cc = std::max(1, v.clip->channels);
        double frame = v.inFx ? (v.lastTf != 0 ? v.base + (double)v.outCount * v.lastTf : v.posD) : (double)(v.pos / cc) + v.frac;
        t = frame / std::max(1, v.clip->rate);
    });
    return t;
}
double AudioMixer::ClipLength(const std::string& name) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    double t = -1;
    EachVoice(name, [&](Voice& v) { if (t < 0) t = (double)(v.clip->samples.size() / std::max(1, v.clip->channels)) / std::max(1, v.clip->rate); });
    if (t >= 0) return t;
    auto it = clips_.find(name);
    if (it != clips_.end() && it->second.clip) return (double)(it->second.clip->samples.size() / std::max(1, it->second.clip->channels)) / std::max(1, it->second.clip->rate);
    return -1;
}


// v2.4: the voice with a pitch, tempo or pan set. Same pitch and tempo: plain resampling. Different: two overlapping Hann grains (overlap-add), which
// changes the length without changing the pitch.
void AudioMixer::MixFx(Voice& v, int frames, float speed) {
    const int ch = channels_;
    const int cc = std::max(1, v.clip->channels);
    const std::vector<int16_t>& s = v.clip->samples;
    const long long clipFrames = (long long)(s.size() / cc);
    if (clipFrames == 0) { v.stopped = true; return; }
    if (!v.inFx) { v.posD = (double)(v.pos / cc) + v.frac; v.base = v.posD; v.outCount = 0; v.inFx = true; }
    const double pf = speed * v.pitch, tf = speed * v.tempo;
    const bool stretch = std::fabs(pf - tf) > 1e-4;
    const float gain = trackVolume_[v.track] * v.volume * masterVolume_;
    const float gl = v.pan > 0 ? 1.0f - v.pan : 1.0f, gr = v.pan < 0 ? 1.0f + v.pan : 1.0f;
    auto at = [&](double p, int c) -> float {
        if (p < 0) return 0;
        if (v.loop) p = std::fmod(p, (double)clipFrames);
        long long i0 = (long long)p;
        if (i0 >= clipFrames) return 0;
        long long i1 = i0 + 1; if (i1 >= clipFrames) i1 = v.loop ? 0 : i0;
        float t = (float)(p - (double)i0);
        float a = s[(size_t)i0 * cc + (cc == 1 ? 0 : c)], b = s[(size_t)i1 * cc + (cc == 1 ? 0 : c)];
        return a + (b - a) * t;
    };
    const int N = 2048, H = 1024;
    v.lastTf = stretch ? tf : 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
        double anchor = stretch ? v.base + (double)v.outCount * tf : v.posD;
        if (!v.loop && anchor >= (double)clipFrames) { v.stopped = true; break; }
        for (int k = 0; k < ch; k++) {
            int c = ch == 1 ? 0 : k;
            float val;
            if (!stretch) val = at(v.posD, c);
            else {
                long long g = (long long)(v.outCount / (unsigned long long)H);
                val = 0;
                for (long long gi = g - 1; gi <= g; gi++) {
                    long long j = (long long)v.outCount - gi * H;
                    float w = std::sin(3.14159265f * ((float)j + 0.5f) / (float)N); w *= w;
                    val += w * at(v.base + (double)(gi * H) * tf + (double)j * pf, c);
                }
            }
            float side = ch == 2 ? (k == 0 ? gl : gr) : 1.0f;
            sum_[(size_t)i * ch + k] += (int)(val * gain * side);
        }
        v.outCount++;
        v.posD += pf;
        if (v.loop && v.posD >= (double)clipFrames) v.posD = std::fmod(v.posD, (double)clipFrames);
    }
}

void AudioMixer::Mix(int16_t* out, int frames) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_);
    int ch = channels_;
    size_t count = (size_t)frames * ch;
    sum_.assign(count, 0);
    // processTracks: the waiting voices join, stopped ones leave
    for (const Voice& v : waiting_) active_.push_back(v);
    waiting_.clear();
    active_.erase(std::remove_if(active_.begin(), active_.end(), [](const Voice& v) { return v.stopped; }), active_.end());

    for (Voice& v : active_) {
        int gain = (int)(trackVolume_[v.track] * v.volume * masterVolume_ * 4096.0);
        const std::vector<int16_t>& s = v.clip->samples;
        float speed = masterSpeed_ * trackSpeed_[v.track] * v.speed;
        bool paused = paused_ || trackPaused_[v.track];
        if (paused) continue;
        if (v.pitch != 1.0f || v.tempo != 1.0f || v.pan != 0.0f) { MixFx(v, frames, speed); continue; }
        if (v.inFx) {      // the effects were reset: hand the position back to the plain paths
            int cc0 = std::max(1, v.clip->channels);
            double p = v.lastTf != 0 ? v.base + (double)v.outCount * v.lastTf : v.posD;
            v.pos = (size_t)p * cc0; v.frac = p - std::floor(p); v.inFx = false;
        }
        if (speed != 1.0f || v.frac != 0) {
            // v2.2: resampled voice (linear interpolation), one output frame at a time
            int cc = v.clip->channels;
            size_t clipFrames = cc > 0 ? s.size() / cc : 0;
            int g = (int)(trackVolume_[v.track] * v.volume * masterVolume_ * 4096.0);
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                size_t fi = cc > 0 ? v.pos / cc : 0;
                if (fi >= clipFrames) {
                    if (!v.loop || clipFrames == 0) { v.stopped = true; break; }
                    fi %= clipFrames; v.pos = fi * cc;
                }
                size_t ni = fi + 1 < clipFrames ? fi + 1 : (v.loop ? 0 : fi);
                float t = (float)v.frac;
                for (int k = 0; k < ch; k++) {
                    int c = cc == 1 ? 0 : k;
                    float a = (float)s[fi * cc + c], b = (float)s[ni * cc + c];
                    sum_[(size_t)i * ch + k] += (int)((a + (b - a) * t) * g) >> 12;
                }
                v.frac += speed;
                size_t adv = (size_t)v.frac;
                v.frac -= (double)adv;
                v.pos += adv * cc;
            }
            continue;
        }
        bool mono = ch == 2 && v.clip->channels == 1;
        size_t need = mono ? count / 2 : count;           // samples to read from the clip
        size_t got = 0;
        size_t outPos = 0;
        while (got < need) {
            size_t left = s.size() - v.pos;
            if (left == 0) {
                if (!v.loop) { v.stopped = true; break; }       // read nothing: the voice ends
                v.pos = 0;
                if (s.empty()) break;
                continue;
            }
            size_t n = std::min(left, need - got);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int x = (s[v.pos + i] * gain) >> 12;
                if (mono) { sum_[outPos++] += x; sum_[outPos++] += x; }
                else sum_[outPos++] += x;
            }
            v.pos += n; got += n;
            if (!v.loop) break;                                  // a one-shot reads once per block
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) out[i] = (int16_t)std::min(32767, std::max(-32768, sum_[i]));
}

void AudioMixer::MixStereo(int16_t* out, int frames, int outRate) {
    int ch = channels_, rate = rate_;
    if (ch == 2 && rate == outRate) { Mix(out, frames); return; }
    if (ch != feedCh_ || rate != feedRate_) { feed_.assign((size_t)ch, 0.0f); feedPos_ = 1; feedCh_ = ch; feedRate_ = rate; }
    double step = (double)rate / outRate;
    for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
        // the four source frames around the position: floor(pos) - 1 .. floor(pos) + 2
        size_t base = (size_t)feedPos_;
        while ((base + 3) * ch >= feed_.size()) {
            int16_t block[512];
            int n = 512 / ch;
            Mix(block, n);
            for (int k = 0; k < n * ch; k++) feed_.push_back(block[k] / 32768.0f);
        }
        float t = (float)(feedPos_ - base);
        for (int side = 0; side < 2; side++) {
            int c = ch == 2 ? side : 0;
            float p0 = feed_[(base - 1) * ch + c], p1 = feed_[base * ch + c], p2 = feed_[(base + 1) * ch + c], p3 = feed_[(base + 2) * ch + c];
            float v = p1 + 0.5f * t * (p2 - p0 + t * (2 * p0 - 5 * p1 + 4 * p2 - p3 + t * (3 * (p1 - p2) + p3 - p0)));   // Catmull-Rom
            out[i * 2 + side] = (int16_t)(std::min(1.0f, std::max(-1.0f, v)) * 32767.0f);
        }
        feedPos_ += step;
    }
    size_t drop = (size_t)feedPos_ - 1;                  // keep one frame before the position
    if (drop > 0) { feed_.erase(feed_.begin(), feed_.begin() + (std::ptrdiff_t)(drop * ch)); feedPos_ -= (double)drop; }
}

}  // namespace ab

```

`src/audio/audio_mixer.h`:

```h
// The exe's audio mixer (audio::AudioMixer, source\audio\AudioMixer.cpp), without DirectSound.
//
// The original mixes in software and hands the result to a DirectSound streaming buffer; this class
// is the same mixer, and whoever owns the sound device (the window layer, through SDL) calls Mix()
// to fetch the next block. What was read from the exe:
//   play        0x4ebba0   (clip, volume, loop, track) -> voice id, or -1 when the output is not started,
//                          the track is above 8, or the track already has `limit` voices (default -1 = none).
//                          The id counter (+0x80) starts at 0. The voice waits in a second list until the next mix.
//   mix16       0x4eb3c0   voices from the waiting list join the active list and stopped ones are dropped; for each
//                          voice gain = ftol(trackVolume[track] * volume * 4096), every sample is added as
//                          (sample * gain) >> 12, a mono clip goes to both channels, the sum is clamped to 16 bits.
//   readFully   0x4ec010   a looping voice restarts at its beginning until the block is full; a voice that
//                          reads 0 bytes without looping is marked stopped (so it lives one block longer than its data).
//   track volume 0x4eb770  0..8, clamped to 0..1, default 1.     track limit 0x4eb880 (default -1)
//   isActive    0x4ea670   any voice of the clip that is not stopped (active or waiting).
//   stop        0x4ea7f0   marks that clip's voices stopped; stopAll 0x4ea8d0 marks all.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace ab {

constexpr int kAudioTracks = 9;

struct AudioClip {
    int channels = 0;
    int rate = 0;
    std::vector<int16_t> samples;     // interleaved
};

// WAV (PCM) or MP3, decided by the extension. The clip is converted to 16 bit; false with a message on failure.
bool LoadAudioClip(const std::string& path, AudioClip& out, std::string* error);

class AudioMixer {
public:
    // createAudioOutput(channels, bits, rate): the scripts always ask for 2, 16, 44100
    AudioMixer() = default;
    ~AudioMixer();
    void CreateOutput(int channels, int bits, int rate);
    void Start() { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); started_ = true; }      // +0x84
    void Stop() { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); started_ = false; }
    bool Created() const { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); return created_; }
    bool Started() const { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); return started_; }
    int Rate() const { return rate_; }
    int Channels() const { return channels_; }
    // Stereo at outRate for the sound device. The mixer itself runs at the rate and channel count the scripts
    // asked for with createAudioOutput (Seasons: mono, 16000 Hz); this converts with cubic interpolation.
    void MixStereo(int16_t* out, int frames, int outRate);

    // The clip is read from disk the first time it is played (the scripts register several hundred).
    void AddClip(const std::string& name, const std::string& path);
    void AddPcmClip(const std::string& name, int rate, int channels, const std::vector<int16_t>& samples);   // v2.2: a clip decoded elsewhere
    int Play(const std::string& name, float volume, bool loop, int track);
    void Stop(const std::string& name);
    void StopAll();
    bool IsActive(const std::string& name);
    void SetTrackVolume(float volume, int track);
    float TrackVolume(int track) const { return track >= 0 && track < kAudioTracks ? trackVolume_[track] : 0; }

    // ---- v2.2: playback controls the original did not have. Speed 1 is the retail mix; any other speed resamples (pitch follows speed, like a tape).
    // track -1 means everything. Paused voices keep their place.
    void SetSpeed(float speed, int track = -1);
    float Speed(int track = -1) const;
    void Pause(bool paused, int track = -1);
    bool Paused(int track = -1) const;
    void SetMasterVolume(float v);
    float MasterVolume() const { return masterVolume_; }
    void SetClipVolume(const std::string& name, float volume);     // the voices of that clip playing now
    void SetClipSpeed(const std::string& name, float speed);
    // v2.4: pitch (speed and pitch together, like a record), tempo (speed alone, pitch unchanged), pan (-1 left .. 1 right), seek and tell. They apply to the voices
    // of that clip playing now and to every play of it afterwards (until ResetClipEffects), so they can be set before the clip is played.
    void SetClipPitch(const std::string& name, float pitch);
    void SetClipTempo(const std::string& name, float tempo);
    void SetClipPan(const std::string& name, float pan);
    void ResetClipEffects(const std::string& name);
    bool SeekClip(const std::string& name, double seconds);
    double ClipTime(const std::string& name);       // seconds into the oldest voice of that clip, -1 if none plays
    double ClipLength(const std::string& name);     // seconds, -1 if the clip is unknown or not decoded yet

    // Fills `frames` frames of interleaved 16 bit samples (silence when nothing plays).
    void Mix(int16_t* out, int frames);

    // The message of the last clip that could not be loaded (and cleared); empty when there is none.
    std::string TakeError() { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(m_); std::string e; e.swap(lastError_); return e; }
    // Counts for the diagnostics: plays asked for, plays refused, voices mixed in the last block.
    int playsAsked = 0, playsRefused = 0;

private:
    struct Entry { std::string path; std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> clip; bool failed = false; };
    struct Voice {
        std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> clip;
        std::string name;
        size_t pos = 0;            // in samples
        double frac = 0;           // v2.2: the part of a frame already passed when the speed is not 1
        float speed = 1;           // v2.2: setAudioClipSpeed
        float volume = 1;
        int id = 0, track = 0;
        bool loop = false, stopped = false;
        float pitch = 1, tempo = 1, pan = 0;     // v2.4
        bool inFx = false;                       // the position lives in posD while the effect path mixes the voice
        double posD = 0, base = 0, lastTf = 1;   // source frame; where the stretch started; tempo last mixed with
        unsigned long long outCount = 0;
    };
    struct ClipFx { float pitch = 1, tempo = 1, pan = 0; };
    std::map<std::string, ClipFx> fx_;
    template <class F> void EachVoice(const std::string& name, F f);
    void MixFx(Voice& v, int frames, float speed);
    std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> ClipFor(Entry& e);
    std::shared_ptr<AudioClip> Decode(const std::string& path, int rate, std::string* error);
    void PreloadLoop();                  // decodes the WAV clips in the background so that the first play does not stall the frame
    std::thread preload_;
    std::condition_variable wake_;
    std::deque<std::string> toLoad_;
    bool quit_ = false;
    int VoicesOnTrack(int track) const;

    std::string lastError_;
    mutable std::mutex m_;
    int channels_ = 2, bits_ = 16, rate_ = 44100;
    bool started_ = false, created_ = false;
    int nextId_ = 0;
    float trackVolume_[kAudioTracks] = {1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1};
    float trackSpeed_[kAudioTracks] = {1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1};
    bool trackPaused_[kAudioTracks] = {false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false};
    float masterSpeed_ = 1, masterVolume_ = 1;
    bool paused_ = false;
    int trackLimit_[kAudioTracks] = {-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1};
    std::map<std::string, Entry> clips_;
    std::vector<Voice> active_, waiting_;
    std::vector<int> sum_;
    std::vector<float> feed_;            // MixStereo: mixed frames not yet used (interleaved, channels_ wide)
    double feedPos_ = 1;
    int feedCh_ = 0, feedRate_ = 0;
};

}  // namespace ab
```

`src/engine/apk_extract.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "engine/apk_extract.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#define AB_MKDIR(p) _mkdir(p)
#else
#include <sys/stat.h>
#define AB_MKDIR(p) mkdir(p, 0755)
#endif

namespace ab {
namespace {

struct Entry { std::string name; uint32_t method, csize, usize, localOffset; };

uint32_t U16(const uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8); }
uint32_t U32(const uint8_t* p) { return p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24); }

bool ReadAll(const std::string& path, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) return false;
    uint8_t buf[65536];
    size_t n;
    while ((n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f)) > 0) out.insert(out.end(), buf, buf + n);
    std::fclose(f);
    return true;
}

void MakeDirs(const std::string& path) {          // every folder of a file path (the last part is the file name)
    for (size_t i = 1; i < path.size(); i++)
        if (path[i] == '/' || path[i] == '\\') AB_MKDIR(path.substr(0, i).c_str());
}

bool WriteFile(const std::string& path, const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes) {
    MakeDirs(path);
    FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!f) return false;
    bool ok = bytes.empty() || std::fwrite(bytes.data(), 1, bytes.size(), f) == bytes.size();
    std::fclose(f);
    return ok;
}

bool ListZip(const std::vector<uint8_t>& z, std::vector<Entry>& out) {
    if (z.size() < 22) return false;
    size_t eocd = std::string::npos;
    for (size_t i = z.size() - 22; ; i--) {
        if (U32(&z[i]) == 0x06054b50) { eocd = i; break; }
        if (i == 0 || z.size() - i > 70000) break;
    }
    if (eocd == std::string::npos) return false;
    uint32_t count = U16(&z[eocd + 10]), at = U32(&z[eocd + 16]);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < count; k++) {
        if ((size_t)at + 46 > z.size() || U32(&z[at]) != 0x02014b50) return false;
        Entry e;
        e.method = U16(&z[at + 10]); e.csize = U32(&z[at + 20]); e.usize = U32(&z[at + 24]); e.localOffset = U32(&z[at + 42]);
        uint32_t nl = U16(&z[at + 28]), xl = U16(&z[at + 30]), cl = U16(&z[at + 32]);
        if ((size_t)at + 46 + nl > z.size()) return false;
        e.name.assign((const char*)&z[at + 46], nl);
        out.push_back(e);
        at += 46 + nl + xl + cl;
    }
    return true;
}

bool Unpack(const std::vector<uint8_t>& z, const Entry& e, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    if ((size_t)e.localOffset + 30 > z.size() || U32(&z[e.localOffset]) != 0x04034b50) return false;
    size_t start = e.localOffset + 30 + U16(&z[e.localOffset + 26]) + U16(&z[e.localOffset + 28]);
    if (start + e.csize > z.size()) return false;
    out.clear();
    if (e.method == 0) { out.assign(&z[start], &z[start] + e.csize); return true; }
    if (e.method == 8) return Inflate(&z[start], e.csize, out);
    return false;
}

bool EndsWith(const std::string& s, const char* t) {
    size_t n = std::strlen(t);
    return s.size() >= n && s.compare(s.size() - n, n, t) == 0;
}

}  // namespace

bool ExtractApk(const std::string& apkPath, const std::string& outDir, std::string* error) {
    const std::string marker = outDir + "/.extracted5";   // 5: an .ipa whose data folder holds scripts_common (Friends, Seasons 4.1.0) is unpacked again (older builds took the wrong folder); 4: music kept as .mp3.zip is unpacked; 3: the .ipa data folder is chosen (data_iphone first) and config.lua rebuilt
    { std::vector<uint8_t> m; if (ReadAll(marker, m)) return true; }
    std::vector<uint8_t> zip;
    if (!ReadAll(apkPath, zip)) { if (error) *error = "cannot open " + apkPath; return false; }
    std::vector<Entry> entries;
    if (!ListZip(zip, entries)) { if (error) *error = apkPath + " is not a readable zip (.apk) file"; return false; }
    // an Android .apk keeps the data in assets/data; an iOS .ipa in Payload/<name>.app/data_iphone (or data_ipad)
    std::string prefix = "assets/data/";
    std::string firstData;
    for (const Entry& e : entries) {
        if (e.name.compare(0, 8, "Payload/") != 0) continue;
        size_t app = e.name.find(".app/", 8);
        if (app == std::string::npos) continue;
        size_t d = app + 5;
        if (e.name.compare(d, 5, "data_") != 0) continue;
        size_t slash = e.name.find('/', d);
        if (slash == std::string::npos) continue;
        std::string p = e.name.substr(0, slash + 1);
        if (e.name.compare(d, 11, "data_iphone") == 0) { prefix = p; firstData.clear(); break; }   // the phone data is what the engine runs (480x320)
        if (firstData.empty()) firstData = p;
    }
    if (!firstData.empty()) prefix = firstData;
    if (firstData.empty() && prefix == "assets/data/") {     // v3.1: an .ipa whose data folder is plain "data" and has scripts_common (Friends, Stella): that data folder is the data
        const std::string sc = "/data/scripts_common/gamelogic.lua";
        for (const Entry& e : entries)
            if (e.name.compare(0, 8, "Payload/") == 0 && e.name.size() > sc.size() && e.name.compare(e.name.size() - sc.size(), sc.size(), sc) == 0) { prefix = e.name.substr(0, e.name.size() - sc.size()) + "/data/"; break; }
    }
    if (firstData.empty() && prefix == "assets/data/") {     // an .ipa without a data_* folder (the first Angry Birds): the folder that holds scripts/gamelogic.lua is the data
        std::string tail = "scripts/gamelogic.lua";
        bool flat = false;
        for (const Entry& e : entries) if (e.name.compare(0, 8, "Payload/") == 0 && e.name.size() > 14 && e.name.compare(e.name.size() - 14, 14, "/gamelogic.lua") == 0 && e.name.find("/scripts/") == std::string::npos) flat = true;   // the first Angry Birds: everything flat in data/
        if (flat && std::none_of(entries.begin(), entries.end(), [](const Entry& e) { return e.name.find("/scripts/gamelogic.lua") != std::string::npos; })) tail = "gamelogic.lua";
        for (const Entry& e : entries) {
            if (e.name.compare(0, 8, "Payload/") != 0 || e.name.size() <= tail.size() || e.name.compare(e.name.size() - tail.size(), tail.size(), tail) != 0) continue;
            prefix = e.name.substr(0, e.name.size() - tail.size());
            break;
        }
    }
    if (prefix != "assets/data/") std::remove((outDir + "/config.lua").c_str());   // an .ipa: the generated config follows the data folder found now
    if (prefix.find("/data_ipad/") != std::string::npos) WriteFile(outDir + "/data_ipad.txt", std::vector<uint8_t>{'1'});   // v3.1: the iPad data (Angry Birds HD): its pictures are made for 1024x768
    int files = 0;
    for (const Entry& e : entries) {
        if (e.name.compare(0, prefix.size(), prefix) != 0 || e.name.back() == '/') continue;
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
        if (!Unpack(zip, e, bytes)) { if (error) *error = "cannot unpack " + e.name; return false; }
        std::string rel = "data/" + e.name.substr(prefix.size());
        if (EndsWith(rel, ".mp3.zip")) {                          // music kept in its own zip (Rio 1.4.2 title music): the mp3 inside is what the game opens
            std::vector<Entry> inner;
            if (ListZip(bytes, inner) && !inner.empty()) {
                std::vector<uint8_t> mp3;
                if (Unpack(bytes, inner[0], mp3) && WriteFile(outDir + "/" + rel.substr(0, rel.size() - 4), mp3)) { files++; continue; }
            }
        }
        if (EndsWith(rel, ".pvr.zip")) {                          // a texture kept in its own zip: the .pvr inside is what the game opens
            std::vector<Entry> inner;
            if (ListZip(bytes, inner) && !inner.empty()) {
                std::vector<uint8_t> pvr;
                if (Unpack(bytes, inner[0], pvr)) {
                    if (WriteFile(outDir + "/" + rel.substr(0, rel.size() - 4), pvr)) files++;
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!WriteFile(outDir + "/" + rel, bytes)) { if (error) *error = "cannot write " + outDir + "/" + rel; return false; }
        files++;
    }
    if (files == 0) {
        bool ipaApp = false;
        for (const Entry& e : entries) if (e.name.compare(0, 8, "Payload/") == 0 && e.name.find(".app/data/") != std::string::npos) { ipaApp = true; break; }
        if (error) *error = ipaApp ? apkPath + " keeps its textures, sounds and Level*.lua files in data/ but has no scripts/gamelogic.lua: the game logic of this early version (Angry Birds 1.0) is in the app's own native program, not in Lua, so this engine has nothing to run it with."
                                   : apkPath + " has no assets/data (.apk) or Payload/*.app/data_* (.ipa) folder (not an Angry Birds app?)";
        return false;
    }
    std::string note = "extracted from " + apkPath + "\n";
    WriteFile(marker, std::vector<uint8_t>(note.begin(), note.end()));
    return true;
}

}  // namespace ab
```

```h
// Opening an Android .apk: an .apk is a zip file, the game's data is in assets/data. The data is unpacked once into a cache folder
// (the engine's own data layout, so the normal start-up runs on it); the textures the game keeps as .pvr.zip inside it are unpacked too.
```

`src/engine/font.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstdio>
#include "engine/font.h"
#include <cstring>

namespace ab {

namespace {

struct Reader {
    const std::vector<uint8_t>& b;
    size_t pos = 0;
    bool ok = true;
    explicit Reader(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes) : b(bytes) {}
    uint32_t U16() {
        if (pos + 2 > b.size()) { ok = false; return 0; }
        uint32_t v = (b[pos] << 8) | b[pos + 1];
        pos += 2;
        return v;
    }
    uint32_t U32() { uint32_t hi = U16(); return (hi << 16) | U16(); }
    int S16() { uint32_t v = U16(); return v >= 0x8000 ? (int)v - 0x10000 : (int)v; }
    std::string Bytes(size_t n) {
        if (pos + n > b.size()) { ok = false; return std::string(); }
        std::string s((const char*)&b[pos], n);
        pos += n;
        return s;
    }
};

bool Fail(std::string* error, const char* why) {
    if (error) *error = why;
    return false;
}

}  // namespace

std::vector<uint32_t> DecodeUtf8(const std::string& s) {
    std::vector<uint32_t> out;
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < s.size()) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)s[i];
        int extra = c < 0x80 ? 0 : (c >> 5) == 6 ? 1 : (c >> 4) == 14 ? 2 : (c >> 3) == 30 ? 3 : -1;
        if (extra < 0 || i + extra >= s.size() + (extra == 0 ? 1 : 0)) {
            out.push_back(0xFFFD);
            i++;
            continue;
        }
        uint32_t cp = extra == 0 ? c : (c & (0x3F >> extra));
        for (int k = 1; k <= extra; k++) cp = (cp << 6) | ((unsigned char)s[i + k] & 0x3F);
        out.push_back(cp);
        i += extra + 1;
    }
    return out;
}

float BitmapFont::StringWidth(const std::string& utf8) const {
    std::vector<uint32_t> chars = DecodeUtf8(utf8);
    int sum = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < chars.size(); i++) {
        auto it = glyphs.find(chars[i]);
        if (it != glyphs.end()) sum += it->second.w;
    }
    return (float)(((int)chars.size() - 1) * tracking + sum);
}

bool ParseBitmapFont(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, BitmapFont& out, std::string* error) {
    Reader r(bytes);
    // Angry Birds 1.0 (iPhone) keeps its fonts without the KA3D header: the file starts at the image name's length
    const bool headerless = bytes.size() > 6 && !(bytes[0] == 'K' && bytes[1] == 'A') && bytes[0] == 0 && bytes[1] > 4 && bytes.size() >= (size_t)(2 + bytes[1]) && bytes[2 + bytes[1] - 4] == '.';
    if (std::getenv("AB_FONT_DEBUG")) std::printf("font headerless=%d size=%zu b0=%d b1=%d\n", (int)headerless, bytes.size(), bytes.empty() ? -1 : bytes[0], bytes.size() > 1 ? bytes[1] : -1);
    if (!headerless) {
        if (r.Bytes(4) != "KA3D") return Fail(error, "not a KA3D file");
        r.U32();
        if (r.Bytes(4) != "FONT") return Fail(error, "not a font");
        r.U32();
        unsigned images = r.U16();
        if (images != 1) return Fail(error, "font with other than one image");
    }
    out.image = r.Bytes(r.U16());
    out.leading = r.S16();
    out.tracking = r.S16();
    unsigned count = r.U16();
    out.glyphs.clear();
    out.maxAscent = out.maxDescent = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < count && r.ok; i++) {
        uint32_t code = r.U16();
        Sprite s;
        s.x = r.S16(); s.y = r.S16(); s.w = r.S16(); s.h = r.S16();
        int ascent = r.S16();
        s.pivotX = 0;
        s.pivotY = ascent;
        if (ascent > out.maxAscent) out.maxAscent = ascent;
        if (s.h - ascent > out.maxDescent) out.maxDescent = s.h - ascent;
        out.glyphs[code] = s;
    }
    if (r.ok && out.glyphs.size() > 300) {
        // v3.1: the international fonts (500+ glyphs: Angry Birds HD, 1.3.5, 2.0.0, 3.3.0) carry accented capitals and hooked letters that reach far
        // above and below the text, which made getFontHeight (and the gap between two lines placed with it, such as Highscore and Score) too big:
        // their height comes from the basic Latin letters
        int a = 0, d = 0;
        for (const auto& g : out.glyphs) if (g.first < 128) { a = std::max(a, g.second.pivotY); d = std::max(d, g.second.h - g.second.pivotY); }
        if (a + d > 0) { out.maxAscent = a; out.maxDescent = d; }
    }
    return r.ok ? true : Fail(error, "font file is cut short");
}

// The Android builds (1.3.x) keep their texts in an older layout without the KA3D header: 5 bytes, the number of locales, the locale names
// (u16 length + text), the number of ids, the ids, then one u32 offset per locale (counted from the end of the first of them) and, at each
// offset, one u16-length string per id. The first locale (en_EN) is used.
static bool ParseLegacyTextGroup(const std::vector<uint8_t>& b, TextGroup& out) {
    auto u16 = [&](size_t at) { return at + 2 <= b.size() ? ((unsigned)b[at] << 8 | b[at + 1]) : 0u; };
    auto u32 = [&](size_t at) { return at + 4 <= b.size() ? ((uint32_t)b[at] << 24 | (uint32_t)b[at + 1] << 16 | (uint32_t)b[at + 2] << 8 | b[at + 3]) : 0u; };
    if (b.size() < 16) return false;
    size_t p = 6;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < b[5]; i++) { p += 2 + u16(p); if (p > b.size()) return false; }
    unsigned count = u16(p); p += 2;
    std::vector<std::string> ids;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        unsigned n = u16(p); p += 2;
        if (p + n > b.size()) return false;
        ids.push_back(std::string((const char*)&b[p], n)); p += n;
    }
    if (b[5] == 0) return false;
    size_t at = p + 4 + u32(p);
    out.strings.clear();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {
        unsigned n = u16(at); at += 2;
        if (at + n > b.size()) return false;
        out.strings[ids[i]] = std::string((const char*)&b[at], n); at += n;
    }
    return true;
}

bool ParseTextGroup(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, TextGroup& out, std::string* error) {
    if (bytes.size() > 16 && std::memcmp(bytes.data(), "KA3D", 4) != 0 && ParseLegacyTextGroup(bytes, out)) return true;
    Reader r(bytes);
    if (r.Bytes(4) != "KA3D") return Fail(error, "not a KA3D file");
    r.U32();
    if (r.Bytes(4) != "TEXT") return Fail(error, "not a text file");
    r.U32();
    r.U16();
    std::vector<std::string> ids;
    bool gotGroup = false;               // 2.0.0 has one TXGP per locale (en_EN first); the first is used
    out.strings.clear();
    while (r.ok && r.pos + 8 <= bytes.size()) {
        std::string tag = r.Bytes(4);
        uint32_t size = r.U32();
        size_t end = r.pos + size;
        if (tag == "LIDS") {
            unsigned n = r.U16();
            for (unsigned i = 0; i < n && r.ok; i++) ids.push_back(r.Bytes(r.U16()));
        } else if (tag == "TXGP" && !gotGroup) {
            gotGroup = true;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < ids.size() && r.ok && r.pos < end; i++) out.strings[ids[i]] = r.Bytes(r.U16());
        }
        r.pos = end;
    }
    return r.ok ? true : Fail(error, "text file is cut short");
}

}  // namespace ab
```

`src/engine/font.h`:

```h
// Bitmap fonts (.dat "KA3D"/"FONT", game::BitmapFont::load 0x43c2a0) and text groups (.dat "KA3D"/"TEXT").
//
// FONT file, big endian:
//   "KA3D" u32 length, "FONT" u32 chunk size, u16 imageCount (1) + name ("FONT_BASIC_IPAD.png", beside the .dat),
//   s16 leading (+0x40), s16 tracking (+0x34), u16 glyphCount, then per glyph six 16-bit values:
//   unicode code, x, y, w, h, ascent. Each glyph is a sprite with its pivot at (0, ascent).
//   The font keeps maxAscent = max(ascent) (+0x38) and maxDescent = max(h - ascent) (+0x3c).
// Width of a string (0x43d6e0): sum of the glyph widths + (characters - 1) * tracking; characters without
// a glyph add nothing to the sum. Drawing (0x43d260): the baseline is y + maxAscent (TOP), y + ascent -
// (maxAscent + maxDescent) / 2 (VCENTER) or y - maxDescent (BOTTOM); x is moved by -width / 2 (HCENTER) or
// -width (RIGHT); then every glyph is drawn with its pivot at the pen and the pen moves by w + tracking.
//
// TEXT file: "KA3D" u32 length, "TEXT" u32 chunk size, u16 1, chunks "LDAT" (locale names), "LIDS"
// (u16 count, then u16-length ids) and "TXGP" (one u16-length UTF-8 string per id).
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "engine/sprite_sheet.h"

namespace ab {

struct BitmapFont {
    std::string image, directory;
    int leading = 0, tracking = 0, maxAscent = 0, maxDescent = 0;
    std::map<uint32_t, Sprite> glyphs;      // keyed by code point; pivotY = ascent

    float StringWidth(const std::string& utf8) const;
};

bool ParseBitmapFont(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, BitmapFont& out, std::string* error);

// A text group: id -> string for the locale in the file.
struct TextGroup {
    std::map<std::string, std::string> strings;
};
bool ParseTextGroup(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, TextGroup& out, std::string* error);

// UTF-8 to code points (invalid bytes become U+FFFD).
std::vector<uint32_t> DecodeUtf8(const std::string& text);

}  // namespace ab

```

```cpp
class GamePlatform::Host : public LuaFrameHost {
public:
    Host(ScriptHost& scripts, GamePlatform& platform) : LuaFrameHost(scripts), platform_(platform) {
        objectNameOf = [this](int id) { return platform_.Physics().NameOf(id); };
        jointNameOf = [this](int index) { return platform_.Physics().JointName(index); };
    }
    void StepWorld(float dt, int velIter, int posIter) override {
        platform_.SyncTuning(velIter, posIter);
        EmitHook(platform_.scripts_->State(), "physicsStep", nullptr, nullptr, 1, dt);
        platform_.scripts_->ApplyForcesAtPhysicsStep();
        platform_.scripts_->PerStepForces();

        platform_.Physics().Step(dt, velIter, posIter);
        platform_.Physics().ApplySpeedCaps();
        EmitHook(platform_.scripts_->State(), "physicsStepEnd", nullptr, nullptr, 1, dt);
        static const char* dumpEvery = std::getenv("AB_BODYDUMP");   // debug: print every body each N steps
        static int step = 0;
        if (dumpEvery && step == 0) { float gx, gy; platform_.Physics().GetGravity(gx, gy); std::fprintf(stderr, "BG %g %g ver=%d\n", gx, gy, (int)platform_.Physics().Version()); }
        if (dumpEvery && step == 0) for (const auto& o : platform_.Physics().Objects()) { BodyInfo bi = platform_.Physics().Inspect(o->name); std::fprintf(stderr, "BI %s st=%d aw=%d m=%g ld=%g ad=%g r=%g\n", o->name.c_str(), (int)bi.isStatic, (int)bi.awake, bi.mass, bi.linearDamping, bi.angularDamping, bi.shapeRadius); }
        if (dumpEvery && step == 0) for (const auto& o : platform_.Physics().Objects()) if (o->pbody && o->pbody->IsStatic()) std::fprintf(stderr, "BS %s %.3f %.3f %.3f\n", o->name.c_str(), o->pbody->PosX(), o->pbody->PosY(), o->pbody->Angle());
        if (dumpEvery && ++step % std::atoi(dumpEvery) == 0) {
            for (const auto& o : platform_.Physics().Objects())
                if (o->pbody && !o->pbody->IsStatic())
                    std::fprintf(stderr, "BD %d %s %.3f %.3f %.3f%s\n", step, o->name.c_str(), o->pbody->PosX(), o->pbody->PosY(), o->pbody->Angle(), o->pbody->IsAwake() ? " A" : "");
        }
    }
    void ClearForces() override { platform_.Physics().ClearForces(); platform_.scripts_->ClearLuaForceFunctions(); }
    // Audio loops and the effects manager are not implemented yet.
    bool LoopActive(LoopSound) override { return false; }
    void StartLoop(LoopSound, float) override {}
    void SetLoopVolume(LoopSound, float) override {}
    void StopLoop(LoopSound) override {}
    void UpdateEffects(float) override {}

private:
    GamePlatform& platform_;
};

namespace {

// Pushes objects.world[name] (nil if there is none) and leaves it on the stack.
void PushWorldEntry(lua_State* L, const std::string& name) {
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    lua_getfield(L, -1, "objects");
    lua_remove(L, -2);
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "world");
        lua_remove(L, -2);
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, name.c_str());
            lua_remove(L, -2);
            return;
        }
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_pushnil(L);
}

bool GetNumber(lua_State* L, int table, const char* key, float& out) {
    lua_getfield(L, table, key);
    bool ok = lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER;
    if (ok) out = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return ok;
}

// A table of material -> number, such as blockTable.damageFactors.X.damageMultiplier
void ReadNumberMap(lua_State* L, int table, const char* key, std::map<std::string, float>& out) {
    lua_getfield(L, table, key);
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_pushnil(L);
        while (lua_next(L, -2) != 0) {
            if (lua_type(L, -2) == LUA_TSTRING && lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER)
                out[lua_tostring(L, -2)] = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
            lua_pop(L, 1);
        }
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
}

// Fills the Lua side of a ContactObject from its objects.world entry (at stack index `entry`).
void ReadContactFields(lua_State* L, int entry, ContactObject& c, DamageFactorSet& factors) {
    c.hasStrength = GetNumber(L, entry, "strength", c.strength);
    c.hasDefence = GetNumber(L, entry, "defence", c.defence);
    lua_getfield(L, entry, "material");
    if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING) c.material = lua_tostring(L, -1);
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    if (c.material.empty()) {   // v3.1: Angry Birds Friends (and the 3.x scripts it shares) name it materialName
        lua_getfield(L, entry, "materialName");
        if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING) c.material = lua_tostring(L, -1);
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_getfield(L, entry, "useLegacyCollisionPath");
    c.useLegacyCollisionPath = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0;
    lua_pop(L, 1);

    // objects.world[name].damageFactors names a set in blockTable.damageFactors (v3.1: a block without one uses its material's, blockTable.materials[m].damageFactors, as Friends' blocks do)
    lua_getfield(L, entry, "damageFactors");
    if (lua_isnil(L, -1) && !c.material.empty()) {
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "blockTable"); lua_remove(L, -2);
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, "materials"); lua_remove(L, -2); }
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, c.material.c_str()); lua_remove(L, -2); }
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, "damageFactors"); lua_remove(L, -2); }
        if (lua_type(L, -1) != LUA_TSTRING) { lua_pop(L, 1); lua_pushnil(L); }
    }
    if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING) {
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "blockTable");
        lua_remove(L, -2);
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "damageFactors");
            lua_remove(L, -2);
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                lua_pushvalue(L, -2);
                lua_gettable(L, -2);
                lua_remove(L, -2);
                if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                    ReadNumberMap(L, lua_gettop(L), "damageMultiplier", factors.damageMultiplier);
                    ReadNumberMap(L, lua_gettop(L), "velocityMultiplier", factors.velocityMultiplier);
                    c.damageFactors = &factors;
                }
            }
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
}

// scoreTable.blocks (nil when the script has none)

    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    lua_getfield(L, -1, "scoreTable");
    lua_remove(L, -2);
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "blocks");
        lua_remove(L, -2);
        return;
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_pushnil(L);
}


// ---- Angry Birds Star Wars contact helpers (0x42f9d0)
bool EntryString(lua_State* L, int entry, const char* key, std::string& out) {
    lua_getfield(L, entry, key);
    bool ok = lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING;
    if (ok) out = lua_tostring(L, -1);
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return ok;
}

// blockTable.damageFactors[entry.damageFactors][field][material], `def` when any step is missing
float DamageFactorOf(lua_State* L, int entry, const char* field, const std::string& material, float def) {
    int top = lua_gettop(L);
    float r = def;
    lua_getfield(L, entry, "damageFactors");
    if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING) {
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "blockTable");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "damageFactors");
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                lua_pushvalue(L, top + 1);
                lua_gettable(L, -2);
                if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                    lua_getfield(L, -1, field);
                    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                        lua_getfield(L, -1, material.c_str());
                        if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER) r = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return r;
}

// blockTable.blocks[entry.definition][key] as a string / number
bool BlockDefField(lua_State* L, int entry, const char* key, std::string* str, float* num) {
    int top = lua_gettop(L);
    bool ok = false;
    lua_getfield(L, entry, "definition");
    if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING) {
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "blockTable");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "blocks");
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                lua_pushvalue(L, top + 1);
                lua_gettable(L, -2);
                if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                    lua_getfield(L, -1, key);
                    if (str && lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING) { *str = lua_tostring(L, -1); ok = true; }
                    if (num && lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER) { *num = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1); ok = true; }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return ok;
}

// Engine tuning from Lua: the global table `tuning` (see docs/SCRIPTING.md, "Tuning table"). A number there replaces the engine's built-in constant of that name.
float Tune(lua_State* L, const char* key, float def) {
    if (!L) return def;
    int top = lua_gettop(L);
    float r = def;
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "tuning");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, key);
            if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER) r = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
        }
    }
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return r;
}

// engine.strengthChange(name, other, oldStrength, newStrength) -> number or nil: a script may replace the strength a block is left with after a hit
float LuaStrengthHook(lua_State* L, const std::string& name, const std::string& other, float oldS, float newS) {
    if (!L) return newS;
    int top = lua_gettop(L);
    float r = newS;
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "engine");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "strengthChange");
            if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
                lua_pushstring(L, name.c_str()); lua_pushstring(L, other.c_str()); lua_pushnumber(L, oldS); lua_pushnumber(L, newS);
                if (lua_pcall(L, 4, 1, 0) == 0) { if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER) r = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1); }
                else std::fprintf(stderr, "engine.strengthChange: %s\n", lua_tostring(L, -1));
            }
        }
    }
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return r;
}

// engine.force(a, b, momentumX, momentumY, force) -> number or nil: a script may replace the force a contact is worked out as (all games)
float LuaForceHook(lua_State* L, const std::string& a, const std::string& b, float mx, float my, float force) {
    if (!L) return force;
    int top = lua_gettop(L);
    float r = force;
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "engine");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "force");
            if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
                lua_pushstring(L, a.c_str()); lua_pushstring(L, b.c_str()); lua_pushnumber(L, mx); lua_pushnumber(L, my); lua_pushnumber(L, force);
                if (lua_pcall(L, 5, 1, 0) == 0) { if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER) r = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1); }
                else std::fprintf(stderr, "engine.force: %s\n", lua_tostring(L, -1));
            }
        }
    }
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return r;
}

// engine.damage(attacker, victim, force, damage) -> number or nil: a script may replace the damage one object deals to another (all games)
float LuaDamageHook(lua_State* L, const std::string& attacker, const std::string& victim, float force, float damage) {
    if (!L) return damage;
    int top = lua_gettop(L);
    float r = damage;
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "engine");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "damage");
            if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
                lua_pushstring(L, attacker.c_str()); lua_pushstring(L, victim.c_str()); lua_pushnumber(L, force); lua_pushnumber(L, damage);
                if (lua_pcall(L, 4, 1, 0) == 0) { if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER) r = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1); }
                else std::fprintf(stderr, "engine.damage: %s\n", lua_tostring(L, -1));
            }
        }
    }
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return r;
}

// A number from the script environment or from worldAttributes (the exe reads its config table at game +0x37c)
float EnvConfigNumber(lua_State* L, const char* key, float def) {
    int top = lua_gettop(L);
    float r = def;
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    lua_getfield(L, -1, key);
    if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER) r = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
    else {
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "worldAttributes");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, key);
            if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TNUMBER) r = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
        }
    }
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return r;
}

}  // namespace

GamePlatform::GamePlatform(const std::string& dataRoot) : dataRoot_(dataRoot) {}

// The physics world is made on first use, when the scripts have told which game this is: Rio uses Box2D 2.2.0, the others 2.1.x.
PhysicsWorld& GamePlatform::Physics() {
    if (physics_) return *physics_;
    Box2DVersion ver = scripts_ && (scripts_->IsRio() || scripts_->IsSpace() || scripts_->IsStella()) ? Box2DVersion::V22 : Box2DVersion::V21;   // (Stella: its blocks are a tenth of the classic size, see below)
    if (const char* f = std::getenv("AB_BOX2D")) ver = std::string(f) == "21" ? Box2DVersion::V21 : Box2DVersion::V22;  // test override
    if (requestedBox2D_) ver = requestedBox2D_ == 21 ? Box2DVersion::V21 : Box2DVersion::V22;
    physics_ = MakePhysicsWorld(ver);
    g_damageHook = [this](const std::string& a, const std::string& v, float f, float d) { return LuaDamageHook(scripts_ ? scripts_->State() : nullptr, a, v, f, d); };
    g_forceHook = [this](const std::string& a, const std::string& b, float mx, float my, float f) { return LuaForceHook(scripts_ ? scripts_->State() : nullptr, a, b, mx, my, f); };
    g_damageTune = [this](const char* k, float d) { return Tune(scripts_ ? scripts_->State() : nullptr, k, d); };
    physics_->luaFilter = [this](const PhysObject* a, const PhysObject* b) -> int {
        if (!scripts_) return -1;
        lua_State* L = scripts_->State();
        int top = lua_gettop(L);
        int res = -1;
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "engine");
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                lua_getfield(L, -1, "shouldCollide");
                if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
                    lua_pushstring(L, a->name.c_str()); lua_pushstring(L, b->name.c_str());
                    if (lua_pcall(L, 2, 1, 0) == 0) { if (lua_isboolean(L, -1)) res = lua_toboolean(L, -1) ? 1 : 0; }
                }
            }
        }
        lua_settop(L, top);
        return res;
    };
    physics_->SetBox2DFlavour(scripts_ && scripts_->IsSpace());   // Space (0x4a3220 tree, 0x4adf20 solver manifold) is a newer Box2D than Rio (0x4f1e00, 0x4f2da0)
    if (scripts_ && scripts_->IsSpace()) {
        physics_->spaceRules = true;
        solverBase_[0] = 0.005f; solverBase_[1] = 0.5f; solverBase_[2] = 0.5f; physics_->SetSolverSettings(0.005f, 0.5f, 0.5f);      // AngryBirdsSpace.exe: linearSlop 0x512484, timeToSleep 0x50f6ac, linear sleep tolerance 0.25 squared (0x51270c)
        physics_->SetPolygonRadius(0.01f);                   // 0x50f77c
    } else if (scripts_ && scripts_->IsStella()) {
        // Stella's blocks are a tenth of the classic size (a 1X10 plank is 1 x 0.1): with the classic games' slop (0.05) and polygon skin (0.1)
        // planks laid edge to edge overlapped by their skins and every structure blew apart on the first step. Box2D's stock values instead.
        solverBase_[0] = 0.005f; solverBase_[1] = 0.5f; solverBase_[2] = 0.01f; physics_->SetSolverSettings(0.005f, 0.5f, 0.01f);
        physics_->SetPolygonRadius(0.01f);
    } else if (scripts_ && scripts_->IsRio()) physics_->SetSolverSettings(0.05f, 0.25f, 0.1f);
    else physics_->SetSolverSettings(0.05f, 0.25f, 0.1f);
    if (!(scripts_ && (scripts_->IsSpace() || scripts_->IsStella()))) { solverBase_[0] = 0.05f; solverBase_[1] = 0.25f; solverBase_[2] = 0.1f; }
    if (scripts_ && scripts_->IsSpace()) physics_->SetGravity(0, 0);   // Space: only the gravitation sensors pull (the scripts never call setWorldGravity)
    physics_->startAsleep = std::getenv("AB_ASLEEPSTART") != nullptr || (scripts_ && scripts_->IsFirstGame() && std::getenv("AB_ASLEEP10") != nullptr);   // v2.2: the exe creates every body awake (b2BodyDef.awake = 1 at 0x411590 and the other creators); AB_ASLEEPSTART=1 starts blocks asleep for testing
    if (std::getenv("AB_PHYSDBG")) std::fprintf(stderr, "PHYS Box2D %s\n", physics_->Version() == Box2DVersion::V22 ? "2.2.0" : "2.1.1");
    physics_->onBeginContact = [this](PhysObject& a, PhysObject& b, ContactHandle& c) { OnContact(a, b, c); };
    physics_->onEndContact = [this](PhysObject& a, PhysObject& b) {
        if (scripts_) EmitHook(scripts_->State(), "contactEnd", a.name.c_str(), b.name.c_str());
        if (scripts_ && scripts_->IsStarWars()) {          // 0x41f370: both bodies wake up, sensors report a trigger exit, every contact reports exitCollision
            if (a.pbody && !a.pbody->IsStatic()) a.pbody->SetAwake(true);
            if (b.pbody && !b.pbody->IsStatic()) b.pbody->SetAwake(true);
            if (a.isSensor || b.isSensor) { CallCollisionPair("exitTriggerCollision", a.name, b.name); SpaceSensorTouch(a, b, false); }
            CallCollisionPair("exitCollision", a.name, b.name);
            return;
        }
        if (!scripts_ || !(a.isSensor || b.isSensor)) return;
        bool space = scripts_->IsSpace();
        if (space) SpaceSensorTouch(a, b, false);
        if (space || HasScriptFunction("enterCollision") || HasScriptFunction("exitCollision")) CallCollisionPair("exitCollision", a.name, b.name);
    };
    // the contact filter reads objects.world[name].material live
    physics_->materialOf = [this](const PhysObject& o) {
        std::string material;
        if (!scripts_) return material;
        lua_State* L = scripts_->State();
        PushWorldEntry(L, o.name);
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "material");
            if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING) material = lua_tostring(L, -1);
            lua_pop(L, 1);
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        return material;
    };
    physics_->starWarsRules = scripts_ && scripts_->IsStarWars();
    physics_->phoneSpaceGravity = scripts_ && scripts_->IsSpace() && !scripts_->IsStarWars() &&
        (scripts_->ScriptPath().find("data_iphone") != std::string::npos || scripts_->ScriptPath().find("data_ipad") != std::string::npos);
    // the contact filter of an object with blockCollision false reads objects.world[name].collisionMaterials live
    physics_->collisionMaterialsOf = [this](const PhysObject& o) {
        std::vector<std::string> list;
        if (!scripts_) return list;
        lua_State* L = scripts_->State();
        PushWorldEntry(L, o.name);
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "collisionMaterials");
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) for (int k = 1; k <= (int)lua_objlen(L, -1); k++) { lua_rawgeti(L, -1, k); if (lua_type(L, -1) == LUA_TSTRING) list.push_back(lua_tostring(L, -1)); lua_pop(L, 1); }
            lua_pop(L, 1);
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        return list;
    };
    return *physics_;
}
GamePlatform::~GamePlatform() {}

void GamePlatform::Attach(ScriptHost& scripts) {
    scripts_ = &scripts;
    host_.reset(new Host(scripts, *this));
}

// Game::update (0x408980) starts the sound output by itself whenever settings.audioEnabled is true and
// the output exists but is not running; the scripts only ever call stopAudioOutput.
void GamePlatform::AddSpeed(float step) {
    speed_ += step;
    if (speed_ < 0.25f) speed_ = 0.25f;
    if (speed_ > 8.0f) speed_ = 8.0f;
    Print("speed: " + std::to_string(speed_) + "x");
}

// v3.1: the later PC exes (Space, Star Wars) take files dropped on their window. What they did with them is not known (no script asks), so:
// engine.on("fileDropped", fn) and a script function onFileDropped(path) get the path first (onFileDropped returning true ends it there);
// otherwise a dropped level file (a .lua with a world table) is loaded as the current level, and any other .lua runs in the game's scripts
void GamePlatform::FileDropped(const std::string& path) {
    Print("dropped: " + path);
    if (!scripts_) return;
    lua_State* L = scripts_->State();
    EmitHook(L, "fileDropped", path.c_str());
    int top = lua_gettop(L);
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    int env = lua_gettop(L);
    lua_getfield(L, env, "onFileDropped");
    if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
        lua_pushstring(L, path.c_str());
        if (lua_pcall(L, 1, 1, 0) != 0) Print(std::string("onFileDropped: ") + lua_tostring(L, -1));
        else if (lua_toboolean(L, -1)) { lua_settop(L, top); return; }
    }
    lua_settop(L, env);
    const bool lua = path.size() > 4 && (path.compare(path.size() - 4, 4, ".lua") == 0 || path.compare(path.size() - 4, 4, ".LUA") == 0);
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    if (!lua || !ab::ReadLuaFile(path, bytes) || bytes.empty()) { lua_settop(L, top); return; }
    std::string text(bytes.begin(), bytes.end());
    const bool level = text.find("world") != std::string::npos && bytes[0] != 0x1b;
    lua_getfield(L, env, "loadLevelInternal");
    if (level && lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, env, "levelFolder");
        std::string folder = lua_isstring(L, -1) ? lua_tostring(L, -1) : "levels/";
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        savedLevels_[folder + "dropped.temp.lua"] = text;      // loadLevel reads a .temp level from memory (the editor's TAB copy)
        lua_pushstring(L, (folder + "dropped.temp").c_str());
        if (lua_pcall(L, 1, 0, 0) != 0) Print(std::string("dropped level: ") + lua_tostring(L, -1));
        lua_settop(L, top);
        return;
    }
    lua_settop(L, env);
    if (luaL_loadbuffer(L, (const char*)bytes.data(), bytes.size(), path.c_str()) == 0) {
        lua_pushvalue(L, env);
        lua_setfenv(L, -2);
        if (lua_pcall(L, 0, 0, 0) != 0) Print(std::string("dropped script: ") + lua_tostring(L, -1));
    } else Print(std::string("dropped script: ") + lua_tostring(L, -1));
    lua_settop(L, top);
}

void GamePlatform::RecordRewind() {
    if (rewindLimit_ <= 0) { rewind_.clear(); return; }
    std::vector<RewindBody> snap;
    for (const auto& o : Physics().Objects()) {
        if (!o || !o->pbody) continue;
        const PhysBody& b = *o->pbody;
        snap.push_back(RewindBody{o->name, b.PosX(), b.PosY(), b.Angle(), b.VelX(), b.VelY(), b.AngularVelocity(), b.IsAwake()});
    }
    rewind_.push_back(std::move(snap));
    while ((int)rewind_.size() > rewindLimit_ + 1) rewind_.pop_front();
}

// v3.3: the state of every body `back` frames ago (0 = the newest snapshot, the frame being shown), for scripts that move things along the history themselves
bool GamePlatform::RewindFrame(int back, std::vector<RewindInfo>& out) {
    out.clear();
    if (back < 0 || back >= (int)rewind_.size()) return false;
    for (const RewindBody& r : rewind_[rewind_.size() - 1 - back]) out.push_back(RewindInfo{r.name, r.x, r.y, r.a, r.vx, r.vy, r.w, r.awake});
    return true;
}

// rewind(frames): back that many frames (1 when left out); objects made since then stay where they are, destroyed ones do not come back.
// Returns how many frames it went back.
int GamePlatform::Rewind(int frames) {
    if (frames < 1) frames = 1;
    int done = 0;
    while (done < frames && rewind_.size() > 1) { rewind_.pop_back(); done++; }   // the newest is the frame being shown
    if (rewind_.empty() || done == 0) return 0;
    for (const RewindBody& r : rewind_.back()) {
        PhysObject* o = nullptr;
        for (const auto& p : Physics().Objects()) if (p && p->pbody && p->name == r.name) { o = p.get(); break; }
        if (!o) continue;
        o->pbody->SetTransform(r.x, r.y, r.a);
        o->pbody->SetLinearVelocity(r.vx, r.vy);
        o->pbody->SetAngularVelocity(r.w);
        o->pbody->SetAwake(r.awake);
        if (r.awake) { o->pbody->SetLinearVelocity(r.vx, r.vy); o->pbody->SetAngularVelocity(r.w); }   // SetAwake(false) zeroes the speeds
    }
    rewindBlock_ = true;     // the frame after a rewind is not recorded twice
    return done;
}

void GamePlatform::RunFrame(float dt) {
    if (!rewindBlock_) RecordRewind();
    rewindBlock_ = false;
    dt *= speed_ * (speedBoost_ ? 2.0f : 1.0f);
    // v2.2: the script globals gameSpeedFactor (the time step of everything: scripts, animations, physics, particles) and
    // physicsSpeedFactor (only the physics steps; the retail 3.2.0+ exes scaled everything with it) are read every frame.
    // Both are plain Lua globals, so scripts and the console (set / lua) can read and write them.
    float physicsScale = 1.0f;
    if (scripts_) {
        lua_State* L = scripts_->State();
        int top = lua_gettop(L);
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "gameSpeedFactor");
        if (lua_isnumber(L, -1) && lua_tonumber(L, -1) > 0) dt *= (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
        // Angry Birds Star Wars bullet time (Obi-Wan, the Force powers): the exe's delta-time multiplier set by
        // setDeltaTimeMultiplier scales the time step of the whole frame; updateBulletTime divides it back out for its own timers.
        // Stella is different: its GameScene.update multiplies the time it is given by getDeltaTimeMultiplier() itself and keeps
        // the given time as real time (g_realDt, the aim reticle's timers), so the scripts get the frame's real time and only the
        // physics and the particles are slowed (scaled twice, Stella's aim timers ran at a millionth and its reticle never showed)
        lua_getfield(L, -2, "g_deltaTimeMultiplier");
        if (lua_isnumber(L, -1) && lua_tonumber(L, -1) > 0) {
            if (scripts_->IsStella()) stellaTimeMult_ = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
            else dt *= (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
        } else stellaTimeMult_ = 1.0f;
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        lua_getfield(L, -2, "physicsSpeedFactor");
        if (lua_isnumber(L, -1) && lua_tonumber(L, -1) > 0) physicsScale = (float)lua_tonumber(L, -1);
        if (scripts_->IsStella()) physicsScale *= stellaTimeMult_;
        lua_settop(L, top);
    }
    Physics().Frame().physicsScale = physicsScale;
    // Angry Birds Space (the exe's 0x482990): every frame each background element moves by its velocity and its scale grows by its scaleSpeed
    if (scripts_ && (scripts_->IsSpace() || scripts_->IsStella()) && newTheme_) { UpdateNewThemeLayers(bgLayers_, dt); UpdateNewThemeLayers(ntFg_, dt); }
    // Space 1.1.0 (iPhone): the planets and clouds drift sideways. velX is in physics units a second, as in the PC exe (0x482990: x += velX * dt,
    // x in physics units), shown at the layer's scale: physicsToWorld * scale pixels of the 1024-wide screen for each unit. (It was taken as
    // 480x320 pixels a frame at 30 fps, which moved the clouds about 3.5 times too fast.)
    if (scripts_ && scripts_->IsSpace() && !newTheme_ && screenWidth_ > 0) {
        float p2w = 20.0f;
        lua_State* L = scripts_->State();
        int top = lua_gettop(L);
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        float p = 0;
        if (GetNumber(L, lua_gettop(L), "physicsToWorld", p) && p > 0) p2w = p;
        lua_settop(L, top);
        for (ThemeSprite& t : themeSprites_) {
            if (t.wrapW != -1 || t.velX == 0) continue;
            float scale = (t.layer >= 0 && t.layer < (int)bgLayers_.size()) ? bgLayers_[t.layer].scale : 1.0f;
            t.x = std::fmod(t.x + t.velX * dt * p2w * scale / 1024.0f + 1.0f, 1.0f);
        }
    }
    if (scripts_ && scripts_->IsSpace()) for (ThemeSprite& t : themeSprites_) {
        if (t.wrapW == -1) continue;   // the iPhone drift above moves these (they are a part of the screen: velX * dt moved them velX screens a second too)
        t.x += t.velX * dt; t.y += t.velY * dt;
        if (t.wrapW > 0) { if (t.x > t.wrapW) t.x -= 2 * t.wrapW; else if (t.x < -t.wrapW) t.x += 2 * t.wrapW; }
        if (t.wrapH > 0) { if (t.y > t.wrapH) t.y -= 2 * t.wrapH; else if (t.y < -t.wrapH) t.y += 2 * t.wrapH; }
        if (t.scaleSpeed != 0 && t.scaleX + t.scaleSpeed * dt > 0) { t.scaleX += t.scaleSpeed * dt; t.scaleY += t.scaleSpeed * dt; }
    }
    Physics().Frame().starWarsSync = scripts_ && scripts_->IsStarWars();
    Physics().Frame().stepOnEqual = scripts_ && scripts_->IsSpace();
    std::string audioError = audio_.TakeError();
    if (!audioError.empty()) Print("audio: " + audioError);
    if (scripts_ && audio_.Created() && !audio_.Started()) {
        lua_State* L = scripts_->State();
        int top = lua_gettop(L);
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "settings");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "audioEnabled");
            if (lua_isboolean(L, -1) && lua_toboolean(L, -1)) audio_.Start();
        }
        lua_settop(L, top);
    }
    UpdateZoom(dt);
    // Seasons restart (R key): the script makes the pause page the current page while the level loads and the
    // page's offset is still 0 from before it was laid out, so it shows next to "Loading..." until the game
    // mode takes over. The page is hidden (animation at 0) then, so keep it off screen for those frames.
    if (scripts_ && !pauseGuard_ && IsSeasonsScripts()) {
        lua_State* L = scripts_->State();
        int top = lua_gettop(L);
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "drawMenu");
        if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
            pauseGuard_ = true;
            const char* code =
                "local orig = drawMenu\n"
                "drawMenu = function(...)\n"
                "  local pp = pausePage\n"
                "  if pp and currentGameMode == updateLoading and currentMenuPage == pp and pp.offsetX == 0 and (pauseBGw or 0) > 0 then\n"
                "    local a = elementAnimations and elementAnimations.ingamePausePageScroll\n"
                "    if a and (a.percentage or 0) <= 0 then\n"
                "      pp.offsetX = -pauseBGw\n"
                "      if pp.backgroundOverlay then pp.backgroundOverlay.shade = 0 end\n"
                "    end\n"
                "  end\n"
                "  return orig(...)\n"
                "end\n";
            if (luaL_loadstring(L, code) == 0) {
                lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
                lua_setfenv(L, -2);
                if (lua_pcall(L, 0, 0, 0) != 0) std::fprintf(stderr, "pause guard: %s\n", lua_tostring(L, -1));
            }
        }
        lua_settop(L, top);
    }
    if (host_) UpdateFrame(Physics().Frame(), *host_, dt);
    static int execFrame = 0;
    if (const char* od = std::getenv("AB_OBJDUMP")) if (execFrame + 1 == std::atoi(od))
        for (const auto& o : Physics().Objects()) { BodyInfo bi = Physics().Inspect(o->name); std::fprintf(stderr, "OD %s spr=%s st=%d sensor=%d r=%g m=%g scaled=%d sc=%g,%g x=%.1f y=%.1f fr=%g e=%g\n", o->name.c_str(), o->sprite.c_str(), (int)bi.isStatic, (int)o->isSensor, bi.shapeRadius, bi.mass, (int)o->scaled, o->scaleX, o->scaleY, o->interpX, o->interpY, o->pbody ? o->pbody->Friction() : 0.0f, o->pbody ? o->pbody->Restitution() : 0.0f); }
```
