`src/engine/sprite_sheet.h`:

```h
// Sprite sheet (.dat, "KA3D") reader. Original: game::SpriteSheet::load (0x439e00), and the lookups
// game::Resources::spriteQuery a/b/c/d (0x435260 / 0x435360 / 0x435460 / 0x435560), which return the
// raw signed 16-bit width, height, pivotX, pivotY of a sprite found by name (across all loaded sheets).
//
// File layout (all numbers big endian):
//   "KA3D"  u32 length (file size - 8)
//   "SPRT"  u32 chunk size
//   u16 imageCount (1), per image: u16 nameLength, name           e.g. "INGAME_BLOCKS_1.png"
//   u16 spriteCount, per sprite: u16 nameLength, name, then s16 x, y, w, h, pivotX, pivotY
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace ab {

struct Sprite {
    std::string name;
    int x = 0, y = 0, w = 0, h = 0, pivotX = 0, pivotY = 0;
};

struct SpriteSheet {
    std::string image;                 // the png this sheet cuts from
    std::string directory;             // the folder the .dat was loaded from (the png is beside it)
    std::vector<Sprite> sprites;
    int order = 0;                     // load order: when two sheets have a sprite of one name, the later one wins
};

// One composite sprite (a "COMP" entry of a *_composprites.dat file): sprites placed relative to one
// origin. The size and origin are computed from the parts' sprites (0x43af10).
struct CompoPart { std::string sprite; int x = 0, y = 0; float fx = 0, fy = 0, scale = 1, angle = 0; bool exact = false; float scaleY = 0; bool flipX = false; };   // scaleY 0: the same as scale; flipX: RVIO flag 0x100   // exact: made by setupCompoObject, placed at (fx, fy) with its own scale and angle
struct CompoSprite {
    std::string name;
    std::vector<CompoPart> parts;
};

// Parses a *_composprites.dat file image.
bool ParseCompoSpriteSet(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, std::vector<CompoSprite>& out, std::string* error);

// Parses a .dat file image. Returns false (with a reason in *error) if it is malformed.
bool ParseSpriteSheet(const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes, SpriteSheet& out, std::string* error);

// All loaded sheets, looked up by sprite name like the exe's hashtable.
class SpriteLibrary {
public:
    bool Load(const std::string& key, const std::string& file, std::string* error);
    void Release(const std::string& key);
    // A sheet made at run time (the Hatchery's painted eggs); the png it cuts from is looked up by the platform
    void Add(const std::string& key, SpriteSheet sheet) { sheet.order = ++loaded_; cache_.clear(); sheets_[key] = std::move(sheet); }
    const SpriteSheet* Sheet(const std::string& key) const { auto it = sheets_.find(key); return it == sheets_.end() ? nullptr : &it->second; }
    const Sprite* Find(const std::string& sprite) const;
    // Same, and also the sheet it belongs to.
    const Sprite* Find(const std::string& sprite, const SpriteSheet** sheet) const;

    // Composite sprites, looked up by name in the loaded sets.
    bool LoadCompoSet(const std::string& key, const std::string& file, std::string* error);
    void ReleaseCompoSet(const std::string& key) { compoCache_.clear(); compoSets_.erase(key); compoOrder_.erase(key); }
    const CompoSprite* FindCompo(const std::string& name) const;
    // a composite made while the game runs (setupCompoObject); a name used again replaces the earlier one
    void AddCompo(const CompoSprite& c);
    // Size and origin of a composite: the union of its parts' rectangles (each part's sprite is placed
    // at (x, y) minus its pivot). width/height are the extent, originX/originY the distance of the
    // composite's (0, 0) from the top left corner.
    void CompoExtent(const CompoSprite& c, int& width, int& height, int& originX, int& originY) const;
private:
    std::map<std::string, SpriteSheet> sheets_;
    int loaded_ = 0;
    // name -> sprite and sheet, filled by Find, cleared whenever a sheet is loaded or released
    mutable std::unordered_map<std::string, std::pair<const Sprite*, const SpriteSheet*>> cache_;
    std::map<std::string, std::vector<CompoSprite>> compoSets_;
    mutable std::unordered_map<std::string, const CompoSprite*> compoCache_;   // name -> composite (or none), cleared whenever a set changes
    std::map<std::string, int> compoOrder_;   // load order of each set, the latest wins like the sheets
};

}  // namespace ab

```

`src/game/collision_damage.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "collision_damage.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace ab {
std::function<float(const char*, float)> g_damageTune;
std::function<float(const std::string&, const std::string&, float, float)> g_damageHook;
std::function<float(const std::string&, const std::string&, float, float, float)> g_forceHook;
namespace {
float T(const char* k, float d) { return g_damageTune ? g_damageTune(k, d) : d; }

float Length(Vec2 v) { return std::sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y); }

float Lookup(const std::map<std::string, float>& m, const std::string& key, float fallback) {
    auto it = m.find(key);
    return it == m.end() ? fallback : it->second;
}

// What one block takes from a force. Returns the damage it absorbed.
// absorbed is cleared when the block's defence is higher than the force.
float HitBlock(const ContactObject& o, float force, bool& notBlockedByDefence, ContactResult& r) {
    notBlockedByDefence = true;
    if (!o.hasStrength) return 0;
    float defence = o.hasDefence ? o.defence : 0.0f;
    if (o.hasDefence && force < defence) {
        notBlockedByDefence = false;
        return 0;
    }
    float excess = force - defence;
    float remaining = o.strength - excess;
    r.strengthUpdates.push_back({o.name, remaining});
    if (remaining > 0) return excess;
    r.destroyed.push_back(o.name);
    return o.strength;
}

}  // namespace

ContactResult ResolveContact(const ContactObject& a, const ContactObject& b) {
    ContactResult r;

    if (!a.controllable && !b.controllable) {
        // block against block: force from the difference of the two momenta
        Vec2 dp = {a.mass * a.velocity.x - b.mass * b.velocity.x,
                   a.mass * a.velocity.y - b.mass * b.velocity.y};
        float force = Length(dp) * T("classic.blockForce", 0.1f);
        if (g_forceHook) force = g_forceHook(a.name, b.name, dp.x, dp.y, force);   // engine.force

        // Rio (0x40ca60): the damage a block takes is scaled by the other block's damageFactors,
        // looked up by the material of the block that is hit (Lua tables with no entry scale by 1).
        // This is what keeps the Mauro boss unharmed by the platforms he jumps onto:
        // DefaultDamageFactors.damageMultiplier.monkeyBoss is 0.
        float forceA = force, forceB = force;
        if (b.damageFactors) forceA *= Lookup(b.damageFactors->damageMultiplier, a.material, 1.0f);
        if (a.damageFactors) forceB *= Lookup(a.damageFactors->damageMultiplier, b.material, 1.0f);
        if (g_damageHook) { forceA = g_damageHook(b.name, a.name, force, forceA); forceB = g_damageHook(a.name, b.name, force, forceB); }

        bool okA, okB;
        float total = HitBlock(a, forceA, okA, r);
        total += HitBlock(b, forceB, okB, r);

        CollisionEvent e;
        e.isBird = false;
        e.object1 = a.name;
        e.object2 = b.name;
        e.force = force;
        e.wasDamageDone = okA || okB;
        r.events.push_back(e);

        if (total > 0) r.blockScoreAdd = std::floor(total) * T("classic.blockScore", 10.0f);
        return r;
    }

    if (a.controllable && b.controllable) {
        // bird against bird: the faster bird decides the force
        const ContactObject& fast =
            (a.velocity.x * a.velocity.x + a.velocity.y * a.velocity.y <=
             b.velocity.x * b.velocity.x + b.velocity.y * b.velocity.y) ? b : a;
        CollisionEvent e;
        e.isBird = true;
        e.object1 = a.name;
        e.object2 = b.name;
        e.force = Length(fast.velocity) * fast.mass / T("classic.birdForceDivisor", 10.0f);
        e.damage = 0;
        r.events.push_back(e);
        return r;
    }

    // bird against block
    const ContactObject& bird = a.controllable ? a : b;
    const ContactObject& block = a.controllable ? b : a;

    float damageMultiplier = 1.0f;
    float velocityMultiplier = 1.0f;
    if (bird.damageFactors) {
        damageMultiplier = Lookup(bird.damageFactors->damageMultiplier, block.material, 1.0f);
        velocityMultiplier = Lookup(bird.damageFactors->velocityMultiplier, block.material, 1.0f);
    } else if (!bird.material.empty() && bird.material == block.material) {
        // v3.1: Angry Birds 1.0 has no damage factors: a bird is strong against the material it is made of (the blue bird is "light" like ice,
        // the yellow one "wood", the black one "rock"); x4, the factor the later games' tables started from (light 4 * 0.725, wood 4 * 0.6, rock 4)
        damageMultiplier = T("classic.sameMaterialDamage", 4.0f);
        // and the Blue Bird keeps its speed through the ice it breaks (the later games' BlueBirdDamageFactors.velocityMultiplier.light, 1.9)
        if (bird.material == "light") velocityMultiplier = T("classic.sameMaterialVelocityLight", 1.9f);
    }

    float impact = Length(bird.velocity) * bird.mass / T("classic.birdForceDivisor", 10.0f);
    if (g_forceHook) impact = g_forceHook(bird.name, block.name, bird.velocity.x * bird.mass, bird.velocity.y * bird.mass, impact);   // engine.force
    float damage = impact * damageMultiplier;
    if (g_damageHook) damage = g_damageHook(bird.name, block.name, impact, damage);
    float dealt = 0;

    if (block.hasStrength) {
        float defence = block.hasDefence ? block.defence : 0.0f;
        float excess = damage - defence;
        dealt = excess;  // the original passes this on even when it is zero or negative
        if (excess > 0) {
            float strength = block.strength;
            float remaining = strength - excess;
            r.strengthUpdates.push_back({block.name, remaining});
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                r.destroyed.push_back(block.name);
                r.hasVelocityChange = true;
                r.velocityChange.name = bird.name;
                if (!bird.useLegacyCollisionPath) {
                    float ratio = ((damage - strength) / damage) * velocityMultiplier;
                    if (ratio > 1.0f) ratio = 1.0f;
                    r.velocityChange.velocity = {bird.velocity.x * ratio, bird.velocity.y * ratio};
                    r.velocityChange.immediate = false;
                } else {
                    float ratio = ((-remaining / bird.mass) / damage) * T("classic.birdForceDivisor", 10.0f) * T("classic.legacyVelocityFactor", 1.75f);
                    if (ratio > 1.0f) ratio = 1.0f;
                    r.velocityChange.velocity = {bird.velocity.x * ratio, bird.velocity.y * ratio};
                    r.velocityChange.immediate = true;
                }
                r.disableContact = true;
                dealt = strength;
            }
        }
    }

    CollisionEvent e;
    e.isBird = true;
    e.object1 = bird.name;
    e.object2 = block.name;
    e.force = damage;
    e.damage = std::floor(dealt);
    r.events.push_back(e);
    return r;
}

}  // namespace ab

```

`src/game/collision_damage.h`:

```h
// Collision damage rules, reconstructed from AngryBirds.exe 1.6.2
// (original: Game contact listener BeginContact, 0x0040b670, "game_handleCollisionDamage").
//
// This is the pure rules part. The caller (the Box2D contact listener) fills in two ContactObject
// values from the two fixtures' user data and body state, calls ResolveContact, then applies the
// result: write the new strengths into objects.world[name], add destroyed names to deadBlocks,
// add blockScoreAdd to scoreTable.blocks.score, call the Lua callbacks in order, disable the
// contact if asked, and apply the bird velocity change.
//
// The caller must already have done the checks the original does first:
//   * return if either of the two game flags at Game+0x1e9 / Game+0x1ea is set,
//   * return if either fixture has no user data,
//   * return unless both object names are keys of objects.world.
#pragma once
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace ab {

struct Vec2 {
    float x = 0, y = 0;
};

// blockTable.damageFactors[<name>]  (see blocks.lua, e.g. "YellowBirdDamageFactors").
// A material that is missing from a map leaves the multiplier at 1.
struct DamageFactorSet {
    std::map<std::string, float> damageMultiplier;
    std::map<std::string, float> velocityMultiplier;
};

// One side of a contact.
struct ContactObject {
    std::string name;                 // key in objects.world
    bool controllable = false;        // true for birds (byte at +0x87 in the original)
    bool hasStrength = false;         // objects.world[name].strength exists
    float strength = 0;
    bool hasDefence = false;          // objects.world[name].defence exists
    float defence = 0;
    std::string material;             // objects.world[name].material
    bool useLegacyCollisionPath = false;
    // For a bird: the set named by objects.world[bird].damageFactors, looked up in
    // blockTable.damageFactors. May be null (all multipliers 1).
    const DamageFactorSet* damageFactors = nullptr;
    float mass = 0;                   // body mass
    Vec2 velocity;                    // body linear velocity at the moment of contact
};

struct CollisionEvent {
    bool isBird = false;              // true: birdCollision(...), false: blockCollision(...)
    std::string object1, object2;
    float force = 0;
    float damage = 0;                 // birdCollision only
    bool wasDamageDone = false;       // blockCollision only
};

struct StrengthUpdate {
    std::string name;
    float strength = 0;               // new value for objects.world[name].strength
};

struct VelocityChange {
    std::string name;
    Vec2 velocity;
    bool immediate = false;           // true: call setVelocity now; false: apply after the step
};

struct ContactResult {
    std::vector<StrengthUpdate> strengthUpdates;
    std::vector<std::string> destroyed;     // add each to deadBlocks[name] = objects.world[name]
    float blockScoreAdd = 0;                // scoreTable.blocks.score += this
    bool disableContact = false;            // contact->SetEnabled(false) (bird goes through)
    bool hasVelocityChange = false;
    VelocityChange velocityChange;
    std::vector<CollisionEvent> events;     // Lua callbacks, in call order
};

// Lua tuning for the rules below (set by the game; without it every constant keeps its built-in value)
extern std::function<float(const char*, float)> g_damageTune;
// Lua damage hook: (attacker, victim, force, damage) -> the damage to use (engine.damage); without it the damage stays
extern std::function<float(const std::string&, const std::string&, float, float)> g_damageHook;
// engine.force(a, b, momentumX, momentumY, force) -> number or nil: replaces the force a contact is worked out as
extern std::function<float(const std::string&, const std::string&, float, float, float)> g_forceHook;

ContactResult ResolveContact(const ContactObject& a, const ContactObject& b);

}  // namespace ab

```

`src/game/frame_update.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "game/frame_update.h"

#include <cmath>

namespace ab {

namespace {

const float kPi = 3.1415927f;
const float kTwoPi = 6.2831855f;

float Angle(const Body& b) { return std::atan2(b.RotCol1Y(), b.RotCol1X()); }

void StopOrAdjust(FrameHost& host, LoopSound which, float volume) {
    if (volume <= 0.0f) {
        host.StopLoop(which);
    } else if (host.LoopActive(which)) {
        host.SetLoopVolume(which, volume);
    } else {
        host.StartLoop(which, volume);
    }
}

}  // namespace

float StepZoom(float zoomLevel, float current, float target) {
    if (target != current) zoomLevel = (current - target) * 0.5f + zoomLevel;
    return zoomLevel;
}

void UpdateFrame(FrameState& s, FrameHost& host, float dt) {
    float woodVolume = 0, rockVolume = 0, lightVolume = 0;

    if (s.running) {
        // 1. fixed steps
        s.accumulator += dt * s.physicsScale;
        while (s.stepOnEqual ? s.accumulator >= kFixedStep : s.accumulator > kFixedStep) {
            host.StepWorld(kFixedStep, 10, 10);
            s.accumulator -= kFixedStep;
            host.CallRemoveBlocks();

            for (size_t i = 0; i < s.birds.size(); i++) {
                FrameObject* o = s.birds[i];
                if (!o->pendingVelocity) continue;
                host.LogBirdVelocity(o->id, o->pendingVx, o->pendingVy);
                if (!o->body->IsStatic()) o->body->SetLinearVelocity(o->pendingVx, o->pendingVy);
                o->pendingVelocity = false;
            }

            if (s.accumulator <= kSnapshotWindow) {
                s.bufferIndex = (s.bufferIndex == 0) ? 1 : 0;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < s.objects.size(); i++) {
                    FrameObject* o = s.objects[i];
                    if (!o->body->IsAwake()) continue;
                    float* st = o->state[s.bufferIndex];
                    st[0] = o->body->PosX();
                    st[1] = o->body->PosY();
                    st[2] = Angle(*o->body);
                    if (o->isBird && o->body->Mass() != 0.0f) o->body->SetBullet(true);
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. interpolation factor
        host.ClearForces();
        float alpha = s.accumulator / kFixedStep;
        float oneMinusAlpha = 1.0f - alpha;
        int cur = s.bufferIndex;
        int prev = (s.bufferIndex == 0) ? 1 : 0;

        // 3. interpolate, and run the destroy timers
        for (size_t i = 0; i < s.objects.size(); i++) {
            FrameObject* o = s.objects[i];
            if (o->body->IsAwake()) {
                o->interpX = o->state[cur][0] * alpha + o->state[prev][0] * oneMinusAlpha;
                o->interpY = o->state[cur][1] * alpha + o->state[prev][1] * oneMinusAlpha;

                float a1 = o->state[cur][2];
                float a0 = o->state[prev][2];
                float diff = a1 - a0;
                if (diff < 0.0f) diff = -diff;
                if (diff >= kPi) {
                    // the angle wrapped between the two snapshots: move the old one by a full turn
                    a0 = (a1 <= a0) ? a0 - kTwoPi : a0 + kTwoPi;
                }
                o->interpAngle = alpha * a1 + a0 * oneMinusAlpha;
            }
            if (o->destroyPending) {
                o->destroyTimer -= dt;
                if (o->destroyTimer <= 0.0f) {
                    host.MarkBlockDead(o->id);
                    o->destroyPending = false;
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. publish to Lua
        bool hasMoving = false, hasAwake = false, hasMovingAboveTolerance = false, hasMovingZero = false;
        if (!s.objects.empty()) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < s.objects.size(); i++) {
                FrameObject* o = s.objects[i];
                Body& b = *o->body;
                if (o->wasAwake || b.IsAwake()) {
                    hasAwake = true;
                    host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "x", o->interpX);
                    host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "y", o->interpY);

                    if (b.Mass() > 0.0f) {
                        // anything that leaves the level is frozen
                        if (s.stepOnEqual) {      // Space (0x483c13): outside any of the four limits, in either direction
                            if ((float)s.levelMaxY < o->interpY || o->interpY < (float)s.levelMinY) host.SetObjectBool(o->id, "frozen", true);
                        } else if (o->interpY > 20.0f) host.SetObjectBool(o->id, "frozen", true);
                        if (o->interpX < (float)s.levelMinX) host.SetObjectBool(o->id, "frozen", true);
                        if ((float)s.levelMaxX < o->interpX) host.SetObjectBool(o->id, "frozen", true);
                    }

                    float vx = b.VelX(), vy = b.VelY();
                    float speedSq = vy * vy + vx * vx;
                    if (speedSq > 0.0005f && !o->isBird && !b.HasJoints()) hasMovingAboveTolerance = true;
                    if (s.starWarsSync) {
                        // 0x43387c / 0x4338bf / 0x433a52: no joint test, and an object flagged with parameter 12 never counts; the angular test uses |w|
                        if (speedSq > 0.0f && !o->isBird && !o->ignoreMoving) hasMovingZero = true;
                        float aw = b.AngularVelocity(); if (aw < 0.0f) aw = -aw;
                        if ((speedSq > 9.0f || aw > 0.1f) && !o->ignoreMoving) hasMoving = true;
                        host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "velocity", std::sqrt(speedSq));   // 0x433953: objects.world[name].velocity, read by gamescene's specialty speed limits
                    } else
                    if (speedSq > 9.0f || (b.AngularVelocity() > 0.1f && !b.HasJoints())) hasMoving = true;

                    bool done = false;
                    if (o->isBird) {
                        host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "xVel", vx);
                        host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "yVel", vy);
                        host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "angle", o->interpAngle);
                        done = true;
                    } else if (o->recordVelocity || (s.starWarsSync && o->rollMaterial == kRollPropeller)) {   // 0x433960: a controlled, propeller or recorded object
                        // Space publishes these for an object the script flagged with setRecordVelocity (0x483eb6), the angle with them. The other
                        // games' exes only do it for birds, so a script could not read a block's velocity from objects.world there; the engine sets the
                        // flag on every object of those games, so objects.world[name].xVel / .yVel work for all of them
                        host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "xVel", vx);
                        host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "yVel", vy);
                        if (o->recordAngle || o->rollMaterial == kRollPropeller) host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "angle", o->interpAngle);
                    }
                    if (!done && o->rolls) {
                        float w = b.AngularVelocity();
                        if (w < 0.0f) w = -w;
                        float volume = ((o->rollFactor * w) / 400.0f) * b.Mass();
                        if (volume > 1.0f) volume = 1.0f;
                        if (o->rollMaterial == kRollWood && woodVolume < volume) woodVolume = volume;
                        if (o->rollMaterial == kRollRock && rockVolume < volume) rockVolume = volume;
                        if (o->rollMaterial == kRollLight && lightVolume < volume) lightVolume = volume;
                    }
                }
                // runs for every object, awake or not
                o->wasAwake = b.IsAwake();
                host.SetObjectNumber(o->id, "angle", Angle(b));
                host.SetObjectBool(o->id, "sleeping", !b.IsAwake());
            }
        }

        // 5. flags
        host.SetGameBool("hasMovingObjects", hasMoving);
        host.SetGameBool("hasAwakeObjects", hasAwake);
        host.SetGameBool("hasMovingObjectsAboveTolerance", hasMovingAboveTolerance);
        if (s.starWarsSync) host.SetGameBool("hasMovingObjectsZeroTolerance", hasMovingZero);

        // 6. joints
        for (size_t i = 0; i < s.joints.size(); i++) {
            if (!s.joints[i]->PublishesEndpoints()) continue;
            float x1, y1, x2, y2;
            s.joints[i]->Anchors(x1, y1, x2, y2);
            host.SetJointNumber((int)i, "x1", x1);
            host.SetJointNumber((int)i, "y1", y1);
            host.SetJointNumber((int)i, "x2", x2);
            host.SetJointNumber((int)i, "y2", y2);
        }
    }

    // 7. rolling loops (when not running all three volumes are 0, so all three are stopped)
    StopOrAdjust(host, kLoopWood, woodVolume);
    StopOrAdjust(host, kLoopRock, rockVolume);
    StopOrAdjust(host, kLoopLight, lightVolume);

    // 8. callbacks
    if (s.versionReceived) {
        host.LatestVersionNumberReceived();
        s.versionReceived = false;
    }
    if (s.updateNoticePending) host.UpdateAvailable(s.updateNoticeValue);
    // v3.3: the update script may load a level (Lua loadLevel -> BeginLevelLoad), which destroys this physics world and with it `s`; whether the effects run
    // is read before the call, not from the freed state afterwards (valgrind: "invalid read of size 1 ... free'd by BeginLevelLoad" when 1-8 of Angry Birds 1.0.0
    // was clicked; on Windows the freed memory was reused and the read crashed)
    const bool runningBeforeUpdate = s.running;
    host.CallUpdate(dt, dt);
    if (runningBeforeUpdate) host.UpdateEffects(dt);
}

}  // namespace ab

```

`src/game/frame_update.h`:

```h
// Per-frame update, reconstructed from AngryBirds.exe 1.6.2
// (original: Game::update, 0x00408980, "game_updateFrame").
//
// What the original does each frame, in order:
//   1. Fixed-step physics: accumulator += dt; while accumulator > 1/30 { Step(1/30, 10, 10);
//      accumulator -= 1/30; Lua removeBlocks(); apply deferred bird velocities;
//      if accumulator <= 2/30 { flip the double buffer and snapshot every awake body } }
//   2. ClearForces, then alpha = accumulator / (1/30).
//   3. For every object: interpolate position/angle between the two snapshots (awake bodies only),
//      and count down the destroy timer (block goes into deadBlocks when it runs out).
//   4. For every object that is awake (or was awake last frame): write x, y into its Lua table,
//      mark it "frozen" if it left the level, work out the moving/awake flags, write xVel/yVel for
//      birds, write angle and sleeping, and collect the rolling-sound volumes.
//   5. Publish hasMovingObjects / hasAwakeObjects / hasMovingObjectsAboveTolerance.
//   6. Write x1,y1,x2,y2 of every joint into objects.joints[name].
//   7. Start/stop/adjust the three rolling loops (wood, rock, light).
//   8. Version-check callbacks, then Lua update(dt, dt), then the effects manager update.
//
// This file contains no Box2D and no Lua: the caller supplies both through Body and FrameHost.
#pragma once
#include <vector>

namespace ab {

constexpr float kFixedStep = 0.033333335f;     // 1/30
constexpr float kSnapshotWindow = 0.06666667f; // snapshots only when this much time or less is left

// A Box2D 2.1.0 body, as far as the frame update touches it.
class Body {
public:
    virtual ~Body() {}
    virtual bool IsStatic() const = 0;          // m_type == b2_staticBody (the original tests m_type != 0)
    virtual bool IsAwake() const = 0;           // flags & e_awakeFlag (2)
    virtual bool HasJoints() const = 0;         // m_jointList != 0
    virtual float PosX() const = 0;
    virtual float PosY() const = 0;
    virtual float RotCol1X() const = 0;         // xf.R.col1.x  (cos angle)
    virtual float RotCol1Y() const = 0;         // xf.R.col1.y  (sin angle)
    virtual float VelX() const = 0;
    virtual float VelY() const = 0;
    virtual float AngularVelocity() const = 0;
    virtual float Mass() const = 0;
    virtual void SetLinearVelocity(float x, float y) = 0;
    virtual void SetBullet(bool on) = 0;        // e_bulletFlag (8)
};

// A joint; endpoints are what the two virtual calls on the original joint wrapper return.
class JointView {
public:
    virtual ~JointView() {}
    virtual bool PublishesEndpoints() const = 0;   // original: kind != 2
    virtual void Anchors(float& x1, float& y1, float& x2, float& y2) const = 0;
};

enum RollMaterial { kRollNone = 0, kRollWood = 1, kRollRock = 2, kRollLight = 3, kRollPropeller = 4 };

// One entry of the game's object table (the original struct, only the fields this code uses).
struct FrameObject {
    int id = 0;                       // host handle for its Lua table (objects.world[name])
    Body* body = nullptr;
    int rollMaterial = kRollNone;     // +0x18
    bool isBird = false;              // +0x87
    bool recordVelocity = false;      // Space +0x189 (setRecordVelocity): xVel / yVel are published for this object too; the other games' objects always have it
    bool ignoreMoving = false;        // Star Wars +0x151 (setObjectParameter 12): the object does not count for hasMovingObjects
    bool recordAngle = false;         // Space: a recorded object also publishes its angle
    bool rolls = false;               // +0x88  makes rolling noise
    float rollFactor = 0;             // +0x70
    // +0x84 .. +0x30: velocity change queued by the collision code, applied after the next Step
    bool pendingVelocity = false;
    float pendingVx = 0, pendingVy = 0;
    bool wasAwake = false;            // +0x85
    bool destroyPending = false;      // +0x8b
    float destroyTimer = 0;           // +0x8c
    // double-buffered state (x, y, angle) at +0x00 and +0x0c, and the interpolated result
    float state[2][3] = {{0, 0, 0}, {0, 0, 0}};
    float interpX = 0, interpY = 0, interpAngle = 0;   // +0x74, +0x78, +0x7c
};

enum LoopSound { kLoopWood = 0, kLoopRock = 1, kLoopLight = 2 };

// Everything outside the physics: Lua, audio, and the engine's other subsystems.
class FrameHost {
public:
    virtual ~FrameHost() {}
    virtual void StepWorld(float dt, int velocityIterations, int positionIterations) = 0;
    virtual void ClearForces() = 0;
    virtual void CallRemoveBlocks() = 0;                       // Lua removeBlocks()
    virtual void LogBirdVelocity(int /*objectId*/, float /*vx*/, float /*vy*/) {}  // "Bird %s new velocity is x: %f, y: %f"

    // Lua table writes. key is the exact string the original uses.
    virtual void SetObjectNumber(int objectId, const char* key, float value) = 0;  // x y xVel yVel angle
    virtual void SetObjectBool(int objectId, const char* key, bool value) = 0;     // frozen sleeping
    virtual void SetGameBool(const char* key, bool value) = 0;                     // hasMovingObjects ...
    virtual void SetJointNumber(int jointIndex, const char* key, float value) = 0; // x1 y1 x2 y2
    // objects.world[name].strength = 0 and objects.deadBlocks[name] = <that table>
    virtual void MarkBlockDead(int objectId) = 0;

    // Rolling loops. Original: isClipActive(handle) / playAudioClip(name, volume, loop=1, 2) /
    // setClipVolume(handle, volume) / stopAudioClip(name).
    virtual bool LoopActive(LoopSound which) = 0;
    virtual void StartLoop(LoopSound which, float volume) = 0;
    virtual void SetLoopVolume(LoopSound which, float volume) = 0;
    virtual void StopLoop(LoopSound which) = 0;

    virtual void LatestVersionNumberReceived() {}   // Game+0x1c set
    virtual void UpdateAvailable(bool /*available*/) {} // Game+0x1d set, value at +0x1e
    virtual void CallUpdate(float dt, float realDt) = 0;  // Lua update(dt, dt)
    virtual void UpdateEffects(float dt) = 0;       // the object at Game+0x60 (0x41cec0), only while running
};

struct FrameState {
    bool running = false;             // Game+0x1f8: a level is loaded and the world exists
    float accumulator = 0;            // Game+0x204
    int bufferIndex = 0;              // Game+0xc8
    int levelMinX = 0, levelMaxX = 0; // Game+0x2a4 / +0x2a8, set by setLevelLimits (args 1 and 3)
    int levelMinY = 0, levelMaxY = 0; // Space: Game+0x3c0 / +0x3c4 (args 2 and 4); the other games freeze below y 20 instead
    bool versionReceived = false;     // Game+0x1c
    bool updateNoticePending = false; // Game+0x1d
    bool updateNoticeValue = false;   // Game+0x1e
    bool starWarsSync = false;        // Star Wars (0x433xxx): hasMovingObjects ignores joints and flagged objects, hasMovingObjectsZeroTolerance is published
    bool stepOnEqual = false;         // Space (0x483xxx): the loop runs while accumulator >= step
    float physicsScale = 1;           // v2.2: physicsSpeedFactor. Only the physics steps see it (the accumulator grows by dt * physicsScale); Lua update(dt) is not scaled
    std::vector<FrameObject*> objects;     // the object hashtable
    std::vector<FrameObject*> birds;       // the array at Game+0x180 checked for pending velocity
    std::vector<JointView*> joints;
};

void UpdateFrame(FrameState& s, FrameHost& host, float dt);

// "zoomLevel" handling at the top of the original: zoom += (current - target) * 0.5 when they differ.
float StepZoom(float zoomLevel, float current, float target);

}  // namespace ab

```

-- achievements_page.lua: Game Center achievements without Game Center (engine side, run once with the game's environment).
--
-- The phone exes read the achievement list of the device (scripts/ipad/achievements.lua, iphone/, gamecenter/iphone/ ...), reported
-- unlockAchievement(id, name) to Game Center (or Chillingo's Crystal in Angry Birds HD 1.4.2) and Game Center sent back each
-- achievement's title and "achieved" text, which the game's own pop-up (AchievementPopup / BannerPopup) shows. Here:
--   * the list is loaded when the scripts left it empty;
--   * every unlock is kept in settings.abAchievements (name = time) and shown with the game's own pop-up when it has one, otherwise
--     with a banner of the same make (title strip, icon, text);
--   * each achievement gets a short text saying how to get it, taken from the conditions the scripts check (the limits are read from
--     the running game where it keeps them: achievementLimits, the achievement processor, the episode list);
--   * F7, the game's Game Center button (showAchievements) and the Crystal button of Angry Birds HD 1.4.2 open a page listing them all.
local env = ...
local _G = _G
local math, string, table, pairs, ipairs, type, tostring, next, rawget, pcall = _G.math, _G.string, _G.table, _G.pairs, _G.ipairs, _G.type, _G.tostring, _G.next, _G.rawget, _G.pcall

if env.abAchPage then return end

-- v3.2: the Android data (Google Play's list is the iPhone's, or scripts/achievements.lua) and the Seasons 4.x PC data (its Xbox Live list) too
local phone = env.iOS or env.deviceModel == "iphone" or env.deviceModel == "ipad" or env.deviceModel == "android" or (env.deviceModel == "windows" and env.commonScriptPath ~= nil)
if phone and type(env.loadLuaFile) == "function" and env.fileExists and env.scriptPath and (type(env.achievements) ~= "table" or next(env.achievements) == nil) then
    local dm = tostring(env.deviceModel or "iphone")
    for _, f in ipairs({dm .. "/achievements.lua", "gamecenter/" .. dm .. "/achievements.lua", "ipad/achievements.lua", "iphone/achievements.lua", "gamecenter/iphone/achievements.lua", "gamecenter/ipad/achievements.lua", "xboxlive/achievements.lua", "achievements.lua"}) do
        local path = env.scriptPath .. "/" .. f
        if env.fileExists(path) then
            pcall(env.loadLuaFile, path, "")
            if type(env.achievements) == "table" and next(env.achievements) then break end
            if type(env.g_achievements) == "table" and next(env.g_achievements) then break end
        end
    end
    -- Angry Birds 2.0.0 (Android) keeps its list as g_achievements (name = {icon = ...})
    if (type(env.achievements) ~= "table" or next(env.achievements) == nil) and type(env.g_achievements) == "table" and next(env.g_achievements) then
        env.achievements = env.g_achievements
    end
end
if type(env.achievements) ~= "table" or next(env.achievements) == nil then return end

local function trim(s) return (string.gsub(s, "^%s+", "")):gsub("%s+$", "") end
local function number(n)
    local s = tostring(math.floor(n + 0.5))
    while true do local k s, k = string.gsub(s, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") if k == 0 then return s end end
end

-- the achievement processor of Classic / Seasons (any table of the game that keeps birdSlingerLimit)
local processor
local function findProcessor()
    if processor ~= nil then return processor end
    processor = false
    for _, v in pairs(env) do
        if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "birdSlingerLimit") ~= nil then processor = v break end
    end
    return processor
end

-- what the game's data says: worlds (pages) that give an achievement when cleared, levels and episodes that give one
local data
local function scan()
    if data then return data end
    data = {clear = {}, level = {}, stars = {}, score = {}, episodeLimit = {}}
    local seen, skip = {}, {objects = true, _G = true, package = true, settings = true, highscores = true, blockTable = true, loadedObjects = true}
    local function walk(t, key, depth)
        if seen[t] or depth > 4 then return end
        seen[t] = true
        local clear, level = rawget(t, "clear_achievement"), rawget(t, "levelAchievement")
        if type(clear) == "string" then data.clear[trim(clear)] = t end
        if type(level) == "string" then data.level[trim(level)] = key end
        local star, score = rawget(t, "starAchievement"), rawget(t, "scoreAchievement")
        if type(star) == "string" then data.stars[trim(star)] = key end
        if type(score) == "string" then data.score[trim(score)] = key end
        for k, v in next, t do
            if type(v) == "table" and not (depth == 0 and skip[k]) then walk(v, k, depth + 1) end
        end
    end
    walk(env, nil, 0)
    -- the episode list (Classic, Seasons): each world's episode, and each episode's score target by number and by name
    data.episodeOf, data.limitByName, data.clearCount = {}, {}, {}
    if type(env.g_episodes) == "table" then
        for i, ep in ipairs(env.g_episodes) do
            if type(ep) == "table" then
                data.episodeLimit[i] = rawget(ep, "score_achievement_limit")
                if type(rawget(ep, "name")) == "string" then data.limitByName[ep.name] = rawget(ep, "score_achievement_limit") end
                if type(rawget(ep, "pages")) == "table" then
                    for _, pg in ipairs(ep.pages) do
                        if type(pg) == "table" and type(rawget(pg, "clear_achievement")) == "string" and pg.clear_achievement ~= "" then
                            data.episodeOf[pg] = ep
                            data.clearCount[ep] = (data.clearCount[ep] or 0) + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return data
end

local function limit(spec)
    local hours = false
    if string.sub(spec, 1, 2) == "H:" then hours = true spec = string.sub(spec, 3) end
    local kind, rest = string.match(spec, "^(%a):(.*)$")
    local name, default = string.match(rest or "", "^(.-)|(.*)$")
    local v
    if kind == "P" then
        local p = findProcessor()
        if p then v = rawget(p, name) end
    elseif kind == "L" then
        local l = type(env.currentAchievementLimits) == "table" and env.currentAchievementLimits or env.achievementLimits
        if type(l) == "table" then v = l[name] end
    end
    if type(v) ~= "number" then v = _G.tonumber(default) or 0 end
    if hours then return number(v / 3600) end
    return number(v)
end

local function describe(name)
    local n = trim(name)
    if type(env.abAchievementTexts) == "table" and type(env.abAchievementTexts[n]) == "string" then return env.abAchievementTexts[n] end      -- 3.6: a script's own text
    local t = texts[n]
    if t then return (string.gsub(t, "{([^}]+)}", limit)) end
    local d = scan()
    local page = d.clear[n]
    if page then
        -- Seasons names its episodes in English and numbers its levels page by page; Classic numbers them by world (1-1, 2-1 ...)
        local ep = d.episodeOf[page]
        local epName = ep and rawget(ep, "name")
        if type(epName) == "string" and not string.find(epName, "^TEXT_") then
            if (d.clearCount[ep] or 0) > 1 and rawget(page, "display_number") then return "Complete every level of " .. epName .. ", page " .. tostring(page.display_number) .. "." end
            return "Complete every level of " .. epName .. "."
        end
        local w = rawget(page, "world_number")
        if w then return "Complete every level of world " .. tostring(w) .. "." end
        return "Complete every level of its world."
    end
    local ep = string.match(n, "^(.-) %- Total Destruction$") or string.match(n, "^(.-) %- War for the Stars$")
    if ep then return "Earn three stars on every level of " .. ep .. "." end
    ep = string.match(n, "^(.-) %- Score Addict$") or string.match(n, "^(.-) %- Power of the Force$")
    if ep then
        local l = type(env.currentAchievementLimits) == "table" and env.currentAchievementLimits[n] or (type(env.achievementLimits) == "table" and env.achievementLimits[n])
        local i = _G.tonumber(string.match(ep, "^Episode (%d+)$") or "")
        if type(l) ~= "number" and i then l = d.episodeLimit[i] end
        if type(l) ~= "number" then l = d.limitByName[ep] end
        -- Angry Birds HD keeps no limits in its scripts (Game Center checked them): these are the ones it showed
        if type(l) ~= "number" and i and string.sub(n, -12) == "Score Addict" then l = ({4000000, 3300000, 4800000, 3900000})[i] end
        if type(l) == "number" then return "Score " .. number(l) .. " points in total in " .. ep .. "." end
        return "Reach the target score of " .. ep .. "."
    end
    if d.level[n] then return "Beat level " .. tostring(d.level[n]) .. "." end
    return ""
end
env.abAchievementText = describe

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- unlocked or not (the engine's own record, and the games' own where they keep one)
local function unlocked(name)
    local s = env.settings
    if type(s) == "table" then
        if type(s.abAchievements) == "table" and s.abAchievements[name] then return s.abAchievements[name] end
        if type(s.achievements) == "table" and s.achievements[name] then return true end
    end
    local sw = env.SettingsWrapper
    if type(sw) == "table" and type(sw.hasAchievement) == "function" then
        local ok, has = pcall(sw.hasAchievement, sw, name)
        if ok and has then return true end
    end
    return nil
end

local function iconOf(name)
    local a = env.achievements[name]
    local icon = type(a) == "table" and a.icon or nil
    if not icon and type(env.g_achievements) == "table" and type(env.g_achievements[name]) == "table" then icon = env.g_achievements[name].icon end
    local popup = env.achievementPopUpPage      -- Angry Birds HD 1.4.2 keeps them with its pop-up page
    if not icon and type(popup) == "table" and type(rawget(popup, "icons")) == "table" then icon = popup.icons[name] end
    return icon
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the unlock pop-up: the game's own (BannerPopup in Space / Star Wars, AchievementPopup in Classic 2.x / 3.x and Seasons), or a banner
-- drawn the same way where the game has none (Angry Birds HD 1.4.2 showed Crystal's)
local queue = {}
local current
local clock = 0   -- seconds of play, counted from the frames (os.clock is processor time: it hardly moves while the game waits for the screen)
if type(env.achievementsEnabled) == "function" and env.gameCenterEnabled ~= true then env.achievementsEnabled = function() return env.achievements ~= nil end end
env.unlockAchievement = function(id, name)
    name = name or tostring(id)
    for _, q in ipairs(queue) do if q.name == name then return end end
    if type(env.settings) == "table" and type(env.settings.abAchievements) == "table" and env.settings.abAchievements[name] then return end   -- reported before: Game Center shows nothing again
    table.insert(queue, {id = id, name = name, icon = iconOf(name), text = describe(name)})
    if type(env.settings) == "table" then
        if type(env.settings.abAchievements) ~= "table" then env.settings.abAchievements = {} end
        if env.settings.abAchievements[name] == nil then env.settings.abAchievements[name] = _G.os.time() end
    end
    _G.print("Game Center: achievement unlocked: " .. name)
end

local function gamePopup(b)
    local frame = env.notificationsFrame
    if type(frame) ~= "table" or type(frame.addChild) ~= "function" then return false end
    local title = trim(b.name)
    if type(env.BannerPopup) == "table" and type(env.BannerPopup.new) == "function" then
        return pcall(function()
            local box = env.BannerPopup:new(title, b.text, b.icon or env.achievementPlaceholderIcon or "")
            box.name = "achievement"
            frame:addChild(box)
            box:onEntry()
            box:layout()
        end)
    end
    if type(env.showAchievementPopUp) == "function" and type(env.achievementPopUpPage) == "table" then
        -- Classic 1.x / 2.0.0 and HD 1.4.2: the pop-up is a menu page that shows gameCenter.achievements[showPopUpID] when Game Center is on
        local id = b.id or b.name
        if type(env.gameCenter) ~= "table" then env.gameCenter = {} end
        if type(env.gameCenter.achievements) ~= "table" then env.gameCenter.achievements = {} end
        env.gameCenter.achievements[id] = {title = title, achievedText = b.text ~= "" and b.text or "Achievement unlocked", icon = b.icon or "", completed = true}
        env.gameCenter.achievements.showPopUpID = id
        local on = env.gameCenterEnabled
        env.gameCenterEnabled = true
        local ok = pcall(env.showAchievementPopUp)
        env.gameCenterEnabled = on
        return ok
    end
    if type(env.AchievementPopup) == "table" and type(env.AchievementPopup.new) == "function" and b.icon then
        -- it reads gameCenter.achievements[id] (title, achievedText, icon) while it lays itself out
        local id = b.id or b.name
        local gc = env.gameCenter
        local made = gc == nil
        if made then env.gameCenter = {achievements = {}} end
        if type(env.gameCenter.achievements) ~= "table" then env.gameCenter.achievements = {} end
        local old = env.gameCenter.achievements[id]
        env.gameCenter.achievements[id] = {title = title, achievedText = b.text, icon = b.icon, completed = true}
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local box = env.AchievementPopup:new(id)
            box.name = "achievement"
            if type(frame.addTimedChild) == "function" then frame:addTimedChild(box, 2.7) else frame:addChild(box) end
            box:onEntry()
            box:layout()
        end)
        env.gameCenter.achievements[id] = old
        if made then env.gameCenter = nil end
        return ok
    end
    return false
end

local function nextPopup()
    local now = clock
    if current and now - current.since < 3.4 then return end
    current = nil
    local b = table.remove(queue, 1)
    if not b then return end
    b.since = now
    b.own = not gamePopup(b)
    current = b
end

local function text(str, tx, ty, size, va, ha, alpha)
    local res = _G.res
    local fh = (res.getFontHeight and res.getFontHeight()) or size
    local k = size / math.max(fh, 1)
    env.setRenderState(0, 0, k, k, 0, 0, 0, alpha or 1)
    res.drawString("", str, tx / k, ty / k, va, ha)
    env.setRenderState()
end
local function font(headline)
    local f = headline and ((env.getFontHeadline and env.getFontHeadline()) or env.FONT_HEADLINE) or nil
    f = f or (env.getFontBasic and env.getFontBasic()) or env.FONT_BASIC or "FONT_BASIC"
    if not pcall(_G.res.useFont, f) then pcall(_G.res.useFont, "FONT_BASIC") end
end
local function icon(name, x, y, size, alpha)
    local res = _G.res
    if not (name and res.getSpriteBounds) then return false end
    local iw, ih = res.getSpriteBounds(name)
    if not (iw and iw > 0) then return false end
    local k = size / math.max(iw, ih)
    env.setRenderState(0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, alpha or 1)
    res.drawSprite(name, x + (size - iw * k) / 2, y + (size - ih * k) / 2, "TOP", "LEFT", iw * k, ih * k)
    env.setRenderState()
    return true
end

-- a stamp for an achievement whose icon the game does not have (Angry Birds HD 1.4.2 ships none: Crystal sent them): a gold badge
-- with the world number, E and the episode number, or the initials of the name
local worldOf = {["Herr Helmet"] = 1, ["Mr Moustache"] = 2, ["Defeat of The King"] = 3, ["The Imposter"] = 4, ["The Mysterious Escape"] = 5,
    ["Hovering Helmet"] = 6, ["Mounting Moustache"] = 7, ["Green Baron"] = 8, ["Hardhat Hidalgo"] = 9, ["Mason Moustache"] = 10, ["Royal Ringleader"] = 11}
local function stamp(name, x, y, size)
    local n = trim(tostring(name or ""))
    local label = worldOf[n] and tostring(worldOf[n]) or nil
    if not label then local e = string.match(n, "^Episode (%d+)") if e then label = "E" .. e end end
    if not label then
        label = ""
        for w in string.gmatch(n, "%a+") do if #label < 2 then label = label .. string.upper(string.sub(w, 1, 1)) end end
    end
    env.drawRect(0.55, 0.36, 0.05, 1, x, y, x + size, y + size, false)
    env.drawRect(0.98, 0.78, 0.2, 1, x + size * 0.07, y + size * 0.07, x + size * 0.93, y + size * 0.93, false)
    env.drawRect(1, 0.9, 0.45, 1, x + size * 0.07, y + size * 0.07, x + size * 0.93, y + size * 0.4, false)
    font(true)
    text(label, x + size / 2, y + size / 2, size * (#label > 1 and 0.5 or 0.62), "VCENTER", "HCENTER")
    return true
end

-- the first of these sprites the game has (0 x 0 when it has none, or its sheet is not loaded)
local function sprite(names)
    local res = _G.res
    if not res.getSpriteBounds then return nil end
    for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        local ok, w, h = pcall(res.getSpriteBounds, n)
        if ok and w and w > 0 and h and h > 0 then return n, w, h end
    end
end
local function useFont(names)
    for _, f in ipairs(names) do if f and pcall(_G.res.useFont, f) then return end end
end

-- a pop-up for a made-up achievement, to see how they look: nothing is recorded
env.abTestAchievement = function()
    local any
    for name in pairs(env.achievements) do if type(name) == "string" and iconOf(name) then any = name break end end
    table.insert(queue, {id = "abTest", name = "Test Achievement", icon = any and iconOf(any), text = "Not a real one: this only shows the pop-up."})
end

env.abDrawBanner = function()
    local b = current
    if not (b and b.own) then return end
    local t = clock - b.since
    if t > 3.4 then return end
    local sw, sh = env.screenWidth or 1024, env.screenHeight or 768
    local h = math.max(64, sh * 0.15)
    local w = math.min(sw * 0.62, h * 4.6)
    local slide = math.min(t / 0.3, 1, (3.4 - t) / 0.3)
    local x, y = sw - w - sh * 0.02, sh - h * slide - sh * 0.02 * slide   -- from the bottom right corner, as the phone's pop-up
    local L, lw, lh = sprite({"ACHIEVEMENT_BG_LEFT"})
    local M = sprite({"ACHIEVEMENT_BG_MIDDLE"})
    local R, rw = sprite({"ACHIEVEMENT_BG_RIGHT"})
    if L and M and R then
        -- the game's own pop-up pieces (Classic's ACHIEVEMENT_BG_LEFT / MIDDLE / RIGHT): title along the top, icon, text below it
        local k = h / lh
        local res = _G.res
        env.setRenderState()
        res.drawSprite(L, x, y, "TOP", "LEFT", lw * k, h)
        res.drawSprite(M, x + lw * k, y, "TOP", "LEFT", math.max(0, w - (lw + rw) * k), h)
        res.drawSprite(R, x + w - rw * k, y, "TOP", "LEFT", rw * k, h)
        useFont({"FONT_GAMECENTER_BASIC", env.getFontBasic and env.getFontBasic(), env.FONT_BASIC, "FONT_BASIC"})
        text(trim(b.name), x + w / 2, y + h * 0.1, h * 0.26, "TOP", "HCENTER")
        local tx = x + w * 0.08
        if icon(b.icon, tx, y + h * 0.38, h * 0.48) or stamp(b.name, tx, y + h * 0.38, h * 0.48) then tx = tx + h * 0.58 end
        useFont({"FONT_GAMECENTER_BASIC", env.getFontBasic and env.getFontBasic(), env.FONT_BASIC, "FONT_BASIC"})
        local str = b.text ~= "" and b.text or "Achievement unlocked"
        local size = h * 0.22
        if res.getStringWidth then
            local fh = (res.getFontHeight and res.getFontHeight()) or size
            local width = res.getStringWidth(str) * size / math.max(fh, 1)
            if width > x + w - tx - h * 0.15 then size = size * (x + w - tx - h * 0.15) / width end
        end
        text(str, tx, y + h * 0.66, size, "VCENTER", "LEFT")
        return
    end
    local head = h * 0.36
    env.drawRect(0.85, 0.82, 0.3, 1, x - 3, y - 3, x + w + 3, y + h + 3, false)
    env.drawRect(0.05, 0.3, 0.33, 0.97, x, y, x + w, y + h, false)
    env.drawRect(0.09, 0.42, 0.45, 1, x, y, x + w, y + head, false)
    env.drawRect(0.6, 0.85, 0.85, 0.6, x, y + head - 1, x + w, y + head + 1, false)
    font(true)
    text(string.upper(trim(b.name)), x + w / 2, y + head * 0.52, head * 0.62, "VCENTER", "HCENTER")
    local tx = x + h * 0.15
    if icon(b.icon, tx, y + head + (h - head - h * 0.52) / 2, h * 0.52) or stamp(b.name, tx, y + head + (h - head - h * 0.52) / 2, h * 0.52) then tx = tx + h * 0.62 end
    font(false)
    local str = b.text ~= "" and b.text or "Achievement unlocked"
    local size = (h - head) * 0.34
    local res = _G.res
    if res.getStringWidth then
        local fh = (res.getFontHeight and res.getFontHeight()) or size
        local width = res.getStringWidth(str) * size / math.max(fh, 1)
        if width > x + w - tx - h * 0.12 then size = size * (x + w - tx - h * 0.12) / width end
    end
    text(str, tx, y + head + (h - head) * 0.5, size, "VCENTER", "LEFT")
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the page: a scrolling list like the Windows Phone port's, with a back arrow, "n / m achieved" and a row per achievement. It scrolls
-- smoothly (a drag carries on and slows down, the wheel and the keys glide) and gives the game no input while it is open
local page = {open = false, scroll = 0, target = 0, items = {}}
env.abAchPage = page

local function list()
    local l = {}
    for name in pairs(env.achievements) do
        if type(name) == "string" then l[#l + 1] = {name = name, title = trim(name), icon = iconOf(name), text = describe(name)} end
    end
    table.sort(l, function(a, b)
        local ua, ub = unlocked(a.name) and 1 or 0, unlocked(b.name) and 1 or 0
        if ua ~= ub then return ua > ub end
        return a.title < b.title
    end)
    return l
end
local function geometry()
    local sw, sh = env.screenWidth or 1024, env.screenHeight or 768
    local head = math.max(56, sh * 0.16)
    local row = math.max(48, sh * 0.135)
    local w = math.min(sw, sh * 1.6)
    local x = (sw - w) / 2
    return sw, sh, x, w, head, row
end
local function most()
    local sw, sh, x, w, head, row = geometry()
    return math.max(0, #page.items * row - (sh - head))
end

page.show = function()
    page.open = true
    page.scroll, page.target, page.vel, page.drag = 0, 0, 0, nil
    page.items = list()
end
page.close = function()
    if not page.open then return end
    page.open = false
    if type(env.crystalUiDeactivated) == "function" then pcall(env.crystalUiDeactivated) end   -- HD 1.4.2: the player closed Crystal
end
env.showAchievements = page.show
-- Angry Birds HD 1.4.2: the gem button (startCrystal) opened Chillingo's Crystal, whose main page was the achievement list
env.activateCrystalUI = page.show
env.activateCrystalUIAtProfile = page.show
env.deactivateCrystalUI = function() page.open = false end
env.isCrystalUIShowing = function() return page.open end
env.userEnabledCrystal = function() return true end

env.abAchievementInput = function()
    clock = clock + math.min(env.abFrameDt or 1 / 60, 0.1)
    nextPopup()
    local kp, kr, kh = env.keyPressed, env.keyReleased, env.keyHold
    if not page.open then
        if type(kp) == "table" and kp.F7 then kp.F7 = nil page.show() else return end
    end
    local sw, sh, x, w, head, row = geometry()
    local dt = math.min(env.abFrameDt or 1 / 60, 0.1)
    local c = env.cursor or {}
    local cx, cy = c.x or 0, c.y or 0
    if type(kp) == "table" then
        if kp.ESCAPE or kp.F7 or kp.BACKSPACE then page.close() end
        if kp.UP then page.target = page.target - row end
        if kp.DOWN then page.target = page.target + row end
        if kp.PAGEUP then page.target = page.target - (sh - head) end
        if kp.PAGEDOWN then page.target = page.target + (sh - head) end
        if kp.HOME then page.target = 0 end
        if kp.END then page.target = most() end
        if kp.T then page.close() env.abTestAchievement() end
        if kp.LBUTTON then
            if cy < head and cx < x + head * 1.2 then page.close()
            elseif cy < head and cx > x + w - head * 2.2 then page.close() env.abTestAchievement()   -- the "test pop-up" button
            else page.drag = {y = cy, scroll = page.scroll, last = cy, moved = 0} page.vel = 0 end
        end
    end
    if c.wheelTriggered and c.wheel and c.wheel ~= 0 then page.target = page.target - c.wheel / math.abs(c.wheel) * row * 1.5 end
    if page.drag and type(kh) == "table" and kh.LBUTTON then
        local d = page.drag
        page.scroll = d.scroll - (cy - d.y)
        if page.scroll < 0 then page.scroll = page.scroll * 0.5 end                  -- pulled past an end: it gives a little
        if page.scroll > most() then page.scroll = most() + (page.scroll - most()) * 0.5 end
        page.vel = (page.vel or 0) * 0.6 + (-(cy - d.last) / math.max(dt, 1 / 240)) * 0.4
        d.last = cy
        page.target = page.scroll
    elseif page.drag then
        page.drag = nil
        page.target = page.scroll + (page.vel or 0) * 0.32                           -- the flick carries on and slows down
        page.vel = 0
    end
    page.target = math.max(0, math.min(page.target, most()))
    if not page.drag then page.scroll = page.scroll + (page.target - page.scroll) * math.min(1, dt * 9) end
    -- the game sees no key, click or touch while the page is open (or on the frame it closes)
    for _, t in ipairs({kp, kr, kh, env.touches}) do if type(t) == "table" then for k in pairs(t) do t[k] = nil end end end
    if c.wheelTriggered ~= nil then c.wheelTriggered = false c.wheel = 0 end
    if env.touchcount then env.touchcount = 0 end
end

env.abDrawAchievements = function()
    if not page.open then return end
    local sw, sh, x, w, head, row = geometry()
    local got = 0
    for _, it in ipairs(page.items) do if unlocked(it.name) then got = got + 1 end end
    env.drawRect(0.03, 0.2, 0.24, 1, 0, 0, sw, sh, false)
    -- rows
    local first = math.max(1, math.floor(page.scroll / row) + 1)
    for i = first, #page.items do
        local it = page.items[i]
        local ry = head + (i - 1) * row - page.scroll
        if ry > sh then break end
        local when = unlocked(it.name)
        local shade = i % 2 == 0 and 0.08 or 0
        env.drawRect(0.1 + shade, 0.52 + shade, 0.58 + shade, 1, x, ry, x + w, ry + row - 2, false)
        local size = row * 0.7
        local ix = x + row * 0.25
        if not (when and (icon(it.icon, ix, ry + (row - size) / 2, size) or stamp(it.name, ix, ry + (row - size) / 2, size))) then
            font(true)
            text("?", ix + size / 2, ry + row / 2, size * 0.8, "VCENTER", "HCENTER", 0.45)
        end
        local tx = ix + size + row * 0.3
        font(true)
        text(it.title, tx, ry + row * 0.36, row * 0.3, "VCENTER", "LEFT")
        font(false)
        if it.text ~= "" then text(it.text, tx, ry + row * 0.72, row * 0.2, "VCENTER", "LEFT", 0.85) end
        local status = "Locked"
        if type(when) == "number" then status = _G.os.date("%Y-%m-%d", when) elseif when then status = "Unlocked" end
        text(status, x + w - row * 0.3, ry + row * 0.5, row * 0.2, "VCENTER", "RIGHT", when and 1 or 0.6)
    end
    -- scroll bar
    local m = most()
    if m > 0 then
        local track = sh - head
        local bar = math.max(row * 0.5, track * track / (track + m))
        local by = head + (track - bar) * math.max(0, math.min(1, page.scroll / m))
        env.drawRect(1, 1, 1, 0.75, x + w - 7, by + 4, x + w - 3, by + bar - 4, false)
    end
    -- header with the back arrow
    env.drawRect(0.02, 0.27, 0.32, 1, 0, 0, sw, head, false)
    env.drawRect(0.5, 0.8, 0.82, 0.5, 0, head - 2, sw, head, false)
    local b = head * 0.72
    local bx, by = x + head * 0.18, (head - b) / 2
    -- the "test pop-up" button at the right
    local tw = head * 1.9
    env.drawRect(0.55, 0.38, 0.05, 1, x + w - tw - head * 0.18 - 2, by + b * 0.15 - 2, x + w - head * 0.18 + 2, by + b * 0.85 + 2, false)
    env.drawRect(0.99, 0.8, 0.22, 1, x + w - tw - head * 0.18, by + b * 0.15, x + w - head * 0.18, by + b * 0.85, false)
    font(true)
    text("TEST POP-UP", x + w - head * 0.18 - tw / 2, head / 2, b * 0.3, "VCENTER", "HCENTER")
    -- the game's own back button (Classic: LS_BACK_BUTTON in BUTTONS_SHEET_1), or one drawn like it
    local back, bw, bh = sprite({"LS_BACK_BUTTON", "BTN_BACK", "BUTTON_BACK", "BACK_BUTTON"})
    if back then
        -- at the size the game's own menus draw it (its picture has a wide clear margin, so it is not fitted to the bar)
        local k = math.min(sh / 768, head * 1.25 / bh)
        env.setRenderState(0, 0, k, k, 0, 0, 0, 1)
        _G.res.drawSprite(back, x / k, (head * 0.92 - bh * k) / k, "TOP", "LEFT")   -- its button sits at the bottom of the picture
        env.setRenderState()
        b = 0
    end
    if b > 0 then
    env.drawRect(0.55, 0.38, 0.05, 1, bx - 2, by - 2, bx + b + 2, by + b + 2, false)
    env.drawRect(0.99, 0.8, 0.22, 1, bx, by, bx + b, by + b, false)
    -- the arrow: a bar and a head made of thin slices (the 2D drawing has no triangles)
    local cxm, cym, l = bx + b / 2, by + b / 2, b * 0.3
    local t = b * 0.11
    env.drawRect(1, 1, 1, 1, cxm - l * 0.35, cym - t / 2, cxm + l, cym + t / 2, false)
    local steps = 24
    for i = 0, steps - 1 do
        local f0, f1 = i / steps, (i + 1) / steps
        local half = l * 0.75 * f1
        env.drawRect(1, 1, 1, 1, cxm - l + l * 0.85 * f0, cym - half, cxm - l + l * 0.85 * f1, cym + half, false)
    end
    end
    font(true)
    text("ACHIEVEMENTS", sw / 2, head * 0.36, head * 0.3, "VCENTER", "HCENTER")
    font(false)
    text(got .. " / " .. #page.items .. " achieved", sw / 2, head * 0.72, head * 0.2, "VCENTER", "HCENTER")
    env.setRenderState()
end

#include <cstdio>
#include "lua/aes.h"
#include "lua/sevenzip.h"
#include "lua/dec_folder.h"
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

namespace ab {

const char kLevelKey[33] = "USCaPQpA4TSNVxMI1v9SK9UC0yZuAnb2";
const char kSeasonsKey[33] = "zePhest5faQuX2S2Apre@4reChAtEvUt";   // Game+0x31c in Angry Birds Seasons
const char kSpaceKey[33] = "RmgdZ0JenLFgWwkYvCL2lSahFbEhFec4";   // Angry Birds Space scripts (found by the community; every Space .lua decrypts to Lua 5.1 bytecode)
const char kSaveKey[33] = "44iUY5aTrlaYoet9lapRlaK1Ehlec5i0";
const char kSpaceSaveKey[33] = "TpeczKQL07HVdPbVUhAr6FjUsmRctyc5";     // Space save files (the exe builds it byte by byte at 0x496180)
const char kStarWarsKey[33] = "An8t3mn8U6spiQ0zHHr3a1loDrRa3mtE";   // Angry Birds Star Wars scripts: AES, then a 7z archive (LZMA) holding the compiled script
const char kStarWars2Key[33] = "B0pm3TAlzkN9ghzoe2NizEllPdN0hQni";  // Angry Birds Star Wars II scripts, same container
const char kFriendsKey[33] = "EJRbcWh81YG4YzjfLAPMssAnnzxQaDn1";   // Angry Birds Friends scripts: AES, then a 7z archive (found in the AB360 LUA Manager's key list)
const char kStellaKey1[33] = "4FzZOae60yAmxTClzdgfcr4BAbPIgj7X";   // Angry Birds Stella: three keys (which one belongs to the scripts was not known; all three are tried)
const char kStellaKey2[33] = "0xMizJJUh7BbwmYhqxpJ038x8YGvk6aU";
const char kStellaKey3[33] = "Bll3qkcy5fKrNVxZqtkFH19Ojn2sdJFu";
const char kStarWarsSaveKey[33] = "e83Tph0R3aZ2jGK6eS91uLvQpL33vzNi";   // Star Wars save files (built byte by byte in the exe, like Space's)
const char kSeasonsSaveKey[33] = "brU4u=EbR4s_A3APu6U#7B!axAm*We#5";   // Seasons settings.lua / highscores.lua

namespace {

uint8_t sbox[256], inv[256];
uint8_t m9[256], m11[256], m13[256], m14[256];   // InvMixColumns multipliers (decrypting 90 KB of blocks.lua took seconds without them)

uint8_t Mul2(uint8_t x) { return (uint8_t)((x << 1) ^ ((x & 0x80) ? 0x1b : 0)); }

uint8_t Mul(uint8_t a, uint8_t b) {
    uint8_t r = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        if (b & 1) r ^= a;
        a = Mul2(a);
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

// The S-box: multiplicative inverse in GF(2^8), then the affine transform.
void InitTables() {
    static bool done = false;
    if (done) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        uint8_t x = 0;
        if (i) for (int j = 1; j < 256; j++) if (Mul((uint8_t)i, (uint8_t)j) == 1) { x = (uint8_t)j; break; }
        uint8_t s = x;
        for (int k = 1; k <= 4; k++) s ^= (uint8_t)((x << k) | (x >> (8 - k)));
        s ^= 0x63;
        sbox[i] = s;
        inv[s] = (uint8_t)i;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        m9[i] = Mul((uint8_t)i, 9); m11[i] = Mul((uint8_t)i, 11); m13[i] = Mul((uint8_t)i, 13); m14[i] = Mul((uint8_t)i, 14);
    }
    done = true;
}

// key expansion: 15 round keys of 16 bytes
void ExpandKey(const uint8_t key[32], uint8_t w[240]) {
    InitTables();
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) w[i] = key[i];
    uint8_t rcon = 1;
    for (int i = 8; i < 60; i++) {
        uint8_t t[4] = {w[(i - 1) * 4], w[(i - 1) * 4 + 1], w[(i - 1) * 4 + 2], w[(i - 1) * 4 + 3]};
        if (i % 8 == 0) {
            uint8_t first = t[0];
            t[0] = (uint8_t)(sbox[t[1]] ^ rcon); t[1] = sbox[t[2]]; t[2] = sbox[t[3]]; t[3] = sbox[first];
            rcon = Mul2(rcon);
        } else if (i % 8 == 4) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) t[j] = sbox[t[j]];
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) w[i * 4 + j] = (uint8_t)(w[(i - 8) * 4 + j] ^ t[j]);
    }
}

}  // namespace

bool AesDecryptCbc(const uint8_t key[32], const std::vector<uint8_t>& in, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    if (in.empty() || in.size() % 16 != 0) return false;
    uint8_t w[240];
    ExpandKey(key, w);

    out.resize(in.size());
    uint8_t prev[16] = {0};
    for (size_t pos = 0; pos < in.size(); pos += 16) {
        uint8_t s[16];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s[i] = (uint8_t)(in[pos + i] ^ w[14 * 16 + i]);
        for (int round = 13; round >= 0; round--) {
            // inverse shift rows (state is column major: s[col * 4 + row])
            uint8_t t[16];
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++)
                for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) t[((c + r) % 4) * 4 + r] = s[c * 4 + r];
            for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s[i] = (uint8_t)(inv[t[i]] ^ w[round * 16 + i]);
            if (round > 0) {
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                    uint8_t a0 = s[c * 4], a1 = s[c * 4 + 1], a2 = s[c * 4 + 2], a3 = s[c * 4 + 3];
                    s[c * 4]     = (uint8_t)(m14[a0] ^ m11[a1] ^ m13[a2] ^ m9[a3]);
                    s[c * 4 + 1] = (uint8_t)(m9[a0] ^ m14[a1] ^ m11[a2] ^ m13[a3]);
                    s[c * 4 + 2] = (uint8_t)(m13[a0] ^ m9[a1] ^ m14[a2] ^ m11[a3]);
                    s[c * 4 + 3] = (uint8_t)(m11[a0] ^ m13[a1] ^ m9[a2] ^ m14[a3]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { out[pos + i] = (uint8_t)(s[i] ^ prev[i]); prev[i] = in[pos + i]; }
    }
    uint8_t pad = out.back();
    if (pad == 0 || pad > 16) return false;
    for (int i = 0; i < pad; i++) if (out[out.size() - 1 - i] != pad) return false;
    out.resize(out.size() - pad);
    return true;
}

void AesEncryptCbc(const uint8_t key[32], const std::vector<uint8_t>& in, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    uint8_t w[240];
    ExpandKey(key, w);
    std::vector<uint8_t> data = in;
    uint8_t pad = (uint8_t)(16 - data.size() % 16);
    data.insert(data.end(), pad, pad);
    out.resize(data.size());
    uint8_t prev[16] = {0};
    for (size_t pos = 0; pos < data.size(); pos += 16) {
        uint8_t s[16];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s[i] = (uint8_t)(data[pos + i] ^ prev[i] ^ w[i]);
        for (int round = 1; round <= 14; round++) {
            uint8_t t[16];
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++)
                for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) t[c * 4 + r] = sbox[s[((c + r) % 4) * 4 + r]];   // sub bytes + shift rows
            if (round < 14) {
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                    uint8_t a0 = t[c * 4], a1 = t[c * 4 + 1], a2 = t[c * 4 + 2], a3 = t[c * 4 + 3];
                    s[c * 4]     = (uint8_t)(Mul2(a0) ^ (Mul2(a1) ^ a1) ^ a2 ^ a3);
                    s[c * 4 + 1] = (uint8_t)(a0 ^ Mul2(a1) ^ (Mul2(a2) ^ a2) ^ a3);
                    s[c * 4 + 2] = (uint8_t)(a0 ^ a1 ^ Mul2(a2) ^ (Mul2(a3) ^ a3));
                    s[c * 4 + 3] = (uint8_t)((Mul2(a0) ^ a0) ^ a1 ^ a2 ^ Mul2(a3));
                }
            } else {
                for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s[i] = t[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) s[i] ^= w[round * 16 + i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { out[pos + i] = s[i]; prev[i] = s[i]; }
    }
}

static bool g_spaceFamily = false;
void SetSaveFamilySpace(bool space) { g_spaceFamily = space; }

#ifdef _WIN32
extern "C" __declspec(dllimport) int __stdcall MoveFileExA(const char* from, const char* to, unsigned long flags);
#endif

bool WriteFileSafely(const std::string& path, const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes) {
    std::string tmp = path + ".tmp";
    FILE* f = std::fopen(tmp.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!f) return false;
    bool ok = bytes.empty() || std::fwrite(bytes.data(), 1, bytes.size(), f) == bytes.size();
    ok = (std::fflush(f) == 0) && ok;
    ok = (std::fclose(f) == 0) && ok;
    if (!ok) { std::remove(tmp.c_str()); return false; }
    if (FILE* in = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb")) {                 // the last good file stays as <path>.bak
        std::vector<uint8_t> old;
        uint8_t buf[4096];
        size_t n;
        while ((n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), in)) > 0) old.insert(old.end(), buf, buf + n);
        std::fclose(in);
        if (!old.empty()) if (FILE* b = std::fopen((path + ".bak").c_str(), "wb")) { std::fwrite(old.data(), 1, old.size(), b); std::fclose(b); }
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    ok = MoveFileExA(tmp.c_str(), path.c_str(), 0x1 | 0x8) != 0;         // MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH
#else
    ok = std::rename(tmp.c_str(), path.c_str()) == 0;
#endif
    if (!ok) std::remove(tmp.c_str());
    return ok;
}

bool ReadSaveFile(const std::string& path, std::string& text, bool& encrypted, const char** keyUsed) {
    std::ifstream f(path.c_str(), std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return false;
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()), plain;
    encrypted = false;
    if (keyUsed) *keyUsed = kSaveKey;
    const char* keys[] = {kSaveKey, kSeasonsSaveKey, kSpaceSaveKey, kStarWarsSaveKey};
    const char* foundKey = nullptr;
    for (size_t k = 0; k < 4 && !encrypted; k++) {
        if (!AesDecryptCbc((const uint8_t*)keys[k], bytes, plain)) continue;
        encrypted = true;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < plain.size() && i < 64; i++)
            if (plain[i] < 0x20 && plain[i] != '\t' && plain[i] != '\n' && plain[i] != '\r') encrypted = false;
        if (encrypted) { foundKey = keys[k]; if (keyUsed) *keyUsed = keys[k]; }
    }
    // a Space or Star Wars save in the folder of an older game (saves written by the wrong game): its tables do not fit these scripts
    // (settings.playtime is a table per device there), so it is kept as <file>.original and the game starts with empty saves
    if (encrypted && !g_spaceFamily && (foundKey == kSpaceSaveKey || foundKey == kStarWarsSaveKey)) {
        std::ifstream probe((path + ".original").c_str(), std::ios::binary);
        if (!probe) { std::ofstream keep((path + ".original").c_str(), std::ios::binary); keep.write((const char*)bytes.data(), (std::streamsize)bytes.size()); }
        encrypted = false; bytes.clear(); plain.clear();
        text.clear();
        return true;
    }
    if (encrypted) bytes = plain;
    else if (!bytes.empty() && bytes.size() % 16 == 0) {
        // not text and no known save key opens it (a game whose save key is not known yet): it is somebody's real save, so it is
        // kept as <file>.original and the game starts with empty saves instead of choking on the cipher text
        bool binary = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes.size() && i < 64; i++)
            if (bytes[i] < 0x20 && bytes[i] != '\t' && bytes[i] != '\n' && bytes[i] != '\r') binary = true;
        if (binary) {
            std::ifstream probe((path + ".original").c_str(), std::ios::binary);
            if (!probe) { std::ofstream keep((path + ".original").c_str(), std::ios::binary); keep.write((const char*)bytes.data(), (std::streamsize)bytes.size()); }
            bytes.clear();
        }
    }
    text.assign(bytes.begin(), bytes.end());
    return true;
}

bool ReadLuaFile(const std::string& path, std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes) {
    if (ReadDecOverride(path, bytes)) return true;       // --use-dec: an edited plain copy in the dec folder wins
    std::ifstream f(path.c_str(), std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return false;
    bytes.assign(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    std::vector<uint8_t> plain;
    const char* keys[] = {kLevelKey, kSeasonsKey, kSpaceKey, kStarWarsKey, kStarWars2Key, kFriendsKey, kStellaKey1, kStellaKey2, kStellaKey3};
    const size_t kKeys = 9;
    static size_t firstKey = 0;                  // the key that worked last time goes first: a wrong key costs a whole file
    for (size_t n = 0; n < kKeys; n++) {
        size_t k = (n + firstKey) % kKeys;
        if (!AesDecryptCbc((const uint8_t*)keys[k], bytes, plain) || plain.size() <= 4) continue;
        // the decrypted file is either bytecode (starts with 0x1b) or plain Lua text; a file that was
        // not encrypted at all (or a wrong key) turns into noise, which has control characters near the start
        bool text = true;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < plain.size() && i < 64; i++)
            if (plain[i] < 0x20 && plain[i] != '\t' && plain[i] != '\n' && plain[i] != '\r') text = false;
        if (plain.size() > 6 && plain[0] == '7' && plain[1] == 'z' && plain[2] == 0xBC && plain[3] == 0xAF) {   // Star Wars: a 7z archive with the script inside
            std::vector<uint8_t> unpacked;
            if (SevenZipExtractFirst(plain, unpacked)) { bytes = unpacked; firstKey = k; break; }
            continue;
        }
        if (plain[0] == 0x1b || text) { bytes = plain; firstKey = k; break; }
    }
    return true;
}

}  // namespace ab

// AES-256 decryption in CBC mode with a zero IV and PKCS#7 padding: the cipher the exe uses for
// its level files (and the *_1.lua scripts). Key: the 32 characters the Game constructor writes at
// this+0x2c4 (0x4058d2..0x405a43), see kLevelKey. Decrypted levels are Lua 5.1 bytecode.
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace ab {

extern const char kLevelKey[33];
// Key of the save files (settings.lua, highscores.lua written with saveLuaFile(..., appData = true)):
// the string the Game constructor writes at this+0x2b8.
extern const char kSaveKey[33];
// Script key of Angry Birds Seasons.
extern const char kSeasonsKey[33];
// Script key of Angry Birds Space.
extern const char kSpaceKey[33];
extern const char kSeasonsSaveKey[33];
// Script keys of Angry Birds Star Wars and Star Wars II (the decrypted file is a 7z archive).
extern const char kStarWarsKey[33];
extern const char kStarWars2Key[33];
// Script key of Angry Birds Friends (same container: AES, then 7z).
extern const char kFriendsKey[33];
// Save key of Angry Birds Space (settings.lua, highscores.lua, bi_data.lua, ...): built by the exe at 0x496180 next to the script key at 0x4960a0.
extern const char kSpaceSaveKey[33];
extern const char kStarWarsSaveKey[33];

// Returns false when the size is not a multiple of 16 or the padding is wrong.
bool AesDecryptCbc(const uint8_t key[32], const std::vector<uint8_t>& in, std::vector<uint8_t>& out);

// Encrypts with the same cipher (zero IV, PKCS#7 padding added here).
void AesEncryptCbc(const uint8_t key[32], const std::vector<uint8_t>& in, std::vector<uint8_t>& out);

// Reads a save file. `encrypted` tells whether it was an original encrypted one (decrypts with kSaveKey
// to text); otherwise the text is the file as it is. Returns false when the file cannot be opened.
void SetSaveFamilySpace(bool space);   // Space and Star Wars saves are read only by those games
// Writes a save file so that a crash or a closed window cannot leave half a file: the bytes go to <path>.tmp first, the previous file is kept as <path>.bak, then the new file replaces the old one in one step
bool WriteFileSafely(const std::string& path, const std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes);
bool ReadSaveFile(const std::string& path, std::string& text, bool& encrypted, const char** keyUsed = nullptr);

// Reads a Lua file. If it is an encrypted one (it decrypts with kLevelKey to Lua bytecode or to plain
// Lua text) the decrypted content is returned, otherwise the file as it is (plain text or plain
// bytecode). Returns false when the file cannot be opened.
bool ReadLuaFile(const std::string& path, std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes);

}  // namespace ab
