```cpp
#include "lua/dec_folder.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>
#include <vector>

#include "lua/aes.h"
extern "C" {
#include "lauxlib.h"
#include "lua.h"
}

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <direct.h>
#else
#include <dirent.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <ctime>
#endif

namespace ab {

namespace {

std::string g_dataRoot, g_decRoot;

std::string Slashes(std::string s) {
    for (char& c : s) if (c == '\\') c = '/';
    while (s.size() > 1 && s.back() == '/') s.pop_back();
    return s;
}

// names of the entries of a folder, folders with a trailing '/'
std::vector<std::string> List(const std::string& dir) {
    std::vector<std::string> names;
#ifdef _WIN32
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA f;
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA((dir + "/*").c_str(), &f);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return names;
    do {
        std::string n = f.cFileName;
        if (n == "." || n == "..") continue;
        names.push_back((f.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) ? n + "/" : n);
    } while (FindNextFileA(h, &f));
    FindClose(h);
#else
    DIR* d = opendir(dir.c_str());
    if (!d) return names;
    while (dirent* e = readdir(d)) {
        std::string n = e->d_name;
        if (n == "." || n == "..") continue;
        struct stat st;
        bool isDir = stat((dir + "/" + n).c_str(), &st) == 0 && S_ISDIR(st.st_mode);
        names.push_back(isDir ? n + "/" : n);
    }
    closedir(d);
#endif
    return names;
}

bool EndsWith(const std::string& s, const char* tail) {
    size_t n = std::char_traits<char>::length(tail);
    return s.size() >= n && s.compare(s.size() - n, n, tail) == 0;
}

void MakeDirectory(const std::string& path) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _mkdir(path.c_str());
#else
    mkdir(path.c_str(), 0755);
#endif
}

void MakePath(const std::string& dir) {          // every folder of the path
    for (size_t i = 1; i <= dir.size(); i++)
        if (i == dir.size() || dir[i] == '/') MakeDirectory(dir.substr(0, i));
}

bool FileExists(const std::string& p) { std::ifstream f(p.c_str(), std::ios::binary); return (bool)f; }

// Runs a shell command and waits at most `seconds` for it (0: as long as it takes). Returns the exit code, or -1 when the time ran out and the command (and
// everything it started) was killed. v3.3: unluac 1.2.2 never finishes on some scripts (Seasons 4.1.0's scripts/menu_flow.lua is one: it loops for ever on a
// loop it cannot rebuild), and the run waited for it for ever, so the second decompiler (unluac-alt, which does finish) never got its turn.
int RunWithTimeout(const std::string& cmd, int seconds) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    HANDLE job = CreateJobObjectA(nullptr, nullptr);
    if (job) {
        JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION info = {};
        info.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE;       // closing the job kills java too, not only cmd.exe
        SetInformationJobObject(job, JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, &info, sizeof(info));
    }
    std::string line = "cmd.exe /c " + cmd;
    std::vector<char> buf(line.begin(), line.end());
    buf.push_back(0);
    STARTUPINFOA si = {};
    si.cb = sizeof(si);
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi = {};
    if (!CreateProcessA(nullptr, buf.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_SUSPENDED | CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi)) { if (job) CloseHandle(job); return std::system(cmd.c_str()); }
    if (job) AssignProcessToJobObject(job, pi.hProcess);
    ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
    DWORD wait = WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, seconds > 0 ? (DWORD)seconds * 1000 : INFINITE);
    int rc = -1;
    if (wait == WAIT_OBJECT_0) { DWORD code = 1; GetExitCodeProcess(pi.hProcess, &code); rc = (int)code; }
    else if (job) TerminateJobObject(job, 1); else TerminateProcess(pi.hProcess, 1);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread); CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    if (job) CloseHandle(job);
    return rc;
#else
    pid_t pid = fork();
    if (pid < 0) return std::system(cmd.c_str());
    if (pid == 0) { setsid(); execl("/bin/sh", "sh", "-c", cmd.c_str(), (char*)nullptr); _exit(127); }
    const time_t start = time(nullptr);
    for (;;) {
        int status = 0;
        pid_t r = waitpid(pid, &status, WNOHANG);
        if (r == pid) return WIFEXITED(status) ? WEXITSTATUS(status) : 1;
        if (r < 0) return 1;
        if (seconds > 0 && time(nullptr) - start >= seconds) { kill(-pid, SIGKILL); waitpid(pid, &status, 0); return -1; }
        usleep(50000);
    }
#endif
}

// `java -jar unluac.jar in > out`: true if the output is not empty. AB_DEC_TIMEOUT=<seconds> changes how long one try may take (default 90, 0: no limit);
// a script that a decompiler cannot finish in that time is given up on and the next decompiler tries it.
bool Decompile(const std::string& jar, const std::string& in, const std::string& out, const std::string& err) {
    // -Xmx / -Xss: the big scripts need more memory and a deeper stack than Java gives by default
    std::string cmd = "java -Xmx1g -Xss64m -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError -jar \"" + jar + "\" \"" + in + "\" > \"" + out + "\" 2> \"" + err + "\"";
#ifdef _WIN32
    cmd = "\"" + cmd + "\"";                                    // cmd.exe /c strips the outer pair of quotes
    for (char& c : cmd) if (c == '/') c = '\\';
#endif
    int seconds = 90;
    if (const char* t = std::getenv("AB_DEC_TIMEOUT")) seconds = std::atoi(t);
    const int rc = RunWithTimeout(cmd, seconds);
    if (rc == -1) { std::printf("dec: %s gave up after %d s on %s\n", jar.c_str(), seconds, in.c_str()); std::fflush(stdout); }
    std::ifstream o(out.c_str(), std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    return rc == 0 && o && o.tellg() > 0;
}

// the decompiled text only counts if Lua 5.1 (the engine's Lua) can load it: unluac writes goto for control flow it cannot rebuild
bool LoadsAsLua51(const std::string& path) {
    std::ifstream f(path.c_str(), std::ios::binary);
    std::string text((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    lua_State* L = luaL_newstate();
    bool ok = luaL_loadbuffer(L, text.data(), text.size(), "dec") == 0;
    lua_close(L);
    return ok;
}

void Walk(const std::string& src, const std::string& dst, const std::vector<std::string>& jars, DecStats& stats) {
    for (const std::string& n : List(src)) {
        if (n.back() == '/') { Walk(src + "/" + n.substr(0, n.size() - 1), dst + "/" + n.substr(0, n.size() - 1), jars, stats); continue; }
        if (!EndsWith(n, ".lua")) continue;
        std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
        if (!ReadLuaFile(src + "/" + n, bytes) || bytes.empty()) continue;
        MakePath(dst);
        std::string target = dst + "/" + n;
        if (bytes[0] != 0x1b) {                                  // plain text already (Classic 1.6.2 is encrypted text)
            // ReadLuaFile hands back the file unchanged when no known key opens it: that is still encrypted, not text
            bool text = true;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes.size() && i < 64; i++)
                if (bytes[i] < 0x20 && bytes[i] != '\t' && bytes[i] != '\n' && bytes[i] != '\r') text = false;
            if (!text) { stats.failed++; stats.failedFiles.push_back(src + "/" + n); continue; }
            std::ofstream out(target.c_str(), std::ios::binary);
            out.write((const char*)bytes.data(), (std::streamsize)bytes.size());
            stats.written++;
            continue;
        }
        // compiled Lua 5.1: write the bytecode beside the target for unluac, decompile to the target, remove the bytecode
        std::string tmp = target + ".luac", err = target + ".err";
        bool ok = false;
        if (!jars.empty()) {
            { std::ofstream t(tmp.c_str(), std::ios::binary); t.write((const char*)bytes.data(), (std::streamsize)bytes.size()); }
            std::printf("dec: decompiling %s ...\n", (src + "/" + n).c_str());
            std::fflush(stdout);
            for (size_t j = 0; j < jars.size() && !ok; j++) ok = Decompile(jars[j], tmp, target, err) && LoadsAsLua51(target);
            if (!std::getenv("AB_DEC_KEEP")) std::remove(tmp.c_str());     // AB_DEC_KEEP=1 leaves the .luac files (the compiled scripts) beside the text
        }
        std::remove(err.c_str());
        if (ok) { stats.written++; stats.fromBytecode++; }
        else { std::remove(target.c_str()); stats.failed++; stats.failedFiles.push_back(src + "/" + n); }
    }
}

}  // namespace

std::vector<std::string> ListFolder(const std::string& dir) { return List(Slashes(dir)); }

std::vector<std::string> FindUnluac(const std::string& exeFolder) {
    std::vector<std::string> candidates, found;
    if (const char* e = std::getenv("AB_UNLUAC")) {
        candidates.push_back(e);
        std::string dir = e;                                             // v3.3: the alternative decompiler beside it is the next one to try
        const size_t cut = dir.find_last_of("/\\");
        candidates.push_back((cut == std::string::npos ? std::string() : dir.substr(0, cut + 1)) + "unluac-alt.jar");
    }
    for (const char* name : {"tools/unluac.jar", "unluac.jar", "tools/unluac-alt.jar", "unluac-alt.jar"}) { candidates.push_back(exeFolder + name); candidates.push_back(name); }
    for (const std::string& c : candidates) {
        if (!FileExists(c)) continue;
        bool dup = false;
        for (const std::string& f : found) dup = dup || f == c;
        if (!dup) found.push_back(c);
    }
    return found;
}

int DecryptTree(const std::string& dataRoot, const std::string& decRoot, const std::vector<std::string>& unluacJars, DecStats& stats) {
    Walk(Slashes(dataRoot), Slashes(decRoot), unluacJars, stats);
    return stats.written;
}

void UseDecFolder(const std::string& dataRoot, const std::string& decRoot) {
    g_dataRoot = Slashes(dataRoot);
    g_decRoot = Slashes(decRoot);
}

bool ReadDecOverride(const std::string& path, std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes) {
    if (g_dataRoot.empty()) return false;
    std::string p = Slashes(path);
    if (p.size() <= g_dataRoot.size() + 1 || p.compare(0, g_dataRoot.size(), g_dataRoot) != 0 || p[g_dataRoot.size()] != '/') return false;
    std::ifstream f((g_decRoot + p.substr(g_dataRoot.size())).c_str(), std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return false;
    bytes.assign(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    return !bytes.empty();
}

}  // namespace ab
```

`src/lua/dec_folder.h`:

```h
// The "dec" folder: plain copies of the game's scripts and levels.
//   AngryBirdsEngine.exe --decrypt [folder]    writes every .lua file of the game's data folder, decrypted, to <exe folder>\dec (or folder)
//   AngryBirdsEngine.exe --use-dec [folder]    reads the scripts and levels from that folder first, so edited copies are used
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace ab {

// What DecryptTree did: the dec folder holds plain-text Lua only (v2.2).
struct DecStats { int written = 0, fromBytecode = 0, failed = 0; std::vector<std::string> failedFiles; };

// Decrypts every .lua file below `dataRoot` into `decRoot`, keeping the folder layout. A file that is compiled Lua 5.1 bytecode (1.6.3.1, 2.0.0,
// Seasons, Rio, the iOS .ipa) is decompiled to text with unluac: `java -jar <unluacJar> file`, the same call the AB360 LUA Manager makes. A file
// that cannot be turned into text is not written to the dec folder (the game then keeps using its own copy). Returns the number of files written.
int DecryptTree(const std::string& dataRoot, const std::string& decRoot, const std::vector<std::string>& unluacJars, DecStats& stats);

// The unluac jars to try, best first: AB_UNLUAC, tools\unluac.jar (1.2.2) and tools\unluac-alt.jar (a version that can decompile what 1.2.2 cannot, but
// writes goto) beside the exe and in the working folder. A decompiled file counts only if Lua 5.1 loads it.
std::vector<std::string> FindUnluac(const std::string& exeFolder);

// The names in a folder (folders with a trailing "/"); empty when the folder does not exist.
std::vector<std::string> ListFolder(const std::string& dir);

// From now on ReadLuaFile looks for a file below `dataRoot` in `decRoot` first.
void UseDecFolder(const std::string& dataRoot, const std::string& decRoot);

// ReadLuaFile's hook: true (and the file's bytes, not decrypted again) if the dec folder has the file.
bool ReadDecOverride(const std::string& path, std::vector<uint8_t>& bytes);

}  // namespace ab
```

`src/lua/editor_classic.lua`:

```lua
-- updateEditor of Angry Birds 1.6.2 (data/scripts/gamelogic.lua). Angry Birds 1.6.3.1 ships the same editor with this one function emptied,
-- so the engine runs this copy when a game's own updateEditor is only a stub (script_host.cpp, EnsureClassicEditor).
-- Everything it calls (cursor, selectedObjects, createObject, saveLevel ...) is defined by the game's own scripts.
function updateEditor(dt, time)
	-- an empty slot of the editor's level list has no file: the game's loadLevelInternal then returns early and never clears this flag, so the next level you pick would never load
	if loadingPageDrawn then loadingPageDrawn = false end
-- editor can be preprocessed out by defining "STRIP_EDITOR"
--#ifndef STRIP_EDITOR

	-- the joint page of the Seasons / 1.6.x editors (menus/editorjointPage.lua), when the game ships it: J and F1 to F5 open it with a new joint
	if EditorJointPage and not editorJointPage then
		if editor == nil then editor = { drawOneLayer = false, currentLayer = 0 } end   -- the window reads it while it is made
		editorJointPage = EditorJointPage:new()
		editorJointPage:onEntry()
	end
	if editorJointPage and editor == nil then
		editor = { drawOneLayer = false, currentLayer = 0 }
	end

	if oldZoomLevel ~= zoomLevel then
		worldScale = worldScale + zoomLevel - oldZoomLevel
		setWorldScale(worldScale)
		oldZoomLevel = zoomLevel
	end	

	updateScale()
	cursorPhysics.x, cursorPhysics.y = screenToPhysicsTransform(cursor.x, cursor.y)
	cursorWorld.x, cursorWorld.y = screenToWorldTransform(cursor.x, cursor.y)

	--print("cp.x_ " .. cursorPhysics.x .. " - cp.y: " .. cursorPhysics.y .. "\n")
	--print("cw.x_ " .. cursorWorld.x .. " - cw.y: " .. cursorWorld.y .. "\n")

	-- Handle input
	-- Escape is taken on release: the menu page the editor hands over to reads the release of the same key as "back" and would go on to the title screen
	-- Escape with the joint window open only closes the window (the game's own editor does the same); a second Escape leaves the editor
	local jointPageOpen = editorJointPage and (editor.newJoint ~= nil or editorJointPage.selectedJoint ~= nil)
	if keyReleased["ESCAPE"] and jointPageOpen then
		editorJointPage.disableSelectedJoint = true
		keyReleased["ESCAPE"] = nil
	end
	-- with the joint page F1 is the distance joint of two selected objects, Escape is the only way out
	if keyReleased["ESCAPE"] or (keyPressed["F1"] and not (editorJointPage and selectedObjects ~= nil and #selectedObjects == 2)) then
		setGameMode(updateMenu)
		setPhysicsEnabled(false)
		physicsEnabled = false
		setActiveMenuPage(levelSelectionEdit[currentThemeNumber])
		if editorJointPage then
			editorJointPage:onExit()
			editorJointPage = nil
			return
		end
	end

	if keyHold["CONTROL"] and keyPressed["S"] then
		checkDirectories()
		saveLevel(levelFolder .. levelName)
		saveLevel(levelFolder .. "temp/" .. levelName .. ".temp")
		levelSaved = true
	end

	if not keyHold["CONTROL"] and keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyPressed["C"] then
		if objects.castleCameraData == nil then
			objects.castleCameraData = {}
		end
		
		objects.castleCameraData.version = "0.02"
		objects.castleCameraData[deviceModel] = { px = screen.x,
												  py = screen.y,
												  sx = worldScale,
												  sy = worldScale,
												  screenWidth = screenWidth,
												  screenHeight = screenHeight }
		levelSaved = false
	end

	if not keyHold["CONTROL"] and keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyPressed["B"] then
		if objects.birdCameraData == nil then
			objects.birdCameraData = {}
		end
		
		objects.birdCameraData.version = "0.02"
		objects.birdCameraData[deviceModel] = { px = screen.x,
												py = screen.y,
												sx = worldScale,
												sy = worldScale,
												screenWidth = screenWidth,
												screenHeight = screenHeight }
		levelSaved = false
	end
	
	--debug camera
	
	if keyHold["CONTROL"] and keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyPressed["SPACE"] then 
		 
		if g_debugCameras == nil then
			g_debugCameras = true
		else 
			g_debugCameras = not g_debugCameras	
			g_cameraToDraw	= nil
		end								
		
	end
	
	-- the cameras list belongs to the games that define it (g_camerasList); where it is missing the click does nothing instead of stopping the script
	if g_debugCameras and g_camerasList ~= nil and keyPressed["LBUTTON"] then								
		for i = 1, #g_camerasList, 1 do
			local t_initialX = 20
			local t_initialY = 150
			
			local t_offsetY = 50
			
			if checkTextBounds("TEXTS_BASIC", g_camerasList[i], "LEFT", "BOTTOM", t_initialX, t_initialY + (t_offsetY * (i-1)), cursor.x, cursor.y) then
				g_cameraToDraw = g_camerasList[i]
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyPressed["P"] then
		setEditing(false)
		setPhysicsEnabled(false)
		local name = "temp/" .. levelName .. ".temp.playtest"
		checkDirectories()
		saveLevel(levelFolder .. name)
		loadLevelInternal(levelFolder .. name)
		startedFromEditor = true
		setGameMode(updateGame)
		levelSelectionPageNumber = currentThemeNumber
		currentThemeNumber = currentThemeIndex
	end

	if keyPressed["TAB"] then
		physicsEnabled = not physicsEnabled
		if physicsEnabled then
			checkDirectories()
			saveLevel(levelFolder .. "temp/" .. levelName .. ".temp")
		else
			loadLevelInternal(levelFolder .. "temp/" .. levelName .. ".temp")
		end
		setPhysicsEnabled(physicsEnabled)
	end

	if keyPressed["MBUTTON"] then
		if keyPressed["SHIFT"] then
			setWorldScale(1)
			worldScale = 1
		else
			setWorldScale(1)
			worldScale = 1
			screen.x = 0
			screen.y = 0
		end
	end

	-- world gravity (v3.1): Shift+G raises it by 1, Ctrl+G lowers it by 1 (Shift+Ctrl+G sets it back to 20), as the editor of Seasons 2.4.1 does; the value is saved in the level as worldGravity
	if keyPressed["G"] and (keyHold["SHIFT"] or keyHold["CONTROL"]) then
		if objects.worldGravity == nil then
			local _, gy = getWorldGravity()
			objects.worldGravity = gy or 20
		end
		if keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyHold["CONTROL"] then
			objects.worldGravity = 20
		elseif keyHold["SHIFT"] then
			objects.worldGravity = objects.worldGravity + 1
		else
			objects.worldGravity = objects.worldGravity - 1
		end
		setWorldGravity(0, objects.worldGravity)
		levelSaved = false
		print("world gravity: " .. objects.worldGravity .. "\n")
	end

	-- set active theme
	if keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyPressed[blockTable.themes.settings.keyCode] then
		currentThemeIndex = currentThemeIndex + 1
		if currentThemeIndex > blockTable.themes.settings.themeAmount then
			currentThemeIndex = 1
		end

		for k0, v0 in _G.pairs(blockTable.themes) do
			if v0.index ~= nil and v0.index == currentThemeIndex then
				currentTheme = k0
				setTheme(currentTheme)
				-- replace all blocks that are theme dependent
				for k1, v1 in _G.pairs(objects.world) do
					v1def = blockTable.blocks[v1.definition]
					if v1def.theme ~= nil and v1def.theme ~= currentTheme then
						-- go through all block definitions to find the correct block to replace this one
						for k2, v2 in _G.pairs(blockTable.blocks) do
							-- if this block definition's group is the same as the one on the current block and the group indexes match then check the theme
							if v2.group == v1def.group and v2.groupIndex == v1def.groupIndex then
								-- does the theme match to the current theme requirements
								if v2.theme == nil or v2.theme == currentTheme then
									-- we found a replacement, update values accordingly
									v1.definition = k2
									v1.sprite = v2.sprite
									v1.damageSprite = v1.sprite
									setSprite(k1, v1.sprite)
									levelSaved = false
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				-- update the cursor object
				if objectToAdd ~= nil then
					updateCursorObjectAccordingToTheme()
				end
				-- replace level defines
				objects.theme = currentTheme

			end
		end
	end

	birdSelected = false
	if selectedObjects[1] ~= nil then
		if selectedObjects[1].controllable then
			birdSelected = true
			for i = 1, #numberKeys do
				if keyPressed[numberKeys[i]] then
					selectedObjects[1].startNumber = i
				end
			end
		end
	end


	-- create blocks from the blocks.lua definitions
	if keyHold["CONTROL"] == false and keyHold["SHIFT"] == false and birdSelected == false then
		for k, v in _G.pairs(blockTable.groups) do
			local groupDataUpdate = false
			if keyPressed[v.keyUp] then
				-- update group information
				if currentGroup == k then
					currentGroupIndex = currentGroupIndex + 1
				else
					currentGroup = k
				end
				groupDataUpdate = true
			end
			if keyPressed[v.keyDown] then
				-- update group information
				if currentGroup == k then
					currentGroupIndex = currentGroupIndex - 1
				else
					currentGroup = k
				end
				groupDataUpdate = true
			end
			-- find the next object to add based on group information
			if groupDataUpdate then
				if currentGroupIndex > blockTable.groups[currentGroup].lastIndex then
					currentGroupIndex = blockTable.groups[currentGroup].firstIndex
				end
				if currentGroupIndex < blockTable.groups[currentGroup].firstIndex then
					currentGroupIndex = blockTable.groups[currentGroup].lastIndex
				end

				--print("Searching for group " .. currentGroup .. " " .. currentGroupIndex .. "\n")
				updateCursorObjectAccordingToTheme()
			end
		end
	end

	if keyPressed["RBUTTON"] then
		if copiedObjects ~= nil then
			copiedObjects = nil
		end
		
		if objectToAdd ~= nil then
			objectToAdd = nil
		else
			if not keyHold["SHIFT"] and not keyHold["ALT"] then
				selectedObjects = { }
			end
			selectedObjectPos.x = 0
			selectedObjectPos.y = 0

			draggingStartPosWorld.x = cursorWorld.x
			draggingStartPosWorld.y = cursorWorld.y

			--find object that was clicked
			for k, v in _G.pairs(objects.world) do
				object = v
				if object.type == "polygon" then
					x = object.x
					y = object.y
					--print(object.name .. " ")
					if checkPolygonObjectBounds(x, y, object.width, object.height, object.angle, getObjectDefinition(k).vertices, cursorPhysics.x, cursorPhysics.y) then
						addObjectToSelection(object, true)
					end
				end
				if object.type == "box" then
					x = object.x
					y = object.y
					--print(object.name .. " ")
					if checkObjectBounds(x, y, object.width, object.height, object.angle, cursorPhysics.x, cursorPhysics.y) then
						addObjectToSelection(object, true)
					end
				end
				if object.type == "circle" then
					if distance(object.x, object.y, cursorPhysics.x, cursorPhysics.y) < object.radius then
						addObjectToSelection(object, true)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if keyHold["RBUTTON"] then
		selectionRectActive = true
	end

	-- this is here so that the dragging position is not set on this frame if LBUTTON is released
	if keyReleased["RBUTTON"] then
		if objectToAdd ~= nil and selectedObjects == nil or #selectedObjects < 1 then
			selectedObjects = getObjectsInsideRect(draggingStartPosWorld.x, draggingStartPosWorld.y, cursorWorld.x, cursorWorld.y)
		else
			if keyHold["SHIFT"] then
				local tempObjects = getObjectsInsideRect(draggingStartPosWorld.x, draggingStartPosWorld.y, cursorWorld.x, cursorWorld.y)
				for k, v in _G.pairs(tempObjects) do
					addObjectToSelection(object, false)
				end
			end
			if keyHold["ALT"] then
				local tempObjects = getObjectsInsideRect(draggingStartPosWorld.x, draggingStartPosWorld.y, cursorWorld.x, cursorWorld.y)
				for k, v in _G.pairs(tempObjects) do
					for soi = 1, #selectedObjects do
						if selectedObjects[soi] == v then
							_G.table.remove(selectedObjects, soi)
							soi = #selectedObjects
						end
					end
				end				
			end
		end
		selectionRectActive = false
	end

	if keyPressed["LBUTTON"] then
		oldCursor.x = cursor.x
		oldCursor.y = cursor.y
		if not keyHold["SPACE"] then
			if objectToAdd ~= nil then
				local name = createObject(blockTable, objectToAdd, nil, cursorPhysics.x, cursorPhysics.y)
				setRotation(name, objectToAddAngle)
				selectedObjects = {}
				_G.table.insert(selectedObjects, objects.world[name])
				levelSaved = false
			end
			if copiedObjects ~= nil then
				for k, v in _G.pairs(copiedObjects) do
					local name = createObject(blockTable, v.definition, nil, cursorPhysics.x + v.x, cursorPhysics.y + v.y)
					setRotation(name, v.angle)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if keyHold["LBUTTON"] then
		if keyHold["SPACE"] then
			screen.x = screen.x - (cursorWorld.x - draggingStartPosWorld.x) * 0.5
			screen.y = screen.y - (cursorWorld.y - draggingStartPosWorld.y) * 0.5
		else
			if objectToAdd ~= nil then
				-- do not allow object selection if object to add is active
			elseif selectedObjects ~= nil and #selectedObjects > 0 then
				for k, v in _G.pairs(selectedObjects) do
					object = v
					x, y = worldToPhysicsTransform(cursor.x - oldCursor.x, cursor.y - oldCursor.y)
					x = x / worldScale
					y = y / worldScale
					setSleeping(object.name, false)
					if keyHold["CONTROL"] then
						setRotation(object.name, object.angle + (cursor.x - oldCursor.x)/180 * _G.math.pi )
					else
						setPosition(object.name, x + object.x, y + object.y)
					end
				end
				levelSaved = false
			end
		end
	end

	if not keyHold["LBUTTON"] and not keyHold["RBUTTON"] then
		draggingStartPosWorld.x = cursorWorld.x
		draggingStartPosWorld.y = cursorWorld.y
	end

	-- handle key input
	if selectedObjects ~= nil and #selectedObjects > 0 then
		local moveAmount = 1
		if keyHold["SHIFT"] then
			moveAmount = 10
		end	
		if keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyHold["CONTROL"] then
			moveAmount = 100
		end
		if not keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyHold["CONTROL"] then
			-- remove movement if only control pressed
			moveAmount = 0
		end
		
		if keyReleased["DELETE"] then
			for k, v in _G.pairs(selectedObjects) do
				if editorJointPage then
					for key, value in _G.pairs(objects.joints) do
						if value.end1 == v.name or value.end2 == v.name then
							editorJointPage:removeItem(value.name)
							editorJointPage:removeItem(value.name .. "_ANCHOR_1")
							editorJointPage:removeItem(value.name .. "_ANCHOR_2")
						end
					end
				end
				local name = v.name
				objects.world[name] = nil
				removeObject(name)
			end
			selectedObjects = {}
			levelSaved = false
		end
		
		local moveKeyDown = false

		if keyHold["LEFT"] or keyHold["RIGHT"] or keyHold["UP"] or keyHold["DOWN"] then
			moveKeyDown = true
		end
		
		if blockMoveTimer == 0 or blockMoveTimer > 0.3 then
			if keyHold["LEFT"] then
				setPositions(-moveAmount, 0)
			end
			if keyHold["RIGHT"] then
				setPositions(moveAmount, 0)
			end
			if keyHold["UP"] then
				setPositions(0, -moveAmount)
			end
			if keyHold["DOWN"] then
				setPositions(0, moveAmount)
			end
		end
		
		if moveKeyDown then
			blockMoveTimer = blockMoveTimer + dt
		else
			blockMoveTimer = 0
		end
	end

	if keyHold["SHIFT"] then
		if keyPressed["R"] then
			if copiedObjects ~= nil then
				local px, py, w, h = getObjectListBounds(copiedObjects)
				for k, v in _G.pairs(copiedObjects) do
					local angle = _G.math.pi/4
					v.angle = v.angle + angle
					
					-- move to origin
					local cx = v.x - px
					local cy = v.y - py
					
					-- rotate around origin
					local tcx = cx * _G.math.cos(angle) - cy * _G.math.sin(angle)
					local tcy = cx * _G.math.sin(angle) + cy * _G.math.cos(angle)
	
					-- move back
					v.x = tcx + px
					v.y = tcy + py
					--print("Rotating copied object: " .. k .. "\n")
				end
			else
				if objectToAdd ~= nil then
					objectToAddAngle = objectToAddAngle + _G.math.pi/4
				else
					if selectedObjects ~= nil and #selectedObjects > 0 then
						for k, v in _G.pairs(selectedObjects) do
							setRotation(v.name, v.angle + _G.math.pi/4)
						end
						levelSaved = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
		
		if keyPressed["J"] then
			if #selectedObjects == 2 then
				if editorJointPage then
					-- the joint page: pick the type, the anchors and the motor / limits there, the joint is made when you click away
					editor.newJoint = { name = selectedObjects[1].name .. selectedObjects[2].name,
									end1 = selectedObjects[1].name, end2 = selectedObjects[2].name, type = 1,
									coordType = 2, x1 = 0, y1 = 0, x2 = 0, y2 = 0, collideConnected = false }
					editorJointPage.newJoint = true
				else
					createJoint(selectedObjects[1].name .. selectedObjects[2].name, selectedObjects[1].name, selectedObjects[2].name, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0)
				end
				levelSaved = false
			end
		end
	end

	if editorJointPage and #selectedObjects == 2 then
		local jointType = (keyPressed["F1"] and 1) or (keyPressed["F2"] and 2) or (keyPressed["F3"] and 3) or (keyPressed["F4"] and 4) or (keyPressed["F5"] and 5)
		if jointType then      -- F1 distance, F2 weld, F3 revolute, F4 prismatic, F5 "destroy attached"
			editor.newJoint = { name = selectedObjects[1].name .. selectedObjects[2].name,
								end1 = selectedObjects[1].name, end2 = selectedObjects[2].name, type = jointType,
								coordType = 2, x1 = 0, y1 = 0, x2 = 0, y2 = 0 }
			if jointType == 4 then
				editorJointPage.items.x.visible = true
				editorJointPage.items.y.visible = true
				editorJointPage.items.x.text = editorJointPage.xTexts[1]
				editorJointPage.items.y.text = editorJointPage.yTexts[1]
			end
			editorJointPage.newJoint = true
		end
	end
		
	if not keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyHold["CONTROL"] then		
		if keyPressed["LEFT"] or keyPressed["RIGHT"] then
			if selectedObjects ~= nil and #selectedObjects > 0 then
				local px, py, w, h = getObjectListBounds(selectedObjects)
								
				for k, v in _G.pairs(selectedObjects) do
					setPosition(v.name, px + (px - v.x), v.y)
				end
				levelSaved = false
			end			
		end
	
		if keyPressed["UP"] or keyPressed["DOWN"] then
			if selectedObjects ~= nil and #selectedObjects > 0 then
				local px, py, w, h = getObjectListBounds(selectedObjects)
								
				for k, v in _G.pairs(selectedObjects) do
					setPosition(v.name, v.x, py + (py - v.y))
				end
				levelSaved = false
			end
		end
	end
	
	if keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyHold["CONTROL"] and (keyPressed["B"] or keyPressed["HOME"]) then
		if objects.birdCameraData and objects.birdCameraData[deviceModel] ~= nil then
			screen.x = objects.birdCameraData[deviceModel].px
			screen.y = objects.birdCameraData[deviceModel].py
			worldScale = objects.birdCameraData[deviceModel].sx
			setWorldScale(worldScale)
			oldScale = worldScale
		end
	end
	
	if keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyHold["CONTROL"] and (keyPressed["C"] or keyPressed["END"]) then
		if objects.castleCameraData ~= nil and objects.castleCameraData[deviceModel]then
			screen.x = objects.castleCameraData[deviceModel].px
			screen.y = objects.castleCameraData[deviceModel].py
			worldScale = objects.castleCameraData[deviceModel].sx
			setWorldScale(worldScale)
			oldScale = worldScale
		end
	end
	
	if not keyHold["SHIFT"] and not keyHold["CONTROL"] and keyPressed["END"] then
		if objects.doNotWaitForMovingObjects ~= nil then
			objects.doNotWaitForMovingObjects = nil
		else
			objects.doNotWaitForMovingObjects = true
		end
	end
	
	if not keyHold["SHIFT"] and keyHold["CONTROL"] and keyPressed["C"] then
		copiedObjects = {}
		local x, y, w, h = getObjectListBounds(selectedObjects)
		for k, v in _G.pairs(selectedObjects) do
			--print("Adding to copied objects: " .. v.name .. "\n")
			copiedObjects[v.name] = { name = v.name, definition = v.definition, x = v.x - x, y = v.y - y, angle = v.angle }
			if v.width == nil then
				copiedObjects[v.name].width = v.radius
				copiedObjects[v.name].height = v.radius
			else
				copiedObjects[v.name].width = v.width
				copiedObjects[v.name].height = v.height
			end
		end
		selectedObjects = {}
	end
	
	defaultCamera(dt)

	oldCursor.x = cursor.x
	oldCursor.y = cursor.y	
	
	if editorJointPage then editorJointPage:update(dt) end
	drawGame()
	if editorJointPage and not drawEditor then editorJointPage:draw() end   -- games with an exe-called drawEditor use __abDrawEditorPage below
--#endif
end

-- called by the engine after drawEditor() (Seasons and later), which repaints the whole game: the joint page must go on top of that
function __abDrawEditorPage()
	if editorJointPage then editorJointPage:draw() end
end
```

```lua
CompoImage = Frame:new()
function CompoImage:init()
	self.visible = true
	self.angle = 0
	self.alpha = nil
	self.floorCoordinates = true
	self.scaleX = 1
	self.scaleY = 1
	self.rotatePivotX = 0
	self.rotatePivotY = 0	
end

function CompoImage:setVisible(visible)
	self.visible = visible
end

function CompoImage:setImage(image)
	self.image = image
	self.w, self.h,self.px, self.py = _G.res.getCompoSpriteBounds(image)

end

function CompoImage:setSize(w,h)
	if w ~= nil then
		self.w = w	
	end
	
	if h ~= nil then
		self.h = h	
	end
end

function CompoImage:drawSelf(x, y, scaleX, scaleY, angle)
	local x = x or 0
	local y = y or 0
	local scaleX = scaleX or 1
	local scaleY = scaleY or 1
	local angle = angle or 0
	
	local finalScaleX = scaleX * self.scaleX
	local finalScaleY = scaleY * self.scaleY
	
	local finalX = x + self.x 
	local finalY = y + self.y
	
	local finalAngle = angle + self.angle	
	
	if(self.image ~= nil and self.visible == true) then
		px, py = self.pivotX or px, self.pivotY or py
		local rotatePivotX, rotatePivotY = self.rotatePivotX or px, self.rotatePivotY or py
		if self.floorCoordinates then 
			finalX = _G.math.floor(finalX)	
			finalY = _G.math.floor(finalY)
		end
	
	
		if self.alpha == nil then
			gamelua.setRenderState(finalX / finalScaleX, finalY / finalScaleY, finalScaleX, finalScaleY, finalAngle, rotatePivotX, rotatePivotY)
		else
			gamelua.setRenderState(finalX / finalScaleX, finalY / finalScaleY, finalScaleX, finalScaleY, finalAngle, rotatePivotX, rotatePivotY, self.alpha)						
		end
		
		
		
		-- _G.res.drawSprite("", self.image, 0, 0,"HPIVOT","VPIVOT", _G.math.floor(self.w * scaleX) , _G.math.floor(self.h * scaleY) )
		_G.res.drawCompoSprite("", self.image, 0, 0,"HPIVOT","VPIVOT", _G.math.floor(self.w) , _G.math.floor(self.h) )
		-- _G.res.drawSprite(self.image, 0, 0)
	end
	
	if self.alpha ~= nil then
		gamelua.setRenderState(0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)	
	else
		gamelua.setRenderState(0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
	end
end

function CompoImage:drawFast(x, y)
	_G.res.drawCompoSprite(self.image, _G.math.floor(self.x + x), _G.math.floor(self.y + y))
end

function CompoImage:draw(x,y, scaleX, scaleY, angle)
	self:drawSelf(x, y, scaleX, scaleY, angle)
	
	Frame.draw(self,x,y, scaleX, scaleY, angle)	
end

function CompoImage:setAngle(angle)
	self.angle = angle
end
```

```lua
InvisibleButton = Frame:new()

function InvisibleButton:init()
	self.width = 0
	self.height = 0
	self.x = 0
	self.y = 0
	self.scaleX = 1
	self.scaleY = 1
end


function InvisibleButton:onPointerEvent(eventType,x,y)
	if ( eventType == "LPRESS") or ( eventType == "LRELEASE") or ( eventType == "LHOLD") and self.enabled ~= false then

		if self:checkCollision(x,y) then
			if  ((not self.activateOnRelease and eventType == "LPRESS") or (self.activateOnRelease and eventType == "LRELEASE")) then
				if self.sound ~= nil then				
					_G.res.playAudio(self.sound, 1, false)				
				elseif self.soundTable ~= nil then
					_G.res.playAudio(self.soundTable[_G.math.random(1, #self.soundTable)])
				end
				return self.returnValue, self.meta, self
			else
				--eat the event anyway so underlying stuff wont bug
				return -1
			end
		end
	end
	
	return Frame.onPointerEvent(self, eventType,x,y)
	
end

function InvisibleButton:checkCollision(x,y)
	
		local px, py = self.width*0.5, self.height*0.5
		local scaleX = self.scaleX or 1
		local scaleY = self.scaleY or 1
		return x >= self.x - px * scaleX and x <= self.x + (self.width - px) * scaleX and y >= self.y - py * scaleY and y <= self.y + (self.height - py) * scaleY 

end



function InvisibleButton:update(dt, time) 
	Frame.update(self,dt,time)
end


function InvisibleButton:draw(x,y, scaleX, scaleY, angle) 

	local debug = false
	if debug then
		
		gamelua.drawRect(1, 0, 0, 0.5,self.x - self.width*0.5,self.y - self.height*0.5, self.x + self.width*0.5, self.y + self.height*0.5, false)
	end
	return
end
```

`src/lua/friends2_natives.lua`:

```lua
-- Angry Birds Friends 2.0.0 (Android): the phone's native services, answered on this computer.
--
-- Friends 2.0.0 is built on Rovio's newer framework: the game reaches its server through native modules
-- (service, social, user, tournament, shop, game, gamerServices ...) that the PC engine does not have. The game's own
-- TutorialMode.lua and PracticeMode.lua replace user, tournament, shop and game with local versions while those modes
-- run, and set them back to nil afterwards; so these modules sit behind the globals (in the environment's fallback),
-- never in them, exactly as the phone's natives did.
--
-- A call is answered the way a server answers: callbacks run one frame later, with nil for "no error".
-- Run by the engine inside the game's environment when scripts/TutorialMode.lua exists (script_host.cpp).

local env = ...

local queue, flushing = {}, false
local function flush()
    local jobs = queue
    queue = {}
    for _, job in ipairs(jobs) do
        local ok, err = xpcall(function() return job.fn(unpack(job.args, 1, job.n)) end, function(m) return debug and debug.traceback and debug.traceback(m) or m end)
        if not ok then print("friends 2.0.0: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end
end
local function later(fn, ...)
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
    local engine = env.engine or _G.engine
    if not (engine and engine.on) then fn(...) return end
    if not flushing then flushing = true engine.on("update", flush) end
    queue[#queue + 1] = {fn = fn, args = {...}, n = select("#", ...)}
end

-- a module whose missing functions do nothing (and say so once), so a call the game makes that is not answered here
-- shows in the console instead of stopping the game
local reported = {}
local function module(name, fields)
    return setmetatable(fields, {__index = function(t, k)
        if type(k) ~= "string" then return nil end
        if not reported[name .. "." .. k] then reported[name .. "." .. k] = true print("friends 2.0.0: " .. name .. "." .. k .. " is not there") end
        return function() end
    end})
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The online part: a guest session on a stand-in server, so "Play Tournament" works on this computer.
--
-- The phone game got the Weekly Tournament's levels, the scores, the coins and the shop from Rovio's server, which is
-- gone. Here the tournament's levels are the level files in data/levels/tournament (Level<code>.lua, the game's own
-- level format; the apk ships none). With more than six there, six are played each week, the week ending on Monday
-- at midnight. Their star scores come from a starLimits.lua in that folder (Level<code> = {silverScore = ...,
-- goldScore = ...}), else from the level file's own scores (Gold / Silver, as Friends 1.0.0's levels have), else from the
-- game's starTable, else 40000 / 60000. The score lists hold the player and the
-- game's two tutorial bots: Red scores each level's three-star score (goldScore) and Chuck its two-star score
-- (silverScore). Coins ("credits"), bought power-ups and slingshots, and the week's scores are kept in settings.lua
-- (settings.abServer2). Prices and prizes are made up: the real ones came from the server.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local floor, max = math.floor, math.max
local WEEK = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60
local EPOCH = os.time({year = 2013, month = 4, day = 29, hour = 0})   -- a Monday at midnight: weeks run Monday to Monday
local LEVELS_PER_WEEK = 6
local PODIUM_COINS = {30, 20, 10}
local STAR_COINS = {2, 4, 8}
local WELCOME_COINS = 100
local DEFAULT_LIMITS = {silverScore = 40000, goldScore = 60000}

-- the shop: power-ups (id = the item the game counts), the pack, and the slingshots (kept for good)
local POWERUP_PRICES = {{price = 30, totalQuantity = 3, freeQuantity = 0, referencePrice = 30, salesPrice = ""}, {price = 90, totalQuantity = 11, freeQuantity = 1, referencePrice = 90, salesPrice = ""}, {price = 200, totalQuantity = 30, freeQuantity = 5, referencePrice = 200, salesPrice = ""}}
local CATALOG = {
    {id = "POWER_UP", name = "Power-ups", items = {
        {id = "superseed", type = "CONSUMABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = POWERUP_PRICES},
        {id = "kingsling", type = "CONSUMABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = POWERUP_PRICES},
        {id = "slingscope", type = "CONSUMABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = POWERUP_PRICES},
        {id = "birdquake", type = "CONSUMABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = POWERUP_PRICES},
        {id = "extrabird", type = "CONSUMABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = {{price = 30, totalQuantity = 1, freeQuantity = 0, referencePrice = 30, salesPrice = ""}, {price = 130, totalQuantity = 5, freeQuantity = 0, referencePrice = 130, salesPrice = ""}}},
        {id = "PowerupBundle", type = "CONSUMABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = {{price = 100, totalQuantity = 3, freeQuantity = 0, referencePrice = 100, salesPrice = ""}, {price = 300, totalQuantity = 10, freeQuantity = 1, referencePrice = 300, salesPrice = ""}}}}},
    {id = "SLINGSHOT", name = "Slingshots", items = {
        {id = "GoldenSling", type = "DURABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = {{price = 500, totalQuantity = 1, freeQuantity = 0, referencePrice = 500, salesPrice = ""}}},
        {id = "WoodChipper", type = "DURABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = {{price = 300, totalQuantity = 1, freeQuantity = 0, referencePrice = 300, salesPrice = ""}}},
        {id = "StoneCutter", type = "DURABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = {{price = 300, totalQuantity = 1, freeQuantity = 0, referencePrice = 300, salesPrice = ""}}},
        {id = "GlassBreaker", type = "DURABLE", currency = "IVC", prices = {{price = 300, totalQuantity = 1, freeQuantity = 0, referencePrice = 300, salesPrice = ""}}}}},
}
local BUNDLE = {PowerupBundle = {"superseed", "kingsling", "slingscope", "birdquake"}}
-- the daily wheel's eight pieces, in the game's order (WheelPopup.lua): 5, 10 and 50 coins, then one of each power-up
local WHEEL = {{"credits", 5}, {"credits", 10}, {"credits", 50}, {"superseed", 1}, {"slingscope", 1}, {"birdquake", 1}, {"extrabird", 1}, {"kingsling", 1}}
local function today(offset) return tonumber(os.date("%Y%m%d", os.time() + (offset or 0))) end

local session = "Uninitialized"
-- the phone points the game at the session's levels (episodes.lua: 1 tournament, 2 tutorial, 3 practice) when it opens one
local function episodes(kind) local f = env["setup" .. kind .. "Episodes"] if type(f) == "function" then f() end end
local player = {id = "0", firstName = "You", lastName = "", name = "You", nickname = "", profileImageURL = ""}

-- the saved state, in the game's own settings table
local function state()
    local settings = env.settings
    if type(settings) ~= "table" then return {items = {}, scores = {}, trophies = {0, 0, 0}} end
    local s = settings.abServer2
    if type(s) ~= "table" then s = {} settings.abServer2 = s end
    s.items = s.items or {}
    s.scores = s.scores or {}
    s.trophies = s.trophies or {0, 0, 0}
    return s
end
local function save()
    if env.saveLuaFileWrapper then pcall(env.saveLuaFileWrapper, "settings.lua", "settings", true) end
end
local function amount(name) return state().items[name] or 0 end
-- a changed amount is told to the game as the phone did (EID_INVENTORY_ITEM_UPDATED: the coin wallet and the shop's counts follow it)
local function give(name, n)
    local s = state()
    local from = s.items[name] or 0
    s.items[name] = max(0, from + n)
    local ev = env.events and env.events.EID_INVENTORY_ITEM_UPDATED
    if ev and env.eventManager and s.items[name] ~= from then
        pcall(env.eventManager.notify, env.eventManager, {id = ev, itemId = name, fromAmount = from, toAmount = s.items[name]})
    end
end

-- the tournament's levels: the files in data/levels/tournament
-- (or, while that folder has none, Friends 1.0.0's tournament levels: the engine copies them to data/levels/friends_1.0.0)
local folderLevels, limits
local levelFolder = "/levels/tournament"
local function dataRoot() return (string.gsub(tostring(env.scriptPath or ""), "/scripts$", "")) end
local function allLevels()
    if folderLevels then return folderLevels end
    folderLevels, limits = {}, {}
    for _, sub in ipairs({"/levels/tournament", "/levels/friends_1.0.0"}) do
        for _, name in ipairs(env.abListFolder and env.abListFolder(dataRoot() .. sub) or {}) do
            local code = string.match(name, "^Level(.+)%.lua$")
            if code and code ~= "" then folderLevels[#folderLevels + 1] = code end
        end
        if #folderLevels > 0 then levelFolder = sub break end
    end
    local folder = dataRoot() .. levelFolder
    table.sort(folderLevels, function(a, b)
        local na, nb = tonumber(string.match(a, "(%d+)$")), tonumber(string.match(b, "(%d+)$"))
        if na and nb and na ~= nb then return na < nb end
        return a < b
    end)
    local ok, t = pcall(env.abNativeLoadLuaTable, folder .. "/starLimits.lua")
    if ok and type(t) == "table" then limits = t end
    if #folderLevels == 0 then print("friends 2.0.0: no tournament levels in " .. dataRoot() .. "/levels/tournament (Level<code>.lua files)") end
    return folderLevels
end
local function weekNumber() return floor((os.time() - EPOCH) / WEEK) end
local function weekCodes(week)
    local all = allLevels()
    if #all <= LEVELS_PER_WEEK then return all end
    local list, weeks = {}, math.ceil(#all / LEVELS_PER_WEEK)
    local first = (week % weeks) * LEVELS_PER_WEEK
    for i = 1, LEVELS_PER_WEEK do list[i] = all[(first + i - 1) % #all + 1] end
    return list
end
local levelScores = {}
local function starLimits(code)                                           -- starLimits.lua in the folder, else the level file's own
    local name = "Level" .. code                                         -- scores (Gold / Silver), else the game's starTable, else 40000 / 60000
    local t = limits and limits[name]
    if type(t) ~= "table" then
        if levelScores[code] == nil then
            levelScores[code] = false
            local ok, level = pcall(env.abNativeLoadLuaTable, dataRoot() .. levelFolder .. "/" .. name .. ".lua")
            local sc = ok and type(level) == "table" and level.scores
            if type(sc) == "table" and tonumber(sc.Gold) and tonumber(sc.Silver) then levelScores[code] = {silverScore = tonumber(sc.Silver), goldScore = tonumber(sc.Gold)} end
        end
        t = levelScores[code] or nil
    end
    if type(t) ~= "table" then t = env.starTable and rawget(env.starTable, name) end
    if type(t) ~= "table" then t = DEFAULT_LIMITS end
    return {silverScore = t.silverScore or DEFAULT_LIMITS.silverScore, goldScore = t.goldScore or DEFAULT_LIMITS.goldScore}
end

-- score lists: the player and the two bots, best first; a list entry has the fields the game's own bots have
local function entry(id, name, points, bot)
    return {id = id, name = name, firstName = name, lastName = "", nickname = name, points = points, rank = 0, isBot = bot, isOwnPlayer = not bot,
            gift = false, tournamentPrize = 0, leagueStars = 0, leagueTier = "", profileImageURL = "", profileImage = ""}
end
local function scoreList(own, red, chuck)
    local list = {entry("-1", "Red", red, true), entry("-2", "Chuck", chuck, true), entry(player.id, player.name, own, false)}
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) if a.points ~= b.points then return a.points > b.points end return a.isOwnPlayer end)
    local ownRank = 1
    for i, e in ipairs(list) do
        e.rank = i
        e.tournamentPrize = PODIUM_COINS[i] or 0
        if e.isOwnPlayer then ownRank = i end
    end
    return list, ownRank
end
local function weekList(week)
    local own, red, chuck = 0, 0, 0
    for _, code in ipairs(weekCodes(week)) do
        local l = starLimits(code)
        own = own + (state().scores[code] or 0)
        red = red + l.goldScore
        chuck = chuck + l.silverScore
    end
    return scoreList(own, red, chuck)
end

-- the league: twenty players a week, the player and nineteen bots of the league the player's rating puts them in. A bot's
-- week total is a share of the week's three-star scores (the same every time for that bot and week, a little higher in a
-- higher league). The top five move the rating up, the bottom five down; first, second and third get the league's prize.
-- The player joins with their first tournament level.
local LEAGUES = {
    {id = "GLASS", ratingThreshold = 0, reward = 20, leagueStars = 0}, {id = "WOOD", ratingThreshold = 500, reward = 30, leagueStars = 0},
    {id = "STONE", ratingThreshold = 1000, reward = 40, leagueStars = 0}, {id = "BRONZE", ratingThreshold = 1500, reward = 60, leagueStars = 0},
    {id = "SILVER", ratingThreshold = 2000, reward = 80, leagueStars = 0}, {id = "GOLD", ratingThreshold = 2500, reward = 100, leagueStars = 0},
    {id = "DIAMOND", ratingThreshold = 3000, reward = 150, leagueStars = 0},
}
local LEAGUE_NAMES = {GLASS = "Glass", WOOD = "Wood", STONE = "Stone", BRONZE = "Bronze", SILVER = "Silver", GOLD = "Gold", DIAMOND = "Diamond"}
local BOTS = {"Terence", "Bomb", "Matilda", "Hal", "Bubbles", "Stella", "Jay", "Jake", "Jim", "Silver", "Willow", "Poppy", "Luca", "Dahlia",
              "Gale", "Foreman", "Corporal", "Leonard", "Ross"}
local function leagueFor(rating)
    local found = LEAGUES[1]
    for _, l in ipairs(LEAGUES) do if rating >= l.ratingThreshold then found = l end end
    local out = {}
    for k, v in pairs(found) do out[k] = v end
    out.name = LEAGUE_NAMES[found.id]
    return out
end
local function share(week, i)                                            -- a fixed number between 0 and 1 for a week and a bot
    local x = math.sin(week * 12.9898 + i * 78.233) * 43758.5453
    return x - floor(x)
end
local function leagueStandings(week, rating, own, final)
    -- the bots play through the week: their totals grow with the time gone (all of it once the week is over)
    local gone = final and 1 or math.min(1, 0.1 + 1.1 * (os.time() - (EPOCH + week * WEEK)) / WEEK)
    local tier = 1
    for i, l in ipairs(LEAGUES) do if rating >= l.ratingThreshold then tier = i end end
    local gold = 0
    for _, code in ipairs(weekCodes(week)) do gold = gold + starLimits(code).goldScore end
    local list = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(BOTS) do
        local points = floor(gold * gone * (0.35 + 0.08 * tier + 0.6 * share(week, i)) / 10) * 10
        list[#list + 1] = {id = "bot" .. i, nickname = name, firstName = name, points = points, isOwnPlayer = false, isFreeSlot = false,
                           profileImage = "FRIEND_LIST_FRIEND_NO_IMAGE", profileImageURL = "", leagueStars = 0}
    end
    local s = state()
    list[#list + 1] = {id = player.id, nickname = s.nickname or player.name, firstName = player.name, points = own, isOwnPlayer = true, isFreeSlot = false,
                       profileImage = s.profileImage or "FRIEND_LIST_FRIEND_NO_IMAGE", profileImageURL = "", leagueStars = 0}
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) if a.points ~= b.points then return a.points > b.points end return a.isOwnPlayer end)
    local reward, ownRank = leagueFor(rating).reward, #list
    for i, e in ipairs(list) do
        e.rank = i
        e.leaguePrize = i == 1 and reward or i == 2 and floor(reward / 2) or i == 3 and floor(reward / 4) or 0
        e.promotion = (i <= 5 and tier < #LEAGUES) and 1 or (i > #list - 5 and tier > 1) and -1 or 0
        if e.isOwnPlayer then ownRank = i end
    end
    return list, ownRank
end
local function weekOwnTotal()
    local own = 0
    for _, code in ipairs(weekCodes(state().week or weekNumber())) do own = own + (state().scores[code] or 0) end
    return own
end
local function inLeague() local s = state() return s.leagueJoined == true or next(s.scores) ~= nil end

-- a new week: last week's standings become the results to claim (coins for the podium), the scores start again
local function rollover()
    local s, week = state(), weekNumber()
    if s.week == nil then s.week = week save() return end
    if s.week >= week then return end
    local played = false
    for _ in pairs(s.scores) do played = true end
    if played then
        local players, rank = weekList(s.week)
        s.lastResult = {players = players, rank = rank, prizes = PODIUM_COINS}
        s.lastClaimed = false
        local rating = s.rating or 0
        local standings, leagueRank = leagueStandings(s.week, rating, weekOwnTotal(), true)
        local before = leagueFor(rating)
        s.rating = max(0, rating + (leagueRank <= 5 and 250 or leagueRank > #standings - 5 and -250 or 0))
        standings[leagueRank].leagueRatingChange = s.rating - rating
        standings[leagueRank].leagueRating = s.rating
        local nextLeague
        for _, l in ipairs(LEAGUES) do if not nextLeague and l.ratingThreshold > s.rating then nextLeague = leagueFor(l.ratingThreshold) end end
        -- the results page: the league before and after the week, the next one up (its progress bar), and the standings
        s.lastLeague = {standings = standings, rank = leagueRank, prize = standings[leagueRank].leaguePrize, previousLeague = before,
                        currentLeague = leagueFor(s.rating), nextLeague = nextLeague}
        s.leagueJoined = true
    end
    s.week = week
    s.scores = {}
    folderLevels = nil
    save()
end
local function results(claimable)
    local s = state()
    local r = s.lastResult
    if not r then return {players = {}, prizes = {}, goldTrophies = s.trophies[1], silverTrophies = s.trophies[2], bronzeTrophies = s.trophies[3]} end
    return {players = r.players, prizes = claimable and r.prizes or {}, goldTrophies = s.trophies[1], silverTrophies = s.trophies[2], bronzeTrophies = s.trophies[3]}
end
local function online() return session == "Guest" end

local service = module("service", {
    loadTournament = function(progress, done) rollover() if type(progress) == "function" then progress(0, 1) end later(done) end,
    testNetwork = function(cb) later(cb) end,                          -- cb(error): nil, the network is there
    getDurationSinceNow = function(t) return math.max(0, (tonumber(t) or 0) - os.time()) end,
    getTimeFromNow = function(seconds) return os.time() + (tonumber(seconds) or 0) end,
    getTournamentBrand = function() return {path = "", name = ""} end,
    getCampaignId = function() return "" end,
    getAppDomain = function() return "" end,
    getItemServerName = function(name) return name end,
    getVideoRewardAmount = function() return 0 end,
    getAnalyticsSessionId = function() return "" end,
    scheduleLocalNotification = function() end,
    removeLocalNotification = function() end,
    refreshAnalyticsSession = function() end,
    tryAppraterActivation = function() end,
    loadImage = function() end,
    toggleZoom = function() end,
})

local tournament = module("tournament", {
    getLevels = function()
        rollover()
        local list = {}
        for i, code in ipairs(weekCodes(state().week or weekNumber())) do
            list[i] = {level = i, code = code, scoreLimits = starLimits(code), unlockTime = "0", locked = false}
        end
        return {levels = list, episode = 1, online = true}
    end,
    getTournamentId = function() return "WEEK" .. tostring(state().week or weekNumber()) end,
    getTimeLeft = function() rollover() return EPOCH + (weekNumber() + 1) * WEEK - os.time() end,
    getTournamentInfoText = function()                                  -- (the banner's flag: none, the line under the title: the time left)
        local left = max(0, EPOCH + (weekNumber() + 1) * WEEK - os.time())
        local d, h = floor(left / 86400), floor(left % 86400 / 3600)
        return nil, d > 0 and ("Ends in " .. d .. "d " .. h .. "h") or ("Ends in " .. h .. "h " .. floor(left % 3600 / 60) .. "m")
    end,
    getTournamentScores = function(cb) rollover() later(cb, nil, (weekList(state().week))) end,
    getPlayerScores = function(cb)
        local list = {}
        for _, code in ipairs(weekCodes(state().week or weekNumber())) do
            local points = state().scores[code]
            if points then
                local l = starLimits(code)
                list[#list + 1] = {level = code, points = points, stars = 0, rank = points >= l.goldScore and 1 or points >= l.silverScore and 2 or 3}
            end
        end
        later(cb, nil, list)
    end,
    getLevelScores = function(_, cb)
        local code = string.match(tostring(env.levelName), "^Level(.+)$")
        local l = starLimits(code or "")
        later(cb, nil, (scoreList(code and state().scores[code] or 0, l.goldScore, l.silverScore)))
    end,
    getLeagueLevelStandings = function(_, cb) later(cb, nil, nil, {}) end,   -- no league: (error, league info, standings)
    clearStandingsCache = function() end,
    checkDynamicPopups = function(cb) later(cb, {}) end,
    markDynamicPopupSeen = function() end,
    checkUnconcludedTournament = function(cb) later(cb, {}) end,
    getUnconcludedResults = function(cb)
        local s = state()
        if s.lastResult and not s.lastClaimed then later(cb, nil, results(true), s.lastLeague or {standings = {}}) else later(cb, nil, {players = {}, prizes = {}}, {standings = {}}) end
    end,
    getPreviousResults = function(cb) later(cb, nil, results(false), state().lastLeague or {standings = {}}) end,   -- (error, tournament, league)
    claimTournamentRewards = function(cb)
        local s = state()
        local coins = 0
        if s.lastResult and not s.lastClaimed then
            coins = PODIUM_COINS[s.lastResult.rank] or 0
            if s.lastResult.rank <= 3 then s.trophies[s.lastResult.rank] = s.trophies[s.lastResult.rank] + 1 end
            give("credits", coins)
            s.lastClaimed = true
            local leagueCoins = s.lastLeague and s.lastLeague.prize or 0
            if leagueCoins > 0 then give("credits", leagueCoins) end
            save()
            later(cb, nil, {{itemId = "credits", receivedQuantity = coins, totalQuantity = amount("credits") - leagueCoins}},
                  leagueCoins > 0 and {{itemId = "credits", receivedQuantity = leagueCoins, totalQuantity = amount("credits")}} or {})   -- (error, tournament rewards, league rewards)
            return
        end
        later(cb, nil, {{itemId = "credits", receivedQuantity = 0, totalQuantity = amount("credits")}}, {})
    end,
    getLeagueStandings = function(cb)                                    -- (error, the player's league, this week's standings); none before the first level
        if not inLeague() then later(cb, nil, nil, {}) return end
        local rating = state().rating or 0
        later(cb, nil, leagueFor(rating), (leagueStandings(state().week or weekNumber(), rating, weekOwnTotal())))
    end,
    getLeagueInfo = function()
        local list = {}
        for i, l in ipairs(LEAGUES) do list[i] = leagueFor(l.ratingThreshold) end
        return list
    end,
    -- the daily wheel: one spin a day; cb(error, day, the eight pieces, {index = the prize, 0 = none today}, remove a piece)
    -- after each spin the player takes one piece off for the next day's spin; a missed day (or two pieces left) puts them all back
    checkWheel = function(cb)
        local s = state()
        local d = s.wheel or {}
        s.wheel = d
        if d.last ~= today() and d.last ~= today(-86400) then d.removed = {} end
        d.removed = d.removed or {}
        local pieces, left = {}, {}
        for i = 1, #WHEEL do
            if not d.removed[i] then pieces[#pieces + 1] = {numericId = i, id = WHEEL[i][1], quantity = WHEEL[i][2]} left[#left + 1] = i end
        end
        local day = d.last == today() and (d.day or 1) or ((d.last == today(-86400)) and ((d.day or 0) % 7 + 1) or 1)
        if d.last == today() then later(cb, nil, day, pieces, {index = 0}, d.removePending == true) return end
        if d.pending == nil or d.pendingDay ~= today() or d.removed[d.pending] then d.pending, d.pendingDay = left[math.random(#left)], today() save() end
        later(cb, nil, day, pieces, {index = d.pending}, false)
    end,
    claimWheelReward = function(cb)
        local s = state()
        local d = s.wheel or {}
        if d.last ~= today() and d.pending then
            local prize = WHEEL[d.pending]
            give(prize[1], prize[2])
            d.day = (d.last == today(-86400)) and ((d.day or 0) % 7 + 1) or 1
            d.last, d.pending = today(), nil
            d.removePending = true
            s.wheel = d
            save()
        end
        later(cb)
    end,
    removeWheelItem = function(id, cb)
        local s = state()
        local d = s.wheel or {}
        d.removed = d.removed or {}
        local n = 0
        for i = 1, #WHEEL do if not d.removed[i] then n = n + 1 end end
        if n <= 2 then d.removed = {} elseif tonumber(id) then d.removed[tonumber(id)] = true end
        d.removePending = false
        s.wheel = d
        save()
        later(cb)
    end,
})

        local price
        for _, page in ipairs(CATALOG) do
            for _, item in ipairs(page.items) do
                if item.id == code then for _, p in ipairs(item.prices) do if p.totalQuantity == quantity then price = p end end end
            end
        end
        if not price then later(cb, {title = "Shop", message = "That is not for sale."}) return end
        if amount("credits") < price.price then later(cb, {title = "Shop", message = "Not enough coins."}) return end
        give("credits", -price.price)
        local got = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(BUNDLE[code] or {code}) do
            give(name, quantity)                                  -- totalQuantity counts the free ones too
            got[#got + 1] = {itemId = name, totalQuantity = amount(name)}
        end
        save()
        later(cb, nil, got)
    end,
})

local game = module("game", {
    useItem = function(name, cb)                                         -- a power-up used up; with none bought it is free, as everywhere here
        if amount(name) > 0 then give(name, -1) save() end
        later(cb)
    end,
    submitScore = function(level, score, _, _, _, cb)                    -- the week's best score of a tournament level
        local code = string.match(tostring(level), "^Level(.+)$") or tostring(level)
        for _, c in ipairs(weekCodes(state().week or weekNumber())) do
            if c == code then
                local s = state()
                -- coins for each star that is new this week: 2 for the first, 4 for the second, 8 for the third (the level end shows them)
                if env.getStarCount then
                    local before = (s.scores[c] or 0) > 0 and env.getStarCount("Level" .. c, s.scores[c]) or 0
                    local now = env.getStarCount("Level" .. c, tonumber(score) or 0) or 0
                    for star = before + 1, now do give("credits", STAR_COINS[star] or 0) end
                end
                s.scores[c] = max(s.scores[c] or 0, tonumber(score) or 0)
                save()
            end
        end
        later(cb)
    end,
    sendBrag = function(_, cb) later(cb) end,
})
```
