`src/lua/motion.lua`:

```lua
-- The `motion` library (3.3): move physics objects any way you like, and play the rewind history back any way you like.
-- Run once into the script environment by script_host.cpp, before any game script. Nothing happens until a script calls it.
-- Everything is plain Lua on top of setPosition, setRotation, setVelocity and the history natives getRewindDepth / getRewindState, so it can be read, copied and changed.
-- Coordinates are physics units, the ones objects.world[name].x / .y and setPosition use; angles are radians.
local env = ...
local G = env._G
local pairs, ipairs, type, tostring = G.pairs, G.ipairs, G.type, G.tostring
local sin, cos, sqrt, pow, abs, floor, min, max, pi = G.math.sin, G.math.cos, G.math.sqrt, G.math.pow or function(a, b) return a ^ b end, G.math.abs, G.math.floor, G.math.min, G.math.max, G.math.pi

local motion = { jobs = {}, nextId = 1 }
env.motion = motion

------------------------------------------------------------------ easing functions: t from 0 to 1 in, progress out (it may leave 0..1: back, elastic)
local E = {}
motion.easing = E
E.linear = function(t) return t end

local function bounceOut(t)
	local n, d = 7.5625, 2.75
	if t < 1 / d then return n * t * t
	elseif t < 2 / d then t = t - 1.5 / d return n * t * t + 0.75
	elseif t < 2.5 / d then t = t - 2.25 / d return n * t * t + 0.9375
	else t = t - 2.625 / d return n * t * t + 0.984375 end
end
local c1, c4 = 1.70158, 2 * pi / 3
local ins = {   -- the "in" form of each family
	Quad = function(t) return t * t end,
	Cubic = function(t) return t * t * t end,
	Quart = function(t) return t * t * t * t end,
	Quint = function(t) return t * t * t * t * t end,
	Sine = function(t) return 1 - cos(t * pi / 2) end,
	Expo = function(t) return t == 0 and 0 or pow(2, 10 * t - 10) end,
	Circ = function(t) return 1 - sqrt(1 - t * t) end,
	Back = function(t) return (c1 + 1) * t * t * t - c1 * t * t end,
}
local outs = {   -- families that are defined by their "out" form
	Elastic = function(t) if t == 0 or t == 1 then return t end return pow(2, -10 * t) * sin((t * 10 - 0.75) * c4) + 1 end,
	Bounce = bounceOut,
}
for name, f in pairs(ins) do
	E["in" .. name] = f
	E["out" .. name] = function(t) return 1 - f(1 - t) end
end
for name, f in pairs(outs) do
	E["out" .. name] = f
	E["in" .. name] = function(t) return 1 - f(1 - t) end
end
local families = {}
for name in pairs(ins) do families[#families + 1] = name end
for name in pairs(outs) do families[#families + 1] = name end
for _, name in ipairs(families) do
	local i, o = E["in" .. name], E["out" .. name]
	E["inOut" .. name] = function(t) if t < 0.5 then return i(t * 2) / 2 end return 0.5 + o(t * 2 - 1) / 2 end
end

-- E.steps(n): n flat steps. E.bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2): the CSS cubic-bezier(). E.spring(stiffness, damping): a damped spring that settles at 1.
E.steps = function(n) return function(t) return floor(t * n) / n end end
E.bezier = function(x1, y1, x2, y2)
	local bx = 3 * x1; local cx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - bx; local ax = 1 - bx - cx
	local by = 3 * y1; local cy = 3 * (y2 - y1) - by; local ay = 1 - by - cy
	return function(t)
		if t <= 0 then return 0 elseif t >= 1 then return 1 end
		local s = t
		for _ = 1, 8 do   -- Newton: the curve parameter whose x is t
			local d = (3 * ax * s + 2 * cx) * s + bx
			if abs(d) < 1e-6 then break end
			s = s - (((ax * s + cx) * s + bx) * s - t) / d
		end
		return ((ay * s + cy) * s + by) * s
	end
end
E.spring = function(stiffness, damping)
	stiffness, damping = stiffness or 12, damping or 0.5
	return function(t) return 1 - cos(t * stiffness) * pow(2.718281828, -t * damping * stiffness) end
end

-- an easing can be a name ("outBounce"), a function(t), a table {x1, y1, x2, y2} (a bezier), or nil (linear)
local function easeOf(spec)
	if spec == nil then return E.linear end
	if type(spec) == "function" then return spec end
	if type(spec) == "string" then
		local f = E[spec]
		if f == nil then G.print("motion: no easing named " .. spec .. ", using linear") return E.linear end
		return f
	end
	if type(spec) == "table" and spec[4] ~= nil then return E.bezier(spec[1], spec[2], spec[3], spec[4]) end
	return E.linear
end
motion.ease = easeOf

------------------------------------------------------------------ putting an object somewhere
local function lerp(a, b, p) return a + (b - a) * p end

local function currentOf(name)
	local o = env.objects and env.objects.world and env.objects.world[name]
	if o == nil then return nil end
	return o.x, o.y, o.angle or 0
end

-- places an object: any of x, y, angle can be nil (kept). Its speed is set to vx, vy (0 when left out) so physics does not fight the move.
local function place(name, x, y, a, vx, vy)
	local cx, cy, ca = currentOf(name)
	if cx == nil then return false end
	if x ~= nil or y ~= nil then env.setPosition(name, x or cx, y or cy) end
	if a ~= nil then env.setRotation(name, a) end
	env.setVelocity(name, vx or 0, vy or 0)
	return true
end

-- motion.teleport(name, x, y [, angle [, keepSpeed]]): an instant move. Speed is kept when keepSpeed is true, else the object stops.
function motion.teleport(name, x, y, angle, keepSpeed)
	local cx, cy, ca = currentOf(name)
	if cx == nil then return false end
	local speed, vx, vy = 0, 0, 0
	if keepSpeed and env.getVelocity then speed, vx, vy = env.getVelocity(name) end
	return place(name, x, y, angle, vx, vy)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------ jobs: everything that moves is a job, and all jobs run from one update handler
-- release: what happens to the speed at the end: "stop" (default), "keep" (the speed from before the job), "throw" (the speed of the last frames of the move), or {vx, vy}
local function finish(job, completed)
	for _, name in ipairs(job.names) do
		if motion.byName[name] == job then motion.byName[name] = nil end
		local rel = job.release
		if env.objects and env.objects.world and env.objects.world[name] ~= nil then
			if rel == "keep" and job.speeds[name] then env.setVelocity(name, job.speeds[name][1], job.speeds[name][2])
			elseif rel == "throw" and job.last[name] then env.setVelocity(name, job.last[name][1], job.last[name][2])
			elseif type(rel) == "table" then env.setVelocity(name, rel[1], rel[2]) end
		end
	end
	motion.jobs[job.id] = nil
	if completed and job.onDone then
		local ok, err = G.pcall(job.onDone, job.names[1], job)
		if not ok then G.print("motion onDone: " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
end
motion.byName = {}

local function newJob(kind, names, o)
	local job = { id = motion.nextId, kind = kind, names = names, t = -(o.delay or 0), time = o.time, loop = o.loop, yoyo = o.yoyo, realTime = o.realTime,
		release = o.release or "stop", onDone = o.onDone, onUpdate = o.onUpdate, speeds = {}, last = {}, pass = 0, o = o }
	motion.nextId = motion.nextId + 1
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		local old = motion.byName[name]
		if old ~= nil then finish(old, false) end   -- a new job on an object replaces the old one
		motion.byName[name] = job
		if env.getVelocity then
			local _, vx, vy = env.getVelocity(name)
			job.speeds[name] = { vx or 0, vy or 0 }
		end
	end
	motion.jobs[job.id] = job
	return job
end

local function listOf(names)
	if type(names) == "string" then return { names } end
	if type(names) == "function" then   -- a filter: every object it says yes to
		local out = {}
		for name, obj in pairs(env.objects.world) do if names(name, obj) then out[#out + 1] = name end end
		return out
	end
	return names
end

-- Catmull-Rom through a list of points {{x, y [, angle]}, ...}: p from 0 to 1 along the whole line
local function along(points, p)
	local n = #points
	if n == 1 then return points[1][1], points[1][2], points[1][3] end
	local f = max(0, min(1, p)) * (n - 1)
	local i = min(floor(f), n - 2)
	local u = f - i
	local function pt(k) k = max(1, min(n, k)) return points[k] end
	local p0, p1, p2, p3 = pt(i), pt(i + 1), pt(i + 2), pt(i + 3)
	local function cr(a, b, c, d) return 0.5 * ((2 * b) + (-a + c) * u + (2 * a - 5 * b + 4 * c - d) * u * u + (-a + 3 * b - 3 * c + d) * u * u * u) end
	local a
	if p1[3] ~= nil and p2[3] ~= nil then a = lerp(p1[3], p2[3], u) end
	return cr(p0[1], p1[1], p2[1], p3[1]), cr(p0[2], p1[2], p2[2], p3[2]), a
end

-- motion.to(name, props): move an object with a tween. props (all optional except that something must say where to):
--   x, y, angle        where it ends (absolute);  dx, dy, dangle  how far it moves from where it is;  from = {x =, y =, angle =}  where it starts (default: where it is)
--   time               seconds (default 1);  delay  seconds to wait;  ease  see below;  easeX, easeY, easeAngle  a different easing for one axis
--   points             {{x, y [, angle]}, ...}: follow a smooth line through these points (the first one is where it starts when `from` is left out)
--   path               function(p, obj) -> x, y [, angle]: ANY movement. p is the eased progress (0 to 1, more or less with an elastic easing); obj is objects.world[name]
--   loop               true or a number of repeats;  yoyo  true: every second run goes back
--   release            "stop" (default), "keep", "throw" or {vx, vy}, see above
--   realTime           true: count real seconds, not game seconds (so slow motion does not slow the move)
--   onUpdate(p, name)  every frame;  onDone(name)  when it has finished (not when it was stopped)
-- ease is a name from motion.easing ("linear", "inQuad", "outCubic", "inOutBack", "outBounce", "outElastic", ... every family has in, out and inOut), a function(t),
-- or {x1, y1, x2, y2} for a bezier. Add your own: motion.easing.wobble = function(t) return t + sin(t * 20) * 0.05 end, then ease = "wobble".
-- It returns the job. Use a table of names, or a function(name, obj) that says yes to the objects you want, to move several at once (they get the same props).
function motion.to(names, props)
	props = props or {}
	names = listOf(names)
	local job = newJob("to", names, props)
	job.time = props.time or 1
	job.ease = easeOf(props.ease)
	job.easeX, job.easeY, job.easeA = easeOf(props.easeX or props.ease), easeOf(props.easeY or props.ease), easeOf(props.easeAngle or props.ease)
	job.start = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		local cx, cy, ca = currentOf(name)
		local from = props.from or {}
		local sx, sy, sa = from.x or cx, from.y or cy, from.angle or ca
		if sx ~= nil then
			job.start[name] = { sx, sy, sa,
				props.x or (props.dx and sx + props.dx) or sx, props.y or (props.dy and sy + props.dy) or sy, props.angle or (props.dangle and sa + props.dangle) or sa }
		end
	end
	return job
end

-- motion.drive(name, fn [, opts]): fn(t, dt, obj) is called every frame with the seconds since the start and returns x, y, angle (nil keeps that part). Return false to stop. opts: delay, release, realTime, onDone.
function motion.drive(names, fn, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local job = newJob("drive", listOf(names), opts)
	job.fn = fn
	return job
end

-- motion.rewind(frames [, opts]): put objects back along the history, as a movement. The history is the one rewind() uses (the last 600 frames, setRewindLimit changes that).
-- opts: names (a name, a table of names, or a function(name, obj); default every object), time (seconds, default 0.5), ease (any easing: the easing decides how fast the history goes by,
-- so "inOutQuad" is a soft rewind, "outBounce" bounces against the old state, a function that goes 0 -> 1 -> 0.5 plays it back and forth), from (the history frame it starts at, 0 = now, default 0),
-- to (default `frames`: how far back it ends; `to` smaller than `from` plays history forward again), release (default "keep": the speed the object had in the history frame it ends on), onDone, delay, realTime.
-- It returns the job, or nil when there is no history.
function motion.rewind(frames, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local depth = env.getRewindDepth and env.getRewindDepth() or 0
	frames = min(frames or depth, depth)
	local from, to = opts.from or 0, opts.to or frames
	from, to = max(0, min(depth, from)), max(0, min(depth, to))
	if depth <= 0 or from == to then return nil end
	local names
	if opts.names == nil then names = listOf(function() return true end) else names = listOf(opts.names) end
	local wanted = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(names) do wanted[n] = true end
	-- the history keeps changing while this runs (every frame is recorded), so the part that is needed is copied now
	local lo, hi = min(from, to), max(from, to)
	local track = {}
	for k = lo, hi do track[k] = env.getRewindState(k) end
	local o = G.setmetatable({}, { __index = opts })
	o.release = opts.release or "keep"
	local job = newJob("scrub", names, o)
	job.time = opts.time or 0.5
	job.ease = easeOf(opts.ease)
	job.track, job.from, job.to, job.lo, job.hi = track, from, to, lo, hi
	return job
end

-- motion.rewindObject(name, frames [, opts]) is motion.rewind for one object
function motion.rewindObject(name, frames, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local o = G.setmetatable({ names = { name } }, { __index = opts })
	return motion.rewind(frames, o)
end

-- motion.stop(nameOrJob [, release]): ends the move of an object (or one job) where it is; the job's onDone is not called. release overrides the job's own.
function motion.stop(what, release)
	local job = type(what) == "table" and what or motion.byName[what]
	if job == nil then return false end
	if release ~= nil then job.release = release end
	finish(job, false)
	return true
end
function motion.stopAll() for _, job in pairs(motion.jobs) do finish(job, false) end end
function motion.isMoving(name) return motion.byName[name] ~= nil end

------------------------------------------------------------------ the frame
local function frameAt(job, name, f)   -- the state of `name` at history position f (a fraction of a frame is a blend of two)
	f = max(job.lo, min(job.hi, f))
	local a = floor(f)
	local b = min(job.hi, a + 1)
	local sa, sb = job.track[a] and job.track[a][name], job.track[b] and job.track[b][name]
	if sa == nil then return sb end
	if sb == nil or a == b then return sa end
	local u = f - a
	return { x = lerp(sa.x, sb.x, u), y = lerp(sa.y, sb.y, u), angle = lerp(sa.angle, sb.angle, u), vx = lerp(sa.vx, sb.vx, u), vy = lerp(sa.vy, sb.vy, u) }
end

local function stepJob(job, dt)
	job.t = job.t + dt
	if job.t < 0 then return end
	local gone = {}
	if job.kind == "drive" then
		for _, name in ipairs(job.names) do
			local obj = env.objects.world[name]
			if obj == nil then gone[#gone + 1] = name
			else
				local ok, x, y, a = G.pcall(job.fn, job.t, dt, obj)
				if not ok then G.print("motion.drive: " .. tostring(x)) finish(job, false) return end
				if x == false then finish(job, true) return end
				local ox, oy = obj.x, obj.y
				place(name, x, y, a)
				if dt > 0 then job.last[name] = { (obj.x - ox) / dt, (obj.y - oy) / dt } end
			end
		end
		return
	end
	local raw = job.time > 0 and job.t / job.time or 1
	local done = false
	if raw >= 1 then
		job.pass = job.pass + 1
		if job.loop == true or (type(job.loop) == "number" and job.pass <= job.loop) then
			job.t = job.t - job.time
			raw = job.t / job.time
		else raw = 1 done = true end
	end
	local runBack = job.yoyo and job.pass % 2 == 1 and not done
	local p = runBack and 1 - raw or raw
	if job.yoyo and done and job.pass % 2 == 0 then p = 0 end
	local progress = job.ease(p)
	for _, name in ipairs(job.names) do
		local obj = env.objects.world[name]
		if obj == nil then gone[#gone + 1] = name
		else
			local ox, oy = obj.x, obj.y
			local x, y, a
			if job.kind == "scrub" then
				local f = job.from + (job.to - job.from) * progress
				local s = frameAt(job, name, f)
				if s ~= nil then x, y, a = s.x, s.y, s.angle end
			elseif job.o.path ~= nil then
				local ok, px, py, pa = G.pcall(job.o.path, progress, obj)
				if not ok then G.print("motion path: " .. tostring(px)) finish(job, false) return end
				x, y, a = px, py, pa
			elseif job.o.points ~= nil then
				x, y, a = along(job.o.points, progress)
			else
				local s = job.start[name]
				if s ~= nil then
					x, y, a = lerp(s[1], s[4], job.easeX(p)), lerp(s[2], s[5], job.easeY(p)), lerp(s[3], s[6], job.easeA(p))
				end
			end
			place(name, x, y, a)
			if dt > 0 then job.last[name] = { (obj.x - ox) / dt, (obj.y - oy) / dt } end
			if job.onUpdate then G.pcall(job.onUpdate, progress, name) end
		end
	end
	for _, name in ipairs(gone) do   -- an object that was removed drops out of the job
		for i, n in ipairs(job.names) do if n == name then G.table.remove(job.names, i) break end end
		if motion.byName[name] == job then motion.byName[name] = nil end
	end
	if #job.names == 0 then finish(job, true) return end   -- every object of the job is gone: nothing is left to move, so it counts as done
	if done then
		if job.kind == "scrub" and job.release == "keep" then   -- the speeds of the history frame it ended on
			for _, name in ipairs(job.names) do
				local s = frameAt(job, name, job.to)
				if s ~= nil then job.speeds[name] = { s.vx or 0, s.vy or 0 } end
			end
		end
		finish(job, true)
	end
end

env.engine.on("update", function(dt, realDt)
	if env.objects == nil or env.objects.world == nil then return end
	local list = {}
	for _, job in pairs(motion.jobs) do list[#list + 1] = job end   -- a copy: a job that ends may start another
	for _, job in ipairs(list) do
		if motion.jobs[job.id] ~= nil then stepJob(job, job.realTime and (realDt or dt) or dt) end
	end
end)
env.engine.on("levelLoaded", function() motion.stopAll() end)

```

```h
// The table passed to createJoint(...). Missing numbers are 0, missing flags false.
struct JointDef {
    std::string name, end1, end2;
    int type = 0;
    int coordType = 0;
    float x1 = 0, y1 = 0, x2 = 0, y2 = 0;
    float frequency = 0, dampingRatio = 0;

    bool motor = false;

    float groundX1 = 0, groundY1 = 0, groundX2 = 0, groundY2 = 0;   // 6: the two fixed pulley points, in world coordinates
    float ratio = 1.0f;                                              // 6 pulley ratio, 7 gear ratio

    float maxForce = 0;                                              // 8 mouse, 10 friction

    float maxLength = 0;                                             // 11 rope
```

`src/lua/save_states.cpp`:

```cpp
// Save states: leave a level half played and come back to exactly that, in every game.
//
// While a level runs, the state of the level is written to a file in the save folder every few seconds and when the level is left (the game mode
// leaves `updateGame`) or the game is closed. When the same level is loaded again it is put back in the first frame the level runs. What is kept:
//   - every object of objects.world: its place, angle and speed (a body that was at rest is put to sleep), and every plain value (number, string,
//     flag) in its table: strength, damage sprite, start number and so on;
//   - the script variables named in saveStates.globals (the bird that is next, shots fired, the score ...), the tables in saveStates.tables
//     (the score table, the camera), the objects the variables in saveStates.objectGlobals point to (the flying bird) and the camera function;
//   - objects that are gone are removed again (also from the tables in saveStates.objectTables).
// A restart, finishing the level and failing it clear the state. Objects the scripts made after the level began are not part of it.
// The settings are the Lua table `saveStates` (made here with its defaults; scripts may change any field). See docs/SCRIPTING.md.
#include "lua/lua_api.h"
#include "lua/platform.h"
#include "lua/aes.h"

#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

extern "C" {
#include "lauxlib.h"
#include "lua.h"
#include "lualib.h"
}

namespace ab {
namespace {

struct State {
    bool pending = false, ready = false, suspended = false, prevRunning = false;
    double clock = 0, lastWrite = 0, leftAt = -1e9, lastSnap = 0;
    std::string curId, lastId;
    Platform* platform = nullptr;
} g;

int AbsIdx(lua_State* L, int i) { return (i > 0 || i <= LUA_REGISTRYINDEX) ? i : lua_gettop(L) + i + 1; }
void PushEnv(lua_State* L) { lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env"); }
void GetG(lua_State* L, const char* name) { PushEnv(L); lua_getfield(L, -1, name); lua_remove(L, -2); }

// ---- settings
void GetCfg(lua_State* L) { GetG(L, "saveStates"); }
bool CfgBool(lua_State* L, const char* k, bool def) {
    GetCfg(L);
    bool r = def;
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, k); if (lua_isboolean(L, -1)) r = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0; lua_pop(L, 1); }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return r;
}
double CfgNum(lua_State* L, const char* k, double def) {
    GetCfg(L);
    double r = def;
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, k); if (lua_isnumber(L, -1)) r = lua_tonumber(L, -1); lua_pop(L, 1); }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return r;
}
std::string CfgStr(lua_State* L, const char* k, const char* def) {
    GetCfg(L);
    std::string r = def;
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, k); if (lua_isstring(L, -1)) r = lua_tostring(L, -1); lua_pop(L, 1); }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return r;
}
// the names in the list saveStates[key]
std::vector<std::string> CfgList(lua_State* L, const char* key) {
    std::vector<std::string> r;
    GetCfg(L);
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, -1, key);
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            const int n = (int)lua_objlen(L, -1);
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) { lua_rawgeti(L, -1, i); if (lua_isstring(L, -1)) r.push_back(lua_tostring(L, -1)); lua_pop(L, 1); }
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return r;
}

// ---- the state in memory: registry["ab.saveStates"] = { levels = { [levelPath] = state } }
void GetData(lua_State* L) {
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.saveStates");
    if (!lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        lua_newtable(L); lua_newtable(L); lua_setfield(L, -2, "levels");
        lua_pushvalue(L, -1); lua_setfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.saveStates");
    }
}
void Escape(std::string& out, const char* s, size_t n) {
    out += '"';
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        unsigned char c = (unsigned char)s[i];
        if (c == '"') out += "\\\""; else if (c == '\\') out += "\\\\"; else if (c == '\n') out += "\\n"; else if (c == '\r') out += "\\r";
        else if (c < 32) { char b[8]; std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "\\%03d", c); out += b; } else out += (char)c;
    }
    out += '"';
}
void Serialize(lua_State* L, int idx, std::string& out, int depth) {
    idx = AbsIdx(L, idx);
    switch (lua_type(L, idx)) {
    case LUA_TNUMBER: { char b[40]; std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%.9g", lua_tonumber(L, idx)); out += b; break; }
    case LUA_TBOOLEAN: out += lua_toboolean(L, idx) ? "true" : "false"; break;
    case LUA_TSTRING: { size_t n; const char* s = lua_tolstring(L, idx, &n); Escape(out, s, n); break; }
    case LUA_TTABLE: {
        if (depth > 8) { out += "{}"; break; }
        out += '{';
        lua_pushnil(L);
        while (lua_next(L, idx)) {
            const int kt = lua_type(L, -2), vt = lua_type(L, -1);
            if ((kt == LUA_TSTRING || kt == LUA_TNUMBER) && (vt == LUA_TNUMBER || vt == LUA_TBOOLEAN || vt == LUA_TSTRING || vt == LUA_TTABLE)) {
                out += '[';
                if (kt == LUA_TSTRING) { size_t n; const char* s = lua_tolstring(L, -2, &n); Escape(out, s, n); } else { char b[40]; std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%.9g", lua_tonumber(L, -2)); out += b; }
                out += "]=";
                Serialize(L, -1, out, depth + 1);
                out += ',';
            }
            lua_pop(L, 1);
        }
        out += '}';
        break;
    }
    default: out += "nil";
    }
}
std::string FilePath(lua_State* L) { return g.platform->ResolveUserFile(CfgStr(L, "file", "savestates.lua"), true); }
void Write(lua_State* L) {
    if (!g.platform) return;
    GetData(L);
    std::string text = "saveStatesData = ";
    Serialize(L, -1, text, 0);
    text += "\n";
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(text.begin(), text.end());
    if (!WriteFileSafely(FilePath(L), bytes)) std::fprintf(stderr, "saveStates: cannot write %s\n", FilePath(L).c_str());
    g.lastWrite = g.clock;
}
void LoadFile(lua_State* L) {          // once: reads the file into the registry
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.saveStates");
    const bool have = lua_istable(L, -1);
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    if (have || !g.platform) return;
    GetData(L); lua_pop(L, 1);
    std::string text; bool enc = false;
    if (!ReadSaveFile(FilePath(L), text, enc)) return;
    if (luaL_loadbuffer(L, text.data(), text.size(), "=savestates") != 0) { lua_pop(L, 1); return; }
    lua_newtable(L); lua_pushvalue(L, -1);
    lua_setfenv(L, -3);
    const int env = lua_gettop(L);
    lua_pushvalue(L, -2);
    if (lua_pcall(L, 0, 0, 0) == 0) {
        lua_getfield(L, env, "saveStatesData");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "levels");
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_pop(L, 1); lua_setfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.saveStates"); }
            else lua_pop(L, 2);
        } else lua_pop(L, 1);
    } else lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_settop(L, env - 2);
}
bool HasState(lua_State* L, const std::string& id) {
    GetData(L); lua_getfield(L, -1, "levels"); lua_getfield(L, -1, id.c_str());
    const bool r = lua_istable(L, -1);
    lua_pop(L, 3);
    return r;
}
void Forget(lua_State* L, const std::string& id) {
    LoadFile(L);
    if (HasState(L, id)) {
        GetData(L); lua_getfield(L, -1, "levels"); lua_pushnil(L); lua_setfield(L, -2, id.c_str()); lua_pop(L, 2);
        Write(L);
    }
    if (id == g.curId) g.suspended = true;        // nothing is saved again until the next level load (a restart is on its way)
}

// ---- state of the game
bool IsRunning(lua_State* L) {
    GetG(L, "currentGameMode"); GetG(L, "updateGame");
    bool r = !lua_isnil(L, -1) && lua_rawequal(L, -2, -1);
    lua_pop(L, 2);
    if (!r) return false;
    GetG(L, "objects");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, "world"); r = lua_istable(L, -1); lua_pop(L, 1); } else r = false;
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return r;
}
// the level is set up: the script variable named in saveStates.readyVariable (the slingshot position) is there and not zero
bool IsReady(lua_State* L) {
    const std::string var = CfgStr(L, "readyVariable", "levelStartPosition");
    if (var.empty()) return true;
    GetG(L, var.c_str());
    bool r = true;
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, "x"); r = !lua_isnumber(L, -1) || lua_tonumber(L, -1) != 0; lua_pop(L, 1); }
    else if (lua_isnil(L, -1)) r = true;
    else if (lua_isboolean(L, -1)) r = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0;
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return r;
}
bool Truthy(lua_State* L, const std::string& name) { GetG(L, name.c_str()); bool r = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0; lua_pop(L, 1); return r; }
bool Positive(lua_State* L, const std::string& name) { GetG(L, name.c_str()); bool r = lua_isnumber(L, -1) && lua_tonumber(L, -1) > 0; lua_pop(L, 1); return r; }

// a copy of the table at idx with its plain values (numbers, strings, flags) and, down to `depth`, its tables
void PlainCopy(lua_State* L, int idx, int depth) {
    idx = AbsIdx(L, idx);
    lua_newtable(L);
    lua_pushnil(L);
    while (lua_next(L, idx)) {
        const int kt = lua_type(L, -2), vt = lua_type(L, -1);
        bool keep = kt == LUA_TSTRING || kt == LUA_TNUMBER;
        if (keep && vt == LUA_TNUMBER) { double d = lua_tonumber(L, -1); keep = d == d && d > -1e30 && d < 1e30; }
        else if (keep && vt != LUA_TBOOLEAN && vt != LUA_TSTRING && !(vt == LUA_TTABLE && depth > 0)) keep = false;
        if (keep) {
            lua_pushvalue(L, -2);
            if (vt == LUA_TTABLE) PlainCopy(L, -2, depth - 1); else lua_pushvalue(L, -2);
            lua_settable(L, -5);
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
}
// copies the values of the table at src into the table at dst (tables are merged)
void Merge(lua_State* L, int dst, int src, bool skipPlace) {
    dst = AbsIdx(L, dst); src = AbsIdx(L, src);
    lua_pushnil(L);
    while (lua_next(L, src)) {
        if (skipPlace && lua_type(L, -2) == LUA_TSTRING) {
            const char* k = lua_tostring(L, -2);
            if (!std::strcmp(k, "x") || !std::strcmp(k, "y") || !std::strcmp(k, "angle") || !std::strcmp(k, "name") || !std::strcmp(k, "definition")) { lua_pop(L, 1); continue; }
        }
        lua_pushvalue(L, -2);
        lua_gettable(L, dst);
        if (lua_istable(L, -1) && lua_istable(L, -2)) { Merge(L, -1, -2, false); lua_pop(L, 1); }
        else { lua_pop(L, 1); lua_pushvalue(L, -2); lua_pushvalue(L, -2); lua_settable(L, dst); }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
}
// env function call with a name and the given numbers; returns the number of results left on the stack
int CallEnv(lua_State* L, const char* fn, const std::string& name, std::initializer_list<double> nums, int nret) {
    GetG(L, fn);
    if (!lua_isfunction(L, -1)) { lua_pop(L, 1); return 0; }
    lua_pushstring(L, name.c_str());
    for (double d : nums) lua_pushnumber(L, d);
    if (lua_pcall(L, 1 + (int)nums.size(), nret, 0) != 0) { lua_pop(L, 1); return 0; }
    return nret;
}
double Num(lua_State* L, int idx, double def = 0) { return lua_isnumber(L, idx) ? lua_tonumber(L, idx) : def; }

// ---- capture
bool HasWorld(lua_State* L) {
    GetG(L, "objects");
    bool r = false;
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, "world"); r = lua_istable(L, -1); lua_pop(L, 1); }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    return r;
}

// `leaving`: the game mode has just left updateGame, the objects are still there
bool g_explain = false;     // 3.7.1: a save that was asked for says on the console why it kept nothing
bool Capture(lua_State* L, bool leaving = false) {
    if (!CfgBool(L, "enabled", true) || g.suspended || !g.ready || !(leaving ? HasWorld(L) : IsRunning(L)) || g.curId.empty()) {
        if (g_explain) std::fprintf(stderr, "save state: nothing kept (%s%s%s)\n", g.suspended ? "this level is in skipLevels or saving is off; " : "", g.ready ? "" : "the level was not set up yet; ", "the level is not running");
        return false;
    }
    for (const std::string& n : CfgList(L, "skipWhen")) if (Truthy(L, n)) { if (g_explain) std::fprintf(stderr, "save state: nothing kept, %s is true (the level is finished)\n", n.c_str()); Forget(L, g.curId); return false; }
    for (const std::string& n : CfgList(L, "skipWhenPositive")) if (Positive(L, n)) { if (g_explain) std::fprintf(stderr, "save state: nothing kept, %s is above 0 (the level is failed)\n", n.c_str()); Forget(L, g.curId); return false; }
    LoadFile(L);
    const int top = lua_gettop(L);
    lua_newtable(L);                              // the state
    const int st = lua_gettop(L);
    lua_newtable(L);                              // objects
    GetG(L, "objects"); lua_getfield(L, -1, "world"); lua_remove(L, -2);
    lua_pushnil(L);
    while (lua_next(L, -2)) {
        if (lua_type(L, -2) == LUA_TSTRING && lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "x");
            const bool placed = lua_isnumber(L, -1);
            lua_pop(L, 1);
            if (placed) {
                const std::string name = lua_tostring(L, -2);
                lua_getfield(L, -1, "mass"); const bool moves = Num(L, -1) > 0; lua_pop(L, 1);
                lua_newtable(L);                  // o
                PlainCopy(L, -2, 0); lua_setfield(L, -2, "f");
                if (moves) {
                    double vx = 0, vy = 0, w = 0;
                    if (CallEnv(L, "getVelocity", name, {}, 3)) { vx = Num(L, -2); vy = Num(L, -1); lua_pop(L, 3); }
                    if (CallEnv(L, "getAngularVelocity", name, {}, 1)) { w = Num(L, -1); lua_pop(L, 1); }
                    lua_pushboolean(L, 1); lua_setfield(L, -2, "moves");
                    // 3.7.1: the body type (the game keeps the birds that wait as static bodies and makes the next one dynamic): without it a restored bird stays where it is
                    GetG(L, "getBodyType");
                    if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
                        lua_pushstring(L, name.c_str());
                        if (lua_pcall(L, 1, 1, 0) == 0 && lua_isstring(L, -1)) lua_setfield(L, -2, "bt"); else lua_pop(L, 1);
                    } else lua_pop(L, 1);
                    lua_pushnumber(L, vx); lua_setfield(L, -2, "vx");
                    lua_pushnumber(L, vy); lua_setfield(L, -2, "vy");
                    lua_pushnumber(L, w); lua_setfield(L, -2, "w");
                    lua_pushboolean(L, vx == 0 && vy == 0 && w == 0); lua_setfield(L, -2, "rest");
                }
                lua_setfield(L, st + 1, name.c_str());
            }
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);                                // the world table
    lua_setfield(L, st, "objects");
    lua_newtable(L);                              // globals
    for (const std::string& n : CfgList(L, "globals")) {
        GetG(L, n.c_str());
        const int t = lua_type(L, -1);
        if (t == LUA_TNUMBER || t == LUA_TSTRING || t == LUA_TBOOLEAN) lua_setfield(L, -2, n.c_str()); else lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_setfield(L, st, "globals");
    lua_newtable(L);                              // tables
    for (const std::string& n : CfgList(L, "tables")) {
        GetG(L, n.c_str());
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { PlainCopy(L, -1, 3); lua_setfield(L, -3, n.c_str()); }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_setfield(L, st, "tables");
    lua_newtable(L);                              // objects the variables point to
    for (const std::string& n : CfgList(L, "objectGlobals")) {
        GetG(L, n.c_str());
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -1, "name"); if (lua_isstring(L, -1)) lua_setfield(L, -3, n.c_str()); else lua_pop(L, 1); }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_setfield(L, st, "refs");
    {   // 3.7.1: the trail that is drawn (kept by the engine, not by a script table)
        std::vector<float> trail;
        g.platform->GetTrajectory(trail);
        if (trail.size() > 1) {
            lua_newtable(L);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < trail.size(); i++) { lua_pushnumber(L, trail[i]); lua_rawseti(L, -2, (int)i + 1); }
            lua_setfield(L, st, "trail");
        }
    }
    GetG(L, "cameraFunction");
    if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
        for (const std::string& n : CfgList(L, "cameras")) {
            GetG(L, n.c_str());
            if (lua_isfunction(L, -1) && lua_rawequal(L, -1, -2)) { lua_pushstring(L, n.c_str()); lua_setfield(L, st, "camera"); }
            lua_pop(L, 1);
        }
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    GetData(L); lua_getfield(L, -1, "levels");
    lua_pushvalue(L, st); lua_setfield(L, -2, g.curId.c_str());
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return true;
}

// ---- put back
void CallEnvStr(lua_State* L, const char* fn, const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
    GetG(L, fn);
    if (!lua_isfunction(L, -1)) { lua_pop(L, 1); return; }
    lua_pushstring(L, a.c_str()); lua_pushstring(L, b.c_str());
    if (lua_pcall(L, 2, 0, 0) != 0) lua_pop(L, 1);
}
void CallEnvSleep(lua_State* L, const std::string& name) {
    GetG(L, "setSleeping");
    if (!lua_isfunction(L, -1)) { lua_pop(L, 1); return; }
    lua_pushstring(L, name.c_str()); lua_pushboolean(L, 1);
    if (lua_pcall(L, 2, 0, 0) != 0) lua_pop(L, 1);
}
// pushes registry data.levels[id]
void PushState(lua_State* L, const std::string& id) { GetData(L); lua_getfield(L, -1, "levels"); lua_getfield(L, -1, id.c_str()); lua_remove(L, -2); lua_remove(L, -2); }
// the string keys of the table at idx
std::vector<std::string> Keys(lua_State* L, int idx) {
    idx = AbsIdx(L, idx);
    std::vector<std::string> r;
    lua_pushnil(L);
    while (lua_next(L, idx)) { if (lua_type(L, -2) == LUA_TSTRING) r.push_back(lua_tostring(L, -2)); lua_pop(L, 1); }
    return r;
}

bool Apply(lua_State* L) {
    LoadFile(L);
    if (!CfgBool(L, "enabled", true) || !IsRunning(L) || g.curId.empty() || !HasState(L, g.curId)) return false;
    const int top = lua_gettop(L);
    PushState(L, g.curId);
    const int st = lua_gettop(L);
    lua_getfield(L, st, "objects");
    const int saved = lua_gettop(L);
    GetG(L, "objects"); lua_getfield(L, -1, "world"); lua_remove(L, -2);
    const int world = lua_gettop(L);
    const std::vector<std::string> objTables = CfgList(L, "objectTables");
    // what was destroyed since the level began
    for (const std::string& name : Keys(L, world)) {
        lua_getfield(L, saved, name.c_str());
        const bool kept = lua_istable(L, -1);
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        if (kept) continue;
        CallEnv(L, "removeObject", name, {}, 0);
        lua_pushnil(L); lua_setfield(L, world, name.c_str());
        for (const std::string& t : objTables) { GetG(L, t.c_str()); if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_pushnil(L); lua_setfield(L, -2, name.c_str()); } lua_pop(L, 1); }
    }
    // the objects that are left
    for (const std::string& name : Keys(L, saved)) {
        lua_getfield(L, world, name.c_str());
        if (!lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_pop(L, 1);
            // an object the level did not start with (the pieces of a Blue Bird that split): made again from its definition, at the place it was saved
            lua_getfield(L, saved, name.c_str()); lua_getfield(L, -1, "f");
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                lua_getfield(L, -1, "definition");
                const std::string def = lua_isstring(L, -1) ? lua_tostring(L, -1) : "";
                lua_pop(L, 1);
                lua_getfield(L, -1, "x"); lua_getfield(L, -2, "y"); lua_getfield(L, -3, "angle");
                const double x = Num(L, -3), y = Num(L, -2), a = Num(L, -1);
                lua_pop(L, 3);
                if (!def.empty()) {
                    PushEnv(L); lua_getfield(L, -1, "createObject"); lua_getfield(L, -2, "blockTable");
                    if (lua_isfunction(L, -2) && lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                        lua_pushstring(L, def.c_str()); lua_pushstring(L, name.c_str()); lua_pushnumber(L, x); lua_pushnumber(L, y);
                        lua_newtable(L); lua_pushnumber(L, a); lua_setfield(L, -2, "angle");
                        if (lua_pcall(L, 6, 0, 0) != 0) lua_pop(L, 1);
                        lua_pop(L, 1);
                    } else lua_pop(L, 3);
                    lua_getfield(L, world, name.c_str());
                    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                        lua_getfield(L, saved, name.c_str()); lua_getfield(L, -1, "f"); lua_getfield(L, -1, "controllable");
                        const bool bird = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0;
                        lua_pop(L, 3);
                        if (bird) { GetG(L, "birds"); if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_pushvalue(L, -2); lua_setfield(L, -2, name.c_str()); } lua_pop(L, 1); }
                    }
                    lua_pop(L, 1);
                }
            }
            lua_pop(L, 2);
            lua_getfield(L, world, name.c_str());
            if (!lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_pop(L, 1); continue; }
        }
        const int obj = lua_gettop(L);
        lua_getfield(L, saved, name.c_str());
        const int o = lua_gettop(L);
        lua_getfield(L, o, "f");
        const int f = lua_gettop(L);
        if (lua_istable(L, f)) {
            lua_getfield(L, f, "sprite");
            const bool hasSprite = lua_isstring(L, -1);
            const std::string want = hasSprite ? lua_tostring(L, -1) : std::string();
            lua_pop(L, 1);
            lua_getfield(L, obj, "sprite");
            const bool differs = hasSprite && (!lua_isstring(L, -1) || want != lua_tostring(L, -1));
            lua_pop(L, 1);
            Merge(L, obj, f, true);
            if (differs) CallEnvStr(L, "setSprite", name, want);
            lua_getfield(L, o, "moves");
            const bool moves = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0;
            lua_pop(L, 1);
            if (moves) {
                lua_getfield(L, f, "x"); lua_getfield(L, f, "y"); lua_getfield(L, f, "angle");
                const double x = Num(L, -3), y = Num(L, -2), a = Num(L, -1);
                lua_pop(L, 3);
                lua_getfield(L, o, "vx"); lua_getfield(L, o, "vy"); lua_getfield(L, o, "w"); lua_getfield(L, o, "rest");
                const double vx = Num(L, -4), vy = Num(L, -3), w = Num(L, -2);
                const bool rest = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0;
                lua_pop(L, 4);
                lua_getfield(L, o, "bt");
                if (lua_isstring(L, -1)) { GetG(L, "setBodyType"); if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) { lua_pushstring(L, name.c_str()); lua_pushvalue(L, -3); if (lua_pcall(L, 2, 0, 0) != 0) lua_pop(L, 1); } else lua_pop(L, 1); }
                lua_pop(L, 1);
                CallEnv(L, "setPosition", name, {x, y}, 0);
                CallEnv(L, "setRotation", name, {a}, 0);
                CallEnv(L, "setVelocity", name, {vx, vy}, 0);
                CallEnv(L, "setAngularVelocity", name, {w}, 0);
                lua_getfield(L, f, "controllable");
                const bool bird = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0;      // a bird is never put to sleep: it is launched later, and a body that sleeps stays where it is
                lua_pop(L, 1);
                if (rest && !bird) CallEnvSleep(L, name);
            }
        }
        lua_settop(L, obj - 1);
    }
    // 3.7.1: a bird that was made again (or one the level did not start with) has none of the timers the games' animation code counts down for every entry of `birds`
    // (jumpTimer, animTimer: the games give a piece of a split bird 9999); the missing ones are given that value so the update does not stop on an empty field
    GetG(L, "birds");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_pushnil(L);
        while (lua_next(L, -2)) {
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
                for (const char* f : {"jumpTimer", "animTimer"}) {
                    lua_getfield(L, -1, f);
                    if (lua_isnil(L, -1)) { lua_pushnumber(L, 9999); lua_setfield(L, -3, f); }
                    lua_pop(L, 1);
                }
            }
            lua_pop(L, 1);
        }
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    // the script variables, tables, objects and the camera
    lua_getfield(L, st, "globals");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        PushEnv(L);
        for (const std::string& n : Keys(L, -2)) { lua_getfield(L, -2, n.c_str()); lua_setfield(L, -2, n.c_str()); }
        // 3.7.1: a listed variable that was empty (nil) when the level was saved is not in the saved table; the freshly loaded level may have set it (the bird that is
        // sent to the slingshot first), so it is emptied again
        for (const std::string& n : CfgList(L, "globals")) {
            lua_getfield(L, -2, n.c_str());
            const bool saved = !lua_isnil(L, -1);
            lua_pop(L, 1);
            if (!saved) { lua_pushnil(L); lua_setfield(L, -2, n.c_str()); }
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_getfield(L, st, "tables");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        for (const std::string& n : Keys(L, -1)) {
            GetG(L, n.c_str());
            if (lua_istable(L, -1)) { lua_getfield(L, -2, n.c_str()); Merge(L, -2, -1, false); lua_pop(L, 1); }
            lua_pop(L, 1);
        }
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_getfield(L, st, "refs");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        PushEnv(L);
        for (const std::string& n : Keys(L, -2)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -2, n.c_str());
            const std::string name = lua_isstring(L, -1) ? lua_tostring(L, -1) : "";
            lua_pop(L, 1);
            lua_getfield(L, world, name.c_str());
            lua_setfield(L, -2, n.c_str());
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_getfield(L, st, "trail");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        std::vector<float> trail;
        const int n = (int)lua_objlen(L, -1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) { lua_rawgeti(L, -1, i); trail.push_back((float)Num(L, -1)); lua_pop(L, 1); }
        g.platform->SetTrajectory(trail);
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_getfield(L, st, "camera");
    if (lua_isstring(L, -1)) { GetG(L, lua_tostring(L, -1)); PushEnv(L); lua_pushvalue(L, -2); lua_setfield(L, -2, "cameraFunction"); lua_pop(L, 2); }
    lua_pop(L, 1);
    GetG(L, "worldScale");                       // the camera's zoom is a variable the engine has to be told about
    if (lua_isnumber(L, -1)) { const double ws = lua_tonumber(L, -1); lua_pop(L, 1); GetG(L, "setWorldScale"); if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) { lua_pushnumber(L, ws); if (lua_pcall(L, 1, 0, 0) != 0) lua_pop(L, 1); } else lua_pop(L, 1); }
    else lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_settop(L, top);
    return true;
}

// 3.6: a copy of the running level's state is kept in memory (twice a second, never written): the pause page changes the camera and other variables, and a save made while it is
// open would keep those. A save asked for while the level is not running writes the last copy.
void Snapshot(lua_State* L) {
    if (g.curId.empty()) return;
    const int top = lua_gettop(L);
    GetData(L); lua_getfield(L, -1, "levels");
    lua_getfield(L, -1, g.curId.c_str());          // what was there
    const int old = lua_gettop(L);
    if (Capture(L, false)) {
        lua_getfield(L, old - 1, g.curId.c_str());
        lua_newtable(L);
        lua_pushstring(L, g.curId.c_str()); lua_setfield(L, -2, "id");
        lua_pushvalue(L, -2); lua_setfield(L, -2, "state");
        lua_setfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.snapshot");
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        lua_pushvalue(L, old); lua_setfield(L, old - 1, g.curId.c_str());      // put back what was there
    }
    lua_settop(L, top);
}

bool SaveNow(lua_State* L, bool leaving = false) {
    if (leaving && !IsRunning(L)) {
        lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.snapshot");
        bool done = false;
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            lua_getfield(L, -1, "id");
            const bool same = lua_isstring(L, -1) && g.curId == lua_tostring(L, -1);
            lua_pop(L, 1);
            if (same && !g.suspended && CfgBool(L, "enabled", true)) {
                lua_getfield(L, -1, "state");
                GetData(L); lua_getfield(L, -1, "levels");
                lua_pushvalue(L, -3); lua_setfield(L, -2, g.curId.c_str());
                lua_pop(L, 3);
                done = true;
            }
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
        if (done) { Write(L); return true; }
    }
    if (!Capture(L, leaving)) return false;
    Write(L);
    return true;
}

// ---- Lua: saveStates.save(), apply(), forget([id]), clearAll(), has([id])
int s_save(lua_State* L) { g_explain = true; const bool r = SaveNow(L, true); g_explain = false; if (r) std::fprintf(stderr, "save state of %s written\n", g.curId.c_str()); lua_pushboolean(L, r); return 1; }      // asked for by a script: saved whenever the level's objects are there (the pause page too)
int s_apply(lua_State* L) { lua_pushboolean(L, Apply(L)); return 1; }
int s_forget(lua_State* L) { Forget(L, lua_isstring(L, 1) ? lua_tostring(L, 1) : g.curId); return 0; }
int s_has(lua_State* L) { LoadFile(L); lua_pushboolean(L, HasState(L, lua_isstring(L, 1) ? lua_tostring(L, 1) : g.curId)); return 1; }
int s_clearAll(lua_State* L) {
    LoadFile(L);
    lua_pushnil(L); lua_setfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.saveStates");
    GetData(L); lua_pop(L, 1);
    Write(L);
    g.suspended = true;
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace

// Makes the global table `saveStates` (the settings, with their defaults, and the functions).
void RegisterSaveStates(lua_State* L, Platform* platform) {
    g = State();
    g.platform = platform;
    const char* defaults =
        "saveStates = {\n"
        "  enabled = true,            -- false: nothing is saved or put back\n"
        "  skipLevels = {},           -- parts of level paths: these levels are never saved or put back\n"
        "  file = 'savestates.lua',   -- in the save folder\n"
        "  autosave = 0,              -- seconds (real time) between writes while a level runs; 0: no automatic writes\n"
        "  saveOnLeave = false,       -- true: the state is also written when the level is left or the game is closed; false: only when saveStates.save() is called (the leave pop-up does)\n"
        "  snapshotEvery = 0.05,      -- seconds (real time) between the copies kept in memory for a save made while the game is paused; the pause page changes variables, so the copy is what the level was just before\n"
        "  restartWindow = 2,         -- a level that is loaded again within this many seconds after it was left is a restart: its state is cleared\n"
        "  readyVariable = 'levelStartPosition',  -- the level is set up when this variable is there (a table: with x not 0)\n"
        "  globals = { 'currentBirdIndex', 'currentBirdName', 'birdToSlingshotBirdName', 'birdSpecialtyAvailable', 'birdFired', 'birdReady', 'fillInNextBird',\n"
        "    'birdSelected', 'showTapIcon', 'birdsShot', 'birdsCounter', 'score', 'nextBirdTimer', 'allowTrajectoryClearing',\n"
        "    'levelCompleteTimer' },\n"
        "                             -- (3.6) the camera (the screen table, the zoom, the camera function) is not kept: the game's own camera starts again, and a camera put back alone left the view beside the slingshot\n"
        "  tables = { 'scoreTable', 'birdTrajectory', 'otherBirds' },\n"
        "  objectGlobals = { 'flyingBird', 'selectedBird', 'cameraTargetObject' },\n"
        "  objectTables = { 'birds', 'otherBirds', 'levelGoals' },\n"
        "  cameras = {},                -- camera functions to keep: none by default (names of global functions)\n"
        "  skipWhen = { 'levelCompleted' },           -- a level that is finished (variable true) or failed (variable above 0) is not kept\n"
        "  skipWhenPositive = { 'levelFailedTimer' },\n"
        "}\n";
    PushEnv(L);
    const int env = lua_gettop(L);
    if (luaL_loadstring(L, defaults) == 0) {
        lua_pushvalue(L, env); lua_setfenv(L, -2);
        if (lua_pcall(L, 0, 0, 0) != 0) lua_pop(L, 1);
    } else lua_pop(L, 1);
    lua_getfield(L, env, "saveStates");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        static const luaL_Reg fns[] = { {"save", s_save}, {"apply", s_apply}, {"forget", s_forget}, {"has", s_has}, {"clearAll", s_clearAll}, {nullptr, nullptr} };
        for (const luaL_Reg* r = fns; r->name; r++) { lua_pushcfunction(L, r->func); lua_setfield(L, -2, r->name); }
    }
    lua_settop(L, env - 1);
}

// loadLevel(file) has loaded a level: its state is put back in the first frame it runs (when there is one)
void SaveStatesLevelLoaded(lua_State* L, const std::string& file) {
    LoadFile(L);
    const bool quick = file == g.lastId && g.clock - g.leftAt < CfgNum(L, "restartWindow", 2);
    g.curId = file;
    g.suspended = false;
    g.ready = false;
    g.pending = CfgBool(L, "enabled", true);
    if (quick && HasState(L, file)) { Forget(L, file); g.suspended = false; }     // a restart: the level begins again from the start
    // 3.6: levels named in saveStates.skipLevels (parts of the level path, as written in the list) are neither saved nor put back
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    lua_getfield(L, -1, "saveStates");
    if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "skipLevels");
        if (lua_istable(L, -1)) {
            const int n = (int)lua_objlen(L, -1);
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                lua_rawgeti(L, -1, i);
                if (lua_isstring(L, -1) && file.find(lua_tostring(L, -1)) != std::string::npos) { g.suspended = true; g.pending = false; Forget(L, file); }
                lua_pop(L, 1);
            }
        }
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    }
    lua_pop(L, 2);
}

// every frame, after the scripts' update
void SaveStatesFrame(lua_State* L, double realDt) {
    if (!g.platform) return;
    g.clock += realDt;
    if (!CfgBool(L, "enabled", true)) return;
    const bool running = IsRunning(L);
    if (g.pending && running && IsReady(L)) {
        g.pending = false;
        const bool done = Apply(L);
        g.ready = true;
        if (done) std::fprintf(stderr, "save state of %s put back\n", g.curId.c_str());
    } else if (g.ready && running) {
        if (g.clock - g.lastSnap >= CfgNum(L, "snapshotEvery", 0.05)) {
            g.lastSnap = g.clock;
            const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            Snapshot(L);
            if (std::getenv("AB_SNAPTIME")) { static double sum = 0; static int n = 0; sum += std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count(); if (++n % 200 == 0) std::fprintf(stderr, "snapshot: %.3f ms on average\n", sum / n); }
        }
        const double every = CfgNum(L, "autosave", 5);
        if (every > 0 && g.clock - g.lastWrite >= every) { if (!SaveNow(L)) g.lastWrite = g.clock; }
    }
    if (g.prevRunning && !running && g.ready) {      // the level was left (the menu, the level select, another level)
        if (CfgBool(L, "saveOnLeave", false)) SaveNow(L, true);
        g.leftAt = g.clock;
        g.lastId = g.curId;
    }
    g.prevRunning = running;
}

// the window is closed or the game ends
void SaveStatesShutdown(lua_State* L) {
    if (!g.platform || !g.ready) return;
    if (IsRunning(L) && CfgBool(L, "saveOnLeave", false)) SaveNow(L);
}

}  // namespace ab
```

```cpp
// Angry Birds 1.6.3.1 ships its level editor with updateEditor emptied out (the menus, saving and every helper are still there);
// 1.6.2 has the full function. A game whose updateEditor is only a stub gets the 1.6.2 one, so the editor works in every version.
void EnsureClassicEditor(lua_State* L) {
    lua_getfield(L, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    lua_getfield(L, -1, "updateEditor");
    bool stub = false;
    if (lua_isfunction(L, -1)) {
        lua_getglobal(L, "string");
        lua_getfield(L, -1, "dump");
        lua_pushvalue(L, -3);
        if (lua_pcall(L, 1, 1, 0) == 0) stub = lua_objlen(L, -1) < 400;
        lua_pop(L, 1);                       // the dump (or the error)
        lua_pop(L, 1);                       // string
    }
    lua_pop(L, 1);                           // updateEditor
    // v3.1: a 1.6.x game (1.6.0 joints) without a joint window of its own (1.6.2) gets Seasons' window and the editor that opens it
    bool jointPage = false, forced = false;
    if (luaL_loadstring(L, "local e = ...; local v = _G.tonumber(_G.string.match(_G.tostring(e.gameVersionNumber or ''), '^(%d+%.%d+)')); "
                           "return e.EditorJointPage == nil and e.Page ~= nil and e.TextItem ~= nil and v ~= nil and v >= 1.6") == 0) {
        lua_pushvalue(L, -2);
        if (lua_pcall(L, 1, 1, 0) == 0) jointPage = lua_toboolean(L, -1) != 0;
        lua_pop(L, 1);
    } else lua_pop(L, 1);
    if (jointPage && luaL_loadbuffer(L, (const char*)kJointPageLua, kJointPageLuaSize, "joint_page.lua") == 0) {
        lua_pushvalue(L, -2);
        lua_setfenv(L, -2);
        if (lua_pcall(L, 0, 0, 0) != 0) { std::fprintf(stderr, "editor: joint window: %s\n", lua_tostring(L, -1)); lua_pop(L, 1); jointPage = false; }
        else { lua_getfield(L, -1, "EditorJointPage"); jointPage = !lua_isnil(L, -1); lua_pop(L, 1); }
        if (jointPage) { stub = true; forced = true; std::fprintf(stderr, "editor: this game has no joint window, using the one of Seasons 2.3.0 with the 1.6.2 editor\n"); }
    } else if (jointPage) lua_pop(L, 1);
    if (stub && luaL_loadbuffer(L, (const char*)kEditorClassicLua, kEditorClassicLuaSize, "editor_classic.lua") == 0) {
        lua_pushvalue(L, -2);                // the environment
        lua_setfenv(L, -2);
        if (lua_pcall(L, 0, 0, 0) != 0) { std::fprintf(stderr, "editor: %s\n", lua_tostring(L, -1)); lua_pop(L, 1); }
        else if (!forced) std::fprintf(stderr, "editor: this game's updateEditor is empty, using the Angry Birds 1.6.2 editor\n");
    } else if (stub) { std::fprintf(stderr, "editor: %s\n", lua_tostring(L, -1)); lua_pop(L, 1); }
    lua_pop(L, 1);                           // the environment
}

int MissingGlobalHook(lua_State* L) {
    // _G.__index(key): remember the key, return nil
    ScriptHost* host = static_cast<ScriptHost*>(lua_touserdata(L, lua_upvalueindex(1)));
    if (lua_type(L, 2) == LUA_TSTRING) {
        const std::string name = lua_tostring(L, 2);
        const std::vector<std::string>& m = host->MissingGlobals();
        bool seen = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m.size(); i++) if (m[i] == name) seen = true;
        if (!seen) const_cast<std::vector<std::string>&>(m).push_back(name);
    }
    return 0;
}
}  // namespace

ScriptHost::ScriptHost(Platform& platform, const BootConfig& config)
    : platform_(platform), config_(config), L_(luaL_newstate()) {
    luaL_openlibs(L_);

    // The scripts run in their own environment table (the exe's Game root table, `this`). Engine
    // functions and values are visible there by bare name; the standard libraries, `res` and
    // `particles` are only reachable through `_G`, which is the real global table.
    lua_newtable(L_);
    lua_pushvalue(L_, -1);
    lua_setfield(L_, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    lua_pushvalue(L_, LUA_GLOBALSINDEX);
    lua_setfield(L_, -2, "_G");
    lua_pushvalue(L_, -1);
    lua_setfield(L_, -2, "this");
    // options.lua sets gamelua.releaseBuild, gamelua.gameVersionNumber ...; the scripts read them by bare
    // name, so gamelua is the environment itself
    lua_pushvalue(L_, -1);
    lua_setfield(L_, -2, "gamelua");
    lua_pop(L_, 1);

    RegisterApi(L_, &platform_);
    // Angry Birds Rio's scripts use `res` and `particles` by bare name (the later versions go through _G)
    lua_getfield(L_, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    lua_getglobal(L_, "res");
    lua_setfield(L_, -2, "res");
    lua_getglobal(L_, "particles");
    lua_setfield(L_, -2, "particles");
    lua_pop(L_, 1);

    // Angry Birds Island HD (Hatchery) tile manager natives (hatchery_natives.lua); only functions, nothing runs until a script calls them
    lua_getfield(L_, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
    if (luaL_loadbuffer(L_, (const char*)kHatcheryNativesLua, kHatcheryNativesLuaSize, "hatchery_natives.lua") == 0) {
        lua_pushvalue(L_, -2);
        if (lua_pcall(L_, 1, 0, 0) != 0) { std::fprintf(stderr, "hatchery natives: %s\n", lua_tostring(L_, -1)); lua_pop(L_, 1); }
    } else { std::fprintf(stderr, "hatchery natives: %s\n", lua_tostring(L_, -1)); lua_pop(L_, 1); }
    lua_pop(L_, 1);

    SetString("scriptPath", config_.scriptPath);
    if (!config_.commonScriptPath.empty()) SetString("commonScriptPath", config_.commonScriptPath);
    if (IsSpaceDataFolder()) {          // Angry Birds Space (the PC game, or a single-folder build)
        if (!config_.commonScriptPath.empty()) SetString("commonScriptPath", config_.commonScriptPath);
        lua_getfield(L_, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
        if (luaL_loadbuffer(L_, (const char*)kSpaceNativesLua, kSpaceNativesLuaSize, "space_natives.lua") == 0) {
            lua_pushvalue(L_, -2);
            if (lua_pcall(L_, 1, 0, 0) != 0) { std::fprintf(stderr, "space natives: %s\n", lua_tostring(L_, -1)); lua_pop(L_, 1); }
        } else { std::fprintf(stderr, "space natives: %s\n", lua_tostring(L_, -1)); lua_pop(L_, 1); }
        lua_pop(L_, 1);
    }
    SetString("imagePath", config_.imagePath);
    SetString("fontPath", config_.fontPath);
    SetString("audioPath", config_.audioPath);
    SetString("localizationPath", config_.localizationPath);
    SetString("levelPath", config_.levelPath);
    SetString("deviceModel", config_.deviceModel);
    mobileData_ = config_.deviceModel == "iphone" || config_.deviceModel == "ipad" || config_.deviceModel == "android";
    // v3.2: the Seasons 4.x PC exe too (lua/Class.lua calls setmetatable by bare name: without it every class failed, initialize() stopped
    // half way and started again each frame, so 4.1.0 loaded its sheets over and over and never left the loading screen)
    if (mobileData_ || config_.seasons4)     // v3.1: on the phone the game's globals are Lua's own: its scripts call assert, pcall, math ... by bare name (Seasons 4.1.0's lua/Math.lua)
        RunString("local env = _G.getfenv(1)\n"
                  "for _, n in _G.ipairs({\"assert\", \"error\", \"pcall\", \"xpcall\", \"type\", \"tostring\", \"tonumber\", \"pairs\", \"ipairs\", \"select\", \"unpack\", \"next\", \"rawget\", \"rawset\", \"rawequal\", \"setmetatable\", \"getmetatable\", \"math\", \"string\", \"table\", \"os\", \"coroutine\", \"loadstring\", \"setfenv\", \"getfenv\", \"collectgarbage\"}) do\n"
                  "    if _G.rawget(env, n) == nil then env[n] = _G[n] end\n"
                  "end\n"
                  "if _G.rawget(_G, \"gamelua\") == nil then _G.gamelua = env end\n");   // and they read _G.gamelua (Seasons 4.1.0's options menu)
    // Seasons 4.x (settingsWrapper.lua builds "installationId_" .. uniqueInstallationId) and the later scripts read these globals from the exe:
    // the id of this install, and the `native` table of the platform services (apprater, ...). A service the PC exe does not have is simply a missing field.
    SetString("uniqueInstallationId", "angrybirdsengine");
    SetString("uniqueDeviceId", "angrybirdsengine");
    lua_pushstring(L_, "angrybirdsengine"); lua_setfield(L_, LUA_GLOBALSINDEX, "uniqueDeviceId");
    lua_pushstring(L_, "angrybirdsengine"); lua_setfield(L_, LUA_GLOBALSINDEX, "uniqueInstallationId");   // also as _G.uniqueInstallationId
    // The `engine` table every script can use (see docs/SCRIPTING.md, "Changing the engine from Lua"): the pristine natives, a list of their names and
    // events the engine raises (update, levelLoaded, objectCreated, objectRemoved). It is made before any game script runs.
    RunString(
        "local G = _G\n"
        "local env = G.getfenv(1)\n"
        "local original, resOriginal, handlers = {}, {}, {}\n"
        "for k, v in G.pairs(env) do if G.type(v) == 'function' then original[k] = v end end\n"
        "if G.type(env.res) == 'table' then for k, v in G.pairs(env.res) do if G.type(v) == 'function' then resOriginal[k] = v end end end\n"
        "local engine = {version = '3.1', original = original, resOriginal = resOriginal, hookCount = 0}\n"
        "engine.tuningDefaults = {['sw.forceDivisor']=10,['sw.homingDamage']=0.2,['sw.wobbleFactor']=0.02,['sw.wobbleMax']=0.1,['sw.removeLimit']=0.88,['rio.wobbleFactor']=0.02,['rio.wobbleMax']=0.1,['zoom.stepIn']=0.2,['zoom.stepOut']=0.1,['zoom.duration']=0.5,['solver.velocityThreshold']=1,['solver.baumgarte']=0.2,['solver.maxRotation']=1.5707964,['solver.angularSleepTolerance']=0.034906585,['solver.maxLinearCorrection']=0.2,['solver.linearSlop']=0.05,['solver.timeToSleep']=0.25,['solver.sleepTolerance']=0.1,['water.buoyancy']=0.1,['water.band']=1.5,['water.keepOrientationOffset']=0.25,['water.boxPushFactor']=0.25,['water.pushSpeedLimit']=15,['gravity.revertFactor']=-0.1,['particle.amountScale']=1,['particle.speedScale']=1,['particle.lifeScale']=1,['particle.sizeScale']=1,['particle.gravityScale']=1,['classic.blockForce']=0.1,['classic.blockScore']=10,['classic.birdForceDivisor']=10,['classic.legacyVelocityFactor']=1.75,['gravity.birdDecay']=1.3,['wobble.duration']=1,['wobble.maxScale']=4,['wobble.cutoff']=0.01,['wobble.frequency']=100,['wobble.baseFrequency']=5,['flip.speed']=3,['moving.tolerance']=0.5,['moving.zeroTolerance']=0.001,['background.skip']=0,['foreground.skip']=0}\n"
        "function engine.natives(includeRes)\n"
        "    local names = {}\n"
        "    for k in G.pairs(original) do names[#names + 1] = k end\n"
        "    if includeRes then for k in G.pairs(resOriginal) do names[#names + 1] = 'res.' .. k end end\n"
        "    G.table.sort(names)\n"
        "    return names\n"
        "end\n"
        "function engine.on(event, fn)\n"
        "    G.assert(G.type(event) == 'string' and G.type(fn) == 'function', 'engine.on(event, function)')\n"
        "    local list = handlers[event]\n"
        "    if not list then list = {}; handlers[event] = list end\n"
        "    list[#list + 1] = fn\n"
        "    engine.hookCount = engine.hookCount + 1\n"
        "    return fn\n"
        "end\n"
        "function engine.off(event, fn)\n"
        "    local list = handlers[event]\n"
        "    if not list then return false end\n"
        "    for i = #list, 1, -1 do if list[i] == fn then G.table.remove(list, i); engine.hookCount = engine.hookCount - 1; return true end end\n"
        "    return false\n"
        "end\n"
        "function engine.emit(event, ...)\n"
        "    local list = handlers[event]\n"
        "    if not list then return end\n"
        "    for i = 1, #list do\n"
        "        local ok, err = G.pcall(list[i], ...)\n"
        "        if not ok then G.print('engine.on(' .. event .. '): ' .. G.tostring(err)) end\n"
        "    end\n"
        "end\n"
        "env.engine = engine\n");
    {   // v3.3: the motion library (tweens, teleport, any movement, the rewind history as a movement), src/lua/motion.lua
        lua_getfield(L_, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX, "ab.env");
```
