```cpp
// that gives the bounce, a friction impulse along the tangent clamped by the Coulomb cone, both applied at the contact point so that the bodies' rotation
// (their inertia and spin) takes part. `restitution` < 0 means "as the fixtures say" (the larger of the two, like Box2D), and Box2D's velocity threshold
// of 1 applies (a slow touch does not bounce).
CollisionPrediction PhysicsWorld::PredictCollision(const std::string& an, const std::string& bn, float restitution, const float* vel) const {
    CollisionPrediction r;
    const PhysObject* a = nullptr; const PhysObject* b = nullptr;
    for (const auto& o : objects_) { if (o->name == an) a = o.get(); if (o->name == bn) b = o.get(); }
    if (!a || !b || !a->pbody || !b->pbody || a == b) return r;                 // the safe exit: valid stays false
    r.valid = true;
    r.filtered = !ShouldCollideObjects(a, b) || a->isSensor || b->isSensor;
    const PhysBody& pa = *a->pbody; const PhysBody& pb = *b->pbody;
    const bool sa = pa.IsStatic(), sb = pb.IsStatic();
    float cax, cay, cbx, cby;                                                   // centres of mass
    pa.CenterOfMass(cax, cay); pb.CenterOfMass(cbx, cby);
    float dx = cbx - cax, dy = cby - cay;
    r.distance = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    // The contact: closest points of the real shapes when the body can tell, otherwise the line between the centres
    float px, py, ax, ay, bx, by, core = 0, ra = 0, rb = 0;
    if (pa.ClosestPoints(pb, ax, ay, bx, by, core, ra, rb)) {
        r.exactShapes = true;
        if (core > 1e-6f) {
            r.nx = (bx - ax) / core; r.ny = (by - ay) / core;
            r.gap = core - ra - rb;
            px = 0.5f * ((ax + r.nx * ra) + (bx - r.nx * rb)); py = 0.5f * ((ay + r.ny * ra) + (by - r.ny * rb));
        } else {                                                                // the cores overlap: push along the line between the centres
            if (r.distance > 1e-6f) { r.nx = dx / r.distance; r.ny = dy / r.distance; } else { r.nx = 0; r.ny = 1; }
            r.gap = -(ra + rb);
            px = 0.5f * (ax + bx); py = 0.5f * (ay + by);
        }
    } else {
        if (r.distance > 1e-6f) { r.nx = dx / r.distance; r.ny = dy / r.distance; } else { r.nx = 0; r.ny = 1; }
        auto reach = [&](const PhysObject* o) {                                 // fallback: circles by radius, other shapes by their box
            BodyInfo bi = Inspect(o->name);
            if (bi.shapeRadius > 0) return bi.shapeRadius;
            float x0, y0, x1, y1;
            if (!o->pbody->Bounds(x0, y0, x1, y1)) return 0.0f;
            return 0.5f * (x1 - x0) * std::fabs(r.nx) + 0.5f * (y1 - y0) * std::fabs(r.ny);
        };
        r.gap = r.distance - reach(a) - reach(b);
        px = 0.5f * (cax + cbx); py = 0.5f * (cay + cby);
    }
    r.contactX = px; r.contactY = py;
    // Lever arms from each centre of mass to the contact point (zero without real shapes, so there is no spin then)
    const float rax = r.exactShapes ? px - cax : 0, ray = r.exactShapes ? py - cay : 0, rbx = r.exactShapes ? px - cbx : 0, rby = r.exactShapes ? py - cby : 0;
    // A velocity given by the caller replaces the body's own (a static body stays at rest); a NaN entry keeps the body's velocity
    auto pick = [&](int i, float own) { return vel && vel[i] == vel[i] ? vel[i] : own; };
    const float avx = sa ? 0 : pick(0, pa.VelX()), avy = sa ? 0 : pick(1, pa.VelY()), bvx = sb ? 0 : pick(2, pb.VelX()), bvy = sb ? 0 : pick(3, pb.VelY());
    const float aw = sa ? 0 : pa.AngularVelocity(), bw = sb ? 0 : pb.AngularVelocity();
    r.massA = sa ? 0 : pa.Mass(); r.massB = sb ? 0 : pb.Mass();
    const float ia = r.massA > 0 ? 1.0f / r.massA : 0, ib = r.massB > 0 ? 1.0f / r.massB : 0;
    const float iA = sa || pa.Inertia() <= 0 ? 0 : 1.0f / pa.Inertia(), iB = sb || pb.Inertia() <= 0 ? 0 : 1.0f / pb.Inertia();
    // Velocity of each body at the contact point (linear velocity plus spin), and of B seen from A
    const float apx = avx - aw * ray, apy = avy + aw * rax, bpx = bvx - bw * rby, bpy = bvy + bw * rbx;
    r.relVx = bpx - apx; r.relVy = bpy - apy;
    const float tx = r.ny, ty = -r.nx;                                          // the tangent: the normal turned by 90 degrees
    const float vn = r.relVx * r.nx + r.relVy * r.ny, vt = r.relVx * tx + r.relVy * ty;
    r.closingSpeed = -vn; r.normalSpeed = vn; r.tangentSpeed = vt;
    r.friction = std::sqrt(std::max(0.0f, pa.Friction()) * std::max(0.0f, pb.Friction()));
    const float eFix = std::max(pa.Restitution(), pb.Restitution());
    r.restitution = restitution >= 0 ? restitution : eFix;
    r.aVx = avx; r.aVy = avy; r.bVx = bvx; r.bVy = bvy; r.aAngVel = aw; r.bAngVel = bw;
    if (r.closingSpeed > 1e-6f) r.timeToContact = r.gap > 0 ? r.gap / r.closingSpeed : 0;
    r.collides = !r.filtered && r.closingSpeed > 1e-6f && (ia + ib) > 0;
    if (r.collides) {
        auto cross = [](float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1) { return x0 * y1 - y0 * x1; };
        const float rnA = cross(rax, ray, r.nx, r.ny), rnB = cross(rbx, rby, r.nx, r.ny);
        const float kn = ia + ib + iA * rnA * rnA + iB * rnB * rnB;
        const float e = vn < -1.0f ? r.restitution : 0.0f;                      // Box2D's velocity threshold: slow contacts do not bounce
        r.impulse = kn > 0 ? -(1.0f + e) * vn / kn : 0.0f;
        const float rtA = cross(rax, ray, tx, ty), rtB = cross(rbx, rby, tx, ty);
        const float kt = ia + ib + iA * rtA * rtA + iB * rtB * rtB;
        float jt = kt > 0 ? -vt / kt : 0.0f;
        const float limit = r.friction * r.impulse;
        jt = std::max(-limit, std::min(limit, jt));                            // Coulomb friction: no more than friction * normal impulse
        r.tangentImpulse = jt;
        const float Px = r.impulse * r.nx + jt * tx, Py = r.impulse * r.ny + jt * ty;
        r.aVx = avx - ia * Px; r.aVy = avy - ia * Py; r.aAngVel = aw - iA * cross(rax, ray, Px, Py);
        r.bVx = bvx + ib * Px; r.bVy = bvy + ib * Py; r.bAngVel = bw + iB * cross(rbx, rby, Px, Py);
        auto energy = [&](float m, float i, float vx, float vy, float w) { return 0.5f * m * (vx * vx + vy * vy) + (i > 0 ? 0.5f * w * w / i : 0.0f); };
        const float before = energy(r.massA, iA, avx, avy, aw) + energy(r.massB, iB, bvx, bvy, bw);
        const float after = energy(r.massA, iA, r.aVx, r.aVy, r.aAngVel) + energy(r.massB, iB, r.bVx, r.bVy, r.bAngVel);
        r.energyLost = before - after;
    }
    return r;
}

// The aim trail (updateBirdTrajectoryTable, 0x479ab0). Retail does not run a formula: it takes the dummy bird, and for `steps` fixed steps lets every
// gravitation sensor whose shape overlaps the bird push it through the very function the real physics uses (0x46f720), integrates the bird on its
// own (`steps` of `h` seconds: simulationIterations steps of objects.currentTimeStep * simulationTimeStepMultiplier, 0x479b1a) with b2World's free-flight integrator (0x497d50: velocity += h * (gravity + invMass * force), damping clamp(1 - h * d, 0, 1), the
// maximum translation of 2 per step, position += h * velocity; no collisions), clears the forces and stores the position every `every` steps (simulationStorePointsSampler). The bird's gravity timer does not run inside the trail (0x479ab0 never advances it). This
// reproduces that loop on copies of the bird's position and velocity, so the real bird is never touched. A radial sensor overlaps the bird while
// the centre distance is within the sensor's radius plus the bird's radius, a field while the bird's box touches the sensor's box.
void PhysicsWorld::SimulateTrajectory(const std::string& n, int steps, int every, float h, std::vector<std::pair<float, float>>& out) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o || !o->pbody) return;
    float x = o->pbody->PosX(), y = o->pbody->PosY(), vx = o->pbody->VelX(), vy = o->pbody->VelY();
    float damp = o->pbody->LinearDamping(), mass = o->pbody->Mass(), invMass = mass > 0 ? 1.0f / mass : 0.0f, r = o->pbody->ShapeRadius();
    float wgx = 0, wgy = 0; GetGravity(wgx, wgy);
    float timer = o->birdGravReduce;
    if (std::getenv("AB_TRAJDBG")) std::fprintf(stderr, "TRAJ0 x=%.3f y=%.3f v=%.3f,%.3f h=%g steps=%d every=%d m=%g isBird=%d cat=%d mult=%g\n", x, y, vx, vy, h, steps, every, mass, (int)o->isBird, o->gravCat, gravityForceMultiplier);
    for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
        float fx = 0, fy = 0;
        for (const auto& so : objects_) {                                // 0x479bf0: the sensors in their list order
            const PhysObject& s = *so;
            if (s.sensorKind != 2 || !s.pbody || &s == o) continue;
            int hit = o->pbody->OverlapAt(*s.pbody, x, y);               // 0x479c05: b2TestOverlap of the two first fixtures' shapes
            if (hit == 0) continue;
            if (s.gravMask > -1 && o->gravCat > -1 && (s.gravMask & o->gravCat) == 0) continue;   // 0x46f720 starts with this filter, so the aim trail honours it too
            if (hit < 0) {                                               // a build that cannot ask (Box2D 2.1): the radius / box approximation
                float x0, y0, x1, y1;
                if (s.gravRadius > -1) {
                    float dx = s.pbody->PosX() - x, dy = s.pbody->PosY() - y, reach = s.gravRadius + r;
                    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > reach * reach) continue;
                } else if (!s.pbody->Bounds(x0, y0, x1, y1) || x + r < x0 || x - r > x1 || y + r < y0 || y - r > y1) continue;
            }
            float px, py;
            if (GravityPull(s, *o, x, y, vx, vy, timer, mass, px, py)) { fx += px; fy += py; }
        }
        vx += h * (wgx + invMass * fx); vy += h * (wgy + invMass * fy);  // 0x497d87: the world's gravity plus the force times the inverse mass
        float k = 1.0f - h * damp; k = k < 0 ? 0 : (k > 1 ? 1 : k);      // 0x497dea: the 2.3 damping clamp
        vx *= k; vy *= k;
        float tx = h * vx, ty = h * vy;
        if (tx * tx + ty * ty > 4.0f) { float q = 2.0f / std::sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty); vx *= q; vy *= q; }   // 0x497e9c: b2_maxTranslation
        x += h * vx; y += h * vy;
        if (every > 0 && (i + 1) % every == 0) out.push_back({x, y});
    }
}

void PhysicsWorld::SetMaterial(const std::string& n, const std::string& material) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) return;
    if (material.compare(0, 4, "wood") == 0) o->rollMaterial = kRollWood;
    if (material.compare(0, 4, "rock") == 0) o->rollMaterial = kRollRock;
    if (material.compare(0, 5, "light") == 0) o->rollMaterial = kRollLight;
    if (starWarsRules && material == "propeller") o->rollMaterial = kRollPropeller;   // 0x42943x: only the exact name
}

void PhysicsWorld::SetSpriteName(const std::string& n, const std::string& sprite) {
    if (PhysObject* o = Find(n)) o->sprite = sprite;
}

void PhysicsWorld::SetTextureName(const std::string& n, const std::string& texture) {
    if (PhysObject* o = Find(n)) o->texture = texture;
}

// ---- contacts

ContactObject PhysicsWorld::MakeContactObject(const PhysObject& o) {
    ContactObject c;
    c.name = o.name;
    c.controllable = o.isBird;
    c.mass = o.pbody->Mass();
    c.velocity.x = o.pbody->VelX();
    c.velocity.y = o.pbody->VelY();
    return c;
}

void PhysicsWorld::ApplyVelocityChange(const VelocityChange& v) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(v.name);
    if (!o) return;
    if (v.immediate) {
        if (!o->pbody->IsStatic()) o->pbody->SetLinearVelocity(v.velocity.x, v.velocity.y);
    } else {
        o->pendingVelocity = true;
        o->pendingVx = v.velocity.x;
        o->pendingVy = v.velocity.y;
    }
}

// 0x40c440. Collide only if both objects have `collision` set, except that a circle created with
// z_order 999 never collides with an object whose material is "immovable".
bool PhysicsWorld::ShouldCollideObjects(const PhysObject* a, const PhysObject* b) const {
    if (a && b && (a->filterUsed || b->filterUsed) && (!(a->filterMask & b->filterCat) || !(b->filterMask & a->filterCat))) return false;   // setFilterMask / setFilterCategory
    bool base = ShouldCollideBase(a, b);
    if (luaFilter && a && b) { int v = luaFilter(a, b); if (v == 0) return false; if (v == 1) return true; }
    return base;
}
bool PhysicsWorld::ShouldCollideBase(const PhysObject* a, const PhysObject* b) const {
    if (!a || !b) return true;
    if (starWarsRules) {
        // Angry Birds Star Wars, 0x410e70 (fields: group +0xf4, kind +0x110, flag19 +0x13d, flag20 +0x157, immovable-off +0x152, collision +0x153, blockCollision +0x154, controlled +0x155)
        auto t57 = [](const PhysObject* o) { return o->sensorKind == 5 || o->sensorKind == 7; };
        if (a->groupIndex == b->groupIndex && a->groupIndex > 0 && b->groupIndex > 0) return false;
        const bool anyA = a->spaceFlagA || b->spaceFlagA;
        if (anyA && (t57(a) || t57(b))) return true;
        if (!a->collision || !b->collision) return false;
        if (a->sensorKind == 7 && b->isBird) return false;
        if (b->sensorKind == 7 && a->isBird) return false;
        if (anyA && (a->spaceActive19e || b->spaceActive19e)) return false;
        if (t57(a) && t57(b)) return false;
        const int ta = a->sensorKind, tb = b->sensorKind;
        if ((ta == 6 || tb == 6) && (a->isBird || b->isBird)) return false;
        if (a->disableImmovable && materialOf && materialOf(*b).compare(0, 9, "immovable") == 0) return false;
        if (b->disableImmovable && materialOf && materialOf(*a).compare(0, 9, "immovable") == 0) return false;
        if (!a->isBird && !b->isBird && ta != 6 && tb != 6) {
            if (ta == 5 && tb != ta) return false;
            if (tb == 5 && ta != tb) return false;
        }
        // an object with blockCollision false collides only with the materials in its collisionMaterials list
        auto listed = [&](const PhysObject* owner, const PhysObject* other) {
            if (!collisionMaterialsOf || !materialOf) return false;
            const std::string m = materialOf(*other);
            for (const std::string& s : collisionMaterialsOf(*owner)) if (s == m) return true;
            return false;
        };
        if (!a->blockCollision) return listed(a, b);
        if (!b->blockCollision) return listed(b, a);
        return true;
    }
    if (spaceRules) {
        // Angry Birds Space, 0x4624e0 (T is the object's +0x15c type: 5, 6 and 7 are special; ctl is the controllable byte +0x19c)
        auto t57 = [](const PhysObject* o) { return o->sensorKind == 5 || o->sensorKind == 7; };
        bool anyA = a->spaceFlagA || b->spaceFlagA;
        if (anyA && (t57(a) || t57(b))) return true;
        if (!a->collision || !b->collision) return false;
        if (a->sensorKind == 7 && b->isBird) return false;
        if (b->sensorKind == 7 && a->isBird) return false;
        if (a->spaceFlagA) return false;
        if (b->spaceFlagA && (a->spaceActive19e || b->spaceActive19e)) return false;
        if (t57(a) && t57(b)) return false;
        int ta = a->sensorKind, tb = b->sensorKind;
        if (ta == 6 || tb == 6) { if (a->isBird || b->isBird) return false; }
        bool aImm = a->disableImmovable, bImm = b->disableImmovable;
        if (aImm && materialOf && materialOf(*b).compare(0, 9, "immovable") == 0) return false;
        if (bImm && materialOf && materialOf(*a).compare(0, 9, "immovable") == 0) return false;
        if (!a->isBird && !b->isBird && ta != 6 && tb != 6) {
            if (ta == 5 && tb != ta) return false;
            if (tb == 5 && ta != tb) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    bool collide = a->collision && b->collision;
    // the original compares the first 9 bytes only
    if (a->special999 && materialOf && materialOf(*b).compare(0, 9, "immovable") == 0) collide = false;
    if (b->special999 && materialOf && materialOf(*a).compare(0, 9, "immovable") == 0) collide = false;
    if (a->disableImmovable && materialOf && materialOf(*b).compare(0, 9, "immovable") == 0) collide = false;
    if (b->disableImmovable && materialOf && materialOf(*a).compare(0, 9, "immovable") == 0) collide = false;
    if (a->disableControllable && b->isBird) collide = false;
    if (b->disableControllable && a->isBird) collide = false;
    if (!colliderRules_.pair[a->colliderType & (kColliderTypes - 1)][b->colliderType & (kColliderTypes - 1)]) collide = false;
    return collide;
}

// ---- Angry Birds Rio queries

void PhysicsWorld::SetRecordVelocity(const std::string& n, bool on) {
    if (PhysObject* o = Find(n)) { o->recordVelocity = on; o->recordAngle = on; }
}

bool PhysicsWorld::GetVelocity(const std::string& n, float& vx, float& vy) const {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o || !o->pbody) { vx = vy = 0; return false; }
    vx = o->pbody->VelX(); vy = o->pbody->VelY();
    return true;
}

float PhysicsWorld::GetSpeed(const std::string& n) const {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    return o ? std::sqrt(o->pbody->VelX() * o->pbody->VelX() + o->pbody->VelY() * o->pbody->VelY()) : 0.0f;
}

bool PhysicsWorld::HasMovingObjects(float tolerance) const {
    for (const auto& o : objects_) {
        if (o->pbody->IsStatic() || !o->pbody->IsAwake()) continue;
        float speed = std::sqrt(o->pbody->VelX() * o->pbody->VelX() + o->pbody->VelY() * o->pbody->VelY());
        if (speed > tolerance || std::fabs(o->pbody->AngularVelocity()) > tolerance) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void PhysicsWorld::GetLocalPoint(const std::string& n, float wx, float wy, float& lx, float& ly) const {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) { lx = wx; ly = wy; return; }
    o->pbody->LocalPoint(wx, wy, lx, ly);
}

void PhysicsWorld::SetColliderType(const std::string& n, int type) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (o && type >= 0 && type < kColliderTypes) o->colliderType = type;
}
int PhysicsWorld::ColliderType(const std::string& n) const {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    return o ? o->colliderType : -1;
}
void PhysicsWorld::SetDecoration(const std::string& n, const std::string& sprite, int amount, float increment, float scale) {
    if (PhysObject* o = Find(n)) { o->decoSprite = sprite; o->decoAmount = amount; o->decoIncrement = increment; o->decoScale = scale; }
}
void PhysicsWorld::SetSpriteLook(const std::string& n, int what, float a, float b) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) return;
    if (what == 0) {                       // 0x47a1e0: the angle is wrapped into 0 .. 2 pi
        const float twoPi = 6.2831853f;
        a = std::fmod(a, twoPi);
        if (a < 0) a += twoPi;
        o->spriteAngle = a;
    } else if (what == 1) { o->pivotOffX = a; o->pivotOffY = b; }
    else o->textureScale = a;
}
void PhysicsWorld::SetObjectScale(const std::string& n, float sx, float sy) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) return;
    o->scaled = true; o->scaleX = sx; o->scaleY = sy; o->wobDX = o->wobDY = 0;
}
bool PhysicsWorld::GetObjectScale(const std::string& n, float& sx, float& sy) const {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) return false;
    sx = o->scaleX; sy = o->scaleY;
    return true;
}
void PhysicsWorld::SetSpeedCap(const std::string& n, float speed, float vx, float vy) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) return;
    if (o->pbody) o->pbody->SetMaxSpeed(speed > 0 ? speed : 0);   // the solver uses it instead of setMaxTranslation for this body
    o->capSpeed = speed > 0 ? speed : 0; o->capVx = vx > 0 ? vx : 0; o->capVy = vy > 0 ? vy : 0;
}
bool PhysicsWorld::GetSpeedCap(const std::string& n, float& speed, float& vx, float& vy) const {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) return false;
    speed = o->capSpeed; vx = o->capVx; vy = o->capVy;
    return true;
}
void PhysicsWorld::ApplySpeedCaps() {
    for (const auto& o : objects_) {
        if (!o->pbody || (o->capSpeed <= 0 && o->capVx <= 0 && o->capVy <= 0) || o->pbody->IsStatic() || !o->pbody->IsAwake()) continue;
        float vx = o->pbody->VelX(), vy = o->pbody->VelY(), nx = vx, ny = vy;
        if (o->capVx > 0) nx = std::max(-o->capVx, std::min(o->capVx, nx));
        if (o->capVy > 0) ny = std::max(-o->capVy, std::min(o->capVy, ny));
        if (o->capSpeed > 0) { float sp = std::sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny); if (sp > o->capSpeed) { float q = o->capSpeed / sp; nx *= q; ny *= q; } }
        if (nx != vx || ny != vy) o->pbody->SetLinearVelocity(nx, ny);
    }
}
std::vector<std::string> PhysicsWorld::TouchingObjects(const std::string& n) const {
    std::vector<std::string> names;
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o || !o->pbody) return names;
    std::vector<PhysObject*> list;
    o->pbody->Touching(list);
    for (PhysObject* p : list) if (p && p != o && std::find(names.begin(), names.end(), p->name) == names.end()) names.push_back(p->name);
    return names;
}
void PhysicsWorld::SetObjectAlpha(const std::string& n, float a) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (o) o->alpha = a < 0 ? 0 : (a > 1 ? 1 : a);
}
float PhysicsWorld::ObjectAlpha(const std::string& n) const {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    return o ? o->alpha : -1.0f;
}
void PhysicsWorld::SetObjectZOrder(const std::string& n, float z) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (o) { o->zOrder = z; o->zSet = true; }
}
float PhysicsWorld::ObjectZOrder(const std::string& n) const {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    return o ? o->zOrder : -1e9f;
}
// front: one above the highest z, and at least 5 so that the object is in the group that is drawn last in every game;
// back: one below the lowest z, which makes it the first of its group
float PhysicsWorld::MoveObjectZ(const std::string& n, bool front) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) return -1e9f;
    float hi = -1e9f, lo = 1e9f;
    for (auto& p : objects_) {
        if (p.get() == o) continue;
        hi = std::max(hi, p->zOrder);
        lo = std::min(lo, p->zOrder);
    }
    if (hi < lo) { hi = lo = o->zOrder; }                       // the only object
    o->zOrder = front ? std::max(hi + 1.0f, 5.0f) : lo - 1.0f;
    o->zSet = true;
    return o->zOrder;
}
void PhysicsWorld::SetColliderRule(int a, int b, bool collide) {
    if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a >= kColliderTypes || b >= kColliderTypes) return;
    colliderRules_.pair[a][b] = colliderRules_.pair[b][a] = collide;
}
bool PhysicsWorld::ColliderRule(int a, int b) const {
    return a >= 0 && b >= 0 && a < kColliderTypes && b < kColliderTypes && colliderRules_.pair[a][b];
}

void PhysicsWorld::SetCollisionEnabled(const std::string& n, bool on) {
    PhysObject* o = Find(n);
    if (!o) return;
    o->collision = on;
    o->pbody->SetSensor(!on);
}

void PhysicsWorld::RemoveJointsFromObject(const std::string& n) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < links_.size();) {
        if (links_[i].end1 == n || links_[i].end2 == n) links_.erase(links_.begin() + i); else i++;
    }
    std::vector<std::string> names;
    for (auto& j : joints_)
        if (j->end1 == n || j->end2 == n) names.push_back(j->name);
    for (const std::string& name : names) DestroyJoint(name);
}

bool PhysicsWorld::HasJoints(const std::string& n) const {
    for (const auto& j : joints_)
        if (j->end1 == n || j->end2 == n) return true;
    for (const Link& l : links_)
        if (l.end1 == n || l.end2 == n) return true;
    return false;
}

std::vector<std::string> PhysicsWorld::IntersectingObjects(float x, float y, float left, float right, float down, float up) const {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    float x0 = x - left, x1 = x + right, y0 = y - down, y1 = y + up;
    if (y0 > y1) std::swap(y0, y1);
    for (const auto& o : objects_) {
        float bx0, by0, bx1, by1;
        if (!o->pbody->Bounds(bx0, by0, bx1, by1)) continue;
        if (bx1 < x0 || bx0 > x1 || by1 < y0 || by0 > y1) continue;
        out.push_back(o->name);
    }
    return out;
}

}  // namespace ab

```

`src/physics/physics_world.h`:

```h
// The game's physics world, reconstructed from AngryBirds.exe 1.6.2 and Angry Birds Rio.
//
// The world is built on Box2D, and the games do not use the same version: Angry Birds Classic and Seasons use
// Box2D 2.1.0 (third_party/box2d is 2.1.1, close enough) and Rio uses 2.2.0 (third_party/box2d22). Both have the
// exe's changed constants in b2Settings.h. Both are linked into the same executable (the 2.2.0 names carry a
// suffix, see b2Rename.h) and MakePhysicsWorld picks one.
//
// This header has no Box2D in it. PhysicsWorld holds what does not depend on the version (the object table, the
// joint records, every call that goes through a body); physics_world_b2.cpp, compiled once for each version,
// fills in the rest: creating bodies, shapes and joints, stepping, and the contact callbacks.
//
// Original code, for reference:
//   world creation      Game constructor: b2World(gravity (0, 20), doSleep = true), warm starting and
//                       continuous physics on (flags 0x101), filter = Game (0x40c440), listener = Game (0x40b670)
//   createBox/Circle/Polygon  0x411590 / 0x411c20 / 0x412230 (helpers) and the Lua wrappers
//   createJoint         0x40ecd0
//   checkJointLimits, setJointParameters, removeObject, setPosition ... see the methods below
#pragma once
#include "physics/collision_prediction.h"
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "game/collision_damage.h"
#include "game/frame_update.h"
#include "lua/platform.h"

namespace ab {

constexpr float kGravityX = 0.0f;
constexpr float kGravityY = 20.0f;       // +y is down in this game

// The Box2D version a world was built with.
enum class Box2DVersion { V21, V22 };

struct PhysObject;

// A body with everything the engine does to one. Implemented once per Box2D version.
class PhysBody : public Body {
public:
    virtual float Angle() const = 0;
    virtual void SetAngularVelocity(float w) = 0;
    virtual void SetAwake(bool awake) = 0;               // false also zeroes the velocities
    virtual void SetStatic(bool isStatic) = 0;           // b2_staticBody or b2_dynamicBody
    virtual void SetKinematic() = 0;                     // b2_kinematicBody (Friends 2.0.0's setBodyType)
    virtual int Type() const { return 1; }               // 3.7.1: 0 static, 1 dynamic, 2 kinematic (getBodyType)
    virtual void SetTransform(float x, float y, float angle) = 0;
    virtual void WorldPoint(float lx, float ly, float& wx, float& wy) const = 0;
    virtual void LocalPoint(float wx, float wy, float& lx, float& ly) const = 0;
    virtual void ApplyImpulse(float ix, float iy, float px, float py) = 0;
    virtual void ApplyForce(float fx, float fy, float px, float py) = 0;
    virtual void SetSensor(bool on) = 0;                 // every fixture
    virtual void SetMaxSpeed(float s) { (void)s; }   // v2.4: this body's own limit instead of the world's max translation (0: the world's)
    virtual void Touching(std::vector<PhysObject*>& out) const { (void)out; }   // v2.4: the objects on the other side of this body's touching contacts right now
    virtual bool Bounds(float& x0, float& y0, float& x1, float& y1) const = 0;   // union of the fixtures' boxes; false: no fixture
    virtual float LinearDamping() const = 0;
    virtual float AngularDamping() const = 0;
    virtual void SetAngularDamping(float d) = 0;
    virtual void SetLinearDamping(float d) = 0;
    virtual void SetFixedRotation(bool on) = 0;
    virtual void SetRestitution(float r) { (void)r; }      // Star Wars setRestitution (0x419d10): the value goes into the body's shape data (+0x14 of the record at +100)
    virtual void SetFriction(float f) { (void)f; }         // 3.x setFriction: every fixture
    virtual void ResizeCircle(float r) { (void)r; }        // 3.x resizeCircle: the radius of every circle fixture, the mass is worked out again
    virtual void SetDensity(float d) { (void)d; }          // v2.5: every fixture, then the mass is worked out again
    virtual void SetActive(bool on) = 0;
    virtual float ShapeRadius() const = 0;               // the first fixture's skin radius (polygons) or radius (circles)
    // The collision prediction's view of a body (predictCollision). Defaults describe a body that cannot be asked.
    virtual float Inertia() const { return 0; }          // rotational inertia about the centre of mass (0: it cannot spin, or static)
    virtual void CenterOfMass(float& x, float& y) const { x = PosX(); y = PosY(); }   // world position of the centre of mass
    virtual float Friction() const { return 0.2f; }      // the first non-sensor fixture's friction
    virtual float Restitution() const { return 0; }      // the first non-sensor fixture's restitution
    // Closest points of the two bodies' real shapes (non-sensor fixtures, every pair). (ax, ay) lies on this body's core shape, (bx, by) on the other's;
    // `dist` is the distance between the core shapes and radA / radB the skin radii to add to each; dist 0 means the cores overlap. false: not available.
    // Would this body's first fixture overlap the other body's first fixture if this body stood at (x, y) with its present angle? (0x49df50, what the
    // aiming aid asks of every gravitation sensor.) 1 overlapping, 0 apart, -1 the build cannot tell (Box2D 2.1) or a body has no fixture.
    virtual int OverlapAt(const PhysBody& other, float x, float y) const { (void)other; (void)x; (void)y; return -1; }
    virtual bool ClosestPoints(const PhysBody& other, float& ax, float& ay, float& bx, float& by, float& dist, float& radA, float& radB) const {
        (void)other; (void)ax; (void)ay; (void)bx; (void)by; (void)dist; (void)radA; (void)radB; return false;
    }
};

// One game object (the exe's 0x90-byte struct).
struct PhysObject : FrameObject {
    std::string name;
    std::unique_ptr<PhysBody> pbody;   // the Box2D body; `body` (from FrameObject) points to the same object
    bool collision = true;       // +0x86  both objects need this set to collide
    bool drawWithBirds = false;  // +0x89  setObjectParameter(n, 1, 1): drawGameNative draws it in the bird pass
    std::string sprite;          // +0x68  setSprite, the name (the exe stores the sprite record)
    std::string texture;         // +0x6c  setTexture, the name (the exe stores the texture id)
    bool scaled = false;         // +0x94  setObjectParameter(n, 6, 1): drawn with scaleX/scaleY
    float scaleX = 1, scaleY = 1;  // +0x98..+0xa4  setObjectParameter(n, 5, v)
    bool flipX = false;          // Angry Birds Rio: setObjectParameter(n, 8, 1) draws the sprite mirrored
    bool disableImmovable = false, disableControllable = false;   // Rio ids 15 and 16: no collisions with immovable blocks / birds
    bool special999 = false;     // +0x8a  circles created with z_order 999 (see ShouldCollide)
    float zOrder = 0;            // +0x80
    // Angry Birds Rio, from the exe's object record: setObjectParameter 6 / 7 (+0xd8 / +0xd4) are the bounce multipliers; an
    // impact starts a wobble of the draw scale (wobActive/wobT/wobAmp0/wobCur = +0xc4/+0xc8/+0xd0/+0xcc), wobDX/wobDY is its
    // current offset from the object's own scale
    bool noHitWobble = false;                        // Star Wars +0x150 (setObjectParameter 11): a bird-bird hit does not start this object's wobble
    float bounceAmp = 0, bounceFreq = 0;
    bool wobActive = false; float wobT = 0, wobAmp0 = 0, wobCur = 0, wobDX = 0, wobDY = 0;
    bool enableFlipping = false, flipBase = false;   // Rio ids 9 and 8: the sprite turns to face the way the object moves
    bool disableRotation = false;                    // Rio id 10 (+0x93): only the drawing ignores the angle, the body still turns
    bool canGetUp = false, gettingUp = false;        // Rio id 14 (+0x96) and the exe's "getting up" state (+0x9a)
    float getUpTimer = 0;                            // +0x9c
    int colliderType = 0;                            // setColliderType (Angry Birds 3.0.1 / Seasons): 0 basic, 1 eagle, 2 static, 3 bird, 4 pig, 5 ghost, 6 sticky
    std::string decoSprite; int decoAmount = 0; float decoIncrement = 0, decoScale = 1;   // Space setDecorationObjects (+0x158): `amount` copies of the sprite about the object, each turned `increment` degrees more
    float spriteAngle = 0;                           // Space setSpriteRotation (+0x114): added to the body's angle when the sprite is drawn
    float pivotOffX = 0, pivotOffY = 0;              // Space setPivotOffset (+0x118, +0x11c): moves the sprite's pivot, the point it turns about
    float textureScale = 1;                          // Space setTextureScale (+0x128): kept for the scripts, the tile draw does not use it yet
    float alpha = 1;                                 // setObjectAlpha (engine addition): drawGameNative draws the object with this transparency, 0 invisible .. 1 solid
    // Angry Birds Space (setObjectParameter 20..27, setSensorGravityMask, setObjectGravityCategory): a gravitation sensor pulls the dynamic objects inside it
    std::vector<CompoundShape> parts;                // a compound body: what each part looks like (drawn about the body)
    bool holed = false;                              // 3.6: made by CreateWithHoles (many fixtures; their simultaneous contacts count as one hit)
    bool isSensor = false;                           // setAsSensor: contacts go to enterCollision / exitCollision instead of blockCollision
    bool revertGravity = false, revertMulti = false;   // setRevertGravity / setRevertGravityWithMultiplier (exe +0x18a, +0x18b)
    float revertMult = 0, revertMaxSpeed = 0;           // +0x18c (stored negated), +0x190
    int ownGravityMode = 0;                          // setObjectGravity / setObjectGravityScale: 0 the world's gravity, 1 an own vector, 2 the world's gravity times a factor
    float ownGravityX = 0, ownGravityY = 0;          // the vector of mode 1 (acceleration, world units per second squared)
    float ownGravityScale = 1;                       // the factor of mode 2 (-1 turns the gravity round: the sky becomes the ground)
    float birdGravReduce = -1;                       // Space id 31 (+0x184) timeSinceCollision: grows by 1/30 per physics step for controllable objects; their gravity multiplier is mult - 1.3 * this (never below 1)
    bool stopOnExit = false;                         // Space id 34 (+0x1a5): leaving a flagged sensor sets the linear damping to 100 (0x470380)
    int sensorKind = 0;                              // id 21: 2 gravitation, 3 stream (+0x15c)
    bool gravOn = false;                             // id 22 (+0x19f)
    int filterMask = 0xFFFFFF, filterCat = 1;        // 3.x setFilterMask / setFilterCategory (Box2D rules: both sides must accept the other); filterUsed once either is set
    bool filterUsed = false;
    int gravMask = -1, gravCat = -1;                 // setSensorGravityMask (+0x160) / setObjectGravityCategory (+0x180); -1: no filtering
    float gravExt = 0;                               // id 35 (+0x178): extent of a directional field
    float gravMin = 0, gravMax = 0, gravRadius = -1; // ids 25, 26, 27 (+0x168, +0x16c, +0x170); radius <= -1: a directional field
    bool spaceFlagA = false, spaceActive19e = false; // Space ids 19 (+0x188) and 20 (+0x19e), read by the contact filter at 0x4624e0
    // Angry Birds Star Wars (setObjectParameter 36, native_setBlockCollisionEnabled / setIgnoresScore / setKeepOrientation / setAffectedByForceMultipliers / setIsWater)
    int groupIndex = 0;                              // id 36 (+0xf4): two objects with the same group above 0 never collide
    bool blockCollision = true;                      // +0x154: false = collides only with the materials in objects.world[name].collisionMaterials
    bool ignoresScore = false, keepOrientation = false, affectedByForceMult = false, isWater = false;   // +0x166, +0x164, +0x165, +0x163
    float waterDensity = 0;                          // +0x168
    bool killOn = false; float killTimer = 0;       // +0x15b, +0xec: when set, objects.world[name].strength becomes 0 and the object is dead after killTimer seconds
    bool isCircle = false; float boxW = 0, boxH = 0; // +0x15c, +0xb0, +0xb4: the size the water code reads
    bool hidden = false;                             // Space id 33 (+0x1ab) = 0: isVisible false, not drawn
    float capSpeed = 0, capVx = 0, capVy = 0;        // v2.4 setSpeedCap: 0 = no limit, applied after every physics step
    bool zSet = false;                               // setObjectZOrder was used: the object is drawn by zOrder in every game (Rio always sorts by it)
};

// The contact that is being reported, as far as the game code touches it.
class ContactHandle {
public:
    virtual ~ContactHandle() {}
    virtual void SetEnabled(bool on) = 0;
    // the first world contact point and the normal (b2Contact::GetWorldManifold); all zero when the contact has no points
    virtual void WorldManifold(float& px, float& py, float& nx, float& ny) { px = py = nx = ny = 0; }
};

// Everything about a body that the tests look at.
struct BodyInfo {
    bool valid = false, isStatic = false, awake = false;
    float posX = 0, posY = 0, angle = 0, velX = 0, velY = 0, angularVelocity = 0;
    float linearDamping = 0, angularDamping = 0, mass = 0, shapeRadius = 0;
};

struct RayHit { PhysObject* obj; float px, py, nx, ny, fraction; float cx = 0, cy = 0; };  // cx, cy: where the centre of a cast shape is at the hit (ray casts: the hit point)

// A shape swept along a segment (shape cast). kind 0 = none (a plain ray), 1 = circle (radius), 2 = polygon, convex or concave, any number of points (pts: x,y pairs around the centre, rotated by angle)
struct CastShape { int kind = 0; float radius = 0; float angle = 0; std::vector<float> pts; };

class PhysicsWorld {
public:
    virtual ~PhysicsWorld() {}

    // v2.2: the game starts its levels with every block asleep (a level authored at rest stays still until something touches it);
    // a world used on its own (the tests) creates awake bodies
    bool startAsleep = false;
    // Angry Birds Space has its own setObjectParameter ids (0x47ac60) and its own contact filter (0x4624e0)
    bool spaceRules = false;
    bool ShouldCollide(const PhysObject* a, const PhysObject* b) const { return ShouldCollideObjects(a, b); }   // the contact filter (for tests)
    float waterForceMultiplier = 2.0f, birdWaterDrag = 0.4f, objectWaterDrag = 0, gameWorldScale = 1;   // game +0x3cc, +0x3d0, +0x3d4, +0x160 (defaults of the constructor at 0x43dedc)
    // Lua tuning (the global `tuning` table, copied in before every step): Tn("water.band", 1.5f) is the script's value or the built-in one
    std::map<std::string, float> tuning;
    float Tn(const char* key, float def) const { auto it = tuning.find(key); return it == tuning.end() ? def : it->second; }
    bool phoneSpaceGravity = false;                  // Space for iPhone / iPad (1.1.0): birds keep their gravity factor off box sensors, and it fades by 2 a second
    bool starWarsRules = false;                      // Star Wars: the contact filter at 0x410e70 (spaceRules is set too)
    std::function<std::vector<std::string>(const PhysObject&)> collisionMaterialsOf;   // objects.world[name].collisionMaterials, read by the filter for an object with blockCollision false

    virtual Box2DVersion Version() const = 0;
    // the skin of the boxes and polygons that are created from now on (Box2D 2.2.0 only; 0 for 2.1.1, which has none)
    virtual void SetPolygonRadius(float r) { (void)r; }
    virtual void SetSolverSettings(float linearSlop, float timeToSleep, float linearSleepTolerance) { (void)linearSlop; (void)timeToSleep; (void)linearSleepTolerance; }
    /// Space is built from a newer Box2D than Rio: its dynamic tree (rotations) and the circle case of the position solver differ, see b2_spaceBuild and b2_coincidentCircleNormal
    virtual void SetBox2DFlavour(bool space) { (void)space; }
    virtual float PolygonRadius() const { return 0; }

    // ---- creation. Each returns the body mass (the original writes it to objects.world[name].mass).
    virtual float CreateBox(const BodyDef& d) = 0;
    virtual float CreateCompound(const BodyDef& d, const std::vector<CompoundShape>& shapes, float damping) = 0;
    virtual float CreateCircle(const BodyDef& d) = 0;
    virtual float CreatePolygon(const BodyDef& d, const std::vector<float>& verts) = 0;
    // 3.6: a body of any outline with holes: the outline and every hole are x,y point lists about the body's origin (any shape, any position). One fixture per convex piece that is left.
    virtual float CreateWithHoles(const BodyDef& d, const std::vector<float>& outline, const std::vector<std::vector<float>>& holes) { (void)holes; return CreatePolygon(d, outline); }
    // createLineShape (Star Wars, 0x439640): a body of edge shapes, one for each pair of neighbouring vertices (Box2D 2.2 only; the 2.1 build makes a polygon)
    virtual float CreateLine(const BodyDef& d, const std::vector<float>& verts) { return CreatePolygon(d, verts); }

    // Joints. The caller has already applied the table defaults (see JointDef in platform.h and the
    // list in ENGINE_SPEC.md). Returns false if an end object is missing (the original creates nothing).
    virtual bool CreateJoint(JointDef& d) = 0;          // may rewrite x1..y2, see the .cpp
    virtual void SetJointParameters(const JointParams& p) = 0;
    virtual void CheckJointLimits(const std::string& name, bool stop = false) = 0;   // stop: Star Wars handleJointLimits (0x410810) sets the motor speed to 0 instead of turning it round
    void DestroyJoint(const std::string& name);

    // Returns the names of the type-5 "link" joints that fired (the caller removes joints[name] from Lua).
    std::vector<std::string> RemoveObject(const std::string& name);

    void ApplyImpulse(const std::string& n, float ix, float iy, float px, float py);
    void ApplyForce(const std::string& n, float fx, float fy, float px, float py);
    bool SetPosition(const std::string& n, float x, float y);                // false: no such object
    bool SetRotation(const std::string& n, float angle, float& normalizedAngle);
    void SetVelocity(const std::string& n, float vx, float vy);
    void SetAngularVelocity(const std::string& n, float w);
    // Angry Birds Space natives that go through a body: cmd 1 linear damping, 2 angular damping, 3 fixed rotation, 4 active, 5 multiply the velocity by a,
    // 6 angular velocity (result), 7 sensor (a != 0: the body no longer collides, it only reports)
    // the gravitation sensors (0x46f720): called before every step
    void ApplyGravitySensors(float dt);
    // gravity of one object, independent of the world's (called from ApplyGravitySensors, before every step)
    void ApplyOwnGravity();
    // 0x41e440: the force and drag of water (a kind 2 sensor with setIsWater) on an object inside it
    void ApplyWater(PhysObject& w, PhysObject& o);
    bool SetOwnGravityVector(const std::string& n, float gx, float gy);
    bool SetOwnGravityScale(const std::string& n, float scale);
    bool ResetOwnGravity(const std::string& n);
    bool GetOwnGravity(const std::string& n, int& mode, float& gx, float& gy, float& scale) const;
    // vel: nullptr, or {aVx, aVy, bVx, bVy} where a NaN entry means "use the body's own velocity"
    CollisionPrediction PredictCollision(const std::string& a, const std::string& b, float restitution, const float* vel = nullptr) const;
    // The exe's list at obj+0x34: one entry per touching fixture pair (0x469ed0 is a plain push_back, 0x470380 erases the first match). Returns the
    // number of entries `other` has left, or -1 when an exit found no entry.
    int SensorPair(PhysObject* sen, PhysObject* other, bool enter);
    float BirdGravityFactor(float timer) const;
    bool GravityPull(const PhysObject& s, const PhysObject& t, float tx, float ty, float tvx, float tvy, float timer, float mass, float& fx, float& fy) const;
    // the aiming aid (updateBirdTrajectoryTable): the object flown on from its position and velocity under the gravitation sensors and its damping, one point every `every` steps
    void SimulateTrajectory(const std::string& n, int steps, int every, float h, std::vector<std::pair<float, float>>& out);
    // extension of the retail trail (which is the bird's free flight): the bird alone in a world with the world's gravity, launched with this velocity and stepped like the real world; no blocks, no ground
    virtual bool SimulateFlight(const std::string& bird, float vx, float vy, int steps, int every, float h, std::vector<std::pair<float, float>>& out, const float* start = nullptr, const float* force = nullptr, const float* zones = nullptr, int zoneCount = 0) { (void)zones; (void)zoneCount; (void)bird; (void)vx; (void)vy; (void)steps; (void)every; (void)h; (void)out; (void)start; (void)force; return false; }
    float gravityForceMultiplier = 4;        // setGravityForceMultiplier (game +0x368)
    bool BodyCommand(const std::string& n, int cmd, float a, float& result);
    void SetSleeping(const std::string& n, bool sleeping);
    void SetRecordVelocity(const std::string& n, bool on);                  // Space setRecordVelocity (0x47a5f0): publish xVel / yVel / angle for this object
    bool GetVelocity(const std::string& n, float& vx, float& vy) const;      // the body's linear velocity; false (0, 0) for an unknown object
    float GetAngle(const std::string& n) const;                              // interpolated angle
    void GetWorldPoint(const std::string& n, float lx, float ly, float& wx, float& wy) const;
    // setObjectParameter (0x40ec00): id 1 -> drawWithBirds = (value == 1); id 2 -> body type static if
    // value is 0, dynamic otherwise. id 5 -> the draw scale; id 6 -> use that scale (value == 1). Other ids do nothing.
    void SetObjectParameter(const std::string& n, int id, float value);
    // setMaterial (0x4125f0): "wood*" -> 1, "rock*" -> 2, "light*" -> 3 (a prefix test); anything else leaves it unchanged.
    void SetMaterial(const std::string& n, const std::string& material);
    void SetSpriteName(const std::string& n, const std::string& sprite);
    void SetTextureName(const std::string& n, const std::string& texture);
    // setMaterial: rolling sound material (1 wood, 2 rock, 3 light, 0 none), rolling flag and factor
    void SetRolling(const std::string& n, int material, bool rolls, float rollFactor);

    // Angry Birds Rio queries
    float GetSpeed(const std::string& n) const;                              // length of the linear velocity
    bool HasJoints(const std::string& n) const;                              // 0x413500: any joint with this object at one end
    bool HasMovingObjects(float tolerance) const;                            // any dynamic body faster than the tolerance
    void GetLocalPoint(const std::string& n, float wx, float wy, float& lx, float& ly) const;
    void SetCollisionEnabled(const std::string& n, bool on);
    // Collider types: every object has one (0 by default) and colliderRules_[a][b] says whether types a and b collide. All pairs collide,
    // except the ghost type (5), which only meets birds (3) and the eagle (1). Scripts change the pairs with setColliderRule.
    enum { kColliderTypes = 16 };
    void SetColliderType(const std::string& n, int type);
    int ColliderType(const std::string& n) const;
    void SetDecoration(const std::string& n, const std::string& sprite, int amount, float increment, float scale);
    void SetSpriteLook(const std::string& n, int what, float a, float b);   // 0 sprite angle, 1 pivot offset, 2 texture scale (Space natives)
    void SetObjectScale(const std::string& n, float sx, float sy);            // v2.4 setScale: the scale every game draws (turns scaled drawing on)
    bool GetObjectScale(const std::string& n, float& sx, float& sy) const;
    void SetSpeedCap(const std::string& n, float speed, float vx, float vy);  // v2.4 setSpeedCap
    bool GetSpeedCap(const std::string& n, float& speed, float& vx, float& vy) const;
    void ApplySpeedCaps();                                                     // after every Step
    std::vector<std::string> TouchingObjects(const std::string& n) const;      // v2.4 getTouchingObjects
    void SetObjectAlpha(const std::string& n, float a);       // 0..1, clamped
    float ObjectAlpha(const std::string& n) const;            // -1 if there is no such object
    void SetObjectZOrder(const std::string& n, float z);     // draw order: higher is drawn later (in front)
    float ObjectZOrder(const std::string& n) const;          // -1e9 if there is no such object
    float MoveObjectZ(const std::string& n, bool front);     // v2.2.3: in front of / behind every other object; returns the new z (-1e9: no such object)
    void SetColliderRule(int a, int b, bool collide);
    bool ColliderRule(int a, int b) const;
    void RemoveJointsFromObject(const std::string& n);
    std::vector<std::string> IntersectingObjects(float x, float y, float left, float right, float down, float up) const;

    // loadLevel: destroys every body and joint and forgets the objects (0x40d2c0)
    void Clear();
    // The name of the i-th joint in Frame().joints (for writing x1..y2 into objects.joints[name])
    const std::string& JointName(int index) const { return joints_[index]->name; }

    void SetLevelLimits(float minX, float maxX) { frame_.levelMinX = (int)minX; frame_.levelMaxX = (int)maxX; }
    void SetLevelLimitsY(float minY, float maxY) { frame_.levelMinY = (int)minY; frame_.levelMaxY = (int)maxY; }   // Space (0x462b10): all four limits are kept, truncated
    void SetRunning(bool on) { frame_.running = on; }

    // ---- stepping, for the frame update (FrameHost::StepWorld / ClearForces)
    virtual void Step(float dt, int velocityIterations, int positionIterations) = 0;
    virtual void ClearForces() = 0;
    virtual void SetGravity(float x, float y) = 0;
    // the scripts' setMaxTranslation: the longest distance a body moves in one step (2.0 when a level loads)
    virtual void SetMaxTranslation(float t) { (void)t; }
    virtual void GetGravity(float& x, float& y) const = 0;
    // Every non-sensor fixture the segment (x1, y1) - (x2, y2) crosses, in the order Box2D reports them (the callback at 0x495760 keeps going)
    virtual void RayCastAll(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, std::vector<RayHit>& out) const { (void)x1; (void)y1; (void)x2; (void)y2; (void)out; }
    // Like RayCastAll, but sweeps `shape` (centred on the segment) from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2): Box2D time of impact against every non-sensor fixture in the swept bounds. `skip` (may be empty) is a body that is left out (the caster). fraction 0 = already overlapping
    virtual void ShapeCastAll(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, const CastShape& shape, const std::string& skip, std::vector<RayHit>& out) const { (void)x1; (void)y1; (void)x2; (void)y2; (void)shape; (void)skip; (void)out; }
    virtual BodyInfo Inspect(const std::string& name) const = 0;
    // motor speed and distance-joint frequency / damping of a joint, for the tests; false: no such joint
    virtual bool InspectJoint(const std::string& name, float& motorSpeed, float& frequency, float& dampingRatio) const = 0;

    FrameState& Frame() { return frame_; }
    PhysObject* Find(const std::string& name) const;
    const std::vector<std::unique_ptr<PhysObject>>& Objects() const { return objects_; }   // in creation order
    std::string NameOf(int id) const { auto it = idNames_.find(id); return it == idNames_.end() ? std::string() : it->second; }
    int BodyCount() const { return (int)objects_.size(); }

    // ---- hooks
    // Called from BeginContact for every contact whose two fixtures both have an object (the
    // original returns early otherwise). The Lua side decides the rest with ResolveContact.
    std::function<void(PhysObject& a, PhysObject& b, ContactHandle& c)> onBeginContact;
    std::function<void(PhysObject& a, PhysObject& b)> onEndContact;
    // objects.world[name].material, read live by the filter. Return "" when absent.
    std::function<std::string(const PhysObject&)> materialOf;

    // Fills the physics part of a ContactObject (name, controllable, mass, velocity).
    static ContactObject MakeContactObject(const PhysObject& o);
    // Applies a VelocityChange from ResolveContact: immediate = setVelocity now, else after the next Step.
    void ApplyVelocityChange(const VelocityChange& v);

protected:
    struct JointRecord {
        std::string name, end1, end2;
        void* joint = nullptr;            // the Box2D joint, only the version's code looks inside
        int coordType = 0;
        bool backAndForth = false;        // v2.2: a motor with limits that reverses by itself at each limit (the exe only has checkJointLimits for Lua to call)
        std::unique_ptr<JointView> view;
    };
    // type-5 joints: no Box2D joint, just "when end1 is removed, end2 is destroyed after destroyTimer"
    struct Link {
        std::string name, end1, end2;
        float destroyTimer = 1;
    };

    // what the version's code needs from the shared part
    PhysObject* NewObject(const BodyDef& d, float rollFactor, bool circle);   // everything except the body
    void AddObject(PhysObject* o, bool bird);                                 // takes the object (the body is already set)
    JointRecord* FindJoint(const std::string& name);
    void RebuildJointViews();
    void DropJointRecord(void* joint);                                        // the Box2D joint is gone (SayGoodbye)
    bool ShouldCollideObjects(const PhysObject* a, const PhysObject* b) const;   // the contact filter: the rule below, then the Lua filter
    bool ShouldCollideBase(const PhysObject* a, const PhysObject* b) const;      // 0x40c440
public:
    // Lua contact filter (engine.shouldCollide(nameA, nameB)): -1 no opinion, 0 never collide, 1 collide
    std::function<int(const PhysObject*, const PhysObject*)> luaFilter;
protected:
    struct ColliderRules {
        bool pair[kColliderTypes][kColliderTypes];
        ColliderRules() {
            for (int a = 0; a < kColliderTypes; a++) for (int b = 0; b < kColliderTypes; b++) pair[a][b] = true;
            for (int t = 0; t < kColliderTypes; t++) if (t != 1 && t != 3) pair[5][t] = pair[t][5] = false;
        }
    } colliderRules_;
    virtual void DestroyBody(PhysObject* o) = 0;                              // also destroys the joints on the body
    virtual void DestroyBox2DJoint(void* joint) = 0;

    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<PhysObject>> objects_;
    std::map<std::string, PhysObject*> byName_;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<JointRecord>> joints_;
    std::vector<Link> links_;
    std::vector<std::pair<PhysObject*, PhysObject*>> sensorPairs_;   // Space: (gravitation sensor, touching object) contacts
    FrameState frame_;
    int nextId_ = 0;
    std::map<int, std::string> idNames_;
};

// Makes the world for a game: Rio uses Box2D 2.2.0, everything else 2.1.x.
std::unique_ptr<PhysicsWorld> MakePhysicsWorld(Box2DVersion version);

// One per Box2D version, defined in physics_world_b2.cpp
std::unique_ptr<PhysicsWorld> MakePhysicsWorld21();
std::unique_ptr<PhysicsWorld> MakePhysicsWorld22();

}  // namespace ab

```

`src/physics/physics_world_b2.cpp`:

```cpp
// The Box2D side of the physics world. This file is compiled twice: for Box2D 2.1.1 (Angry Birds Classic and
// Seasons) and, with AB_BOX2D_V22 defined, for Box2D 2.2.0 (Angry Birds Rio). See physics_world.h.
#include <Box2D/Box2D.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <map>
#include <set>

#include "physics/physics_world.h"
#include "physics/polygon_decompose.h"

#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
#define AB_B2_NAMESPACE box2d_v22
#define AB_B2_VERSION Box2DVersion::V22
#define AB_MAKE_WORLD MakePhysicsWorld22
#else
#define AB_B2_NAMESPACE box2d_v21
#define AB_B2_VERSION Box2DVersion::V21
#define AB_MAKE_WORLD MakePhysicsWorld21
#endif

namespace ab {
namespace AB_B2_NAMESPACE {

namespace {

class B2Body : public PhysBody {
public:
    explicit B2Body(b2Body* b) : b_(b) {}
    b2Body* Get() const { return b_; }
    void Wake(const char* why = "") { if (b_->GetType() != b2_staticBody && !b_->IsAwake()) { if (std::getenv("AB_WAKEDBG")) std::fprintf(stderr, "WAKE %s\n", why); b_->SetAwake(true); } }   // v2.2: a script that moves a body wakes it (levels now start asleep)

    bool IsStatic() const override { return b_->GetType() == b2_staticBody; }
    bool IsAwake() const override { return b_->IsAwake(); }
    void SetMaxSpeed(float s) override { b_->SetMaxSpeed(s); }
    void Touching(std::vector<PhysObject*>& out) const override {
        for (b2ContactEdge* e = b_->GetContactList(); e; e = e->next) {
            if (!e->contact->IsTouching()) continue;
            b2Fixture* fa = e->contact->GetFixtureA();
            b2Fixture* f = fa->GetBody() == b_ ? e->contact->GetFixtureB() : fa;
            PhysObject* o = static_cast<PhysObject*>(f->GetUserData());
            if (o) out.push_back(o);
        }
    }
    bool HasJoints() const override { return b_->GetJointList() != nullptr; }
    float PosX() const override { return b_->GetPosition().x; }
    float PosY() const override { return b_->GetPosition().y; }
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
    float RotCol1X() const override { return b_->GetTransform().q.c; }
    float RotCol1Y() const override { return b_->GetTransform().q.s; }
#else
    float RotCol1X() const override { return b_->GetTransform().R.col1.x; }
    float RotCol1Y() const override { return b_->GetTransform().R.col1.y; }
#endif
    float VelX() const override { return b_->GetLinearVelocity().x; }
    float VelY() const override { return b_->GetLinearVelocity().y; }
    float AngularVelocity() const override { return b_->GetAngularVelocity(); }
    float Mass() const override { return b_->GetMass(); }
    void SetLinearVelocity(float x, float y) override { Wake("SetLinearVelocity"); b_->SetLinearVelocity(b2Vec2(x, y)); }
    void SetBullet(bool on) override { b_->SetBullet(on); }

    float Angle() const override { return b_->GetAngle(); }
    void SetAngularVelocity(float w) override { Wake("SetAngularVelocity"); b_->SetAngularVelocity(w); }
    void SetAwake(bool awake) override { if (awake && !b_->IsAwake() && std::getenv("AB_WAKEDBG")) std::fprintf(stderr, "WAKE SetAwake\n"); b_->SetAwake(awake); }
    void SetKinematic() override { b_->SetType(b2_kinematicBody); }
    int Type() const override { return b_->GetType() == b2_staticBody ? 0 : b_->GetType() == b2_kinematicBody ? 2 : 1; }
    void SetStatic(bool isStatic) override { if (!isStatic && !b_->IsAwake() && std::getenv("AB_WAKEDBG")) std::fprintf(stderr, "WAKE SetStatic\n"); b_->SetType(isStatic ? b2_staticBody : b2_dynamicBody); }
    void SetTransform(float x, float y, float angle) override { b_->SetTransform(b2Vec2(x, y), angle); }
    void WorldPoint(float lx, float ly, float& wx, float& wy) const override {
        b2Vec2 p = b_->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(lx, ly));
        wx = p.x; wy = p.y;
    }
    void LocalPoint(float wx, float wy, float& lx, float& ly) const override {
        b2Vec2 p = b_->GetLocalPoint(b2Vec2(wx, wy));
        lx = p.x; ly = p.y;
    }
    void ApplyImpulse(float ix, float iy, float px, float py) override { Wake("ApplyImpulse"); b_->ApplyLinearImpulse(b2Vec2(ix, iy), b2Vec2(px, py)); }
    void ApplyForce(float fx, float fy, float px, float py) override { Wake("ApplyForce"); b_->ApplyForce(b2Vec2(fx, fy), b2Vec2(px, py)); }
    void SetRestitution(float r) override { for (b2Fixture* f = b_->GetFixtureList(); f; f = f->GetNext()) f->SetRestitution(r); }
    void SetFriction(float f) override { for (b2Fixture* fx = b_->GetFixtureList(); fx; fx = fx->GetNext()) fx->SetFriction(f); }
    void ResizeCircle(float r) override {
        for (b2Fixture* fx = b_->GetFixtureList(); fx; fx = fx->GetNext())
            if (fx->GetShape()->GetType() == b2Shape::e_circle) const_cast<b2CircleShape*>(static_cast<const b2CircleShape*>(fx->GetShape()))->m_radius = r;
        b_->ResetMassData();
        b_->SetTransform(b_->GetPosition(), b_->GetAngle());     // refreshes the broad-phase boxes
    }
    void SetDensity(float d) override {
        for (b2Fixture* f = b_->GetFixtureList(); f; f = f->GetNext()) f->SetDensity(d);
        b_->ResetMassData();
    }
    void SetSensor(bool on) override {
        for (b2Fixture* f = b_->GetFixtureList(); f; f = f->GetNext()) f->SetSensor(on);
    }
    bool Bounds(float& x0, float& y0, float& x1, float& y1) const override {
        b2AABB box;
        bool first = true;
        if (!b_->IsActive()) return false;      // an inactive body has no broad-phase proxies, so its fixtures have no AABB
        for (const b2Fixture* f = b_->GetFixtureList(); f; f = f->GetNext()) {
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
            const b2AABB& a = f->GetAABB(0);
#else
            const b2AABB& a = f->GetAABB();
#endif
            if (first) { box = a; first = false; } else box.Combine(box, a);
        }
        if (first) return false;
        x0 = box.lowerBound.x; y0 = box.lowerBound.y; x1 = box.upperBound.x; y1 = box.upperBound.y;
        return true;
    }
    float LinearDamping() const override { return b_->GetLinearDamping(); }
    float AngularDamping() const override { return b_->GetAngularDamping(); }
    void SetAngularDamping(float d) override { b_->SetAngularDamping(d); }
    void SetLinearDamping(float d) override { b_->SetLinearDamping(d); }
    void SetFixedRotation(bool on) override { b_->SetFixedRotation(on); }
    void SetActive(bool on) override { b_->SetActive(on); }
    float ShapeRadius() const override { return b_->GetFixtureList() ? b_->GetFixtureList()->GetShape()->m_radius : 0.0f; }
    float Inertia() const override {
        if (b_->GetType() != b2_dynamicBody) return 0.0f;
        b2Vec2 lc = b_->GetLocalCenter();
        float i = b_->GetInertia() - b_->GetMass() * (lc.x * lc.x + lc.y * lc.y);     // GetInertia is about the body origin
        return i > 0 ? i : 0.0f;
    }
    void CenterOfMass(float& x, float& y) const override { b2Vec2 c = b_->GetWorldCenter(); x = c.x; y = c.y; }
    const b2Fixture* SolidFixture() const { for (const b2Fixture* f = b_->GetFixtureList(); f; f = f->GetNext()) if (!f->IsSensor()) return f; return nullptr; }
    float Friction() const override { const b2Fixture* f = SolidFixture(); return f ? f->GetFriction() : 0.2f; }
    float Restitution() const override { const b2Fixture* f = SolidFixture(); return f ? f->GetRestitution() : 0.0f; }
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
    int OverlapAt(const PhysBody& other, float x, float y) const override {
        const B2Body* o = dynamic_cast<const B2Body*>(&other);
        const b2Fixture* fa = b_->GetFixtureList();
        const b2Fixture* fb = o ? o->b_->GetFixtureList() : nullptr;
        if (!fa || !fb) return -1;
        b2Transform xf = b_->GetTransform();
        xf.p.Set(x, y);
        return b2TestOverlap(fa->GetShape(), 0, fb->GetShape(), 0, xf, o->b_->GetTransform()) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    bool ClosestPoints(const PhysBody& other, float& ax, float& ay, float& bx, float& by, float& dist, float& radA, float& radB) const override {
        const B2Body* o = dynamic_cast<const B2Body*>(&other);
        if (!o) return false;
        bool found = false;
        float best = 0;
        for (const b2Fixture* fa = b_->GetFixtureList(); fa; fa = fa->GetNext()) {
            if (fa->IsSensor()) continue;
            for (const b2Fixture* fb = o->b_->GetFixtureList(); fb; fb = fb->GetNext()) {
                if (fb->IsSensor()) continue;
                b2DistanceInput in;
                in.proxyA.Set(fa->GetShape(), 0); in.proxyB.Set(fb->GetShape(), 0);
                in.transformA = b_->GetTransform(); in.transformB = o->b_->GetTransform();
                in.useRadii = false;                                  // the cores; the skin radii are added back by the caller
                b2SimplexCache cache; cache.count = 0;
                b2DistanceOutput out;
                b2Distance(&out, &cache, &in);
                float surface = out.distance - fa->GetShape()->m_radius - fb->GetShape()->m_radius;
                if (!found || surface < best) {
                    found = true; best = surface;
                    ax = out.pointA.x; ay = out.pointA.y; bx = out.pointB.x; by = out.pointB.y; dist = out.distance;
                    radA = fa->GetShape()->m_radius; radB = fb->GetShape()->m_radius;
                }
            }
        }
        return found;
    }
#endif

private:
    b2Body* b_;
};

// The two end points the exe publishes to objects.joints[name].x1..y2 (anchor A, anchor B).
class B2JointView : public JointView {
public:
    B2JointView(b2Joint* j, int coordType) : j_(j), coordType_(coordType) {}
    bool PublishesEndpoints() const override { return coordType_ != 2; }
    void Anchors(float& x1, float& y1, float& x2, float& y2) const override {
        b2Vec2 a = j_->GetAnchorA(), b = j_->GetAnchorB();
        x1 = a.x; y1 = a.y; x2 = b.x; y2 = b.y;
    }

private:
    b2Joint* j_;
    int coordType_;
};

class ContactRef : public ContactHandle {
public:
    explicit ContactRef(b2Contact* c) : c_(c) {}
    void SetEnabled(bool on) override { c_->SetEnabled(on); }
    void WorldManifold(float& px, float& py, float& nx, float& ny) override {
        b2WorldManifold wm;
        c_->GetWorldManifold(&wm);
        px = wm.points[0].x; py = wm.points[0].y; nx = wm.normal.x; ny = wm.normal.y;
    }

private:
    b2Contact* c_;
};

b2Body* BodyOf(const PhysObject* o) { return static_cast<B2Body*>(o->pbody.get())->Get(); }

// The angle the joint solvers measure: the body's raw sweep angle. Box2D 2.2.0's GetAngle() wraps it to (-pi, pi], so a joint def
// initialised from GetAngle() gets a reference angle that is off by 2*pi for a body whose angle was set to e.g. 4.37 (the scripts
// keep angles in [0, 2*pi)) - the solver then tries to turn the bodies a whole revolution and the structure explodes.
// 2.1.1's GetAngle() is the sweep angle itself.
float RelativeAngle(const b2Body* a, const b2Body* b) {
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
    return b->GetSweepAngle() - a->GetSweepAngle();
#else
    return b->GetAngle() - a->GetAngle();
#endif
}

#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
#define AB_WHEEL 1
#else
#define AB_WHEEL 0
#endif

class Impl : public PhysicsWorld, public b2ContactListener, public b2ContactFilter, public b2DestructionListener {
public:
    Impl() : world_(b2Vec2(kGravityX, kGravityY), true) {
        world_.SetWarmStarting(std::getenv("AB_NOWARM") == nullptr);
        world_.SetContinuousPhysics(std::getenv("AB_NOCCD") == nullptr);   // the exe runs with continuous collision on (world flag at +0x19255 is set to 1 and never cleared); AB_NOCCD=1 turns it off for testing
        world_.SetContactListener(this);
        world_.SetContactFilter(this);
        world_.SetDestructionListener(this);
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
        if (const char* r = std::getenv("AB_POLYRADIUS")) b2_polygonRadiusValue = (float)std::atof(r);   // test override
        if (const char* r = std::getenv("AB_SOLVERSKIN")) b2_solverSkinFraction = (float)std::atof(r);   // test override
#endif
    }

    ~Impl() override {
        // the world is destroyed after this body runs; keep the callbacks from touching freed records
        world_.SetDestructionListener(nullptr);
        world_.SetContactListener(nullptr);
        world_.SetContactFilter(nullptr);
    }

    // 3.6: the skin of the shapes that are already in the world changes as well (polygons only; circles have their radius)
    void ApplySkin(float r) {
        for (b2Body* b = world_.GetBodyList(); b; b = b->GetNext())
            for (b2Fixture* f = b->GetFixtureList(); f; f = f->GetNext())
                if (f->GetType() == b2Shape::e_polygon) const_cast<b2Shape*>(f->GetShape())->m_radius = r;
    }
    Box2DVersion Version() const override { return AB_B2_VERSION; }
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
    void SetBox2DFlavour(bool space) override { b2_coincidentCircleNormal = !space; b2_spaceBuild = space; }
#endif
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
    void SetPolygonRadius(float r) override { if (r >= 0) { b2_polygonRadiusValue = r; ApplySkin(r); } }
    float PolygonRadius() const override { return b2_polygonRadiusValue; }
#else
    void SetPolygonRadius(float r) override { if (r >= 0) { b2_polygonRadiusValue21 = r; ApplySkin(r); } }      // 3.6: the skin of every game (in 2.1.1 it is what the distance and time-of-impact code adds around a shape)
    float PolygonRadius() const override { return b2_polygonRadiusValue21; }
#endif
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
    void SetSolverSettings(float linearSlop, float timeToSleep, float linearSleepTolerance) override { b2_linearSlopValue = linearSlop; b2_timeToSleepValue = timeToSleep; b2_linearSleepToleranceValue = linearSleepTolerance; }
#endif

    void Step(float dt, int velocityIterations, int positionIterations) override {
        // AngryBirdsRio.exe steps the world with 10 velocity and 10 position iterations (0x4e4480 is called with 1/30, 10, 10 at 0x40e7b3 area);
        // the scripts' own counts are used as they come.
        static const char* vi = std::getenv("AB_VELITERS"); static const char* pi = std::getenv("AB_POSITERS");   // test overrides
        if (vi) velocityIterations = std::atoi(vi);
        if (pi) positionIterations = std::atoi(pi);
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
        b2_velocityThresholdV22 = Tn("solver.velocityThreshold", 1.0f); b2_maxLinearCorrectionV22 = Tn("solver.maxLinearCorrection", 0.2f);
        b2_baumgarteV22 = Tn("solver.baumgarte", 0.2f); b2_maxRotationV22 = Tn("solver.maxRotation", 1.5707964f); b2_angularSleepToleranceV22 = Tn("solver.angularSleepTolerance", 0.034906585f);
#else
        b2_velocityThresholdV21 = Tn("solver.velocityThreshold", 1.0f); b2_maxLinearCorrectionV21 = Tn("solver.maxLinearCorrection", 0.2f);
        b2_contactBaumgarteV21 = Tn("solver.baumgarte", 0.2f); b2_maxRotationV21 = Tn("solver.maxRotation", 1.5707964f); b2_angularSleepToleranceV21 = Tn("solver.angularSleepTolerance", 0.034906585f);
#endif
        ProcessGearKills();
        hitsThisStep_.clear();
        world_.Step(dt, velocityIterations, positionIterations);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < joints_.size(); i++)      // v2.2: backAndForth joints turn round at their limits without the scripts having to ask
            if (joints_[i]->backAndForth) CheckJointLimits(joints_[i]->name);
        // debug aid: AB_CONTACTDBG=<part of an object name> lists the contacts of the matching objects after every step
        static const char* watch = std::getenv("AB_CONTACTDBG");
        static int stepNo = 0;
        stepNo++;
        if (watch)
            for (b2Contact* c = world_.GetContactList(); c; c = c->GetNext()) {
                PhysObject* a = static_cast<PhysObject*>(c->GetFixtureA()->GetUserData());
                PhysObject* b = static_cast<PhysObject*>(c->GetFixtureB()->GetUserData());
                if (!a || !b || (a->name.find(watch) == std::string::npos && b->name.find(watch) == std::string::npos)) continue;
                std::fprintf(stderr, "CT %d %s | %s touching=%d enabled=%d points=%d\n", stepNo, a->name.c_str(), b->name.c_str(),
                             c->IsTouching() ? 1 : 0, c->IsEnabled() ? 1 : 0, c->GetManifold()->pointCount);
            }
    }
    // The aiming aid's arc (extension of the retail trail, which is the bird's free flight): the bird alone in a world with the same gravity, launched with
    // the given velocity and stepped like the real world (1/30 s, 10 + 10 iterations, the speed caps after every step). No blocks, no ground.
    bool SimulateFlight(const std::string& bird, float vx, float vy, int steps, int every, float h, std::vector<std::pair<float, float>>& out, const float* start = nullptr, const float* force = nullptr, const float* zones = nullptr, int zoneCount = 0) override {   // zones: 5 numbers each (x, y, radius, gx, gy), round areas where the bird has its own gravity (v3.3); force: a push applied before every step, like a script's applyForce each frame (the Boomerang Bird's lift)
        PhysObject* o = Find(bird);
        if (!o || !o->pbody) return false;
        b2Body* src = BodyOf(o);
        b2World scratch(world_.GetGravity(), true);
        b2BodyDef bd; bd.type = b2_dynamicBody; bd.position = start ? b2Vec2(start[0], start[1]) : src->GetPosition(); bd.angle = src->GetAngle();
        bd.linearDamping = src->GetLinearDamping(); bd.angularDamping = src->GetAngularDamping(); bd.bullet = true;
        b2Body* bb = scratch.CreateBody(&bd);
        for (b2Fixture* f = src->GetFixtureList(); f; f = f->GetNext()) {
            if (f->IsSensor()) continue;
            b2FixtureDef fd; fd.shape = f->GetShape(); fd.friction = f->GetFriction(); fd.restitution = f->GetRestitution(); fd.density = f->GetDensity(); fd.filter = f->GetFilterData();
            bb->CreateFixture(&fd);
        }
        { b2MassData md; src->GetMassData(&md); bb->SetMassData(&md); }      // v3.1: the copy weighs what the real bird weighs (a pushed bird, like the Boomerang, flew with the wrong mass)
        bb->SetLinearVelocity(b2Vec2(vx, vy));
        const float bodyR = o->pbody->ShapeRadius();
        const b2Vec2 worldG = world_.GetGravity();
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            if (force) bb->ApplyForce(b2Vec2(force[0], force[1]), bb->GetWorldCenter());
            // v3.3: inside a gravity area the bird accelerates by the area's gravity instead of the world's (what setObjectGravity does in the real world, as a script's sensor zone uses it)
            for (int z = 0; z < zoneCount; z++) {
                const float* a = zones + z * 5;
                b2Vec2 p0 = bb->GetPosition();
                float dx = p0.x - a[0], dy = p0.y - a[1], reach = a[2] + bodyR;
                if (dx * dx + dy * dy < reach * reach) {
                    float m = bb->GetMass();
                    bb->ApplyForce(b2Vec2(m * (a[3] - worldG.x), m * (a[4] - worldG.y)), bb->GetWorldCenter());
                    break;
                }
            }
            scratch.Step(h, 10, 10);
            scratch.ClearForces();      // forces are not cleared by the step here (as in the exe): the frame loop clears them, so the copy does too
            if (o->capVx > 0 || o->capVy > 0 || o->capSpeed > 0) {
                b2Vec2 n0 = bb->GetLinearVelocity();
                if (o->capVx > 0) n0.x = std::max(-o->capVx, std::min(o->capVx, n0.x));
                if (o->capVy > 0) n0.y = std::max(-o->capVy, std::min(o->capVy, n0.y));
                if (o->capSpeed > 0) { float sp = std::sqrt(n0.x * n0.x + n0.y * n0.y); if (sp > o->capSpeed) { float k = o->capSpeed / sp; n0.x *= k; n0.y *= k; } }
                bb->SetLinearVelocity(n0);
            }
            b2Vec2 p = bb->GetPosition();
            if (every > 0 && (i + 1) % every == 0) out.push_back({p.x, p.y});
        }
        return true;
    }
    void ClearForces() override { world_.ClearForces(); }
    void SetGravity(float x, float y) override { world_.SetGravity(b2Vec2(x, y)); }
    void SetMaxTranslation(float t) override { b2_maxTranslation = t; b2_maxTranslationSquared = t * t; }
    void RayCastAll(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, std::vector<RayHit>& out) const override {
        struct Collect : b2RayCastCallback {
            std::vector<RayHit>* hits;
            float32 ReportFixture(b2Fixture* f, const b2Vec2& p, const b2Vec2& n, float32 fraction) override {
                PhysObject* o = static_cast<PhysObject*>(f->GetUserData());
                if (!f->IsSensor() && o) hits->push_back({o, p.x, p.y, n.x, n.y, fraction});
                return 1.0f;
            }
        } cb;
        cb.hits = &out;
        world_.RayCast(&cb, b2Vec2(x1, y1), b2Vec2(x2, y2));
    }
    void ShapeCastAll(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, const CastShape& cs, const std::string& skip, std::vector<RayHit>& out) const override {
        if (cs.kind == 0) { RayCastAll(x1, y1, x2, y2, out); return; }
        // the swept shape: a circle, or convex pieces of any number of points (a concave outline is split; the distance proxy has no vertex limit)
        b2CircleShape circle;
        std::vector<std::vector<b2Vec2>> pieces;
        std::vector<b2DistanceProxy> proxies;
        float ext = cs.radius;
        if (cs.kind == 1) {
            circle.m_p.SetZero(); circle.m_radius = cs.radius;
            b2DistanceProxy px;
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
            px.Set(&circle, 0);
#else
            px.Set(&circle);
#endif
            proxies.push_back(px);
        } else {
            float c = std::cos(cs.angle), s = std::sin(cs.angle);
            std::vector<polydecomp::Pt> pp;
            for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < cs.pts.size(); i += 2) pp.push_back({cs.pts[i] * c - cs.pts[i + 1] * s, cs.pts[i] * s + cs.pts[i + 1] * c});
            std::vector<std::vector<polydecomp::Pt>> parts;
            polydecomp::Decompose(pp, 256, parts);
            for (const auto& part : parts) {
                std::vector<b2Vec2> v;
                for (const polydecomp::Pt& q : part) { v.push_back(b2Vec2(q.x, q.y)); ext = std::max(ext, std::sqrt(q.x * q.x + q.y * q.y)); }
                if (v.size() >= 3) pieces.push_back(v);
            }
            if (pieces.empty()) return;
            for (const auto& v : pieces) { b2DistanceProxy px; px.m_vertices = v.data(); px.m_count = (int)v.size(); px.m_radius = 0.0f; proxies.push_back(px); }
        }
        ext += 0.1f;
        b2AABB box; box.lowerBound.Set(std::min(x1, x2) - ext, std::min(y1, y2) - ext); box.upperBound.Set(std::max(x1, x2) + ext, std::max(y1, y2) + ext);
        struct Q : b2QueryCallback { std::vector<b2Fixture*> f; bool ReportFixture(b2Fixture* x) override { f.push_back(x); return true; } } q;
        world_.QueryAABB(&q, box);
        float dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1, len = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        for (b2Fixture* f : q.f) {
            PhysObject* o = static_cast<PhysObject*>(f->GetUserData());
            if (f->IsSensor() || !o || (!skip.empty() && o->name == skip)) continue;
            b2Body* body = f->GetBody();
            b2DistanceProxy proxyB;
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
            proxyB.Set(f->GetShape(), 0);
#else
            proxyB.Set(f->GetShape());
#endif
            // every convex piece of the swept shape against this fixture: the earliest touch counts
            float bestT = 2.0f; size_t best = 0;
            for (size_t k = 0; k < proxies.size(); k++) {
                b2TOIInput in; in.proxyA = proxies[k]; in.proxyB = proxyB; in.tMax = 1.0f;
                in.sweepA.localCenter.SetZero(); in.sweepA.c0.Set(x1, y1); in.sweepA.c.Set(x2, y2); in.sweepA.a0 = in.sweepA.a = 0;
                in.sweepB.localCenter = body->GetLocalCenter(); in.sweepB.c0 = in.sweepB.c = body->GetWorldCenter(); in.sweepB.a0 = in.sweepB.a = body->GetAngle();
                b2TOIOutput out2; b2TimeOfImpact(&out2, &in);
                // the bundled 2.1 solver (exe-matched) reports only t and leaves the state unknown: t < 1 is a hit there
                bool hit = out2.state == b2TOIOutput::e_touching || out2.state == b2TOIOutput::e_overlapped || (out2.state == b2TOIOutput::e_unknown && out2.t < 1.0f);
                if (!hit) continue;
                float t = out2.state == b2TOIOutput::e_overlapped ? 0.0f : out2.t;
                if (t < bestT) { bestT = t; best = k; }
            }
            if (bestT > 1.0f) continue;
            float t = bestT;
            float cxp = x1 + dx * t, cyp = y1 + dy * t;
            b2Transform xa; xa.Set(b2Vec2(cxp, cyp), 0);
            b2DistanceInput di; di.proxyA = proxies[best]; di.proxyB = proxyB; di.transformA = xa; di.transformB = body->GetTransform(); di.useRadii = true;
            b2SimplexCache cache; cache.count = 0; b2DistanceOutput dout; b2Distance(&dout, &cache, &di);
            RayHit h; h.obj = o; h.fraction = t; h.cx = cxp; h.cy = cyp;
            b2Vec2 n(dx, dy);
            if (dout.distance > 1e-5f) { n = dout.pointA - dout.pointB; n.Normalize(); h.px = dout.pointB.x; h.py = dout.pointB.y; }
```
