```cpp
            else { if (len > 1e-6f) n = b2Vec2(-dx / len, -dy / len); h.px = cxp; h.py = cyp; }
            h.nx = n.x; h.ny = n.y;
            out.push_back(h);
        }
    }
    void GetGravity(float& x, float& y) const override { b2Vec2 g = world_.GetGravity(); x = g.x; y = g.y; }

    BodyInfo Inspect(const std::string& name) const override {
        BodyInfo i;
        PhysObject* o = Find(name);
        if (!o) return i;
        const PhysBody& b = *o->pbody;
        i.valid = true;
        i.isStatic = b.IsStatic(); i.awake = b.IsAwake();
        i.posX = b.PosX(); i.posY = b.PosY(); i.angle = b.Angle();
        i.velX = b.VelX(); i.velY = b.VelY(); i.angularVelocity = b.AngularVelocity();
        i.linearDamping = b.LinearDamping(); i.angularDamping = b.AngularDamping();
        i.mass = b.Mass(); i.shapeRadius = b.ShapeRadius();
        return i;
    }

    bool InspectJoint(const std::string& name, float& motorSpeed, float& frequency, float& dampingRatio) const override {
        motorSpeed = frequency = dampingRatio = 0;
        for (const auto& r : joints_) {
            if (r->name != name) continue;
            b2Joint* joint = static_cast<b2Joint*>(r->joint);
            if (joint->GetType() == e_revoluteJoint) motorSpeed = static_cast<b2RevoluteJoint*>(joint)->GetMotorSpeed();
            if (joint->GetType() == e_prismaticJoint) motorSpeed = static_cast<b2PrismaticJoint*>(joint)->GetMotorSpeed();
            if (joint->GetType() == e_distanceJoint) {
                frequency = static_cast<b2DistanceJoint*>(joint)->GetFrequency();
                dampingRatio = static_cast<b2DistanceJoint*>(joint)->GetDampingRatio();
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ---- creation
    float CreateBox(const BodyDef& d) override {
        PhysObject* o = MakeObject(d, -1.0f, false);
        b2PolygonShape shape;
        shape.SetAsBox(d.w * 0.5f, d.h * 0.5f);
        MakeFixture(BodyOf(o), o, shape, d);
        AddObject(o, false);
        return o->pbody->Mass();
    }

    // Angry Birds Space createCompoundObject: one body, one fixture per part (a box, a polygon, a line as a thin box, or a circle)
    float CreateCompound(const BodyDef& d, const std::vector<CompoundShape>& shapes, float damping) override {
        PhysObject* o = MakeObject(d, -1.0f, false);
        b2Body* body = BodyOf(o);
        for (const CompoundShape& cs : shapes) {
            if (cs.kind == 3) {
                b2CircleShape c;
                c.m_radius = cs.w;
                c.m_p.Set(cs.x, cs.y);
                MakeFixture(body, o, c, d);
            } else if (cs.kind == 1 && cs.verts.size() >= 6) {
                float ca = std::cos(cs.angle), sa = std::sin(cs.angle);
                std::vector<b2Vec2> pts;
                for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < cs.verts.size(); i += 2)
                    pts.push_back(b2Vec2(cs.x + ca * cs.verts[i] - sa * cs.verts[i + 1], cs.y + sa * cs.verts[i] + ca * cs.verts[i + 1]));
                std::vector<polydecomp::Pt> pp;
                for (const b2Vec2& v : pts) pp.push_back({v.x, v.y});
                if (pts.size() <= 8 && (polydecomp::IsConvex(pp) || polydecomp::IsConvex(std::vector<polydecomp::Pt>(pp.rbegin(), pp.rend())))) {
                    b2PolygonShape poly;
                    poly.Set(pts.data(), (int)pts.size());
                    MakeFixture(body, o, poly, d);
                } else AddConcaveFixtures(body, o, pts, d);      // concave, or more points than Box2D takes in one shape
            } else {
                b2PolygonShape box;
                float hh = cs.kind == 2 ? 0.05f : cs.h * 0.5f;
                box.SetAsBox(cs.w * 0.5f, hh, b2Vec2(cs.x, cs.y), cs.angle);
                MakeFixture(body, o, box, d);
            }
        }
        o->parts = shapes;
        o->pbody->SetLinearDamping(damping);
        if (d.controllable) o->pbody->SetAngularDamping(2.0f);
        AddObject(o, d.controllable);
        return o->pbody->Mass();
    }

    float CreateCircle(const BodyDef& d) override {
        PhysObject* o = MakeObject(d, d.w, true);
        b2CircleShape shape;
        shape.m_radius = d.w;
        shape.m_p.Set(0, 0);
        MakeFixture(BodyOf(o), o, shape, d);
        // GUESS: the exe tests the z_order argument here (ftol(...) == 999). Check on a real level.
        o->special999 = (int)d.zOrder == 999;
        if (d.controllable) o->pbody->SetAngularDamping(2.0f);
        AddObject(o, d.controllable);
        return o->pbody->Mass();
    }

    float CreateWithHoles(const BodyDef& d, const std::vector<float>& outline, const std::vector<std::vector<float>>& holes) override {
        PhysObject* o = MakeObject(d, -1.0f, false);
        std::vector<polydecomp::Pt> out;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < outline.size(); i += 2) out.push_back({outline[i], outline[i + 1]});
        std::vector<std::vector<polydecomp::Pt>> hs;
        for (const auto& h : holes) {
            std::vector<polydecomp::Pt> hp;
            for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < h.size(); i += 2) hp.push_back({h[i], h[i + 1]});
            if (hp.size() >= 3) hs.push_back(hp);
        }
        // the same block made again (a level with ten of them) reuses the pieces: the cut is the slow part
        std::string key;
        { char buf[40]; for (const auto& pt : out) { std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%.4f,%.4f;", pt.x, pt.y); key += buf; }
          for (const auto& hp : hs) { key += '|'; for (const auto& pt : hp) { std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%.4f,%.4f;", pt.x, pt.y); key += buf; } } }
        std::vector<std::vector<polydecomp::Pt>>& pieces = holeCache_[key];
        if (pieces.empty()) polydecomp::CutHoles(out, hs, (size_t)b2_maxPolygonVertices, pieces);
        if (std::getenv("AB_HOLEDBG")) std::fprintf(stderr, "holes: %d pieces\n", (int)pieces.size());
        int made = 0;
        for (const auto& pc : pieces) {
            std::vector<b2Vec2> v;
            for (const polydecomp::Pt& q : pc) v.push_back(b2Vec2(q.x, q.y));
            b2PolygonShape shape;
            shape.Set(v.data(), (int)v.size());
            MakeFixture(BodyOf(o), o, shape, d);
            made++;
        }
        o->holed = true;
        if (made == 0) {     // the holes took everything: a tiny box, so the object still has a body
            b2PolygonShape shape;
            shape.SetAsBox(0.05f, 0.05f);
            MakeFixture(BodyOf(o), o, shape, d);
        }
        if (d.controllable) o->pbody->SetAngularDamping(2.0f);
        AddObject(o, false);
        return o->pbody->Mass();
    }

    float CreatePolygon(const BodyDef& d, const std::vector<float>& verts) override {
        PhysObject* o = MakeObject(d, -1.0f, false);
        std::vector<b2Vec2> pts;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < verts.size(); i += 2) pts.push_back(b2Vec2(verts[i], verts[i + 1]));
        float area2 = 0;     // twice the signed area: Box2D wants the points counter-clockwise, and Stella has shapes drawn the other way round
        for (size_t i = 0; i < pts.size(); i++) { const b2Vec2& p = pts[i]; const b2Vec2& q = pts[(i + 1) % pts.size()]; area2 += p.x * q.y - q.x * p.y; }
        if (area2 < 0) std::reverse(pts.begin(), pts.end());
        if (pts.size() >= 3 && std::fabs(area2) < 2e-5f) pts.resize(2);    // no area: made as the small box below
        bool concave = false;
        if (pts.size() >= 3) {
            std::vector<polydecomp::Pt> pp;
            for (const b2Vec2& v : pts) pp.push_back({v.x, v.y});
            concave = !polydecomp::IsConvex(pp);
        }
        if (concave) {
            // a concave outline (a star, a crescent, an L): convex pieces of at most b2_maxPolygonVertices points, one fixture each; they share the body, so it moves as one
            AddConcaveFixtures(BodyOf(o), o, pts, d);
        } else if (pts.size() >= 3 && (int)pts.size() <= b2_maxPolygonVertices) {
            b2PolygonShape shape;
            shape.Set(pts.data(), (int)pts.size());
            MakeFixture(BodyOf(o), o, shape, d);
        } else if (pts.size() > (size_t)b2_maxPolygonVertices) {
            // Stella's levels have shapes with more points than Box2D takes (8): a fan of triangles from the first point (Box2D asserts, or writes
            // past its array in a release build, on a polygon this large). Triangles too thin to be a shape are left out.
            for (size_t i = 1; i + 1 < pts.size(); i++) {
                b2Vec2 tri[3] = {pts[0], pts[i], pts[i + 1]};
                float area = 0.5f * ((tri[1].x - tri[0].x) * (tri[2].y - tri[0].y) - (tri[2].x - tri[0].x) * (tri[1].y - tri[0].y));
                if (std::fabs(area) < 1e-5f) continue;
                if (area < 0) std::swap(tri[1], tri[2]);   // counter-clockwise, as Box2D wants
                b2PolygonShape shape;
                shape.Set(tri, 3);
                MakeFixture(BodyOf(o), o, shape, d);
            }
        } else {
            b2PolygonShape shape;      // fewer than three points: a small box, so the object still has a body
            shape.SetAsBox(0.05f, 0.05f);
            MakeFixture(BodyOf(o), o, shape, d);
        }
        if (d.controllable) o->pbody->SetAngularDamping(2.0f);
        AddObject(o, false);
        return o->pbody->Mass();
    }

#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
    // 0x4254d0: one b2EdgeShape fixture for each pair of neighbouring vertices, created with the object's density, friction and restitution
    float CreateLine(const BodyDef& d, const std::vector<float>& verts) override {
        PhysObject* o = MakeObject(d, -1.0f, false);
        b2Body* body = BodyOf(o);
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 3 < verts.size(); i += 2) {
            b2EdgeShape edge;
            edge.Set(b2Vec2(verts[i], verts[i + 1]), b2Vec2(verts[i + 2], verts[i + 3]));
            MakeFixture(body, o, edge, d);
        }
        AddObject(o, false);
        return o->pbody->Mass();
    }
#endif

    // 0x40ecd0. The anchors follow the exe literally, including its quirk for distance joints with
    // coordType 1: the local anchor is (world point - body position), which ignores the body's rotation.
    bool CreateJoint(JointDef& d) override {
        if (d.type == 5) {
            Link l;
            l.name = d.name; l.end1 = d.end1; l.end2 = d.end2; l.destroyTimer = d.destroyTimer;
            links_.push_back(l);
            return true;
        }
        PhysObject* o1 = Find(d.end1);
        PhysObject* o2 = Find(d.end2);
        if (d.type == 8) { if (!o1) return false; }                         // mouse: one body, pulled towards a point
        else if (d.type != 7 && (!o1 || !o2)) return false;                 // gear: two joints, no bodies of its own
        if (std::getenv("AB_JOINTDBG") && d.end1.find(std::getenv("AB_JOINTDBG")) != std::string::npos) std::fprintf(stderr, "JT type=%d %s - %s coord=%d freq=%g damp=%g limit=%d lo=%g hi=%g motor=%d coll=%d\n", d.type, d.end1.c_str(), d.end2.c_str(), d.coordType, d.frequency, d.dampingRatio, (int)d.limit, d.lowerLimit, d.upperLimit, (int)d.motor, (int)d.collideConnected);
        b2Body* b1 = o1 ? BodyOf(o1) : nullptr;
        b2Body* b2b = o2 ? BodyOf(o2) : nullptr;
        b2Joint* joint = nullptr;
        b2Joint* gearJ1 = nullptr; b2Joint* gearJ2 = nullptr;

        switch (d.type) {
        case 1: {  // distance
            b2DistanceJointDef jd;
            jd.bodyA = b1;
            jd.bodyB = b2b;
            b2Vec2 pa = b1->GetPosition(), pb = b2b->GetPosition();
            if (d.coordType == 0) {
                jd.localAnchorA.Set(0, 0);
                jd.localAnchorB.Set(0, 0);
                jd.length = b2Distance(pa, pb);
                d.x1 = pa.x; d.y1 = pa.y; d.x2 = pb.x; d.y2 = pb.y;     // written back to the Lua table
            } else if (d.coordType == 1) {
                jd.localAnchorA.Set(d.x1 - pa.x, d.y1 - pa.y);
                jd.localAnchorB.Set(d.x2 - pb.x, d.y2 - pb.y);
                jd.length = b2Distance(b2Vec2(d.x1, d.y1), b2Vec2(d.x2, d.y2));
            } else if (d.coordType == 2) {
                jd.localAnchorA.Set(d.x1, d.y1);
                jd.localAnchorB.Set(d.x2, d.y2);
                jd.length = b2Distance(b1->GetWorldPoint(jd.localAnchorA), b2b->GetWorldPoint(jd.localAnchorB));
            } else {
                jd.localAnchorA.Set(0, 0);
                jd.localAnchorB.Set(0, 0);
                jd.length = 1.0f;
            }
            jd.frequencyHz = d.frequency;
            jd.dampingRatio = d.dampingRatio;
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            break;
        }
        case 2: {  // weld: the anchor is the midpoint of the two transformed local anchors
            b2WeldJointDef jd;
            b2Vec2 a = b1->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(d.x1, d.y1));
            b2Vec2 b = b2b->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(d.x2, d.y2));
            b2Vec2 mid(a.x + (b.x - a.x) * 0.5f, a.y + (b.y - a.y) * 0.5f);
            jd.Initialize(b1, b2b, mid);
            jd.referenceAngle = RelativeAngle(b1, b2b);
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            break;
        }
        case 3: {  // revolute
            b2RevoluteJointDef jd;
            b2Vec2 anchor = b1->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(d.x1, d.y1));
            jd.Initialize(b1, b2b, anchor);
            jd.referenceAngle = RelativeAngle(b1, b2b);
            jd.enableMotor = d.motor;
            jd.motorSpeed = d.motorSpeed;
            jd.maxMotorTorque = d.maxTorque;
            jd.enableLimit = d.limit;
            jd.lowerAngle = d.lowerLimit;
            jd.upperAngle = d.upperLimit;
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            break;
        }
        case 4: {  // prismatic
            b2PrismaticJointDef jd;
            b2Vec2 anchor = b1->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(d.x1, d.y1));
            jd.Initialize(b1, b2b, anchor, b2Vec2(d.worldAxisX, d.worldAxisY));
            jd.referenceAngle = RelativeAngle(b1, b2b);
            jd.enableLimit = d.limit;
            jd.lowerTranslation = d.lowerLimit;
            jd.upperTranslation = d.upperLimit;
            jd.enableMotor = d.motor;
            jd.motorSpeed = d.motorSpeed;
            jd.maxMotorForce = d.maxTorque;
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            break;
        }
        // ---- the joints no editor offers (6-11): the Box2D joint types the engine did not expose before
        case 6: {  // pulley: end1's anchor and end2's anchor (local points) hang from two fixed world points; length1 + ratio * length2 stays constant
            b2PulleyJointDef jd;
            b2Vec2 a = b1->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(d.x1, d.y1));
            b2Vec2 b = b2b->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(d.x2, d.y2));
            if (std::isnan(d.groundX1) || std::isnan(d.groundY1)) { d.groundX1 = a.x; d.groundY1 = a.y - 3.0f; }   // default: 3 units above the anchor (+y is down)
            if (std::isnan(d.groundX2) || std::isnan(d.groundY2)) { d.groundX2 = b.x; d.groundY2 = b.y - 3.0f; }
            if (!(d.ratio > 0.001f)) d.ratio = 1.0f;
            jd.Initialize(b1, b2b, b2Vec2(d.groundX1, d.groundY1), b2Vec2(d.groundX2, d.groundY2), a, b, d.ratio);
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            break;
        }
        case 7: {  // gear: couples two joints (revolute or prismatic) that already exist: coordinate1 + ratio * coordinate2 stays constant
            JointRecord* r1 = FindJoint(d.joint1);
            JointRecord* r2 = FindJoint(d.joint2);
            if (!r1 || !r2 || r1 == r2) return false;
            b2Joint* j1 = static_cast<b2Joint*>(r1->joint);
            b2Joint* j2 = static_cast<b2Joint*>(r2->joint);
            auto geared = [](b2Joint* j) { return j->GetType() == e_revoluteJoint || j->GetType() == e_prismaticJoint; };
            if (!geared(j1) || !geared(j2)) return false;
            b2GearJointDef jd;
            jd.bodyA = j1->GetBodyB();
            jd.bodyB = j2->GetBodyB();
            jd.joint1 = j1;
            jd.joint2 = j2;
            jd.ratio = d.ratio;
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            gearJ1 = j1; gearJ2 = j2;
            d.end1 = r1->end2; d.end2 = r2->end2;        // the bodies the gear acts on
            break;
        }
        case 8: {  // mouse: a soft spring from end1 (at its centre) to the target point
            if (!mouseGround_) { b2BodyDef gd; gd.type = b2_staticBody; mouseGround_ = world_.CreateBody(&gd); }
            b2MouseJointDef jd;
            jd.bodyA = mouseGround_;
            jd.bodyB = b1;
            b2Vec2 p = b1->GetPosition();
            if (std::isnan(d.targetX)) d.targetX = p.x;
            if (std::isnan(d.targetY)) d.targetY = p.y;
            if (d.maxForce < 0) d.maxForce = 1000.0f * b1->GetMass();
            jd.target = p;                  // the joint grabs the body at its centre; the real target is set right after
            jd.maxForce = d.maxForce;
            jd.frequencyHz = d.frequency;
            jd.dampingRatio = d.dampingRatio;
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            static_cast<b2MouseJoint*>(joint)->SetTarget(b2Vec2(d.targetX, d.targetY));
            d.x1 = p.x; d.y1 = p.y; d.x2 = d.targetX; d.y2 = d.targetY;
            b1->SetAwake(true);
            break;
        }
        case 9: {  // line (2.1): slide along an axis with an optional motor and limits. wheel (2.2): the same with a suspension spring and no limits
            float ax = d.worldAxisX, ay = d.worldAxisY;
            if (ax * ax + ay * ay < 1e-8f) { ax = 0; ay = 1; d.worldAxisX = 0; d.worldAxisY = 1; }
            b2Vec2 anchor = b1->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(d.x1, d.y1));
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
            b2WheelJointDef jd;
            jd.Initialize(b1, b2b, anchor, b2Vec2(ax, ay));
            jd.enableMotor = d.motor;
            jd.motorSpeed = d.motorSpeed;
            jd.maxMotorTorque = d.maxTorque;
            jd.frequencyHz = d.frequency;
            jd.dampingRatio = d.dampingRatio;
#else
            b2LineJointDef jd;
            jd.Initialize(b1, b2b, anchor, b2Vec2(ax, ay));
            jd.enableLimit = d.limit;
            jd.lowerTranslation = d.lowerLimit;
            jd.upperTranslation = d.upperLimit;
            jd.enableMotor = d.motor;
            jd.motorSpeed = d.motorSpeed;
            jd.maxMotorForce = d.maxTorque;
#endif
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            break;
        }
        case 10: {  // friction: top-down friction between the two bodies at the anchor (force and torque limits)
            b2FrictionJointDef jd;
            b2Vec2 anchor = b1->GetWorldPoint(b2Vec2(d.x1, d.y1));
            jd.Initialize(b1, b2b, anchor);
            jd.maxForce = d.maxForce;
            jd.maxTorque = d.maxTorque;
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            break;
        }
        case 11: {  // rope: the two local anchors may not be further apart than maxLength (they can come closer)
            b2RopeJointDef jd;
            jd.bodyA = b1;
            jd.bodyB = b2b;
            jd.localAnchorA.Set(d.x1, d.y1);
            jd.localAnchorB.Set(d.x2, d.y2);
            if (std::isnan(d.maxLength)) d.maxLength = b2Distance(b1->GetWorldPoint(jd.localAnchorA), b2b->GetWorldPoint(jd.localAnchorB));
            jd.maxLength = d.maxLength;
            jd.collideConnected = d.collideConnected;
            joint = world_.CreateJoint(&jd);
            break;
        }
        default:
            return false;
        }
        if (!joint) return false;
        if (gearJ1) gearDeps_[joint] = std::make_pair(gearJ1, gearJ2);

        std::unique_ptr<JointRecord> r(new JointRecord());
        r->name = d.name; r->end1 = d.end1; r->end2 = d.end2;
        r->joint = joint;
        r->coordType = d.type == 8 ? 1 : d.coordType;
        r->backAndForth = d.backAndForth && d.motor && d.limit && (d.type == 3 || d.type == 4 || (d.type == 9 && !AB_WHEEL));
        if (d.motor) { joint->GetBodyA()->SetAwake(true); joint->GetBodyB()->SetAwake(true); }   // a motor drives its bodies from the start
        r->view.reset(new B2JointView(joint, d.coordType));
        joints_.push_back(std::move(r));
        RebuildJointViews();
        return true;
    }

    void SetJointParameters(const JointParams& p) override {
        for (auto& rec : joints_) {      // 0x411a20 walks every joint record and applies the values to each one with this name
        if (rec->name != p.name) continue;
        b2Joint* joint = static_cast<b2Joint*>(rec->joint);
        if (joint->GetType() == e_revoluteJoint) {
            b2RevoluteJoint* j = static_cast<b2RevoluteJoint*>(joint);
            if (p.hasMotor) j->EnableMotor(p.motor);
            if (p.hasMotorSpeed) j->SetMotorSpeed(p.motorSpeed);
            if (p.hasMaxTorque) j->SetMaxMotorTorque(p.maxTorque);
            if (p.hasLimit) j->EnableLimit(p.limit);
            if (p.hasLowerLimit) j->SetLimits(p.lowerLimit, j->GetUpperLimit());
            if (p.hasUpperLimit) j->SetLimits(j->GetLowerLimit(), p.upperLimit);
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_prismaticJoint) {
            b2PrismaticJoint* j = static_cast<b2PrismaticJoint*>(joint);
            if (p.hasMotor) j->EnableMotor(p.motor);
            if (p.hasMotorSpeed) j->SetMotorSpeed(p.motorSpeed);
            if (p.hasMaxTorque) j->SetMaxMotorForce(p.maxTorque);
            if (p.hasLimit) j->EnableLimit(p.limit);
            if (p.hasLowerLimit) j->SetLimits(p.lowerLimit, j->GetUpperLimit());
            if (p.hasUpperLimit) j->SetLimits(j->GetLowerLimit(), p.upperLimit);
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_distanceJoint) {
            b2DistanceJoint* j = static_cast<b2DistanceJoint*>(joint);
            if (p.hasFrequency) j->SetFrequency(p.frequency);
            if (p.hasDampingRatio) j->SetDampingRatio(p.dampingRatio);
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_gearJoint) {
            if (p.hasRatio) static_cast<b2GearJoint*>(joint)->SetRatio(p.ratio);
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_mouseJoint) {
            b2MouseJoint* j = static_cast<b2MouseJoint*>(joint);
            if (p.hasTarget) {
                b2Vec2 t = j->GetTarget();
                if (!std::isnan(p.targetX)) t.x = p.targetX;
                if (!std::isnan(p.targetY)) t.y = p.targetY;
                j->SetTarget(t);
            }
            if (p.hasMaxForce) j->SetMaxForce(p.maxForce);
            if (p.hasFrequency) j->SetFrequency(p.frequency);
            if (p.hasDampingRatio) j->SetDampingRatio(p.dampingRatio);
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_frictionJoint) {
            b2FrictionJoint* j = static_cast<b2FrictionJoint*>(joint);
            if (p.hasMaxForce) j->SetMaxForce(p.maxForce);
            if (p.hasMaxTorque) j->SetMaxTorque(p.maxTorque);
#ifdef AB_BOX2D_V22
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_wheelJoint) {
            b2WheelJoint* j = static_cast<b2WheelJoint*>(joint);
            if (p.hasMotor) j->EnableMotor(p.motor);
            if (p.hasMotorSpeed) j->SetMotorSpeed(p.motorSpeed);
            if (p.hasMaxTorque) j->SetMaxMotorTorque(p.maxTorque);
            if (p.hasFrequency) j->SetSpringFrequencyHz(p.frequency);
            if (p.hasDampingRatio) j->SetSpringDampingRatio(p.dampingRatio);
#else
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_lineJoint) {
            b2LineJoint* j = static_cast<b2LineJoint*>(joint);
            if (p.hasMotor) j->EnableMotor(p.motor);
            if (p.hasMotorSpeed) j->SetMotorSpeed(p.motorSpeed);
            if (p.hasMaxTorque) j->SetMaxMotorForce(p.maxTorque);
            if (p.hasLimit) j->EnableLimit(p.limit);
            if (p.hasLowerLimit) j->SetLimits(p.lowerLimit, j->GetUpperLimit());
            if (p.hasUpperLimit) j->SetLimits(j->GetLowerLimit(), p.upperLimit);
#endif
        }
        }
    }

    // 0x410810 (handleJointLimits in Star Wars, the same body as checkJointLimits): a motor with limits that has reached the limit its speed points at turns round, or stops when `stop` is set.
    // The exe's prismatic test reads (motor and limit on and speed > 0 and upper reached) or (speed < 0 and lower reached): the lower side does not look at the two flags.
    void CheckJointLimits(const std::string& name, bool stop = false) override {
        for (auto& rec : joints_) {      // every joint with this name (0x410810 loops over all records)
        if (rec->name != name) continue;
        b2Joint* joint = static_cast<b2Joint*>(rec->joint);
        if (joint->GetType() == e_revoluteJoint) {
            b2RevoluteJoint* j = static_cast<b2RevoluteJoint*>(joint);
            if (!(j->IsMotorEnabled() && j->IsLimitEnabled())) continue;
            float speed = j->GetMotorSpeed();
            float angle = j->GetJointAngle();
            if ((speed > 0 && angle >= j->GetUpperLimit()) || (speed < 0 && angle <= j->GetLowerLimit()))
                j->SetMotorSpeed(stop ? 0.0f : -speed);
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_prismaticJoint) {
            b2PrismaticJoint* j = static_cast<b2PrismaticJoint*>(joint);
            float speed = j->GetMotorSpeed();
            float t = j->GetJointTranslation();
            if ((j->IsMotorEnabled() && j->IsLimitEnabled() && speed > 0 && t >= j->GetUpperLimit()) || (speed < 0 && t <= j->GetLowerLimit()))
                j->SetMotorSpeed(stop ? 0.0f : -speed);
#ifndef AB_BOX2D_V22
        } else if (joint->GetType() == e_lineJoint) {      // the line joint (2.1) turns round at its limits like the prismatic one
            b2LineJoint* j = static_cast<b2LineJoint*>(joint);
            if (!(j->IsMotorEnabled() && j->IsLimitEnabled())) continue;
            float speed = j->GetMotorSpeed();
            float t = j->GetJointTranslation();
            if ((speed > 0 && t >= j->GetUpperLimit()) || (speed < 0 && t <= j->GetLowerLimit()))
                j->SetMotorSpeed(stop ? 0.0f : -speed);
#endif
        }
        }
    }

    // ---- Box2D callbacks
    void BeginContact(b2Contact* c) override {
        PhysObject* a = static_cast<PhysObject*>(c->GetFixtureA()->GetUserData());
        PhysObject* b = static_cast<PhysObject*>(c->GetFixtureB()->GetUserData());
        if (!a || !b) return;
        ContactRef ref(c);
        // a block with holes is many fixtures, and it touches another body with more than one of them at once: that is one hit
        if (!a->isSensor && !b->isSensor && (a->holed || b->holed)) {
            const std::pair<PhysObject*, PhysObject*> key = a < b ? std::make_pair(a, b) : std::make_pair(b, a);
            if (!hitsThisStep_.insert(key).second) return;
        }
        if (onBeginContact) onBeginContact(*a, *b, ref);
    }
    void EndContact(b2Contact* c) override {
        PhysObject* a = static_cast<PhysObject*>(c->GetFixtureA()->GetUserData());
        PhysObject* b = static_cast<PhysObject*>(c->GetFixtureB()->GetUserData());
        if (a && b && onEndContact) onEndContact(*a, *b);
    }
    bool ShouldCollide(b2Fixture* fa, b2Fixture* fb) override {
        return ShouldCollideObjects(static_cast<PhysObject*>(fa->GetUserData()), static_cast<PhysObject*>(fb->GetUserData()));
    }
    void SayGoodbye(b2Joint* joint) override {
        gearDeps_.erase(joint);
        gearsToKill_.erase(std::remove(gearsToKill_.begin(), gearsToKill_.end(), joint), gearsToKill_.end());
        KillDependentGears(joint, false);
        DropJointRecord(joint);
    }
    void SayGoodbye(b2Fixture*) override {}

protected:
    void DestroyBody(PhysObject* o) override { world_.DestroyBody(BodyOf(o)); ProcessGearKills(); }
    void DestroyBox2DJoint(void* joint) override {
        b2Joint* j = static_cast<b2Joint*>(joint);
        gearDeps_.erase(j);
        KillDependentGears(j, true);
        world_.DestroyJoint(j);
    }

private:
    // the object and its Box2D body (b2BodyDef as the exe fills it)
    PhysObject* MakeObject(const BodyDef& d, float rollFactor, bool circle) {
        PhysObject* o = NewObject(d, rollFactor, circle);
        o->isCircle = circle; o->boxW = d.w; o->boxH = d.h;
        b2BodyDef bd;
        bd.type = d.density != 0.0f ? b2_dynamicBody : b2_staticBody;
        bd.position.Set(d.x, d.y);
        bd.angle = 0;
        bd.linearDamping = 0;
        bd.angularDamping = 1.0f;
        bd.allowSleep = true;
        bd.awake = d.density == 0.0f || !startAsleep;
        bd.active = true;
        bd.userData = o;
        o->pbody.reset(new B2Body(world_.CreateBody(&bd)));
        return o;
    }

    // fixtures for a concave (or very large) outline: convex pieces of at most b2_maxPolygonVertices points
    static void AddConcaveFixtures(b2Body* body, PhysObject* o, const std::vector<b2Vec2>& pts, const BodyDef& d) {
        std::vector<polydecomp::Pt> pp;
        for (const b2Vec2& v : pts) pp.push_back({v.x, v.y});
        std::vector<std::vector<polydecomp::Pt>> pieces;
        polydecomp::Decompose(pp, (size_t)b2_maxPolygonVertices, pieces);
        for (const auto& pc : pieces) {
            std::vector<b2Vec2> v;
            for (const polydecomp::Pt& q : pc) v.push_back(b2Vec2(q.x, q.y));
            if (v.size() < 3) continue;
            b2PolygonShape shape;
            shape.Set(v.data(), (int)v.size());
            MakeFixture(body, o, shape, d);
        }
    }
    static void MakeFixture(b2Body* body, PhysObject* o, const b2Shape& shape, const BodyDef& d) {
        b2FixtureDef fd;
        fd.shape = &shape;
        fd.friction = d.friction;
        fd.restitution = d.restitution;
        fd.density = d.density;
        fd.filter.categoryBits = 1;
        fd.filter.maskBits = 0xFFFF;
        fd.filter.groupIndex = 0;
        fd.isSensor = false;
        fd.userData = o;
        body->CreateFixture(&fd);
    }

    // A gear joint holds pointers to the two joints it couples, so it has to go before either of them does.
    // Explicit destruction takes the gears first; when a body (and with it a joint) is removed, the gears are queued and destroyed
    // before the next step.
    void KillDependentGears(b2Joint* j, bool now) {
        std::vector<b2Joint*> gears;
        for (auto& g : gearDeps_) if (g.second.first == j || g.second.second == j) gears.push_back(g.first);
        for (b2Joint* g : gears) {
            if (!now) { if (std::find(gearsToKill_.begin(), gearsToKill_.end(), g) == gearsToKill_.end()) gearsToKill_.push_back(g); continue; }
            gearDeps_.erase(g);
            DropJointRecord(g);
            KillDependentGears(g, true);
            world_.DestroyJoint(g);
        }
    }
    void ProcessGearKills() {
        std::vector<b2Joint*> list;
        list.swap(gearsToKill_);
        for (b2Joint* g : list) {
            if (!gearDeps_.count(g)) continue;       // already gone with its bodies
            gearDeps_.erase(g);
            DropJointRecord(g);
            world_.DestroyJoint(g);
        }
    }

    b2World world_;
    b2Body* mouseGround_ = nullptr;                                          // the fixed body mouse joints pull against (made on first use)
    std::map<b2Joint*, std::pair<b2Joint*, b2Joint*>> gearDeps_;            // gear joint -> the two joints it couples
    std::vector<b2Joint*> gearsToKill_;
    std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::vector<polydecomp::Pt>>> holeCache_;      // CutHoles results by outline and holes
    std::set<std::pair<PhysObject*, PhysObject*>> hitsThisStep_;      // the pairs a block with holes has already hit in this step
};

}  // namespace

}  // namespace AB_B2_NAMESPACE

std::unique_ptr<PhysicsWorld> AB_MAKE_WORLD() { return std::unique_ptr<PhysicsWorld>(new AB_B2_NAMESPACE::Impl()); }

}  // namespace ab
```

`src/physics/polygon_decompose.h`:

```h
// Concave polygons for Box2D, which only takes convex ones: ear clipping into triangles, then the triangles are merged back into as few convex pieces
// as the vertex limit allows (the Hertel-Mehlhorn method). Header only; used by the physics (bodies and shape casts).
#pragma once
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>

namespace ab {
namespace polydecomp {

struct Pt { float x, y; };

inline float Cross(const Pt& o, const Pt& a, const Pt& b) { return (a.x - o.x) * (b.y - o.y) - (a.y - o.y) * (b.x - o.x); }

inline float Area2(const std::vector<Pt>& p) {   // twice the signed area, positive when counter-clockwise (y up)
    float s = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); i++) { const Pt& a = p[i]; const Pt& b = p[(i + 1) % p.size()]; s += a.x * b.y - b.x * a.y; }
    return s;
}

// counter-clockwise polygon: every turn is left (or straight)
inline bool IsConvex(const std::vector<Pt>& p, float eps = 1e-6f) {
    size_t n = p.size();
    if (n < 3) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (Cross(p[i], p[(i + 1) % n], p[(i + 2) % n]) < -eps) return false;
    return true;
}

inline bool InTriangle(const Pt& p, const Pt& a, const Pt& b, const Pt& c) {
    return Cross(a, b, p) >= -1e-7f && Cross(b, c, p) >= -1e-7f && Cross(c, a, p) >= -1e-7f;
}

// Splits a simple polygon (any winding, convex or concave) into convex pieces of at most maxVerts vertices, each counter-clockwise.
// Returns false (and a fan of triangles from the first point) when the outline does not triangulate (it crosses itself).
inline bool Decompose(std::vector<Pt> pts, size_t maxVerts, std::vector<std::vector<Pt>>& out) {
    out.clear();
    if (maxVerts < 3) maxVerts = 3;
    // drop repeated points
    std::vector<Pt> p;
    for (const Pt& q : pts) if (p.empty() || std::fabs(q.x - p.back().x) > 1e-6f || std::fabs(q.y - p.back().y) > 1e-6f) p.push_back(q);
    while (p.size() > 1 && std::fabs(p.front().x - p.back().x) < 1e-6f && std::fabs(p.front().y - p.back().y) < 1e-6f) p.pop_back();
    if (p.size() < 3) return false;
    if (Area2(p) < 0) std::reverse(p.begin(), p.end());
    if (IsConvex(p) && p.size() <= maxVerts) { out.push_back(p); return true; }

    // ear clipping
    std::vector<int> idx;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); i++) idx.push_back((int)i);
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> tris;
    bool ok = true;
    int guard = 0;
    while (idx.size() > 3 && guard++ < 100000) {
        size_t n = idx.size();
        bool clipped = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n && !clipped; i++) {
            int ia = idx[(i + n - 1) % n], ib = idx[i], ic = idx[(i + 1) % n];
            const Pt &a = p[ia], &b = p[ib], &c = p[ic];
            float cr = Cross(a, b, c);
            if (cr <= 1e-7f) continue;                                    // reflex or straight: not an ear
            bool empty = true;
            for (size_t j = 0; j < n && empty; j++) {
                int k = idx[j];
                if (k == ia || k == ib || k == ic) continue;
                const Pt& q = p[k];
                if ((std::fabs(q.x - a.x) < 1e-6f && std::fabs(q.y - a.y) < 1e-6f) || (std::fabs(q.x - c.x) < 1e-6f && std::fabs(q.y - c.y) < 1e-6f) || (std::fabs(q.x - b.x) < 1e-6f && std::fabs(q.y - b.y) < 1e-6f)) continue;
                if (InTriangle(q, a, b, c)) empty = false;
            }
            if (!empty) continue;
            tris.push_back({ia, ib, ic});
            idx.erase(idx.begin() + i);
            clipped = true;
        }
        if (!clipped) {
            // no ear: a straight vertex can go (it only adds a point to a line), otherwise the outline is not simple
            bool removed = false;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < idx.size() && !removed; i++) {
                size_t n2 = idx.size();
                if (std::fabs(Cross(p[idx[(i + n2 - 1) % n2]], p[idx[i]], p[idx[(i + 1) % n2]])) <= 1e-7f) { idx.erase(idx.begin() + i); removed = true; }
            }
            if (!removed) { ok = false; break; }
        }
    }
    if (idx.size() == 3 && Cross(p[idx[0]], p[idx[1]], p[idx[2]]) > 1e-7f) tris.push_back({idx[0], idx[1], idx[2]});
    if (!ok || tris.empty()) {
        out.clear();
        for (size_t i = 1; i + 1 < p.size(); i++) {
            std::vector<Pt> t = {p[0], p[i], p[i + 1]};
            if (Area2(t) > 1e-7f) out.push_back(t);
        }
        return false;
    }

    // merge neighbours while the union stays convex and within the vertex limit
    bool merged = true;
    while (merged) {
        merged = false;
        for (size_t a = 0; a < tris.size() && !merged; a++) {
            for (size_t b = a + 1; b < tris.size() && !merged; b++) {
                std::vector<int>& A = tris[a];
                std::vector<int>& B = tris[b];
                if (A.size() + B.size() - 2 > maxVerts) continue;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < A.size() && !merged; i++) {
                    int a0 = A[i], a1 = A[(i + 1) % A.size()];
                    for (size_t j = 0; j < B.size() && !merged; j++) {
                        if (B[j] != a1 || B[(j + 1) % B.size()] != a0) continue;       // the shared edge runs the other way round in B
                        std::vector<int> m;
                        for (size_t k = 1; k <= A.size(); k++) m.push_back(A[(i + k) % A.size()]);   // a1 ... a0
                        for (size_t k = 2; k < B.size(); k++) m.push_back(B[(j + k) % B.size()]);    // the rest of B
                        std::vector<Pt> mp;
                        for (int v : m) mp.push_back(p[v]);
                        if (!IsConvex(mp)) continue;
                        tris[a] = m;
                        tris.erase(tris.begin() + b);
                        merged = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (const auto& t : tris) {
        std::vector<Pt> piece;
        for (int v : t) piece.push_back(p[v]);
        out.push_back(piece);
    }
    return true;
}

// ---- holes: subtract shapes from a shape, keeping convex pieces
// Keeps the part of a convex polygon on one side of the line a-b (side > 0: the left, side < 0: the right).
inline std::vector<Pt> ClipSide(const std::vector<Pt>& poly, const Pt& a, const Pt& b, int side) {
    std::vector<Pt> out;
    const size_t n = poly.size();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const Pt& p = poly[i]; const Pt& q = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        float dp = side * Cross(a, b, p), dq = side * Cross(a, b, q);
        if (dp >= 0) out.push_back(p);
        if ((dp > 0 && dq < 0) || (dp < 0 && dq > 0)) {
            float t = dp / (dp - dq);
            out.push_back({p.x + (q.x - p.x) * t, p.y + (q.y - p.y) * t});
        }
    }
    return out;
}

// Drops repeated and straight-through points; a piece that is left with no real area comes back empty.
inline std::vector<Pt> CleanPiece(const std::vector<Pt>& in, float minEdge = 1e-3f, float minArea2 = 2e-4f) {
    std::vector<Pt> p;
    for (const Pt& q : in) if (p.empty() || std::hypot(q.x - p.back().x, q.y - p.back().y) > minEdge) p.push_back(q);
    while (p.size() > 1 && std::hypot(p.front().x - p.back().x, p.front().y - p.back().y) <= minEdge) p.pop_back();
    bool again = true;
    while (again && p.size() >= 3) {
        again = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); i++) {
            const Pt& a = p[(i + p.size() - 1) % p.size()]; const Pt& b = p[i]; const Pt& c = p[(i + 1) % p.size()];
            float len = std::hypot(c.x - a.x, c.y - a.y);
            if (len > 0 && std::fabs(Cross(a, b, c)) / len < minEdge * 0.5f) { p.erase(p.begin() + i); again = true; break; }
        }
    }
    if (p.size() < 3 || std::fabs(Area2(p)) < minArea2) p.clear();
    return p;
}

// A minus B for two convex counter-clockwise polygons: the part of A outside every edge of B, as convex pieces.
inline void SubtractConvex(const std::vector<Pt>& A, const std::vector<Pt>& B, std::vector<std::vector<Pt>>& out) {
    std::vector<Pt> rest = A;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < B.size() && rest.size() >= 3; i++) {
        const Pt& a = B[i]; const Pt& b = B[(i + 1) % B.size()];
        std::vector<Pt> outside = ClipSide(rest, a, b, -1);
        if (outside.size() >= 3) out.push_back(outside);
        rest = ClipSide(rest, a, b, +1);
    }
    // what is left of `rest` lies inside B and is gone
}

// Convex hull (counter-clockwise) of a point set
inline std::vector<Pt> Hull(std::vector<Pt> p) {
    std::sort(p.begin(), p.end(), [](const Pt& a, const Pt& b) { return a.x < b.x || (a.x == b.x && a.y < b.y); });
    const size_t n = p.size();
    if (n < 3) return p;
    std::vector<Pt> h(2 * n);
    size_t k = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { while (k >= 2 && Cross(h[k - 2], h[k - 1], p[i]) <= 1e-9f) k--; h[k++] = p[i]; }
    for (size_t i = n - 1, t = k + 1; i > 0; i--) { while (k >= t && Cross(h[k - 2], h[k - 1], p[i - 1]) <= 1e-9f) k--; h[k++] = p[i - 1]; }
    h.resize(k - 1);
    return h;
}

// Joins neighbouring convex pieces whose union is still convex (and has at most maxVerts points): cutting holes leaves many slivers, this puts them back together.
// Only pieces whose boxes touch are tried, and the scan goes on after a join instead of starting again.
inline void MergePieces(std::vector<std::vector<Pt>>& pieces, size_t maxVerts) {
    struct Box { float x0, y0, x1, y1; };
    auto boxOf = [](const std::vector<Pt>& p) { Box b{1e30f, 1e30f, -1e30f, -1e30f}; for (const Pt& q : p) { b.x0 = std::min(b.x0, q.x); b.y0 = std::min(b.y0, q.y); b.x1 = std::max(b.x1, q.x); b.y1 = std::max(b.y1, q.y); } return b; };
    bool any = true;
    int guard = 0;
    while (any && guard++ < 50) {
        any = false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < pieces.size(); i++) {
            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < pieces.size();) {
                Box a = boxOf(pieces[i]), b = boxOf(pieces[j]);
                const float e = 1e-3f;
                if (a.x1 + e < b.x0 || b.x1 + e < a.x0 || a.y1 + e < b.y0 || b.y1 + e < a.y0) { j++; continue; }
                std::vector<Pt> all = pieces[i];
                all.insert(all.end(), pieces[j].begin(), pieces[j].end());
                std::vector<Pt> hull = CleanPiece(Hull(all), 1e-3f, 0.0f);
                const float ai = Area2(pieces[i]);
                if (hull.size() < 3 || hull.size() > maxVerts || Area2(hull) > ai + Area2(pieces[j]) + 1e-3f * (1.0f + ai)) { j++; continue; }
                pieces[i] = hull;
                pieces.erase(pieces.begin() + j);
                any = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

// The convex pieces (at most maxVerts points each, counter-clockwise) of `outline` with every polygon in `holes` cut out.
// The outline and the holes may be concave, a hole may lie anywhere (fully inside, across an edge or a corner, or outside, which does nothing),
// and holes may overlap each other.
inline void CutHoles(const std::vector<Pt>& outline, const std::vector<std::vector<Pt>>& holes, size_t maxVerts, std::vector<std::vector<Pt>>& out) {
    out.clear();
    std::vector<std::vector<Pt>> pieces;
    Decompose(outline, maxVerts, pieces);
    for (const auto& hole : holes) {
        std::vector<std::vector<Pt>> hp;
        if (!Decompose(hole, maxVerts, hp)) continue;
        for (const auto& h : hp) {
            std::vector<std::vector<Pt>> next;
            for (const auto& pc : pieces) SubtractConvex(pc, h, next);
            pieces.swap(next);
        }
    }
    for (const auto& pc : pieces) {
        std::vector<Pt> c = CleanPiece(pc);
        if (c.size() < 3) continue;
        std::vector<std::vector<Pt>> parts;
        Decompose(c, maxVerts, parts);
        for (auto& q : parts) { std::vector<Pt> r = CleanPiece(q); if (r.size() >= 3) out.push_back(r); }
    }
    MergePieces(out, maxVerts);
}

}  // namespace polydecomp
}  // namespace ab
```

```cpp
#include "video/video_audio.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <mfapi.h>
#include <mfidl.h>
#include <mfreadwrite.h>
#include <mferror.h>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#pragma comment(lib, "mfplat.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "mfreadwrite.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "mfuuid.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")

namespace ab {
template <class T> static void Release(T*& p) { if (p) { p->Release(); p = nullptr; } }

bool DecodeVideoAudio(const std::string& path, std::vector<int16_t>& pcm, int& rate, int& channels, std::string* error) {
    HRESULT hr = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    bool coInit = SUCCEEDED(hr);
    if (FAILED(MFStartup(MF_VERSION))) { if (coInit) CoUninitialize(); if (error) *error = "Media Foundation did not start"; return false; }
    bool ok = false;
    IMFSourceReader* reader = nullptr;
    IMFMediaType* type = nullptr;
    IMFMediaType* actual = nullptr;
    int wlen = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, path.c_str(), -1, nullptr, 0);
    std::vector<wchar_t> wide((size_t)(wlen > 0 ? wlen : 1), 0);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, path.c_str(), -1, wide.data(), wlen);
    hr = MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL(wide.data(), nullptr, &reader);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
        const DWORD audio = (DWORD)MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_AUDIO_STREAM;
        reader->SetStreamSelection((DWORD)MF_SOURCE_READER_ALL_STREAMS, FALSE);
        reader->SetStreamSelection(audio, TRUE);
        hr = MFCreateMediaType(&type);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
            type->SetGUID(MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, MFMediaType_Audio);
            type->SetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, MFAudioFormat_PCM);
            type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_BITS_PER_SAMPLE, 16);
            type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_NUM_CHANNELS, 2);
            type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_SAMPLES_PER_SECOND, 44100);
            type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_BLOCK_ALIGNMENT, 4);                // v3.0: all of the PCM format spelled out, so the reader cannot pick another one
            type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_AVG_BYTES_PER_SECOND, 44100 * 4);
            type->SetUINT32(MF_MT_ALL_SAMPLES_INDEPENDENT, TRUE);
            hr = reader->SetCurrentMediaType(audio, nullptr, type);
        }
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && SUCCEEDED(reader->GetCurrentMediaType(audio, &actual))) {
            UINT32 r = 44100, c = 2;
            actual->GetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_SAMPLES_PER_SECOND, &r);
            actual->GetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_NUM_CHANNELS, &c);
            UINT32 bits = 16; GUID sub = {};
            actual->GetUINT32(MF_MT_AUDIO_BITS_PER_SAMPLE, &bits);
            actual->GetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, &sub);
            const bool isFloat = sub == MFAudioFormat_Float;
            rate = (int)r; channels = (int)c;
            LONGLONG stampSum = 0;                                          // the length the reader itself gives the sound (100 ns units)
            for (;;) {
                DWORD flags = 0;
                IMFSample* sample = nullptr;
                hr = reader->ReadSample(audio, 0, nullptr, &flags, nullptr, &sample);
                if (FAILED(hr) || (flags & MF_SOURCE_READERF_ENDOFSTREAM)) { Release(sample); break; }
                if (sample) {
                    LONGLONG dur = 0; if (SUCCEEDED(sample->GetSampleDuration(&dur))) stampSum += dur;
                    IMFMediaBuffer* buffer = nullptr;
                    if (SUCCEEDED(sample->ConvertToContiguousBuffer(&buffer))) {
                        BYTE* data = nullptr; DWORD len = 0;
                        if (SUCCEEDED(buffer->Lock(&data, nullptr, &len))) {
                            size_t at = pcm.size();
                            if (isFloat) {                                  // 32 bit float samples: made 16 bit
                                size_t n = len / 4; pcm.resize(at + n);
                                const float* f = (const float*)data;
                                for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { float v = f[i] * 32767.0f; pcm[at + i] = (int16_t)(v > 32767 ? 32767 : v < -32768 ? -32768 : v); }
                            } else if (bits == 8) {
                                pcm.resize(at + len);
                                for (DWORD i = 0; i < len; i++) pcm[at + i] = (int16_t)((data[i] - 128) * 256);
                            } else {
                                pcm.resize(at + len / 2);
                                std::memcpy(pcm.data() + at, data, (len / 2) * 2);
                            }
                            buffer->Unlock();
                        }
                    }
                    Release(buffer);
                    Release(sample);
                }
            }
            ok = !pcm.empty();
            // the reader's own timing against the sample count: when they disagree the sample rate it reported is wrong, and the timing is believed
            double seconds = (double)stampSum / 1e7, frames = (double)pcm.size() / (channels > 0 ? channels : 2);
            std::printf("video sound: %u Hz, %u channels, %u bits%s, %.0f frames, the reader says %.2f s (%.0f Hz)\n", r, c, bits, isFloat ? " float" : "", frames, seconds, seconds > 0 ? frames / seconds : 0.0);
            std::fflush(stdout);
            if (ok && seconds > 1.0) { double eff = frames / seconds; if (std::fabs(eff - rate) > rate * 0.02) rate = (int)(eff + 0.5); }
            if (!ok && error) *error = "the file has no sound";
        } else if (error) *error = "the sound could not be decoded (no AAC decoder?)";
    } else if (error) *error = "Media Foundation could not open the file";
    Release(actual); Release(type); Release(reader);
    MFShutdown();
    if (coInit) CoUninitialize();
    return ok;
}
}  // namespace ab
#else
namespace ab {
bool DecodeVideoAudio(const std::string&, std::vector<int16_t>&, int&, int&, std::string* error) {
    if (error) *error = "this system has no AAC decoder in the engine: the video plays without sound";
    return false;
}
}  // namespace ab
#endif
```

`src/video/video_player.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "video/video_player.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

extern "C" {
#include "h264bsd_decoder.h"
}

namespace ab {

namespace {

uint32_t U32(const uint8_t* p) { return (uint32_t)p[0] << 24 | (uint32_t)p[1] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 8 | p[3]; }
uint16_t U16(const uint8_t* p) { return (uint16_t)(p[0] << 8 | p[1]); }
uint64_t U64(const uint8_t* p) { return (uint64_t)U32(p) << 32 | U32(p + 4); }

struct Box { size_t start, dataStart, end; char type[5]; };

// the box that starts at `at` inside [at, limit)
bool ReadBox(const std::vector<uint8_t>& f, size_t at, size_t limit, Box& b) {
    if (at + 8 > limit) return false;
    uint64_t size = U32(&f[at]);
    b.start = at;
    std::memcpy(b.type, &f[at + 4], 4);
    b.type[4] = 0;
    b.dataStart = at + 8;
    if (size == 1) {
        if (at + 16 > limit) return false;
        size = U64(&f[at + 8]);
        b.dataStart = at + 16;
    } else if (size == 0) {
        size = limit - at;
    }
    if (size < (uint64_t)(b.dataStart - at) || at + size > limit) return false;
    b.end = (size_t)(at + size);
    return true;
}

bool Find(const std::vector<uint8_t>& f, size_t from, size_t to, const char* type, Box& out) {
    size_t at = from;
    Box b;
    while (ReadBox(f, at, to, b)) {
        if (!std::strcmp(b.type, type)) { out = b; return true; }
        at = b.end;
    }
    return false;
}

}  // namespace

VideoPlayer::~VideoPlayer() {
    CloseSystem();
    if (decoder_) { h264bsdShutdown((storage_t*)decoder_); h264bsdFree((storage_t*)decoder_); }
}

bool VideoPlayer::Open(const std::string& path, std::string* error) {
    {   // the system decoder first (Windows); when it cannot open the file, h264bsd below tries the baseline profile
        std::string sysError;
        if (OpenSystem(path, &sysError)) return true;
        if (!sysError.empty()) std::printf("playVideo: system decoder: %s; using the built-in baseline decoder\n", sysError.c_str());
    }
    std::FILE* fp = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!fp) { if (error) *error = "cannot open " + path; return false; }
    std::fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = std::ftell(fp);
    std::fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_SET);
    file_.resize(n > 0 ? (size_t)n : 0);
    if (n > 0 && std::fread(file_.data(), 1, (size_t)n, fp) != (size_t)n) { std::fclose(fp); if (error) *error = "cannot read " + path; return false; }
    std::fclose(fp);
    if (!Parse(error)) return false;
    decoder_ = h264bsdAlloc();
    if (!decoder_ || h264bsdInit((storage_t*)decoder_, 1) != 0) { if (error) *error = "the H.264 decoder did not start"; return false; }
    return true;
}

bool VideoPlayer::Parse(std::string* error) {
    Box moov;
    if (!Find(file_, 0, file_.size(), "moov", moov)) { if (error) *error = "not an MP4 file (no moov box)"; return false; }
    size_t at = moov.dataStart;
    Box trak;
    while (at < moov.end && ReadBox(file_, at, moov.end, trak)) {
        at = trak.end;
        if (std::strcmp(trak.type, "trak")) continue;
        Box mdia, hdlr, mdhd, minf, stbl, stsd;
        if (!Find(file_, trak.dataStart, trak.end, "mdia", mdia)) continue;
        if (!Find(file_, mdia.dataStart, mdia.end, "hdlr", hdlr) || hdlr.end - hdlr.dataStart < 12) continue;
        if (std::memcmp(&file_[hdlr.dataStart + 8], "vide", 4) != 0) continue;
        if (!Find(file_, mdia.dataStart, mdia.end, "mdhd", mdhd)) continue;
        const uint8_t* m = &file_[mdhd.dataStart];
        uint32_t timescale = m[0] == 1 ? U32(m + 20) : U32(m + 12);
        if (!timescale) timescale = 1000;
        if (!Find(file_, mdia.dataStart, mdia.end, "minf", minf) || !Find(file_, minf.dataStart, minf.end, "stbl", stbl)) continue;

        // the sample description: the avc1 entry holds the avcC box with the parameter sets
        if (!Find(file_, stbl.dataStart, stbl.end, "stsd", stsd)) continue;
        Box entry;
        if (!ReadBox(file_, stsd.dataStart + 8, stsd.end, entry)) continue;
        if (std::strcmp(entry.type, "avc1") != 0 && std::strcmp(entry.type, "avc3") != 0) { if (error) *error = "the video is not H.264"; return false; }
        width_ = U16(&file_[entry.dataStart + 24]);
        height_ = U16(&file_[entry.dataStart + 26]);
        Box avcC;
        if (!Find(file_, entry.dataStart + 78, entry.end, "avcC", avcC) || avcC.end - avcC.dataStart < 7) { if (error) *error = "no avcC box"; return false; }
        const uint8_t* a = &file_[avcC.dataStart];
        nalLength_ = (a[4] & 3) + 1;
        size_t p = avcC.dataStart + 6;
        int count = a[5] & 0x1f;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < count && p + 2 <= avcC.end; i++) {
                size_t len = U16(&file_[p]);
                p += 2;
                if (p + len > avcC.end) break;
                parameterSets_.emplace_back(file_.begin() + p, file_.begin() + p + len);
                p += len;
            }
            if (pass == 0 && p < avcC.end) count = file_[p++];
        }

        // the sample tables
        Box stts, stsz, stsc, stco, stss;
        bool wide = false;
        if (!Find(file_, stbl.dataStart, stbl.end, "stts", stts) || !Find(file_, stbl.dataStart, stbl.end, "stsz", stsz) ||
            !Find(file_, stbl.dataStart, stbl.end, "stsc", stsc)) { if (error) *error = "incomplete sample tables"; return false; }
        if (!Find(file_, stbl.dataStart, stbl.end, "stco", stco)) { if (!Find(file_, stbl.dataStart, stbl.end, "co64", stco)) { if (error) *error = "no chunk offsets"; return false; } wide = true; }
        bool haveSync = Find(file_, stbl.dataStart, stbl.end, "stss", stss);

        const uint8_t* sz = &file_[stsz.dataStart];
        uint32_t fixedSize = U32(sz + 4), sampleCount = U32(sz + 8);
        std::vector<uint32_t> sizes(sampleCount);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < sampleCount; i++) {
            if (fixedSize) sizes[i] = fixedSize;
            else if (stsz.dataStart + 12 + (size_t)i * 4 + 4 <= stsz.end) sizes[i] = U32(sz + 12 + (size_t)i * 4);
        }
        std::vector<uint64_t> chunks;
        {
            const uint8_t* c = &file_[stco.dataStart];
            uint32_t n = U32(c + 4);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                size_t at2 = stco.dataStart + 8 + (size_t)i * (wide ? 8 : 4);
                if (at2 + (wide ? 8 : 4) > stco.end) break;
                chunks.push_back(wide ? U64(&file_[at2]) : U32(&file_[at2]));
            }
        }
        struct Run { uint32_t first, perChunk; };
        std::vector<Run> runs;
        {
            const uint8_t* c = &file_[stsc.dataStart];
            uint32_t n = U32(c + 4);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && stsc.dataStart + 8 + (size_t)i * 12 + 12 <= stsc.end; i++)
                runs.push_back({U32(c + 8 + i * 12), U32(c + 8 + i * 12 + 4)});
        }
        std::vector<double> times(sampleCount, 0.0);
        {
            const uint8_t* c = &file_[stts.dataStart];
            uint32_t n = U32(c + 4);
            uint64_t t = 0; uint32_t s = 0;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && stts.dataStart + 8 + (size_t)i * 8 + 8 <= stts.end; i++) {
                uint32_t cnt = U32(c + 8 + i * 8), delta = U32(c + 8 + i * 8 + 4);
                for (uint32_t k = 0; k < cnt && s < sampleCount; k++, s++) { times[s] = (double)t / timescale; t += delta; }
            }
            duration_ = (double)t / timescale;
        }
        std::vector<bool> sync(sampleCount, !haveSync);
        if (haveSync) {
            const uint8_t* c = &file_[stss.dataStart];
            uint32_t n = U32(c + 4);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && stss.dataStart + 8 + (size_t)i * 4 + 4 <= stss.end; i++) {
                uint32_t idx = U32(c + 8 + i * 4);
                if (idx >= 1 && idx <= sampleCount) sync[idx - 1] = true;
            }
        }
        uint32_t s = 0;
        for (size_t ch = 0; ch < chunks.size() && s < sampleCount; ch++) {
            uint32_t per = 0;
            for (const Run& r : runs) if (r.first <= ch + 1) per = r.perChunk;
            uint64_t off = chunks[ch];
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < per && s < sampleCount; k++, s++) {
                samples_.push_back({off, sizes[s], times[s], (bool)sync[s]});
                off += sizes[s];
            }
        }
        if (samples_.empty() || width_ <= 0 || height_ <= 0) { if (error) *error = "the video track is empty"; return false; }
        return true;
    }
    if (error) *error = "no video track";
    return false;
}

bool VideoPlayer::DecodeSample(size_t index) {
    const Sample& smp = samples_[index];
    if (smp.offset + smp.size > file_.size()) return false;
    std::vector<uint8_t> stream;
    static const uint8_t start[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1};
    if (!sentParameters_) {
        for (const auto& ps : parameterSets_) { stream.insert(stream.end(), start, start + 4); stream.insert(stream.end(), ps.begin(), ps.end()); }
        sentParameters_ = true;
    }
    size_t p = (size_t)smp.offset, end = p + smp.size;
    while (p + nalLength_ <= end) {
        size_t len = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nalLength_; i++) len = len << 8 | file_[p + i];
        p += nalLength_;
        if (p + len > end) break;
        stream.insert(stream.end(), start, start + 4);
        stream.insert(stream.end(), file_.begin() + p, file_.begin() + p + len);
        p += len;
    }
    uint8_t* data = stream.data();
    u32 left = (u32)stream.size();
    bool gotPicture = false;
    while (left > 0) {
        u32 read = 0;
        u32 r = h264bsdDecode((storage_t*)decoder_, data, left, 0, &read);
        if (r == H264BSD_PIC_RDY) {
            u32 picId, idr, errs;
            u32* pic = h264bsdNextOutputPictureRGBA((storage_t*)decoder_, &picId, &idr, &errs);
            if (pic) {
                // the picture is whole macroblocks wide and high; the cropping of the stream (1080p is 1088 coded) cuts it to size
                u32 crop = 0, cl = 0, cw = 0, ct = 0, chh = 0;
                h264bsdCroppingParams((storage_t*)decoder_, &crop, &cl, &cw, &ct, &chh);
                if (!crop) { cl = 0; ct = 0; cw = (u32)codedW_; chh = (u32)codedH_; }
                width_ = (int)cw; height_ = (int)chh;
                rgba_.resize((size_t)cw * chh * 4);
                const uint8_t* src = (const uint8_t*)pic;
                for (u32 y = 0; y < chh; y++) std::memcpy(&rgba_[(size_t)y * cw * 4], src + ((size_t)(y + ct) * codedW_ + cl) * 4, (size_t)cw * 4);
                gotPicture = true;
            }
        } else if (r == H264BSD_HDRS_RDY) {
            u32 w = h264bsdPicWidth((storage_t*)decoder_), h = h264bsdPicHeight((storage_t*)decoder_);
            if (w && h) { codedW_ = (int)w * 16; codedH_ = (int)h * 16; }
        } else if (r == H264BSD_ERROR || r == H264BSD_PARAM_SET_ERROR || r == H264BSD_MEMALLOC_ERROR) {
            if (read == 0) break;
        }
        if (read == 0) break;
        data += read;
        left -= read;
    }
    if (gotPicture) decoded_++;
    return gotPicture;
}

bool VideoPlayer::Advance(double dt) {
    if (finished_) return false;
    if (mf_) return AdvanceSystem(dt);
    clock_ += dt;
    bool changed = false;
    // decode every frame that is due, in order (P frames need the ones before them)
    while (next_ < samples_.size() && samples_[next_].time <= clock_) {
        if (DecodeSample(next_)) changed = true;
        next_++;
    }
    if (next_ >= samples_.size() && clock_ >= duration_) finished_ = true;
    return changed;
}

}  // namespace ab

// ---- the system decoder ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#ifdef _WIN32
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <mfapi.h>

#include <mfreadwrite.h>

#pragma comment(lib, "mfplat.lib")

namespace ab {
namespace {
struct MfState { IMFSourceReader* reader = nullptr; bool coInit = false; bool started = false; LONG stride = 0; };
template <class T> void Rel(T*& p) { if (p) { p->Release(); p = nullptr; } }
}

void VideoPlayer::CloseSystem() {
    MfState* m = (MfState*)mf_;
    if (!m) return;
    Rel(m->reader);
    if (m->started) MFShutdown();
    if (m->coInit) CoUninitialize();
    delete m;
    mf_ = nullptr;
}

bool VideoPlayer::OpenSystem(const std::string& path, std::string* error) {
    MfState* m = new MfState;
    HRESULT hr = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    m->coInit = SUCCEEDED(hr);
    if (FAILED(MFStartup(MF_VERSION))) { if (error) *error = "Media Foundation did not start"; if (m->coInit) CoUninitialize(); delete m; return false; }
    m->started = true;
    int wlen = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, path.c_str(), -1, nullptr, 0);
    std::vector<wchar_t> wide((size_t)(wlen > 0 ? wlen : 1), 0);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, path.c_str(), -1, wide.data(), wlen);
    IMFAttributes* attrs = nullptr;
    if (SUCCEEDED(MFCreateAttributes(&attrs, 1))) attrs->SetUINT32(MF_SOURCE_READER_ENABLE_VIDEO_PROCESSING, TRUE);   // lets the reader convert to RGB
    hr = MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL(wide.data(), attrs, &m->reader);
    Rel(attrs);
    if (FAILED(hr)) { if (error) *error = "Media Foundation could not open the file"; mf_ = m; CloseSystem(); return false; }
    const DWORD video = (DWORD)MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM;
    m->reader->SetStreamSelection((DWORD)MF_SOURCE_READER_ALL_STREAMS, FALSE);
    m->reader->SetStreamSelection(video, TRUE);
    IMFMediaType* type = nullptr;
    hr = MFCreateMediaType(&type);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) {
        type->SetGUID(MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, MFMediaType_Video);
        type->SetGUID(MF_MT_SUBTYPE, MFVideoFormat_RGB32);
        hr = m->reader->SetCurrentMediaType(video, nullptr, type);
    }
    Rel(type);
    IMFMediaType* actual = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(hr) || FAILED(m->reader->GetCurrentMediaType(video, &actual))) {
        if (error) *error = "the video cannot be decoded to pictures";
        Rel(actual); mf_ = m; CloseSystem(); return false;
    }
    UINT32 w = 0, h = 0;
    MFGetAttributeSize(actual, MF_MT_FRAME_SIZE, &w, &h);
    m->stride = (LONG)(INT32)MFGetAttributeUINT32(actual, MF_MT_DEFAULT_STRIDE, 0);
    Rel(actual);
    if (!w || !h) { if (error) *error = "the video has no size"; mf_ = m; CloseSystem(); return false; }
    width_ = (int)w; height_ = (int)h;
    PROPVARIANT var;
    PropVariantInit(&var);
    duration_ = 0;
    if (SUCCEEDED(m->reader->GetPresentationAttribute((DWORD)MF_SOURCE_READER_MEDIASOURCE, MF_PD_DURATION, &var)) && var.vt == VT_UI8)
        duration_ = (double)var.uhVal.QuadPart / 1.0e7;
    PropVariantClear(&var);
    mf_ = m;
    rgba_.assign((size_t)w * h * 4, 0);
    for (size_t i = 3; i < rgba_.size(); i += 4) rgba_[i] = 255;
    return true;
}

// the size and row step of the pictures the reader delivers now (they can differ from the size at the start: the decoder may work on whole
// macroblocks and the reader may change its output type after the first sample)
static void ReadOutputType(IMFSourceReader* reader, int& w, int& h, LONG& stride) {
    IMFMediaType* t = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(reader->GetCurrentMediaType((DWORD)MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM, &t)) || !t) return;
    UINT32 cw = 0, ch = 0;
    if (SUCCEEDED(MFGetAttributeSize(t, MF_MT_FRAME_SIZE, &cw, &ch)) && cw && ch) { w = (int)cw; h = (int)ch; }
    stride = (LONG)(INT32)MFGetAttributeUINT32(t, MF_MT_DEFAULT_STRIDE, 0);
    if (stride == 0) { LONG s = 0; if (SUCCEEDED(MFGetStrideForBitmapInfoHeader(MFVideoFormat_RGB32.Data1, (DWORD)w, &s))) stride = s; }
    Rel(t);
}

// reads the next picture into out (w x h RGBA, top row first); false at the end of the stream
static bool ReadPicture(IMFSourceReader* reader, int& w, int& h, LONG& stride, std::vector<uint8_t>& out, double& time) {
    for (;;) {
        DWORD flags = 0;
        LONGLONG stamp = 0;
        IMFSample* sample = nullptr;
        HRESULT hr = reader->ReadSample((DWORD)MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM, 0, nullptr, &flags, &stamp, &sample);
        if (FAILED(hr) || (flags & MF_SOURCE_READERF_ENDOFSTREAM)) { Rel(sample); return false; }
        if (flags & MF_SOURCE_READERF_CURRENTMEDIATYPECHANGED) ReadOutputType(reader, w, h, stride);
        if (!sample) continue;                      // a gap in the stream: ask again
        IMFMediaBuffer* buffer = nullptr;
        bool got = false;
        if (SUCCEEDED(sample->ConvertToContiguousBuffer(&buffer))) {
            const BYTE* row0 = nullptr;       // the first row of the picture, top
            LONG pitch = 0;                   // the step from one row to the next (negative: the rows are stored bottom first)
            IMF2DBuffer* b2 = nullptr;
            BYTE* locked = nullptr;
            bool plain = false;
            if (SUCCEEDED(buffer->QueryInterface(__uuidof(IMF2DBuffer), (void**)&b2)) && b2 && SUCCEEDED(b2->Lock2D(&locked, &pitch))) {
                row0 = locked;
            } else {
                Rel(b2);
                DWORD maxLen = 0, curLen = 0;
                if (SUCCEEDED(buffer->Lock(&locked, &maxLen, &curLen)) && locked) {
                    plain = true;
                    LONG st = stride ? stride : -(LONG)w * 4;
                    pitch = st;
                    row0 = pitch < 0 ? locked + (size_t)(h - 1) * (size_t)(-pitch) : locked;
                }
            }
            static bool said = false;
            if (!said) { said = true; std::printf("playVideo: picture %dx%d, row step %ld, %s buffer\n", w, h, (long)pitch, plain ? "plain" : "2D"); std::fflush(stdout); }
            if (row0) {
                out.resize((size_t)w * h * 4);
                for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
                    const BYTE* src = row0 + (ptrdiff_t)y * (ptrdiff_t)pitch;
                    uint8_t* dst = &out[(size_t)y * w * 4];
                    for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) { dst[x * 4] = src[x * 4 + 2]; dst[x * 4 + 1] = src[x * 4 + 1]; dst[x * 4 + 2] = src[x * 4]; dst[x * 4 + 3] = 255; }   // BGRA -> RGBA
                }
                got = true;
                if (b2) b2->Unlock2D(); else buffer->Unlock();
            }
            Rel(b2);
        }
        Rel(buffer);
        Rel(sample);
        if (got) { time = (double)stamp / 1.0e7; return true; }
    }
}

bool VideoPlayer::AdvanceSystem(double dt) {
    MfState* m = (MfState*)mf_;
    clock_ += dt;
    bool changed = false;
    for (;;) {
        if (!havePending_) {
            if (!ReadPicture(m->reader, width_, height_, m->stride, pending_, pendingTime_)) { finished_ = true; break; }
            havePending_ = true;
        }
        if (pendingTime_ > clock_) break;
        rgba_.swap(pending_);
        havePending_ = false;
        changed = true;
        decoded_++;
    }
    return changed;
}
}  // namespace ab
#else
namespace ab {
void VideoPlayer::CloseSystem() {}
bool VideoPlayer::OpenSystem(const std::string&, std::string*) { return false; }
bool VideoPlayer::AdvanceSystem(double) { return false; }
}  // namespace ab
#endif
```

`src/video/video_player.h`:

```h
// v2.2: the video of playVideo, played inside the engine. An MP4 / M4V file is read here (the boxes of the video track), its H.264
// (baseline, as the iOS Angry Birds Free / Lite videos are) is decoded by h264bsd (third_party/h264bsd, Apache-2.0 / MIT) and the
// frames come out as RGBA. The sound of the file is decoded separately (video_audio.h).
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>


namespace ab {

class VideoPlayer {
public:
    VideoPlayer() = default;
    ~VideoPlayer();
    VideoPlayer(const VideoPlayer&) = delete;
    VideoPlayer& operator=(const VideoPlayer&) = delete;

    bool Open(const std::string& path, std::string* error);
    int Width() const { return width_; }
    int Height() const { return height_; }
    double Duration() const { return duration_; }
    double Time() const { return clock_; }
    // Moves the clock on by dt seconds (frames are decoded up to there). True when the picture changed.
    bool Advance(double dt);
    bool Finished() const { return finished_; }
    const std::vector<uint8_t>& Rgba() const { return rgba_; }       // width * height * 4, top row first
    int FramesDecoded() const { return decoded_; }
    bool UsesSystemDecoder() const { return mf_ != nullptr; }

private:
    struct Sample { uint64_t offset; uint32_t size; double time; bool sync; };
    bool Parse(std::string* error);
    bool DecodeSample(size_t index);
    // Windows: Media Foundation (the decoder that comes with the system) decodes every H.264 profile, h264bsd only the baseline one
    bool OpenSystem(const std::string& path, std::string* error);
    bool AdvanceSystem(double dt);
    void CloseSystem();
    void* mf_ = nullptr;
    std::vector<uint8_t> pending_;
    double pendingTime_ = 0;
    bool havePending_ = false;
    std::vector<uint8_t> file_;
    std::vector<Sample> samples_;
    std::vector<std::vector<uint8_t>> parameterSets_;     // SPS and PPS from the avcC box
    int nalLength_ = 4;
    int width_ = 0, height_ = 0;
    int codedW_ = 0, codedH_ = 0;             // the decoded picture: whole macroblocks
    double duration_ = 0, clock_ = 0;
    size_t next_ = 0;
    int decoded_ = 0;
    bool finished_ = false, sentParameters_ = false;
    void* decoder_ = nullptr;                // h264bsd's storage_t
    std::vector<uint8_t> rgba_;
};

}  // namespace ab
```

`src/window/exe_replace.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "window/exe_replace.h"

#include <SDL.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

namespace ab {

namespace {

bool ReadAll(const std::string& path, std::vector<unsigned char>& out) {
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "rb");
    if (!f) return false;
    out.clear();
    unsigned char buf[65536];
    size_t n;
    while ((n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f)) > 0) out.insert(out.end(), buf, buf + n);
    std::fclose(f);
    return true;
}

bool WriteAll(const std::string& path, const std::vector<unsigned char>& data) {
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!f) return false;
    bool ok = data.empty() || std::fwrite(data.data(), 1, data.size(), f) == data.size();
    ok = (std::fclose(f) == 0) && ok;
    return ok;
}

// replaces `to` with the file `from`: written beside it first, so a failure leaves `to` as it was
bool ReplaceFile(const std::string& from, const std::string& to) {
    std::vector<unsigned char> data;
    if (!ReadAll(from, data)) return false;
    const std::string tmp = to + ".new";
    if (!WriteAll(tmp, data)) { std::remove(tmp.c_str()); return false; }
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!MoveFileExA(tmp.c_str(), to.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)) { std::remove(tmp.c_str()); return false; }
#else
    chmod(tmp.c_str(), 0755);
    if (std::rename(tmp.c_str(), to.c_str()) != 0) { std::remove(tmp.c_str()); return false; }
#endif
    return true;
}

bool HasExeExtension(const std::string& p) {
    if (p.size() < 5) return false;
    const char* e = p.c_str() + p.size() - 4;
    return (e[0] == '.') && (e[1] | 32) == 'e' && (e[2] | 32) == 'x' && (e[3] | 32) == 'e';
}

bool SameFile(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    char fa[MAX_PATH * 2], fb[MAX_PATH * 2];
    if (!GetFullPathNameA(a.c_str(), sizeof fa, fa, nullptr) || !GetFullPathNameA(b.c_str(), sizeof fb, fb, nullptr)) return false;
    return _stricmp(fa, fb) == 0;
#else
    struct stat sa, sb;
    return stat(a.c_str(), &sa) == 0 && stat(b.c_str(), &sb) == 0 && sa.st_ino == sb.st_ino && sa.st_dev == sb.st_dev;
#endif
}

void Say(bool error, const std::string& text) {
    std::printf("%s\n", text.c_str());
    SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(error ? SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR : SDL_MESSAGEBOX_INFORMATION, "Angry Birds engine", text.c_str(), nullptr);
}

bool Ask(const std::string& text, bool confirm) {
    if (!confirm) return true;
    const SDL_MessageBoxButtonData buttons[] = {{SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_RETURNKEY_DEFAULT, 1, "Yes"}, {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_ESCAPEKEY_DEFAULT, 0, "No"}};
    SDL_MessageBoxData box = {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_WARNING, nullptr, "Angry Birds engine", text.c_str(), 2, buttons, nullptr};
    int pressed = 0;
    if (SDL_ShowMessageBox(&box, &pressed) != 0) return false;      // no way to ask: do nothing
    return pressed == 1;
}

}  // namespace

std::string SelfExePath() {
#ifdef _WIN32
    char buf[MAX_PATH * 2];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, buf, sizeof buf);
    return n > 0 && n < sizeof buf ? std::string(buf, n) : std::string();
#else
    char buf[4096];
    ssize_t n = readlink("/proc/self/exe", buf, sizeof buf - 1);
    return n > 0 ? std::string(buf, (size_t)n) : std::string();
#endif
}

static int Restore(const std::string& target, const std::string& backup, bool confirm) {
    if (!Ask("Put the original back?\n\n" + target + "\n\nThe copy saved before the replacement is " + backup + ".", confirm)) return 1;
    if (!ReplaceFile(backup, target)) {
        Say(true, "Could not write " + target + ". Is the game still running? Close it and try again.");
        return 2;
    }
    std::remove(backup.c_str());
    Say(false, "Done: " + target + " is the original again.");
    return 0;
}

int RestoreExe(const std::string& target, bool confirm) {
    const std::string backup = target + ".original";
    std::vector<unsigned char> probe;
    if (!ReadAll(backup, probe)) { Say(true, "There is no saved original (" + backup + "), nothing to restore."); return 2; }
    return Restore(target, backup, confirm);
}

int ReplaceOrRestoreExe(const std::string& target, bool confirm) {
    const std::string self = SelfExePath();
    if (self.empty()) { Say(true, "Cannot tell where this exe is, so it cannot copy itself."); return 2; }
    std::vector<unsigned char> targetData, selfData;
    if (!HasExeExtension(target)) { Say(true, target + " is not an .exe."); return 2; }
    if (!ReadAll(target, targetData)) { Say(true, "Cannot read " + target + "."); return 2; }
    if (SameFile(target, self)) { Say(true, "That is this program itself. Drag the exe you want to replace onto it, not the engine."); return 1; }
    if (!ReadAll(self, selfData)) { Say(true, "Cannot read this exe (" + self + ")."); return 2; }
    const std::string backup = target + ".original";
    std::vector<unsigned char> backupData;
    const bool isEngine = targetData == selfData || (targetData.size() == selfData.size() && std::memcmp(targetData.data(), selfData.data(), selfData.size()) == 0);
    if (isEngine) {
        if (!ReadAll(backup, backupData)) { Say(false, target + " already is the engine, and no saved original was found next to it, so there is nothing to put back."); return 1; }
        return Restore(target, backup, confirm);    // dropping it a second time undoes the replacement
    }
    if (!Ask("Replace this exe with the engine?\n\n" + target + "\n\nThe original is kept as\n" + backup + "\nand dropping the exe on the engine again puts it back.\n\nThe engine then starts from this exe's folder, the way the original did.", confirm)) return 1;
    if (!WriteAll(backup, targetData)) { Say(true, "Cannot save the original as " + backup + ", so nothing was changed."); return 2; }
    if (!ReplaceFile(self, target)) {
        std::remove(backup.c_str());
        Say(true, "Could not write " + target + ". Is the game still running? Close it and try again. Nothing was changed.");
        return 2;
    }
    Say(false, "Done: " + target + " is now the engine.\nThe original is saved as " + backup + ".\nDrop " + target + " on the engine again to put it back.");
    return 0;
}

}  // namespace ab
```

```h
// v3.3: the engine's exe can take the place of another exe (usually the game's own AngryBirds.exe), and give it back.
#pragma once
#include <string>

namespace ab {

// Replaces `target` (an .exe) with a copy of the running engine exe, after saving the original next to it as "<target>.original". If `target` already is the engine and
// the backup is there, it puts the original back instead (the same call undoes itself). `confirm` false skips the question (--yes). Prints what it did and shows a message box.
// Returns 0 when done, 1 when nothing was changed on purpose (the user said no, nothing to do), 2 on an error.
int ReplaceOrRestoreExe(const std::string& target, bool confirm);

// "--restore-exe <target>": puts the saved original back and refuses to do anything else.
int RestoreExe(const std::string& target, bool confirm);

// The full path of the running exe ("" when it cannot be found).
std::string SelfExePath();

}  // namespace ab
```
